Vracím se domů z náročného a úmorně dlouhého porodu (trval DNY!). Sestra mě překvapuje čistým povlečením. Jak se plazí doprostřed, aby upevnila poslední roh… šev… se TRHÁ! Sestra se propadá. Můj devatenáctiměsíční synovec letí vzduchem. Doslova jsem se rozplakal/a, když jsem ho chytal/a. Ta naprosto směšná záplata (všimněte si toho čtverce) sice drží, ale jakmile začneme uvažovat o opětovném nafouknutí, uletí. Dnes večer v 19:30 jsem k smrti unavený/á. Takže na pomoc přichází vteřinové lepidlo a lepicí páska. Po 30 minutách je nafouknuto a drží. Nemám jinou možnost, takže se budu modlit, abych na ní mohl/a spát a odpočinout si. A pak budu muset vymyslet, co sakra dělat dál. Nevím, jak ostatní… ale já opravdu nemám nazbyt hromadu peněz, které jen tak čekají, až si narychlo koupím postel. Jsem nesmírně zklamaný/á.

source_doc: Handiest thing you never knew you needed! Absolutely loved these clips! I bought them originally because those hanging toys made for the car seats always slipped everywhere on the baby’s car seat handle. Drove me nuts! I looked for these and they did not disappoint! I use them for everything! I probably could have gotten a smaller pack but it’s fine because I keep a set in everything: car, stroller, car seat, house….. my favorite thing to use this for is as a shade for my baby while he’s in the stroller. His car seat clicks onto the stroller but the shade doesn’t help much most of the time. I would try and maneuver my head to block the sun but now I can just clip his Muslim blanket on the car seats handle and clip the other on the stroller handle and there you have it a shade that’s breathable and I’m the exactly place you need it. Can hand it off the side. Helps keep the blanket hooked over the car seat if it’s windy/dusty and it won’t move. Holds toys in place that can hang. I love these so many possibilities and I highly recommend to any parent! I can even use them for myself to block the sun in the car. I’ve used them before to clip a Muslim blanket to my shirt so I can nurse when I’ve forgotten my cover. So many things! They are durable and I have yet to break any.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Nejužitečnější věc, o které jste ani nevěděl/a, že ji potřebujete! Tyto spony jsem si naprosto zamiloval/a! Původně jsem je koupil/a, protože ty závěsné hračky určené na autosedačky neustále klouzaly po celém madlu dětské autosedačky. Přivádělo mě to k šílenství! Hledal/a jsem něco takového a tyto spony mě nezklamaly! Používám je na všechno! Pravděpodobně by mi stačilo i menší balení, ale to nevadí, protože mám teď jednu sadu všude: v autě, v kočárku, u autosedačky, doma... nejraději je používám jako stínítko pro syna, když je v kočárku. Jeho autosedačka se dá nacvaknout na kočárek, ale její stříška většinou moc nepomáhá. Dříve jsem se snažil/a natáčet hlavu, abych blokoval/a slunce, ale teď stačí jednoduše připnout jeho mušelínovou deku k madlu autosedačky a druhý konec k madlu kočárku a voňavá clona, která je prodyšná a přesně tam, kde ji potřebujete, je na světě. Může viset i ze strany. Pomáhá udržet deku přetaženou přes autosedačku, i když je větrno nebo prašno, a ani se nepohne. Drží na místě hračky, které se dají pověsit. Miluji je, nabízí tolik možností a vřele je doporučuji každému rodiči! Můžu je použít i pro sebe k zastínění slunce v autě. Už jsem je použil/a i k připnutí mušelínové deky k tričku, abych mohl/a kojit, když jsem si zapomněl/a svůj kojicí šátek. Tolik využití! Jsou odolné a zatím se mi nepodařilo žádnou rozbít.

source_doc: This is my new litter choice. I don’t notice the smell as much as other reviewers.  I have 10 cats so I clean the boxes everyday.  I love that it is lightweight.  I do not notice any litter on the floor anymore.  When I scoop it stays in the shape it was in the box it does not break apart.  I doubt I will ever change to another litter as long as they keep this formula.  I did mix it at first so I wouldn’t have any problems with the cats rejecting it but now I use just this litter.  100% satisfied

source_doc: Initial thoughts are good. I went from a hard folding cover to this one due to the weight of taking the cover on and off. I just always kept the hard cover on but I bought an ATV that will be riding in the bed of the truck. I like having something over the bed when driving around. I've never had a soft cover before, but that was the only option to get away from the weight. I went with this one as I needed the bed rails free for a removable rack I use with the tonneau. This one sits nice and flush. The only reason I took a star is the cover is completely flat, it has some ripples in it that run the length of the bed. I'm thinking this will probably settle, but for now I'm taking a star. The only other slight issue is the front clips are harder to snap in place than I expected. Again, I think this will probably resolve once it's been installed a while.Update: Had to return it. Maybe it's the tailgate mat I have installed or the way it fits on the rails, but the tailgate hits on the rail and makes it really hard to close. I have the rail all the way forward and it's still hitting on the drivers side. I can close it, but it's much harder.

source_doc: Awesome!!! This pole is awesome I've never fly fished before because it seemed to be expensive and took some practice/skill to do butt this pole is super simple. I watched a bunch of videos then took a practice fly out in the yard setup a coffee can and started to practice before I new it i was able to pop that fly into the can with easy its all on the wrist. I like that the pole is all self contained i did get a line holder that attaches to the rod just above your hand so when collapsed you can just wind the line around it slip it in the tube and be on your way. I dont know that Ill every want to buy a fly rod I have several lengths and weights of tippet lines and most of the small streams and brooks I fish are tight quarters so your not able to cast a country mile anyway. I suppose on the bigger lakes you would want a fly rod too but the portability of this rod is awesome I would recommend trying one out especial if you already have the fly gear its quick to setup and be on the edge of in the water with 13 ft and a 12-16 ft  tippet you can get a decent amount of distance and accuracy. I think its a great setup for beginners or pro's its just another style of fishing.

source_doc: Works great for me! As I have gotten older and I suppose less active, I seem to have more trouble going and staying asleep. I did not want to take a prescription sleep aid, so I tried the Sleep Foundation formula with melatonin. supplement, and I am glad that I did. I have tried other melatonin supplements but really did not have good results. This product not only helped me get to sleep faster, but I stayed asleep most of the night with the exception of having to get up to go to the bathroom as usual. I did not feel groggy in the morning and according to my sleep tracker, I was sleeping better. I believe that the price is a little high as similar products sell for quite a bit less, but if it keeps working for me it is worth it.

I am still very happy with the product. Like I said, great price and does exactly what I need it to.

source_doc: Might work for others, but not for me. I am an older lady.  I have a small, older car.  It will probably be the last car I own, too.  So I wanted to try to protect the seats.  The problem is, I didn't think about how I get into my car.  Because it is a small car and I am older, I open the driver's door, turn away from the driver's seat and then lower myself onto the seat.  THEN I both turn and pull my legs into the car.  Because of how I pivot by turning and pulling my legs in, these lay-on-top covers just get all twisted beneath me!  You really think I want to try to lean up in the seat and fiddle with this tangled/twisted seat cover beneath me???  SMH...for this price these should be way better than they are.

source_doc: For Curly Hair. My experience…it’s okay but results are not instant. I like the scent. source_doc: Not A Bad Alternative For Cat Litter. I wasn't so sure about this litter but I was surprised that it was not so bad. I have 3 cats and 2 litter boxes so the main issue I have with cat litter is the strong smell that the boxes leave around the house. I've tried all kinds of litter and while they do work it doesn't get rid of the smell entirely. I started using this mixed litter and it works really well. I know the litter is flushable but I feel better just throwing it away when I clean the boxes. The cats took a bit to get used to the mixed litter but I was surprised that it did handle the odor really well. I would have to get more bags to handle my 3 cats but I would use this Mixed Litter again because it did get rid of the odor and easy upkeep.

source_doc: Expensive. After watching a few videos I purchased this lacquer to refinish an old Gibson guitar.  I applied gloss black lacquer over automotive primer.  I bought two cans @ $35 for each can.  I followed the instructions and warmed the cans before use. The first can applied fairly evenly but the second can I had all kinds of problems with splatter.  I had to sand out some big globs of paint and put on another coat.  I tried shaking the can, heating warmer and lower but the splatter would not stop.  I had to spray for a couple of seconds then clean the nozzle with a rag to stop the splatter. The other problem was orange peel.  I have used other brands for 1/3 the price and gotten better results.  If I had to do this over again, I would use a less expensive lacquer.

source_doc: Perfect for what we wanted!! So we wanted to put these lights all around our room.  I took measurements and decided I needed to buy 75’ roll.  However what i didn’t expect at all was the strip has markings about every foot where you can cut it shorter!  This made all the difference for me.  I needed more than 50’ but less than 100’ and I was able to cut over 10’ off so there wasn’t a lot of extra where I came down to receptacle!  So after reading other reviews I used a cleaner and sprayed and wiped the entire area I was sticking it too!  Then I waited until it’s completely dry and installation was so easy!  And they are amazing!  I prefer using the app on my iPhone!  And connecting it to my phone was so simple.  They provide a QR code so setup was a Breeze!  I would highly recommend these lights!  And they are nice and bright

source_doc: Such a cute keepsake. I was hesitant to get this because I have never saved any of my kids teeth before… something about teeth just laying around grossed me out.. but I must say this is so adorable and I definitely will be keeping her teeth and putting them into the holders. I have a half in my 3 year old room and I already put this together so she think it’s just a cute decoration, so I will be able to add the teeth and I don’t think she will even notice. I really think this is such a cute idea and wish I would have done this with my other kids. It takes a weird keepsake like teeth and turns it into something quite adorable! It even has sticker if you want to put what tooth it is on the little plastic holder. I don’t think I will do that but I’m definitely going to put her little teeth in there!

source_doc: I love these. These are perfect for me. I have a small coffee machine and my current coffee mugs, ( aka: run out the door making coffee in the last minute) are too large for the machine. I also needed some smaller ones so I didn’t have to drink so much more liquid when I work at a manufacturing place and don’t want to have to go to the bathroom so soon after I get to work… anyways, I like the colors and the simple lid. They seal very tightly and the coffee comes out nicely. I have had ones with the small holes be very difficult to get the coffee to come out.The only problem is the lids are a bit difficult to turn when putting them on or taking them off. I put the “over” the lid, lid up and use it to help turn the whole lid. I still want to buy more of them. I even use them at home just so I don’t spill.

And...It worked!

source_doc: I can never go back. I was very skeptical about this car seat. I held off on using to start with but then I had no other option as my son and I were in an accident that rendered his current car seat unusable. Thank goodness I just this one ready to go. The user manual explained well how to install and adjust for your kiddo. I was able to install quickly and easily, I love the lock bar in the base to ensure a tight fit! The straps are easy to adjust. And I love that I don’t have to reach around and maneuver to get my kid in his seat, especially now that he’s in the wrestle phase of getting in the car. I don’t think I’ll ever be able to use a “normal” car seat after the ease of this 360 seat. It’s also very plush and comfy and has all the safety of other evenflo seats!

source_doc: Not enough fragrance. I really wanted to like this product. When it came out of the package, the scent packets smelled amazing. I put it in its holder and stuck it to the side of my trash can, which has its own tall cabinetry drawer. I expected to come back and smell lemons the next time I opened the trash drawer. I just smelled trash. I took the trash out and put a new trash bag in and shut the door. When I came back, I still could not smell lemons. I finally leaned over towards the scent packet and had to practically press my nose against the plastic holder to smell the lemons. I revisited the trash several times over two days and it never improved. I won’t be ordering this product again. The convenience of the holder and the great scent doesn’t make a difference if you can only smell it when it is in your face.

source_doc: Do not overtighten the bolts. I bought this about a year and a half ago based on the features and reviews.  I don't run a windshield on my cruiser, so my phone gets hit with direct wind when I ride.  I have gone 75+ mph with no trouble at all and no concern that my phone would come loose.  I do occasionally have to re-tighten the knob, which shouldn't happen but isn't a big deal.I only rated it 4 stars (debated about 3) because I had to remove it today and the aluminum mount snapped in half next to one of the bolts when I was attempting to reinstall it.  I didn't think I had cranked on it too hard, but maybe I have some of the blame.  I'm just glad it didn't break while I was riding.  I just bought another one, so that should say something about the quality.  I will be more careful not to overtighten the bolts when I install the new one and see what happens.

source_doc: Replacement to another Inspire. I had/have an inspire that is just fine except that where the band clips in, it broke and there is nothing to attach the band to. It is no longer under warranty. I really did not want to buy another one, but I couldn't come up with any way to fix it.  I did buy the little attachment so you can put it on your belt, but I use this as an alarm to remind me to take a med that has to be taken very early in the morning.  I was not going to wear the thing on my PJs because first of all I would probably lose it in the bed.  I tried another inexpensive smart watch, but the step count was really bad, and the silent alarm was one very short vibration and that was all.  So, I broke down and bought another Inspire.  I really hope this one doesn't break.  Other than that, I love this thing.  It isn't huge like most of them, and it works for what I need, counting steps and as a silent alarm.

source_doc: Using as an Ice Bin. I am writing this review and including pictures for those, like myself, who wants to use this as an ice bin.  I don't have a refrigerator with an built in ice maker and so I needed something to store a bag of ice.  I had originally purchased the 21 cup LocknLock but when it arrived, it didn't look big enough to hold a big bag of ice; so I sent that one back and ordered this 50.7 cup LocknLock bin.  It is large and takes up almost half to the upper freezer shelf but as I have a separate stand alone freezer, this isn't a problem.  What I like about it is that this bin have a large front door that I can scoop ice out of.  The lid snaps easily in place and the base seems pretty solid so I don't expect any leakage.  No cons so far but will update if I experience any.  The pictures shown are what was left of the bag of ice I'd purchase, so about a quarter of the bag.  I think another bag of ice will fill this bin completely full.

source_doc: The plastic adheres when soaked. I bought these as liners for my reusable belly bands. First of all, I realize they do give measurements but you definitely need to go larger than a belly band sizing to get them to fit, so I should've gotten bigger ones. I think the length is inadequate to the width for the absorbance to wick away if you have an excessive urinator, which I do. But the worst part is when they're fully soaked, which happens quickly with my foster cairn that had bladder stones previously, then the plastic backing will sort of permanently stick to your fabric belly band. I had to soak in very hot water and pick away at it to get it all off. This had happened several times, so I won't be rebuying. I honestly should return them it's so bad. I much rather keep with the disposable Amazon brand wraps. My dog chews on those so I have to cover with a fabric one to keep him from eating them and as backup if they become soaked. I'm honestly surprised at the rating level on these, because that's why I tried them. It should be lower.

source_doc: I finally found the perfect one! Here is my story. I've been looking for a heating blanket, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a go.  I am very happy I did!! Only setting number three on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if I go above seven. Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

source_doc: Ordered 2 new monitors. One was already opened. When I opened the first shipping box, I saw that the product box inside was not sealed. The tape appeared to have been cut or torn. I thought maybe i had cut it when opening the outer box, or maybe the tape had split. It wasn't until I started opening the second monitor's box that I realized the first one was used. The second one had a padded bag around the speaker. The first did not. The second one had the volume knob turned all the way down. The first one had it turned all the way up.I would have rated these 5 stars, easily. They sound great. But sending used products to people paying new prices is unacceptable. I don't know how much it has been used. I don't know if it was abused. I don't know if someone else registered the serial number, which could cause me issues if I have a warranty issue down the line. I would not have ordered these if I knew I would be getting a used one. So I'm knocking it down to 3 stars.

source_doc: 5 stars isn’t enough! I have a 1968 Yamaha F230 12 string that I bought brand new and the strings have over time raised up off the neck and made it very difficult to play. Now I plan to take it to a luthier to get it worked on but in the mean time wanted to pick up something cheap. So I took a chance on this Tario. I figured if this was junk it would make a beautiful wall hanger, and it is beautiful. The strings that came with it were junk so I put a set of Elixirs on it. This guitar has exceeded my expectations 10 fold. It plays beautifully and sounds fantastic. I had a buddy play it who owns a Goodall and he looked at me with a smile and said this thing is great. If I could have given it ten stars I would have. I try to stay away from buying things made in china but I have to admit this thing is worth ten times what I paid for it. I then bought a Gator hard shell case for it.

Nyní ji plánuji dát kytaráři na seřízení, ale mezitím jsem si chtěl/a pořídit něco levného. A tak jsem to risknul/a s touto značkou Tario. Říkal/a jsem si, že i kdyby to byl šmejd, bude to aspoň krásná dekorace na zeď – a krásná opravdu je. Struny, které s ní přišly, nestály za nic, tak jsem na ni natáhl/a sadu Elixirů. Tato kytara desetinásobně předčila má očekávání. Hraje se na ni nádherně a zní fantasticky. Nechal/a jsem na ni zahrát kamaráda, který vlastní kytaru Goodall, a on se na mě usmál a řekl, že tenhle kousek je skvělý. Kdybych mohl/a dát deset hvězdiček, dal/a bych je. source_doc: All I can say is "WOW"!!! I was skeptical of this type of product and its claims of moving dust/dirt out of my car's interior versus a standard blowgun. I always thought it was the same PSI getting to the gun, how can it possibly be better? I finally broke down and bought this version as it was cheaper than the recommended one I see in all the car detailing groups. I hooked it up the day I got it and did a side-by-side comparison with my metal blowgun. My standard blowgun blew up a little dust on the floorboard of my wife's Jeep for the first test, and then after I attached the Vortex and went to it, it was literally a dust storm. I had to move away from the vehicle to get fresh air. I am literally blown away by this product and time will tell for the longevity of the product.I highly recommend this to anyone looking to up their car interior cleaning game. I will be bragging about this to my friends & family, it truly is a great product, and I would buy it again if ever needed.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Jediné, co můžu říct, je „PÁNI“!!! Byl/a jsem skeptický/á k tomuto typu produktu a k jeho tvrzením, že dokáže z interiéru mého auta odstranit prach a nečistoty lépe než standardní ofukovací pistole. Vždycky jsem si myslel/a, že do pistole jde stejný tlak (PSI), tak jak by to vůbec mohlo být lepší? Nakonec jsem se nechal/a zlomit a koupil/a si tuto verzi, protože byla levnější než ta doporučovaná, kterou vídám ve všech skupinách o detailingu aut. Zapojil/a jsem ji hned v den, kdy mi přišla, a provedl/a přímé srovnání se svou kovovou ofukovací pistolí. Moje standardní ofukovací pistole při prvním testu vyfoukala z podlahy džípu mé manželky jen trochu prachu, ale když jsem pak připojil/a Vortex a pustil/a se do toho, byla to doslova prachová bouře. Musel/a jsem od auta odejít, abych se nadýchal/a čerstvého vzduchu. Jsem z tohoto produktu doslova nadšený/á a čas ukáže, jaká bude jeho životnost. Vřele ho doporučuji každému, kdo chce pozvednout čištění interiéru svého auta na vyšší úroveň. Budu se s tím chlubit svým přátelům a rodině, je to opravdu skvělý produkt a v případě potřeby bych si ho koupil/a znovu.

source_doc: A Practice Tool. I bought this transmitter specifically for practice.  I don't think I'd ever use a low-end wireless for a live performance.  There are too many cross signals that will cause signal drop.  I was surprised when I got some drop in my practice room.  To be fair, not long after it dropped a few times, the battery died about 10 minutes later. So that was probably the cause so kudos because it didn't drop more frequently.  The volume control is not linear, at least by my experience.  It went from to quite to booming with just a few touches.  I had to play with it a bit to get the level where I wanted it.  I also noticed the wireless is tonally different than the cord.  Actually, I like the sound a bit better.  I didn't notice that difference with my other wireless system.  I have only used this device in my practice room so, I don't know how it will react if practicing with a group, especially if there are other wireless devices in the room.  When I know, I'll update this review.

source_doc: Mixed feelings. The 2 star is for THIS mat I bought. I must admit, it's taken me 5 years to write this review.  But I just used my OLD Jade mat and thought I should write this review.  I have mixed feeling because I bought a Jade mat at my yoga studio and have used it for many years. Great mat! I love it.  It was getting kind of dingy, so I thought I would use that one at home and buy another one for the studio.  So I bought this orange one. After about 2-3 months of uses, and past the return, it started to deteriorate.  I'd find orange specks all over my pants, as it was visibly breaking down. Life was busy so I just shoved the new crappy one in a closet and went back to using my old mat, which is over 10 years old and holding up.  I can't get it sparkling clean looking, but at least it's not falling apart.  I'm still disappointed that I wasted $80. Why was one mat great and durable and the other one crappy?

source_doc: Works great for pets. I am using this item to secure my dog's car seat/booster seat. The lap belt of my rear seat hooks into her car seat. I liked that I could actually lock the belt nice and tight so in case of an accident, her seat would be as immobile as possible. This way, in an accident, I know the lap belt is locked, and I don't have to depend on seat belt locking itself.l Also, the lock mechanism for the belt release button is also handy in case I am in the back seat, wrangling groceries and packages, and accidentally hit the belt release buttons. This is a great invention, and I wish I would have found it when caring for my grandfather who had dementia. I can't tell you how many times I would slow down the car to park, and he would be releasing his seat belt and trying to get out of a still moving car. I did have a little trouble getting the belt locking clip on my seatbelt. (I have a 2018 or 2019 Buick Encore). I took a little trial and error, but after about 5 minutes, I locked it where I wanted it.

hypo_0: Skvěle funguje pro domácí mazlíčky. Tento produkt používám k zajištění autosedačky/podsedáku pro svého psa. Dvoubodový bezpečnostní pás na mém zadním sedadle se uchycuje do její autosedačky. Líbilo se mi, že jsem mohl/a pás opravdu pevně a těsně uzamknout, takže v případě nehody by její sedačka byla co nejstabilnější. Tímto způsobem mám při nehodě jistotu, že je dvoubodový pás uzamčený, a nemusím se spoléhat na to, že se bezpečnostní pás uzamkne sám. Také uzamykací mechanismus pro tlačítko uvolnění pásu je praktický pro případ, že jsem na zadním sedadle, zápasím s nákupem a balíky a nechtěně stisknu tlačítko pro uvolnění pásu. Je to skvělý vynález a kéž bych ho našel/našla, když jsem pečoval/a o svého dědečka, který měl demenci. Ani vám nedokážu říct, kolikrát jsem zpomalil/a auto, abych zaparkoval/a, a on si odepínal bezpečnostní pás a pokoušel se vystoupit z ještě jedoucího auta. Měl/a jsem trochu potíže s nasazením uzamykací spony na svůj bezpečnostní pás (mám Buick Encore z roku 2018 nebo 2019). Vyžadovalo to trochu pokusů a omylů, ale asi po 5 minutách jsem ho zajistil/a tam, kde jsem chtěl/a.

source_doc: Love it! I honestly don’t know why I haven’t tried a silicone insert for my air fryer sooner! Washing the air fryer basket is a nightmare and I can never seem to get it a clean as I would like. If I had been using one of these wonderful inventions a long time ago, I would not have had this problem. I absolutely love this set! They fit my Ninja air fryer basket perfectly and clean so easily. Removing the silicone insert from my air fryer is easy as I just take a pair of tongs and pull it right out. Since these are collapsible, storing them is a breeze when not in use. I can hand wash these or run them through the dishwasher. I haven't used them other than in the air fryer, but I can certainly see many other uses as they can withstand heat up to 450°. The only time I probably would not use these is the air fryer is if I am cooking bacon since I want the bacon to drain and not sit in its grease unless it's just one or two slices. These will certainly last a very long time and I don’t see that I will ever need to replace them. Since they come as a set of two, I will always have one handy!  Great quality!

hypo_0: Naprosto to miluji! Upřímně nechápu, proč jsem silikonovou vložku do své horkovzdušné fritézy nevyzkoušel/a už dříve! Mytí koše fritézy je noční můra a nikdy se mi nedaří ho vyčistit tak, jak bych si představoval/a. Kdybych jeden z těchto skvělých vynálezů používal/a už dávno, tento problém bych neměl/a. Tuto sadu naprosto zbožňuji! Do koše mé fritézy značky Ninja pasují naprosto dokonale a čistí se tak snadno. Vyjmout silikonovou vložku z fritézy je hračka, stačí vzít kleště a prostě ji vytáhnout ven. Vzhledem k tomu, že jsou skládací, je jejich skladování v době, kdy se nepoužívají, naprostá pohoda. Mohu je mýt v ruce nebo je dát do myčky nádobí. Zatím jsem je nepoužil/a jinde než v horkovzdušné fritéze, ale rozhodně pro ně vidím mnoho dalších využití, protože odolají teplotám až do 450 °F (230 °C). Jediný případ, kdy bych je ve fritéze pravděpodobně nepoužil/a, je příprava slaniny, protože chci, aby ze slaniny odtekal tuk a neležela v něm, ledaže by šlo jen o jeden nebo dva plátky. Tyto vložky rozhodně vydrží velmi dlouho a nemyslím si, že je budu někdy muset vyměnit. Vzhledem k tomu, že se dodávají v sadě po dvou, budu mít vždy jednu po ruce! Skvělá kvalita!

source_doc: Slight Odor in the Bags. I am not as impressed with this PAMI brand of gallon storage bags as I was with their quart-sized double lock bags.  There are 100 bags but NO twist ties were included with my order even though it states it on the box.  I have a ton of extra twist ties, so I moved on.  The bag is wider and shorter than my store bought ones.  So, it probably is still gallon sized.  I do like that the top is slightly uneven for easy opening.  I also like that there’s multiple suffocation warning prints on the front.Why did I give it 3 stars?  When I opened one to place prepared vegetables, I noticed a slight odor.  It’s not unpleasant or plasticky.  My store bought ones don’t have an odor.  Even though the bags are BPA-free, I decided to use it for storing non-food items, just to be safe.  For storing craft items, they are quite useful.  Each bag is about 8 cents, so twice as much as generic store-bought ones.  I would give it a resounding five stars, if it weren’t for the odor.

source_doc: It will jam up, and break. So. I bought this specifically for the claimed 5 ton power. I wanted the overkill.  My 4500 lb sub got a we stuck in some wet mud. It's awd so it's horrible in that environment. After the heavy rain. The ground got really soft and I sunk while driving on my grass. I thought, ok I'll get this to save hundreds for a tow... Fast forward. I hooked it up  so I read the terrible instructions since it's a double hook. Watched some YouTube videos. Got it going.. Click click. After a couple feet. It made a weird sound and kicked back a few inches. I inspected everything... Couldn't see anything crazy, but now it's really hard to crank, and stuff in both directions.... I thought. Ok maybe it's just the tension...? But no I still had a good length to go before I had to release and start over. And as I was cranking the lever, snap!!* The cable broke and the comealong hit my leg.So. Long story short, DON'T BUY THIS POS ..

source_doc: Pretty Good. I haven’t been in a sleeping bag in a long time.  So I got this and tried it in the back yard.  Well, I picked a cold night with wind, below 30 on the mercury, and it did good.I had no tent which might have been ok if I had no wind.  It was cold.  But I did sleep, about as good as I could expect for the conditions.  I used my field coat to cover my face but the wind woke me up many times.I’m a little over 6 foot and medium build, I fit in the bag.  I feel like my head could have a little more room but it wasn’t a problem.Most importantly for me was having a very thin foam filled self inflating mattress.  it kept me off the cold ground.  And it was much better than being directly on the lumpy ground.  Again, a tent would helped a lot with the wind.Not that I needed it, but the bag has snaps that let it shut without being closed, or maybe there’s another purpose.  The zipper worked great.  The sleeping bag rolls back up easily to fit the carrying bag.I think with a blanket and a tent I would do just fine camping for a weekend.  Hope this helps you.

source_doc: Best hair product I’ve used to date. I’m 39 So this picture shows only a few of the hair products I’ve tried over the years. Anything from slick back, to spiked etc.. I like something that I can manipulate a bunch of different ways. It took me a little to figure out the best way to use it but it’s by far my favorite now. I’ve switched back through all my products thinking I can go through them so I don’t waste, but I like Reuzel so much that it drives me nuts and I go back. It keeps my hair in place, it doesn’t feel too greasy or anything bad.  When I’m washing it out it doesn’t feel like it gets stuck in my hair or burn my eyes😆. To style my spiked hair, I have it damp to start(I’ll usually rinse my hair in the morning real quick in the sink because I’m a night showerer), then with my handle slightly wet I use about a pea size or smaller and add to my hair and style. I’ll do another run if I feel like I need it, or to get me fohawk a little more hawk lol. This is one of those I wish I had the last twenty years
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

Mám rád/a něco, co mohu upravovat na spoustu různých způsobů. Chvíli mi trvalo, než jsem přišel/přišla na to, jak ho nejlépe používat, ale teď je to zdaleka můj nejoblíbenější produkt. source_doc: Not bright, what timer function? I was excited about this great deal; batteries with the lights were enticing. I thought how easy it was all together.  I got the lights and put them together, put them up, and then got the remote to set the lights. The first night they were great, shining bright in the windows. The second night I noticed they were not all turned on, so I reset them and paid extra attention to the settings, so I wasn't making a mistake. I saw the next night that the lights were again not turning on together. I had to manually turn them on so many times, which was a nuisance. I don't know if the remote was not working correctly or if there is just something wrong with the lights, but they were so difficult to use. The lights were supposed to be on every night for 8hr max. (according to the remote setting) but they seemed like they would turn off after 2 to 4 hours, no matter how I adjusted them and redid the remote. The most upsetting part was that the batteries they came with didn't even last until Christmas. By Christmas day, more than half of the 12 lights I had in my windows were completely dead. I don't recommend these lights; very disappointed.

source_doc: Surprisingly comfy for a good night's sleep! This turned out to be a life saver on a recent camping trip. I was planning on tent camping but during the night the weather turned and I was pummeled by rain & hail. My tent is great in the rain, but I was set up in a low area and the space under the tent quickly turned into a lake and my tent turned into a giant waterbed. Since I had this in the car, I decided to inflate it and see how it worked. It was pretty easy to set up/inflate quickly and it was SO comfortable! I was honestly surprised at how comfortable it was. I'm 5'0 and had to sleep a little curled up, so if you're taller, consider how you like to sleep.The only downside is in my Mazda 3 I had to move the front seats all the way up to fit it, so I can't drive around with it installed. I could probably pull the pieces out of the footwells and angle the mattress a bit to push the seats back to drive, but haven't tried it yet. I do love the versatility this provides! Now I have another option for camping when I don't want to go through the hassle of setting up a tent for just one night.

source_doc: Nice low glow color ring. I wanted an adjustable light in my bedroom but I didn't have a ceiling mount (where I wanted to put it) in place with the wires to the breaker box. Since the lamp itself was very lightweight, I wired with old lamp parts that plugged into a wall socket. It worked out perfectly for me. I like that I can turn off the main light with the color ring on for the late nights and serves as a nicely dimmed nightlight. There are several light settings to choose from to please any mood or brightness needed. The main light is impressively bright and can be toned down to my preference at that moment. When I turn everything off and turn it on the next day, it remembers my last settings of both lights. To me at first, the remote was a little complicated to figure out and remember each buttons capabilities. Even after a week I was fiddling around with the remote to change the settings where I wanted. Now that I got the hang of it, I love this light and happy that I decided to order this one out of several different choices I was considering. This lamp has many setting option and I would recommend it for any room.

source_doc: Not anti-kink hose. I've had this hose for over 4 years now and have used it many times in the travel trailer.  I also have the 10' version to use when the trailer is much closer to the water outlet at campgrounds.  I wish I could use the 10 footer all the time, but many times I need to get the 25' hose out, which drives me nuts.  It's a real pain to put back in the storage bin if it's slightly cold out as it won't coil up neatly and I have to fling it all around to get it to curve correctly so it goes in the bin.  It has several kinks in it that won't go away.  So, yeah, not anti-kink in my opinion and it's been that way ever since I got it.  (Didn't realize I hadn't reviewed it until I was searching my orders for another hose I purchased a few years ago.)  I'm about ready to toss it as I just ordered another 10 footer and will connect the two together when I need to.  The good thing about the hose - knock wood, it's never leaked or split in the years of periodic usage.  But, yeah, anti-kink is a lie.  Can't really address the hooking issue as I have it hooked to a Hose-Grip from J Wright Concepts, which is wonderful and a device every camper needs!

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Není to hadice odolná proti kroucení. Tuto hadici mám už více než 4 roky a mnohokrát jsem ji použil/a v obytném přívěsu. Mám také třímetrovou verzi pro případy, kdy je přívěs v kempech mnohem blíže k přívodu vody. Kéž bych mohl/a tu třímetrovou používat pořád, ale často musím vytáhnout tu osmimetrovou, což mě přivádí k šílenství. Je to opravdové utrpení uklidit ji zpět do úložného boxu, pokud je venku trochu chladno, protože se nedá úhledně svinout a musím s ní všemožně házet, aby se správně ohnula a vešla se do boxu. Má v sobě několik zlomů, které už nejdou odstranit. Takže ano, podle mého názoru není odolná proti kroucení a je taková od té doby, co jsem ji pořídil/a. (Nedošlo mi, že jsem na ni nenapsal/a recenzi, dokud jsem neprohledával/a své objednávky kvůli jiné hadici, kterou jsem koupil/a před několika lety.) Už se pomalu chystám ji vyhodit, protože jsem si právě objednal/a další třímetrovou a v případě potřeby je spojím dohromady. Dobrá věc na této hadici je – klepu na dřevo –, že za ty roky občasného používání nikdy netekla ani nepraskla. Ale ano, odolnost proti kroucení je lež. Otázku připojování nemohu úplně posoudit, protože ji mám připojenou k držáku Hose-Grip od J Wright Concepts, což je skvělá věc a pomůcka, kterou potřebuje každý kempař!

source_doc: Nice kit with plenty of extensions. I used this to pull the center drive shaft bearing on my BMW. I found it really easy to setup and get everything in place. I had to use a pair of extenders to reach down the shaft a ways, but even with them combined I found that the tool worked perfectly.All of the pieces are well made and precisely cast. There is a pretty sharp edge to the bearing separator that is great for some applications. This tool is made of cast metal, but it's stronger than I expected.The case is great also at keeping things organized.This is my first tool from Orion Motor Tech, but I'm happy enough that I'll look for their brand next time.Update 02/20/23...I have now used this to remove 5 different bushing or bearing sets and I'm Really Really happy with it. The last bushing I removed was the lower control arm bushing and I used a low torque impact wrench to turn the shaft instead of my fixed ratchet. No matter what I throw at this tool it remains looking and working like brand new. If I lose this one day I would buy it again. Of course I can't imagine it breaking at this point, but I would buy it again in that case as well.

source_doc: great stabilizers and super pretty!!! OMG! I LOVE these rings! I purchased a set of 6"-12" crystal bowls from Amazon. I really enjoy them, as does my kitty Olivia who regularly totally blisses out listening to them! (The root chakra bowl is her favorite, in case your interested!) The only problem was that the tiniest bowl, the crown chakra bowl, was seriously unstable. I found it super difficult and frustrating to play. The problem may well have been that I have the bowls on carpet. I don't know, although I did try setting it on a stone coaster. (Desperate, I know!)  But it got frustrating enough that I eventually replaced it with an 8" bowl. I needn't have bothered! The new ring perfectly, absolutely, 100% stablizes the bowl, perhaps because it raises it above the caarpet. I don't know! I DO know that these rings are much thicker and actually  hug the bowl. Also, unlike the rubber rings which seem to come in only 2 sizes,  these are individually sized to fit each bowl. The bowls aslo seem to sound better. The carpet issue again?? They are also color coordinated to each bowl and are readily visible, so they are super pretty, I mean, really pretty! I am thrilled with this purchase.

hypo_0: skvělé stabilizátory a super krásné!!! Ó můj bože! Tyto kroužky si naprosto marnotratně UŽÍVÁM! Na Amazonu jsem si koupil/a sadu křišťálových mís o velikosti 6"–12". Opravdu mě baví, stejně jako moji kočičku Olivii, která při jejich poslechu pravidelně zažívá naprostou blaženost! (Mísa pro kořenovou čakru je její nejoblíbenější, kdyby vás to zajímalo!) source_doc: Native DualSense touchpad on PS4 with new firmware. I love my DualSense controller, it's amazing, and I don't own a PS5 primarily being a PC gamer.  Recently dusted off my old PS4 to discover that I was running firmware 8.5, and thus could jailbreak it on 9.00, breathing life back into the old device.  The DS4 controller is good, but it's no DualSense, so I set out looking for a way to usef the DualSense on PS4.  I had previously purchased a Magic-NS a couple years ago to use it with a Switch, so I looked into Mayflash devices again.Enter the Magic-S.  All around it was exactly what I was searching for.  I could pair the controller to the device and then move it between the various platforms I game on without having to repair it.  Only setback was touchpad wasn't fully functional.  However I contacted the developers, discovered there is a way to do gestures on it, but it was clunky.  Well new firmware came out a day or two ago and now there is native touchpad with DualSense on PS4!  Freaking amazing!Highly reccomened if you are looking to use your PS5 controller on a PS4 or other devices.  And superb communications when I bumped into pebkac issues.  Thanks!

source_doc: NOT ACCURATE! As usual, you get what you pay for. After wearing the watch for a few weeks, I can say that I am totally disappointed. It DOES keep good record of temperature, time,  blood pressure and oxygen levels, but TOTALLY FAILS in calorie count and steps. I am extremely active and I am AMAZED at the calories burned and steps taken. I jog at least 2 miles a day and I am up and down stairs all day long I have always had at least 10,000 to 12,000 steps a day. This watch has measured 4,000 on the best day and shows my calorie count as no more than 395 in a day. If that was all I actually burned every day, I would weigh about 1,000 pounds by now.  The calorie count and steps are really the most important things to me, so the watch is really useless. I am wearing the watch right now and have been running around the house since 5 AM. It shows only 105 steps and 3 calories burned. Uggg 3/10/2023 I am updating my review. I stand by my original statements, but I have to report that the seller has been harassing me every day asking to compensate me in exchange for removing my review.  Apparently Amazon has not been able to make them stop, as it is still happening. It is getting creepy

source_doc: Beautiful drawer handles! I was upset when I opened these because I had ordered the rose gold, and I was only going to give three stars for receiving the wrong color. However, after looking at these more closely and holding them up to my cabinets, I actually think I like these better. Not only are they gorgeous, they match all of my oil rubbed bronze fixtures throughout my house. My mailbox, house numbers, all faucets, towel racks, shower racks, and some decor are the rubbed bronze color, and these tie in perfectly with that theme. These handles have a nice weight to them, you can tell they are real metal. They feel so smooth and luxurious to the touch. The pictures really don’t do them justice, it’s so hard to tell from a photo but these really are extremely nice drawer handles. I’m waiting until I get my cabinets refinished to use them in the kitchen, but I tested out the screws and they fit seamlessly into the handles. Sometimes with screws they feel like they just don’t like up right and it’s a pain to get them in all the way but these fit in flawlessly. I like that the screws are cuttable too, depending on the thickness of your drawer front/cabinet. Overall these are what I would call deluxe drawer/cabinet handles, and I would highly recommend them.

hypo_0: Krásné úchytky na zásuvky! Když jsem je rozbalil/a, byl/a jsem zklamaný/á, protože jsem si objednal/a růžové zlato, a chtěl/a jsem dát jen tři hvězdičky za to, že mi přišla špatná barva. Nicméně poté, co jsem si je prohlédl/a zblízka a přiložil/a je ke svým skříňkám, si vlastně myslím, že se mi tyto líbí více. Nejenže jsou nádherné, ale hodí se ke všem mým doplňkům z tmavého olejem gumovaného bronzu po celém domě. Moje poštovní schránka, domovní čísla, všechny kohoutky, věšáky na ručníky, poličky do sprchy a některé dekorace jsou v této bronzové barvě a tyto úchytky s tímto motivem dokonale ladí. Tyto úchytky mají příjemnou hmotnost, je vidět, že je to skutečný kov. Na dotek jsou velmi hladké a luxusní. Fotky jim opravdu nedělají dostatečnou reklamu, z fotografie se to těžko posuzuje, ale tyto úchytky na zásuvky jsou opravdu mimořádně pěkné. Čekám, až mi zrenovují skříňky, abych je mohl/a použít v kuchyni, ale vyzkoušel/a jsem šrouby a do úchytek pasují naprosto hladce. Někdy to se šrouby vypadá, že prostě nesedí správně a je utrpení je zašroubovat až nadoraz, ale tyto pasují bezchybně. source_doc: Love this kit, would love to buy another, but don't try to take throught TSA checkpoint. I watched a youtube tutorial or two, got the panotuner app, and ordered this kit.  I was able to get my parents' piano sounding much better in just a few minutes.  Unfortunately, I tried to carry the kit through the TSA checkpoint, and it would not go (the tuner device is a tool more than 7 inches) so I had to ship it to my parents' house, and I left it there.  My piano is also slightly out of tune, but I am hoping they will restock and I can get another kit like the one I got my parents.  Otherwise, I will be shipping that tuning kit back to me in a few months.  Much cheaper than hiring a piano tuner, and just as effective.

source_doc: Black and Gold Luxurious Dining Setup. I got sold on this table cloth’s color combination.  A black table cloth with a separate gold sequin table runner is a clever idea.  I thought that the gold fabric was attached to the black cloth, but when I opened the package, I saw that they were two pieces.  Please see the photos I posted.This table cloth is a perfect size for my kitchen's island marble table.  I love that I can decorate my table with just black cloth or spice it up, and I can lay out in the middle of the gold sequin runner.  I could even use a different table-runner.  I think I will buy this company's rose-gold variant, so I can mix and match them.The fabric had no toxic odor.  The black cloth would be easy to clean, but the gold sequin I believe needs careful and gentle methods for removing food stains.  This table cloth plus the gold sequin runner appears luxurious, except for the gold runner edges.  The easiest, fastest, and cheapest way to prevent fabric from fraying is to use sergers and form a zigzag pattern across the edges that this table runner utilizes.  I wish that the manufacturer fold the edges of this table runner and create a seam that would make it perfectly nice.For the kitchen/dining aesthetic, it will bring for a reasonable price, and I would say this gets my thumbs up approval!  Highly recommended!

source_doc: Simple versus Stanley. Simple modern every day hands-down! I bought this one because it had my football team logo on it even though I received a Stanley for Christmas. I have since bought two more simple modern tumblers.My simple modern is light weight and holds ice until the next day. It is perfect for my iced coffee. My ice does not melt down and water down my product. Of course no tumbler is spill proof when there is a straw involved however, it does not leak when it spills over unless it comes out of the straw when it’s been completely flipped. I found that out when I hit the brakes and my lunch bag went flying from the car seat to the floorboard upside down. With a Stanley, it does not seem to keep ice as long and I do get the water down effect and it is heavier. also when it tips it doesn’t leak not only from the straw but the straw hole in the sides of the lid. I do have the new Stanley H2O.Another great thing about the Simple Modern is the price.  It’s affordable and I definitely use it. There is a $10 price difference between this and the Stanley.I absolutely love this and and I am definitely more hydrated and I noticed that my skin does not look as dry. I would recommend this cup.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: You guys…buy this ASAP! This thing is magical! Seriously. Where has this been all my life??? Why have I been sleeping on this!? Why have I been using a blower dryer AND a round brush all my hair drying life when I could’ve been using this all along? Well maybe this didn’t exist, but it does now and that’s all that matters.With a blow dryer, it would normally take me 45-60 min to blow dry my hair. I have THICK hair, that’s somewhat coarse and curly/wavy, but even more textured towards my scalp/hairline. It’s impossible to straighten with a blow dryer and I heavily rely on a flat iron. AND I can’t blow dry my hair as soon as I get out of the shower. I typically have to wait 30-45 min for it to air dry some or else I’m standing there sweating for eternity while 20 hairs dry. It’s torture.I don’t know what kinda witchery this is, but I literally blow dried my hair in 30-40 min today. Straight out the shower! What?! And flat ironing was minimal! I can’t believe it. I’m beyond happy!The dryer seemed kind of loud, but it’s powerful. The heat felt kind of too hot at times, but I had it on the highest setting. I just had to make sure I didn’t let it blow on my skin/scalp for too long or it would get uncomfortable. Aside from that, it’s perfection. Believe the hype. Seriously.

source_doc: Just what I needed. With a young kid and a baby on the way I wanted something that could accommodate both kids.  I really like that there is space for the baby but also a seat for when my older one wants to ride instead of walk. I really like the cup holders for my drinks as I can put a drink for me and a drink for my older kid in it and keep my hands more free.  I admit I don't leave my phone in the tray.  The under storage is big enough for the things I think I need to bring but I tend to store stuff there I don't need as often.  I like that the baby seat can recline or go more upright as my little one grows.  The canopy is small but easy to position.  I like how easy it is to fold up, this works best when the basket is empty.  I do not have the matching car seat so I can not comment on that.

Líbí se mi, že se dětská sedačka dá sklopit nebo napřímit podle toho, jak moje maličké roste. Stříška je malá, ale snadno se nastavuje. Líbí se mi, jak snadno se kočárek skládá, což funguje nejlépe, když je košík prázdný. Nemám kompatibilní autosedačku, takže to nemohu posoudit.

source_doc: Nice full featured mouse. This is a nice mouse. It's comfortable. I've had mice with a DPI button before but I couldn't always figure out what setting It was on. I like that this one has a display so I don't have to guess. It also works either USB, 24G, or with one of two Bluetooth devices. I like using the Bluetooth mode so I don't need to take up a USB port with a receiver.  I also like that I can plug in the cable and use it while It charges and I don't have to replace batteries. I like that it has software that allows me to re-program what buttons do what. I've been annoyed in the past by mice that kept messing things up when I accidentally bumped it's extra buttons and I couldn't change how it worked.

source_doc: It is better than i expected with a small cabinet!!! I have a sub that is a 6" that I paired with a set of Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. The bass was lacking and I wanted something a little stronger. I ordered it and It was delivered in 24 hours on prime. It is much smaller than I expected. It’s just 2” deeper than the 6" cabinet it is replacing. I connected it to the system with the Presonus Ceres 4.5BT monitors. It turns on right away. And it has strong smooth bass not muddy bass. I actually had to turn it down 5-7db below 0db on the gain control to match the monitors. Now, I have a complete Presonus system, that is very impressive for the cost. I have several other systems, A KRK VXT system and a Blue Sky system this is smallest system and it is very impressive compared to the KRK and Blue Sky systems I have in head to head comparison using the Mackie Big Knob 3. Very happy with this sub. highly recommended.

source_doc: perfect for daily powder supplements on vacation. These helped me bring 15 days' worth of powder supplements to make my morning smoothies while on vacation; I poured the powder from these directly into my wide-mouth "ShakeSphere" bottle and added drinking water to shake it up. My powders filled each container right to the brim (approximately 70cc I think, if I did my math correctly from all the various scoop sizes). I didn't like being forced to use the funnel top as the lid on the topmost container; I don't have a baby and I didn't need to use a funnel, so it was wasted space in my already tight luggage - I would have preferred a flat top lid. When closing be sure the pieces are securely tightened with each other, and strangely, when you use too much force, the pieces don't twist apart nicely; after I loosened my grip, then the pieces came apart smoothly. I used these for a 1 week trip to San Diego and now I'm packing them up for a 2-wk trip to Hawaii. I use these weekly at home too, because I love the time savings in the mornings of not needing to measure all the powders out each day (now I do that only once per week).

hypo_0: ideální na každodenní práškové doplňky stravy na dovolené. Tyto nádobky mi pomohly vzít si s sebou na dovolenou zásobu práškových doplňků na 15 dní na přípravu mých ranních smoothies; prášek jsem z nich sypal/a přímo do své láhve „ShakeSphere“ s širokým hrdlem a přidal/a pitnou vodu, abych to protřepal/a. Moje prášky naplnily každou nádobku až po okraj (myslím, že přibližně 70 cm³, pokud jsem to podle různých velikostí odměrek správně spočítal/a). Nelíbilo se mi, že jsem byl/a nucen/a použít víčko s nálevkou jako uzávěr nejvrchnější nádobky; nemám dítě a nálevku jsem nepotřeboval/a použít, takže to bylo jen vyhozené místo v mém už tak plném kufru – byl/a bych raději pro ploché víčko. Při zavírání se ujistěte, že jsou jednotlivé díly k sobě pevně dotažené, a kupodivu, když použijete příliš velkou sílu, nejdou od sebe dobře odšroubovat; až když jsem stisk povolil/a, šly od sebe hladce oddělit. Použil/a jsem je na týdenní výlet do San Diega a teď si je balím na dvoutýdenní cestu na Havaj. Používám je i doma každý týden, protože se mi líbí ta úspora času ráno, kdy nemusím každý den odměřovat všechny prášky (teď to dělám jen jednou týdně).

Nelíbilo se mi, že jsem byl/a nucen/a použít víčko s nálevkou jako uzávěr nejvrchnější nádobky; nemám dítě a nálevku jsem nepotřeboval/a používat, takže to bylo jen zbytečně zabrané místo v mém už tak plném kufru – uvítal/a bych spíše ploché víčko. Při zavírání se ujistěte, že jsou jednotlivé díly k sobě pevně dotažené, a zvláštní je, že když použijete příliš velkou sílu, nejdou od sebe dobře odšroubovat; až když jsem stisk povolil/a, šly díly hladce oddělit. Použil/a jsem je na týdenní cestu do San Diega a teď si je balím na dvoutýdenní výlet na Havaj. source_doc: I like this shampoo...just one thing. I am very picky about shampoo, having been in the hair business all of my life. I am retired now and often try different shampoos. The shampoo I love from Neutrogena has been discontinued so I have been trying to find another I like. I do like the Biolage shampoo, but have a hard time finding the genuine kind. So I decided to try this. I do like it. I will probably get it again. However, I typically wash my hair under the kitchen sink and water tends to run in your face and sometimes near your eyes. I don't know what it is that was in this shampoo, but it burned the skin around my eyes.

source_doc: I'm REALLY Impressed. At the beginning of pandemic, I was constantly on video calls/doing virtual presentations etc. I heard a lot of  other people in meetings where you could barely understand them, and decided that I didn't want that to be me. I decided to buy a Blue Yeti because I figured it's probably important that other people can hear you speaking.After a few months, I upgraded to the Shure SM7B. It was an incredible upgrade and I was very happy with it. If you can, start with the Shure as opposed to a USB mic.Fast forward a few years, and I'm doing meetings and hosting webinars at least once a day. I heard the Neumann U87 is what NPR uses and I wanted to up the professionalism. I couldn't stomach paying $3500 for a U87, so I decided to compromise and get the TLM 103. It's a huge step up from the Shure.Both are great, but the 103 is way less fuzzy and sounds a lot more like my actual voice. A bonus, is that now I don't have to use a $150 cloud lifter to get decent sound out of the Shure. I highly recommend this product. The price is still a kick in the teeth, but it's noticeably better than anything I'd tried previously.

source_doc: Amazing!💕 I was on the hunt for an awesome collagen facial cream and read many reviews. I knew I already Loved the Baebody eye gel so I thought I would give it a whirl. I can honestly say that I am so glad I did! This cream absorbs well and does Not leave a greasy residue. That is huge for me since I like to apply to both my face & neck and don't like an oil slick on my face (lol). I also love that I can use this day & night instead of using separate creams. Some of the brands you find in stores don't live up to their hype or especially their expensive prices but this one has a wonderful result at a fantastic price point. If you need an excellent face cream look no further, this one is Perfection! Btw, I am 53 years old, this may be useful since I am not still in my 20's or 30's but love to look as young as possible with healthy products. 💕🥰💟

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: Totally worth it! So, I know you're supposed to clean the humidifier daily - that's all well and good when you're a) not disabled; b) dealing with Stage 4 Cancer ; and c) just too dang tired.  I wanted to wait and see just how well they worked before writing my review.  Each time I refilled the humidifier I would add 6-7 drops.  Normally, I clean them once a week - and I have 2 humidifiers so it takes some time to clean them.  Well, I have been very sick for 2 weeks, and I knew the chambers were probably gooky so I turned them off for about 2 1/1 days.  I cleaned them today expecting some kind of science experiment gone wrong - even cleaning them weekly I'd get a ton of gook.  Well, there was gook, but surprisingly not nearly what I expected.  I am now using 10 drops because I realized I have an almost 2 gallon tank so I'm hoping next week when I clean them I'll see even less gook.

source_doc: Its ok. not great, but not terrible. I looked at almost every bedside bassinet on market. Read every review, and ended up getting this one. Its not bad. its ok. I dont see much of an issue with sturdiness like some report. I think if you push with force any object even a livingroom couch you can get it to teeter totter. I think the collapsable feature to fold up and set back up is not as simple as i had thought. I wish i had watched a video of someone doing both. I imagine we will leave it assembled and just pick it up to go to another room if needed. The height has 4 settings, although not as high as i imagined. it wont even line up flush with our basic bedframe and matress i think is low to begin with, sits lower. For what it is and for the price, i cant imagine any other would be any better. So, for now, it may work out. baby not here yet, so havent actually used it yet.

source_doc: Best Bassinet!! This bassinet is absolutely perfect. I am so happy with it! I bought 2 because my daughter had twins. Best baby buy EVER. I wanted a bassinet that had the side to side glide but I wanted it to be sturdy and it not be able to shift a baby into the side panels (we have 5 and 3 yr old siblings.) I wasn't crazy about the all white but it works so beautifully it could be puke green and worth every penny.If I were on the design team I would change that the glide motion have an "always on" feature for the exhausted new mom in addition to the 60 min timer.  I would improve the sound quality. Its harsh. The white noise and nature sounds are great but not so much the music. I would not have the flashing light. We havent figured out exactly what the flashing light is all about. I'm sure it's just that we haven't set up the wifi yet. Which we will get to and update if it changes our perception of the bassinet.I have 4 children and I have 6 grandchildren. I wish this product was around for the past 40 years!!!

source_doc: Love the Zero Water concept; Filter Quality Control Is A Problem. Normally I try to be positive with my reviews of products, however with these replacement Zero Water filters it is a struggle. Love the 23 cup Zero Water I purchased. The  original Filter that came with the dispenser worked perfect. Came time to replace the filter, I purchased the 6 pack, (I was committed). First filter I tried I let set overnight to give it "a chance". Next morning, no filtered water, surprise, surprise. Opened a second filter and installed it. Fourteen hours later I had 8 cups of water. 2 for 2 bad. Too late smart, I looked on the web for other people having a similar experience. I found I was not alone, in fact I was one of many, many people experiencing quality issues with the Zero Water filters. Since I purchased them as a 6 box set, I have to return them as a set. I can't begin to tell you how disappointed I am with this whole experience. And by the way, they were original equipment manufacturer with the name proudly emblazoned on the side. Love/hate, you have to be ready for a measure of both with this product.

source_doc: Nice. I have lots of long thick hair.  I am particular about how I wash and dry it.  I didn't realize this was rectangular when I got it so when I opened it I was a little disappointed.  I've been using those ergonomic head-shaped twist ones for so long I was skeptical (you know, like turbie-twist).  So when I tried this I was really surprised.  It's really big and fluffy but it actually stays better up on my head than the contoured ones.  It isn't as heavy as it seems and it doesn't pull on my hair as tightly as the ones I was using before.  I actually get more volume in my hair with this because y hair isn't compacted down as tightly and it doesn't pull my hair backwards into a tight little towel.  It's a single piece of fabric with very tough elastic sewn onto it for your tuck.And as I discovered just the other day, if your kids spill a jug on the floor then use every bathroom towel to clean up their mess right before your shower, this towel wrap is big enough to dry your whole body, cover you as you duck down the hall and still dry enough to use on your hair afterwards.

source_doc: My dog started using this as a chew toy. I purchased this because slip leads seem to be recommended and my dog was pulling a lot. My adopted dog was like a completely different dog once out of the shelter. When I first saw her at the shelter, she was calm, no pulling whatsoever. I sign the papers and she immediately started pulling and running up to each thing.I noticed that the leash they use for the shelter dogs was a slip lead and the leash they give you upon adoption is a standard. I thought it must have something to do with the leash and ordered this one.While she walked better on this leash, she would also rile herself up and decide to start attacking it and playing tug of war. I saw a video on how to turn your slip lead into a harness - it worked better, but wasn't perfect. I ultimately switched to a short leash and harness because I can almost hold the leash loosely without problems with that combination. Even if I hadn't gone that way I wouldn't still be using this leash - someone else walked her for a few days with it and I didn't notice till later it has been chewed through - if she did decide to run I could not trust the leash in its current state to restrain her.

source_doc: Best pillow I have purchased! Oh my-I really do not where to begin. I purchased a Rainmr queen size bed pillow for myself. We have a king size bed so naturally you buy king size pillows. No matter how hard I tried I could not sleep on this huge pillow. I  knew I had to find something else. Upon receiving the Rainmr queen size pillow I was so pleased how cool, soft & comfortable it is. It comes with it’s own cooling pillowcase. The memory foam they use doesn’t have a strong odor which is something I liked. I am a side sleeper. I was amazed how the pillow keeps it’s shape. To sum it up the cost of the pillow is worth every penny I spent. If you are looking for a pillow that keeps it’s shape, and stays cool while you sleep-this pillow is just what you need. I would highly recommend this pillow.

source_doc: I can't deny, I love these bare limbed lighted trees. I have one the same height as this one but it is all white lights.  I still love it - it puts off more light that you would think and it's just really pretty when lit up at night.  This one, having colorful lights is just as pretty, but I do love that this one has several colors.  The only thing I might wish for is that this had a remote so that I could change the colors to a solid color, have it fade or pulse, or even have all the colors race.  See, I don't put up a Christmas tree and this would be sort of a substitute.  Other than that, I love this tree.  It was easy to put together and I used a smart plug so that I could turn it on with voice control through Alexa.  Love this tree!

source_doc: Wonderful! I absolutely love this product! The older I get the more trouble sleeping I seem to have. For the longest time I was taking an acetaminophen nighttime formula, but I was getting concerned about taking that every day and decided that it was time to try a melatonin supplement and I am so glad that I did! Not only are the gummies very tasty, but within 30 minutes of taking two of these at bedtime, I feel the need to sleep. Although there is a small amount of sugar in these gummies the sugar does not seem to bother me, and I am very sensitive to sugar especially when trying to sleep. Not only do I fall asleep faster, I stay asleep except for the occasional times I have to use the bathroom due to an “old age” bladder.  The jar is rather big as it contains 100 gummies. Suggested use is 2 gummies at bedtime so this jar will last me 50 days if I should need to use them every night.  From the makers of Nyquil, this formula works great for me, and I plan on having these in stock at my house for as long as they do.

What I don't understand is why the seller doesn't group up the flower scents and the musky [really, musty] scents in one pack? I get there's an inflation going on but this is stingy.For the price I wouldn't buy this again unless the seller is more flexible in how they're bundling the scents together. Makes no sense and I don't like that I paid for scents I hate and won't use.

source_doc: After a year of trying, I'm over it. I was gifted the Gaming Mouse during the December 2021/ January 2022 holiday season. This item was purchased via Amazon.The mouse started randomly dying and coming back. By that I mean my PC would say it had disconnected, the mouse LEDs would turn off and it the mouse would not respond. Upon research and inspection, it appears that the power cord connection is faulty.There is no stress to the cord, there are no pets or children around to have damaged it. I emailed the seller on Friday, Apr 8, 2022 to inform them of the issue. At that time, I had not had the mouse long enough to consider this routine wear and tear. I love the size and shape of the mouse so I would much rather get a replacement than simply returning it. I received not response. I rigged the mouse together and just focused on controller gaming. It is now January 2023. I loved how big the mouse was so I really tried to like it but its stupid to try and make this work. Please do not buy it. "Lizsword" has a way better mouse. Equally affordable and lasts way longer. My husband has had that brand for years so I should have started with that one.

source_doc: Exactly what I needed in my closet. These are great! There are two different sizes you can order and I chose the smaller ( I think its like 7 inches)  since I wanted to use them in a sliding door closet with limited wall space. I put one on each end, at two different levels and now I can see my clothes so much better when I slide the doors open. My bedroom is dark and its impossible to tell black from navy and I was having to take them out into the next room for better lighting to see what I wanted to wear. Now, I slide the closet door open, the lights come right on and so much easier! And I can make it hand-held if I want an even closer look. They have a magnetic strip that attached them to the wall and it just pops off and on. The bigger size would probably give even more light, but for the space I had to use them, the smaller size work just great. I have mine set at the auto setting so they turn on activated by motion and shut off automatically once the door is closed again after like 20 seconds. But you can also just use the on/off switch if that’s better for you.

source_doc: This gives me great breath, and I think whiter teeth. My girlfriend had this electric toothbrush and liked it, so I decided to buy it. I love it! I truly believe it has made my teeth whiter. I didn’t realize that I was not brushing my teeth long enough until I got this toothbrush. My breath feels like it. It’s fresher after I brush with this toothbrush The only thing it seems to drip a little messy toothpaste on the charger that I have to keep wiping up. When I brush as long as recommended, I have watery toothpaste, dripping down my chin, and down the toothbrush. Other than that, I love this, in fact, I’m going to buy the same toothbrush to give as a gift to my sister.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Díky tomu mám skvělý dech a myslím, že i bělejší zuby. Moje přítelkyně tento elektrický zubní kartáček měla a byla s ním spokojená, tak jsem se rozhodl/a si ho koupit. Naprosto ho zbožňuji! Opravdu věřím, že mám díky němu bělejší zuby. Dokud jsem si nepořídil/a tento kartáček, neuvědomoval/a jsem si, že si zuby nečistím dostatečně dlouho. Můj dech tomu odpovídá. Po vyčištění tímto kartáčkem je svěžejší. Jedinou věcí je, že z něj na nabíječku zřejmě trochu kape pasta, což dělá nepořádek a musím to neustále utírat. Když si čistím zuby tak dlouho, jak se doporučuje, zředěná zubní pasta mi stéká po bradě a po kartáčku dolů. Kromě toho jsem z něj nadšený/á, vlastně se chystám koupit stejný kartáček jako dárek pro svou sestru.

source_doc: I thought it had an on off button. I have a few Snarks  and the pivoting features  have broken..  I had tried to duct tape them, but  ultimately they were finished... Since I have several guitars, my theory is to have a tuner with each guitar... everything in it's place. to replace the Snarks, I ordered 2 FENDER  tuners, wanting to try something different.I  was pleasantly pleased! Fender's oval hinge feature makes me believe that I will not have any breakage issues. The tuner's panel is very easy to read and shuts off in 5 minutes. I've had these tuners  for 2 days now, and so far they are pretty nice. Of course i will come back and update later on in the year, but for now i give it 4 stars until I witness the Fender's durability.One thing I didn't count on, was the lack of an on/off switch. I almost sent the tuners back, but tried it out for the hell of it. The on/off is automatic and shuts itself off in 5 minutes, which is more than enough time to tune up.  If you are jamming and want to tune later in your session, all you have to do is unclip from guitar re-clip to the head stock. I'm guessing the on/off switch is paired up with the tuner's clip on screw. It's not that bad of a feature.Good Job, Fender!

source_doc: Did not work with my cats. I have a 10 year old cat and just adopted a kitten. I was hoping the Relaxavet would help ease the transition while they got used to each other. If this calmed my cat down, then I don't want to know what she would have been like. After I unplugged them, I saw no change in her behavior.I've used Feliway in the past for different situations, but thought I would give a different product a try. I can't say if the Feliway would have been better, I did not switch. I just stopped using the Relaxavet when I felt it wasn't working.Fact is that she is slowly (very slowly) adjusting to the kitten's presence. I even noticed her playing with him the other day when she thought I wasn't looking. So I think the real solution here is time.

source_doc: Absolutely Awesome! I needed to fine away that I can have my dehumidifier in my basement run consistently without me having to remember to empty the bucket. In the summertime, my dehumidifier will fill up a 70 pint bucket every day! Since I don't go down to the basement every day to empty the bucket, I wanted something that can empty the water itself. I noticed one of these pumps on my fathers central air unit in his basement. He told me that this pumps collects the condensation until it gets full. Once it's full, it just pumps it out a hose into the back yard. Unfortunately I don't have the ability to run a hose out to the back yard but I do have access to main sewar line in my basement. I mounted this to the side of the table that holds my dehumidifier and ran a hose from the water outlet tube to the inlet of the pump. I connected the hose from the pump to a threaded barb fitting I mounted on a 2" PVC cap that screws onto my main sewar line. This setup has been running for months and I has worked flawlessly!
