source_doc: Great rower. Pros:  I have been using this rower for a few months now.  This is a great, sturdy, affordable rower! I do not personally have any trouble with the foot straps.  They are velco and very strong.  I love the whole body workout that I get from this rower.  I filled the water to maximum strength and after 10 minutes, my heart is pumping!  The seat is more comfortable than other rowers I have used, and seems to be a little cushioned as opposed to hard plastic which was one of the main reason why I purchased this one.  Having a comfy seat, will allow me to work out longer!Cons: I wish it came with a few water purification tablets.  I don't understand the electronic board and I threw away the manual.  I wish the timer would stay put instead of going back and forth to some other number.

source_doc: Brings sound down a notch and are super comfy. I work from home and have a couple of dogs a toddler and various other distractions around the house, usually when I want to tune them out I throw on some headphones but sometimes I just want quiet so I got these to help with that.  It came packaged well and I didn't see any defects in them.  In the box you get a case, two rings to put the ear tips on, and 6 different ear tips to use.  I chose the large double-flanged and got to it. Getting the stock tips off was fairly easy and putting the new ones on was too after that I stuck them in.  It isn't complete noise cancelation I can still hear most things fine but it's like the volume got turned down a bit which I love.  Also when Im wearing them I can barely feel them so I might actually try sleeping in them.  All in all, these are fantastic 5 starts not notes.

hypo_0: Snižují hluk o úroveň níž a jsou super pohodlné. Pracuji z domova a mám doma pár psů, batole a různé jiné rušivé vlivy, a když je obvykle chci vytěsnit, nasadím si sluchátka, ale někdy chci prostě jen klid, tak jsem si pořídil/a tyto, aby mi s tím pomohly. Přišly dobře zabalené a nenašel/našla jsem na nich žádné vady. V krabičce dostanete pouzdro, dva kroužky na nasazení koncovek a 6 různých koncovek do uší. Vybral/a jsem si ty velké s dvojitým závojem a pustil/a se do toho. Sundat původní koncovky bylo docela snadné a nasadit nové také, a pak jsem si je strčil/a do uší. Není to úplné potlačení hluku, většinu věcí stále slyším v pořádku, ale je to, jako by se trochu snížila hlasitost, což se mi moc líbí. Také když je mám na sobě, sotva je cítím, takže v nich možná zkusím i spát. Celkově vzato jsou fantastické, 5 hvězdiček, bez výhrad.

source_doc: Helps for arthritis-type pain. Many reviewers say the capsules are big. I agree. I take with a cupful of water and thoroughly wet it before swallowing but it still sticks in my throat for a few minutes. I don’t know why.That said, this supplement is amazing. Another reviewer mentioned it helped with her arthritis. I don’t know if what I have is arthritis, but for nearly a year I have had pain in my left hand and have not been able to close my fingers completely into a fist. Not even halfway. I tried creams, ibuprofen, Tylenol, and even dmso, and nothing helped the pain or changed how my fingers closed. It got to the point I became used to the pain and basically accepted it as my new normal until I got around to seeing a doctor—not easy to do in the rural area I live in. So when I read the review that mentioned how it helped with the person’s arthritis, I looked at my hand. I had only been taking it for 2 or 3 days, but the pain was gone, and I could close my hand almost completely. I hadn’t even noticed! I take only one capsule a day now (half the daily dosage), and take it with liposomal vitamin c for better absorption, and my hand is doing great. I’m sure it must be helping me in other ways I don’t recognize. Great product!

source_doc: Versatile cat shelter. I helped a young feral cat all fall. I bought this shelter for him.  I was impressed with it's sturdiness, and how rain rolled right off.  I stuffed it with straw and he used it regularly.  Recently I found a barn home for him. I have 2 other feral shelters in the back yard so I wondered if I should leave this one out too.  I cleaned out the straw and put a soft rug in it. I put it back in one closet.  I was not sure if my inside cats would take to it, but they did. Now there's a race to see who gets it first. No need to hang a no vacancy sign on it.  One cat is always in it.

source_doc: Not quite as sharp as expected, doesn't stick as well on textured wall, lion version limiting. The Mandek 8-pack acoustic panels arrived packaged well, and I was excited at trying these out. Unfortunately, the wall where I wanted to install these is textured (orange peel) and the panels did not adhere as well as I had expected. So far they are staying put, so I am keeping my fingers crossed. You have to be careful when peeling back to the paper from the adhesive, too - the adhesive wanted to peel up with the paper when I went too fast. As far as looks go, I chose the Lion version, and the picture is not quite as sharp as the product pictures.One thing I did not think about when picking the Lion style was that if I needed more panels, they aren't going to match. I am not going to want repeated pictures of a lion! I mention this because I found I needed more panels to get more effect sound proofing in my office. That was short-sightedness on my part, and hopefully that will help you make a better decision on which style to choose with these panels or others that are decorated.Overall, these are nice panels and they look good despite the lower resolution of the picture. I would like to have the option of 16, 24, or 32 panels with the same design options for better coverage on larger walls.

source_doc: Great console organizer! Even better with a few modifications! I got the one without the coin holder and USB ports! I did this for several reasons:1. I want to use a rapid charger for my phone2. I've read reviews about the coin holder being a knuckle buster when putting the car in park3. The USB ports could break later on meaning you'd need to replace the entire unit4. Better utilization of space to not have the USB ports taking up space in an already small compartment.So i made a few modifications to an already great console organizer. I used my dremel to cut a square in the top to allow the console light to enter the top compartment. I also cut 2 holes in the back of the organizer to allow me to run my apple charger through any compartment that I wanted. I chose the small upper right corner for my ear pod charger. Check out the photos.The unit fits tight and snug like a glove. I really don't have any complaints about this unit although it would have been better if it already came with the modifications that I did. Overall I'll give it 5 stars and I would highly recommend it!

source_doc: Love the color and brightness, but they do not last. I purchased 2 boxes of these lights 2 years ago (march of 2021) to replace old can lighting in our basement and kitchen. Out of the 24 lights I installed probably 17 of them. I love the color of the light and how bright they are. HOWEVER.... I am giving these lights 1 start because over the last year one by one they have been dying and need to be replaced. I am at the point where I have had to use the 7 extras that I had to replace ones that died. Since using the last spare I had which was maybe 2 weeks ago,  I now am sitting in my basement with 2 dead lights and one dead one in my kitchen. Very disappointed how they did not last at all. Total waste of money as I am going to have to buy all new lights knowing that the ones I have left are going to die soon.

source_doc: Does not work well at all! I will truly say that this is one time that I should have paid more attention to reviews than I did. I have been waiting to give my review in hopes that it would work better and I could make it work. However, I purchased it for my cats and the food does not release. I thought maybe dog food got stuck but my cat food is small and will not come out. What happens is my cats then knock the bowl over trying to get the food out and you guessed it, it all hits the floor along with the water, which is also another problem. The water will not come out unless you pushed down on the top of the bottle. I guess I have not been able to train my cats to do that. :( It is also made very lightweight so knocking it over is not a issue for my cats. I am very disappointed in my purchase and the fact that I spent $30.00 on this. My window to return has now closed and that's my own fault, but I buy a lot on Amazon and can say this has been one of worst purchases.

I am fair and have sun sensitivities. Add in that I take a couple of meds that exacerbate this, and I just cover up. I can get giant bottles of cheap stuff which is fine in a pinch, but for every day use, multiple times a day.. I choose wisely.Keep in mind that this is aromatic. This comes with an air freshener of this aroma. It is beachy and pleasant, but also a tad perfumy. If you like colognes and such then you will likely enjoy this. I dont mind it but it is something I am aware of when I have it on.

source_doc: Wanted to like these but it doesnt work for my Jeep. I was so excited when I saw these because I was very ready for a different look for my TJ's tail lights and I liked the sort of modern look these gave. Unfortunately these don't work with my TJ because I have Rugged Ridge's heavy duty hinge kit for my tailgate and the tail lights are shorter in depth than the stock lights. I thought about cutting a 1/2 inch thick rubber sheet to shape but that also didnt work because the bolts didnt end up being long enough to also reach through the body with it. When I did test fit them though, they were bright and worked like they should so that's why I gave them 3 stars. I really liked them but I just wish they were similar to stock in depth so I could have used them.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

Bohužel na můj TJ nepasují, protože mám na zadních dveřích zesílenou sadu pantů od Rugged Ridge a tato zadní světla mají menší hloubku než ta původní. Když jsem je ale zkoušel/a namontovat, svítily jasně a fungovaly, jak měly, proto dávám 3 hvězdičky. source_doc: Bright is a Under Statement. I have been wanting to switch over to LED's for awhile now, but I have held off because the colors of LED's were more pastel and didn't look good to me. So I can honestly say these do look great and remind me of my classic C9's. I still have over 20 strands of C9 Christmas Lights from the 70's that are still going strong with GE light blubs. More than half are still original and look great, but as you can guess my light bill for Nov. - Jan. shoots up a lot when using.So when I saw these lights I decided to try one box. When they came and I first tried out I was blown away how good they looked.  They look so good. I will be definitely getting more.  Well let me redo that last statement. If these hold up this season, and make it through the cold weather, rain, snow, ice. Then I will be getting more. I will update later if they don't, but for now all is good.

source_doc: Made me break out, scent is a bit strong for me. This has a sticky texture and doesn't quite absorb into the skin, but rather, sits on top of it. I personally didn't love the scent and found it to be a bit strong. I put this on my body and immediately started itching and developed hives. As soon as that happened, I went to wash it off my body and then came to read the reviews, where I learned from another review that this is meant to be WASHED OFF after applying, though it isn't included in the package instructions. I must say that, after rinsing, I did feel a bit of relief from the pain I was experiencing and it did help me feel sleepy.I would use it again, but this needs clearer instructions.Also, about the pack@ging: Personally, I feel it's a bit wasteful to pack the plastic-wrapped bottle in a heavy b0x, use something to fill the empty space. And the note from the family is sweet, but I don't know them and it's printed on heavy cardstock. I'm not hanging it in my house anywhere, and I'd rather none of this was included, it just gave me more to discard (I recycled the b0x, its filling and the note). But even if I were giving this as a gift (which I wouldn't), it felt a bit overdone and wasteful.

source_doc: I was unsure at first BUT... I was unsure when I first took this out of it's box. I needed a carrier because I realized I really can't carry my newborn and do other things around the house at the same time. I forgot how useful carriers were with my first son. It's intimidating at first to see all the straps, but once you get this adjusted for your body and baby it's a breeze to snap it right on you. My 6 week old currently loves being close to me and sleeping on my chest. In fact this is his favorite place to take naps in during the day. It gets him settled down real quick when he gets a little fussy. It's so durable and sturdy I don't worry about baby in here when doing anything around the house. I even take this with me at the office, fortunately I own my own business so I can take baby with me to work. For the price it's great, it's worth every penny and more. I plan to use this the whole time baby can stay in a carrier. I love this better Tham the bjorn, which I had with my first son. This is so much more versatile and transforms as the baby grows.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a"

hypo_0: Zpočátku jsem si nebyl/a jistý/á, ALE... Když jsem to poprvé vyndal/a z krabice, nebyl/a jsem si jistý/á. Potřeboval/a jsem nosítko, protože jsem si uvědomil/a, že opravdu nemohu nosit své novorozeně a zároveň dělat jiné věci kolem domu. Zapomněl/a jsem, jak užitečná nosítka byla u mého prvního syna. Na první pohled to se všemi těmi popruhy působí děsivě, ale jakmile to přizpůsobíte svému tělu a miminku, je hračka si to na sebe rychle nasadit. Moje šestitýdenní miminko je momentálně moc rádo u mě a spí na mé hrudi. Vlastně je to jeho nejoblíbenější místo na spaní během dne. Velmi rychle ho to uklidní, když je trochu neklidné. Je to tak odolné a pevné, že se o miminko vůbec nebojím, když dělám cokoli kolem domu. Beru si ho s sebou i do kanceláře, naštěstí vlastním svou firmu, takže si mohu brát miminko s sebou do práce. Za tu cenu je to skvělé, stojí to za každou korunu a ještě víc. Mám v plánu to používat po celou dobu, co miminko může v nosítku být. Mám ho raději než Babybjörn, který jsem měl/a u svého prvního syna. Tohle je mnohem univerzálnější a mění se podle toho, jak miminko roste.

source_doc: My cat love this water fountain! I used to buy my cat bottled water for her water dish (yes, I know I am a little over the top, but everyone's pipes are gross). source_doc: Well worth the price! I love everything about this slim eyeliner by Eco Soul! Since I have aged, eyeliner has become more difficult to apply. It is either too thick or too thin going across my eyelids as they seem to have become “bumpy” as I have gotten older. I also tend to have watery eyes for no apparent reason and my eyeliner will run. None of these prior problems with eyeliner has occurred with the new Eco Soul Super Slim Eyeliner.  The eyeliner applies very smoothly without tugging and I can have a very thin line, or bolder if I choose without any struggle. I love being able to just twist the tube just a little to get the point come out further when needed. I have not noticed any loss of my eyeliner when my eyes water as it stays put all day until I remove it at night. I especially appreciate the brown color of the eyeliner as it is more subtle than a harsh black. I am really enjoying using this new powerproof slim eyeliner and I would definitely recommend this to any age, but especially to older women who struggle with eyeliner.

Žádný z těchto předchozích problémů se s novou linkou Eco Soul Super Slim Eyeliner neobjevil. Linka se nanáší velmi hladce bez zadrhávání a bez jakéhokoli úsilí mohu mít velmi tenkou linku, nebo klidně výraznější, pokud se tak rozhodnu. Líbí se mi, že stačí tužkou jen trochu pootočit, aby hrot v případě potřeby více povylezl. Nevšiml/a jsem si žádného rozmazání linek, když mi slzí oči, protože drží na svém místě po celý den, dokud je večer neodlíčím. Zvláště oceňuji hnědou barvu této linky, protože je jemnější než tvrdá černá. Používání této nové voděodolné tenké linky si opravdu užívám a rozhodně bych ji doporučil/a pro jakýkoli věk, ale obzvláště starším ženám, které s očními linkami zápasí.

source_doc: If you put together many items, this is a great addition to your toolbox. I have a couple of wrenches - ratcheting ones - that I have used to hold nuts in place while screwing bolts down tight.  I mean, if you have ever bought "easy to assemble" furniture, you have probably cursed halfway through and wanted to throw the mess in the dumpster, right?  They give you this cheap-o "wrench" to hold the nut while you wrestle with a single "stick" Allen wrench to tighten the bolt.  That is WHY I have this set!  I throw out the "helpful" tools the manufacturer sends with their chair/table (whatever).  I have a drill with hex bits and this ratcheting wrench set - it shaves about half the time to put the item together, for real!  The last set I put together was a gliding outdoor chair that I love, but had I used the included items, I know putting the glider chair together would have taken me at least 4 hours to complete.  I believe it took me just under 2 hours (reading, checking, then doing) to complete the chair and with this wrench set holding the nuts while the drill tightened the hex-head bolts, I finished with no cursing at all!  Woo-hoo!  Thank you drill and ratcheting wrenches for that!  The heads included should help with most of the items you will encounter in household item builds and for me, that's enough!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Pokud sestavujete hodně věcí, je to skvělý doplněk do vaší sady nářadí. Mám několik klíčů – ráčnových –, které používám k přidržení matic na místě, zatímco pevně utahuji šrouby. Chci říct, pokud jste si někdy koupil/a nábytek se „snadnou montáží“, pravděpodobně jste v polovině nadával/a a chtěl/a ten nepořádek vyhodit do popelnice, že? Dají vám tenhle laciný „klíč“, abyste podržel/a matici, zatímco zápasíte s jedním imbusovým klíčem v podobě obyčejné tyčky, abyste šroub utáhl/a. A to je DŮVOD, proč mám tuhle sadu! Vyhazuji ty „užitečné“ nástroje, které výrobce posílá se svou židlí/stolem (nebo čímkoli jiným). Mám vrtačku s imbusovými bity a tuhle sadu ráčnových klíčů – vážně to zkrátí čas na sestavení věci zhruba o polovinu! Poslední věc, kterou jsem sestavoval/a, bylo závěsné zahradní křeslo, které naprosto miluji, ale kdybych použil/a přiložené nářadí, vím, že sestavení tohoto houpacího křesla by mi trvalo nejméně 4 hodiny. Věřím, že mi sestavení křesla trvalo necelé 2 hodiny (čtení návodu, kontrola a pak práce), a díky této sadě klíčů, která držela matice, zatímco vrtačka utahovala šrouby s šestihrannou hlavou, jsem skončil/a bez jakéhokoli nadávání! Juchů! Děkuji za to vrtačce a ráčnovým klíčům! Přiložené hlavice by měly pomoci s většinou věcí, na které při sestavování vybavení domácnosti narazíte, a mně to bohatě stačí!

source_doc: Fantastic beginners microphone. I purchase this microphone to make videos for my YouTube channel. The reason I went with the ATR is because it is a dynamic microphone. Apparently, this type of microphone is very good at isolating only your voice, and not picking up background noises. Since I am making these videos in a non-soundproofed room, it only made sense to get this microphone. There are newer, looking and cooler looking microphones if you’re a neophyte like me and it would’ve been easy to choose them however, I am very happy with the choice I made.I wish I purchased the boom package as well as I now recognize that the boom makes it so that there are no extraneous sounds making it into the recording. Tapping noises, if close enough to the microphone will unfortunately make it into the recording. So now, I am looking for a boom.Are use this microphone with my iPad Pro 2021 and also with an OWC thunderbolt hub. It works well. I did not choose to go down the XLR option but instead I am using the USB-C option. I highly recommend this microphone.I also purchased a wind blocking cover for the microphone head it seems to be helping.

source_doc: I use this for my dog's toys. My dog, Hank, is overly spoiled and has a ridiculous amount of toys. The material seems sturdy, so I think it will last a while. But, even using a hair dryer like they suggest, it's not really keeping its shape. Since I ordered this for my dog's toys, that's not a deal breaker for me. For what I wanted to use it for, it's perfect. It's also more of a dark grayish/black, but again, that doesn't bother me for what I wanted it for. It may be important for someone who is using it more as a nice, decorative way to store blankets, etc. though. I also may have done something wrong when I tried to form it. Despite those tiny quirks I love the basket and am really happy I ordered it.

source_doc: Handy multi-device car charger with useful voltmeter. I don't currently have any auto devices that need their own power port so the best thing about this charger for me currently is the voltmeter so I can always know the condition of my battery. I am hoping to get a dash cam soon though so perhaps that will need the extra power port. I like this charger a lot but it fits a bit too snugly in my van's power port, when putting it in and removing it I worry I could damage my van's power port. My first generation Toyota Sienna may have a slightly smaller power port than usual because I had that problem with another charger, I also read about another Toyota RAV4 owner with the same problem. If it weren't for the tight fit I would probably use this as my main charger so I could always know the condition of my battery. Another odd thing, but not a big issue is that since my port is low, when I insert the charger so that I read the port labels right side up, I am forced to see the fine print on what I consider the bottom of the charger, maybe that's a good thing in some situations. I like the soft touch on off switch.

source_doc: Excellent feed. I bought this for my green winged macaw because her other food went up $20 and I wanted something a little less expensive. Despite what some people said about their birds rejecting it I decided to try it anyways. It had a good pellet size, smelled good and had a nice crumble factor to it. My bird usually dives into her other food but only ate a little bit of it when I put it in her dish. Usually she eats all her food by 5 pm which is her second feeding time. There were pellets left over. I waited a few days for her to get used to it but she never did. I did not want her to go to many more days without eating so I broke down and despite the cost  bought her, her old food which is what I will keep her on from now on. I have nothing negative to say about this product except you have a 50/50 chance of your bird liking it. I didnt want this to go to waste so I gave it to my friend who owns a bunch of parrots.

source_doc: Great for reptile enclosure!! I got this lock for a 4x2x2 Dubia reptile enclosure for my Uromastyx. She does a lot of window surfing and I wanted to be sure she couldn't slide it open and get out. I also wanted peace of mind to prevent me from leaving the enclosure open. It was very simple to install. My husband screwed it on for me while I held it in place. Probably don't even need two people to do it. I just wanted to make sure it was exactly where I wanted it placed. It comes when two keys. We just leave the keys in it at all times. We don't have children in the home so don't need to worry about that. The price is great. I had seen some locks that were cheaper, but went with this one because I read a review stating it was longer. I keep it all the way to the last locking point. So even if the enclosure gets opened, my Uro can't get out. I have made a routine so that once I finish spot cleaning or feeding, I put the lock back on ASAP. So no more being at work suddenly wondering did I close it all the way. I would get this again. If I get another Uromastyx I will get this lock.

source_doc: Gear for Motorcycle front sprocket. I used this sprocket JT1264.17 17-tooth to swap out the front sprocket gearing of my Lifan Xpect 200cc motorcycle.  There are videos on how to do it on youtube. It's a very well-made sprocket and heavy-duty. After removing the sprocket cover and loosening the back wheel and chain I was able to take the stock 15-tooth sprocket (JT1264.15) out and install this 17-tooth with little issue.  The sprocket cover needed a little wiggling to get back on over the larger sprocket, but it worked. The result: This was a test I conducted as my own gear ratio experiment. Please consult for advice, from a mechanic professional, the manual, and the service dealer before doing this experiment. What did I gain? I was able to extend lower gears out longer and gained a comfortable (less RPM) 5th-gear speed riding the paved highway.  What did I lose by doing this swap?  I lost lower gear torque to the rear wheel.  I don't want to lose lower-gear torque. I am going to ride the bike on dirt roads and ATV trails where I need lower-gear torque for many purposes.  I won't keep the 17-tooth front sprocket in the motorcycle.  The 17-tooth sprocket looks very well made.  No manufacturing imperfections.  If you have a purpose for this front sprocket this looks like a good one to buy.  I am a DIYer.  Please consult your dealer service department for professional advice.

source_doc: Needed a mouse that has the buttons that remind me of a controller so I can switch over to mnk. First Logitech product I've purchased and I can say that it works wonders.  I was a controller player for years and when I switched to pc I continued to play controller for fps games.  I was looking for a mouse that had multiple buttons that I can use as I would on a controller and this was it.  I've changed my keybinds for all of the buttons on the side of the mouse because I was used to using my thumbs for multiple buttons anyways.  This worked out perfectly and now I can game comfortably and stick to mouse and keyboard.  This mouse was so great I bought another one for my pc while is use the first one for my laptop. Easy to setup just plug and play.

source_doc: 1mg time release lasts WAY too long, 13+ hrs after taking pill. I've done a lot of experimenting with different timing/dosage of melatonin, so I have a pretty good sense for how any given pill is affecting me. In theory, a 1mg time-release pill should be exactly what I need (more on this below). However, for me, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then induces drowsiness WAY too long. I don't feel much affect until 1-2 hours after taking it, and then it gets most intense right when I need to be waking up (about 8 hours in), and then it continues to make me sleepy for 4+ hours after that. I can definitely feel the affects lasting more than 12 hours.Before trying this tablet, I had been taking a regular melatonin pill divided into 0.5mg pieces twice per night---0.5mg before bed, and 0.5mg between sleep cycles (about 4 hours later). I had been doing this because I need help both falling asleep and staying asleep, and I only need a little melatonin to notice the affects. Taking 0.5mg twice worked well for me. Then I discovered this time-release 1mg tablet, which sounded ideal since I wouldn't have to take a second dose halfway through the night. However, this pill takes too long to kick in, and then lasts WAY too long after that (as described above).

Před vyzkoušením této tablety jsem užíval/a běžnou tabletu melatoninu rozdělenou na 0,5mg kousky dvakrát za noc --- 0,5 mg před spaním a 0,5 mg mezi spánkovými cykly (asi o 4 hodiny později). Dělal/a jsem to proto, že potřebuji pomoct jak s usínáním, tak s udržením spánku, a stačí mi jen trocha melatoninu, abych zaznamenal/a účinky. Užívání 0,5 mg dvakrát mi vyhovovalo. Pak jsem objevil/a tuto 1mg tabletu s postupným uvolňováním, což znělo ideálně, protože bych nemusel/a brát druhou dávku uprostřed noci. Tato tableta však začíná účinkovat příliš pozdě a poté působí neuvěřitelně dlouho (jak je popsáno výše).

source_doc: Needed it to sleep outside. I’m not one to rough it in the outdoors.  And I don’t function well without sleep.  So, when I decided I’d like to try testing in preparation for camping again.  I knew I’d need something like this, and I was right.I picked about the coldest night to test this out.  I first laid out my bag and crawled my over six foot self in without this mattress.  I could feel every lump under my nearly 200 pound body.  I know that if I raked up the earth under me it would’ve been better but that’s not something I was prepared to do.So, I then unscrewed the valve cap to the mattress and it inflated very quickly.  I set my bag on top and got in it again.  It was quite a difference.  But, after 10 minutes or so, the mattress had settled some.  So got out and opened the  valve again.  It sucked in more air.  That held for the rest of the night.  And I needed this comfort to feel relaxed enough to sleep.It was easy enough to deflate, just open the valve and roll it up.  The strap works great to store it.For anybody who is thinking about camping in the woods after having not done it, I think you’ll want this.

source_doc: Not the Quality I Was Expecting. Typically I love JRPG's. The ones published by Square Enix have often become some of my favorite games so I was surprised to find myself having trouble getting into this one. First off, I felt the player movement was too slow and to me it seemed pretty laggy on my PS4. I didn't feel any sense of flow in the movement or the battles and found this to be one of the few non first person games to give me motion sickness which greatly influenced my negative opinion of the game. The battles weren't anything super complicated which usually I would enjoy as I like to just enjoy the story on my first playthrough of a game. Unfortunately there was keeping me hooked on the story so I didn't feel the need to continue forcing myself to play hoping at least that would be worth it in the end. I also found the world itself didn't feel worth exploring as I wasn't finding anything notable in the treasure chests or making interesting discoveries along the way so I will admit I have not finished the game. If it were to get updated at some point I would consider trying to play again, but as of right now I don't feel it's worth playing.

source_doc: Never Ever Again Using A Cync by GE product again. Unfortunately I have run out of patience. I had a Cync hub, the app says i can now only use light bulbs and light switches. I was having a lot of trouble keeping the hub connected to the WiFi. Which is why I wanted the no-hub plug. But now I can't use the plug and the hub at the same time!?!?!So, i uninstalled the hub.Now I go to set up my plug.App says to be within 40ft. That's okay I'm within 15 ft.App failed to connect to WiFi.Move within 8ftApp connects to WiFiPlug turns off during "Adding to your home"App fails to add plug to homeApp tells me to factory reset plug and try againI tried 4 times. It never ever connected.I missed my return windowSo i decided to try it againSame issue.Contacted support.Get message saying they will reach out to me.No one ever reached out to me.Found chat help within the app.Get message saying someone will reach out to me.Now I have no hub for cync light bulbs because it won't reconnectAnd no plugs 'cause the plugs won't connect.This is the most garbage product I have ever failed to use. I should've known better, but hey at least it was worth the try, right.... No, no it wasn't.

source_doc: Pet gate. I purchased the gate to keep my 13 week old goldendoodle from accessing parts of the house. She has managed to climb over other play pens I recently purchased . I opened the box and noticed one of the free stands were broke. I reached out to the seller and within 2 to 3 days they had sent a replacement . I love this gate!!! I can even make a kennel using the wall with this thing and she has not been able to climb over it either . We have always had gates up that was you had to open and close the gate and it was aggravating when moving furniture because we would have to take those gates down .  This one I just slid around to wherever and it’s much better !! I give this. 11 star out of 10!! I will be getting another one so I can block off my dining room on both sides .  This is just one of the many ways I am using it .

source_doc: i love these diapers but they’re not perfect. i love these diapers but i can’t give them 5 stars. my baby turned 4 months old today and i just finished my first box of 68 size 3 diapers… they fit her but they’re on the verge of being to small, to the point of me being unsure wether or not i should order a size up on our next box. I had to buy a pack of pampers in the mean time and noticed a significant size difference between pampers size 3 and these size 3s, i think it’s safe to say these run small. These are also the first diapers my baby has managed to pee through and have a “blow out” with but it may just be because they’re on the smaller size. i’ll have to see how the size 4 does for her. i will continue to buy these diapers though bc they’re so stinkin cute, after 2 boys, i ended up having a surprise pregnancy that has given me a baby girl & im fully enjoying all things girly.. including these slightly overpriced, not the best functioning, but ridiculously cute diapers! i love the girly bright prints, they’re so much prettier than any of the others i’ve come across! I did try Hello Bello diapers and they’re a definite no, they’re cute but way worse on the absorbency, her skin would be visibly wet when i’d change her diaper with those!

source_doc: Cute Starburst Lights. I have wanted some of these starburst lights to add to my holiday decor.  I ordered these because they can be used outdoors and could be used for different holidays like Christmas and the 4th of July etc.  I haven’t quite managed to get them shaped like the picture but will do a better job when I am ready to hang them.  I like that they are battery operated because that will mean I can hang them just about anywhere.  My plan was to hang them in the large tree in my front yard.  The quality seems to be good but I don’t know how long they will last.  The only thing that disappointed me was the size.  They are very small.  I put a pen next to it in the photo for reference.  Based on the size, I don’t think they will work for the look I wanted, especially since the tree is so large.  I also think the price is a bit high based on the size.

source_doc: Great game. I see a lot of game reviews that really really going to a lot of detail about the game. I’m not going to do that lol. I will say that I am in my mid 40s and although I did just got a PlayStation five recently I have very much enjoyed playing PlayStation 3 games. This game was very very addictive and I enjoyed it immensely. So much so that when it was actually over, I was very disappointed. Not disappointed about the ending but just thought it was over and I couldn’t play anymore. I liked it so much that I began looking into other resident evil games as this was the first one that I had played.  I don’t really have other games to compare it to but if you are looking for a good game, Joe, Marsha self into your attention that moderately challenging I would say this is definitely the game for you

source_doc: Great bulbs! I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I was thinking I'd switch to all Kasa so I'd have just the one app on my phone.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I decided I'd just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2 minis.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  I thought it was me.  I decided last resort to try a Lumiman bulb just to eliminate a Kasa hardware factor and maybe my WiFi was an issue and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  Plus, these have no color which I rarely use on any of my smart bulbs.  So win win.  Too bad it seems there are no Lumiman plugs.  I used the second bulb in a lamp where I was using a Kasa plug.  Anyone have any recommendations to replace my other Kasa plugs?

source_doc: This does not do as it is advertised. I don't understand what people are raving about. I tried this and it did nothing. I tried this on my carpet, on my stairs, on my rugs and I didn't get any hair pulled up.  I have 2 100 pd dogs that shed profusely. I vacuum every 2 days to keep the hair up.  I know there is hair on my floors even after I vacuum because it comes up on my pants an d socks.  So this should be picking stuff up.Anyways, I am unhappy about the shipping. What happened to the shipping box?  I got my box today and it was crushed. I got several boxes today at the same time and THIS was the only box that was crushed. Like it had to be deliberately chosen to be crushed.  This is not the first time my deliveries have been crushed, ripped open, etc by Amazon or UPS. In fact, I had over $1000 in tile crushed on my last UPS order over the holiday. Which I watched UPS from my window as they threw each box of tile out of their truck and onto my pavement. So no wonder my tile was crushed. But what happened here?

source_doc: Buy a concert instead. I bought an Enya Nova plus concert uke and liked it so much I decided to get the tenor also because of the metal frets. I sent it back the day after I got it. I did like the looks of it and the fret board with those rounded frets really looked nice but the action was so high I felt like I was having to chase the strings around. I think the price is high and I didn't want to have to pay to get it set up by someone else. It's also really heavy and the neck is thinner than most of my other ukes ( I have 14). And it feels kind of slippery. It just didn't feel comfortable to play. Maybe the non electric would be better, but I didn't care for the titanium strings either so all in all I think the concert is a better deal.

source_doc: Refreshing. Here I thought we have a really nice shower head until I came across this. How silly of me that I did not know a dual shower head/spray exists. It's not complicated to install, I actually thought I had to wait for the hubby to do it but I managed to do it myself. I love, love that it has 2 places where water comes out of so that I can shower more fully and quickly. Our current shower head has only 3 settings and with the highest pressure turned on, you don't get to cover lots of areas because the spray coverage is narrow. I love that I don't have to sacrifice the water pressure to get the most body parts washed. I also love that there are 9 different settings so even the pickiest person should be able to find the most suitable setting for their liking. Usually I'd have to take off the handheld to rinse properly but with the dual feature on this shower, I don't need to do any unnecessary work. I actually feel like I'm staying in some fancy hotel, it's really nice and refreshing.

source_doc: Compact, easy to use and nice carrying case. The BOOKOO jump starter is great to have in case of you need to give yourself a boost or help someone else out with dead battery. It’s easy to use. I have not had to use this particular one yet I do keep it in my boat in case my cranking battery dies or one goes bad. I feel confident this will boost when I need it to!I have multiple BOOKOO boosters and used one with less mah to completely jump my truck. I wanted to test it out so I unhooked my battery completely from my truck so it would be as if my battery were COMPLETELY dead and I hooked up the BOOKOO booster and it successfully started my 5.4 l pickup multiple times! I didn’t test how many times it could jump without having original battery even hooked up but I did at least three times and I know it had mor juice left. I was just happy with those results so I unhooked it and recharged it and put in in vehicle for use when needed. I now keep one in every vehicle we own.I’ve also jumped a 4 wheeler with the BOOKOO booster no problem.

source_doc: Worth every penny. I was skeptical that this would work as well as people have said but we had a small grease fire and I decided to give it a try since entering else had cleaned the stove very well. I had read it is best to smear it on and let it sit for a few minutes before scrubbing so I smeared it all over the stove and under the lid making it really thick in the bad areas. Almost everything wiped clean and I only needed a little elbow grease in a couple spots. Even the spots I had to scrub didn't need much effort. As you can see in the pictures that the stove is spotless! Next came the metal drip pan under the burner that caught fire. Included is a before and after picture. I did two rounds of smearing it on, letting it sit for about 5 minutes and scrubbing. As you can see it cleaned most of the burn off! I am amazed. Im sure if I continued a couple more times it would have removed the remainder (but honestly this was good enough for me as im going to cover it with foil anyway). I am amazed and highly recommend this for the tough jobs! Oh also, I didn't notice a strong offensive scent and I was elbows deep in this stuff.

source_doc: Pumps well and came with 21 mm as well. I really enjoy using this hands free pump in addition to my other pumps I have from last couple of years. I just had my 3rd baby and hands free is the way to go if you have little ones. It's easy to use and cleaning is not hard, basically same as other pumps with cups. I got this because I wanted to have other options when pumping middle of the night. Also, I didn't see it mention in the listing but 21mm came with it as well.As for the cons, I noticed the actual pumps on top falls off and is not as secure as I would have liked. I wished it had a bit of a screw on so it would remain in place. Sometimes when I angle it to put them on my breasts, the pump (top) parts comes off. Also, I am not sure if they sell the actual cup for this pump but it would be a good idea since there are special and spectra cups would not fit here. The noise level seems a bit louder than my willow 3.0 but  since they work fine, I am pretty much used to it now.

source_doc: Meh. I was really excited to get this car charger adapter for my spectra. Well, my excitement was short lived once I started using it. Once I plugged it in and turner my pump on, I could clearly hear the motor of the pump struggling. This adapter doesn't provide enough power to give my pump what it needs to function properly. As a result I need to pump longer, on higher settings/vaccum and my output is less than half of what I usually can get. I use this once I day while at work on my lunch break and as soon as I get home I have to pump again because I still have milk left that needs to be extracted. Is this adapter great for relieving pressure- yes. Would I recommend it for a reliable addition to your pump for every day use- that would be a no. Other than that, it's a sturdy item that came shortly after it was ordered and packaging was nice and cute.

source_doc: Very easy install. I purchased this timer from a local store, just because I was afraid it wouldn't work and could take back. With that being said, this 62 year old female who is not an electrician had no trouble installing this switch. It helped that whoever did the original wiring had the box nice and neat. The only thing I had to figure out was which black wire was the load wire that you connect to the red on switch. Planned on using my tester, but it no longer worked. So I did the next thing I saw when googled. It was the wire that came in from top of box. Wasn't sure I was right, but figured if I was wrong all I had to do was change around. Turned power back on and it worked!!! The worse part was connecting the white to my whites, there were a lot wrapped up together, but I managed. Now for the operation of switch. The buttons are really tiny so not the easiest to push, but I use 40 minutes most of the time for after showering. Have it set so just push the big rocker switch and it starts on 40. You can easily override by pushing any other button. So didn't get 5 stars because of the button size, but I am otherwise very happy with this switch, better than leaving fan on all day cause forgot to shut off.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Amazing customer service. I bought this headset for my new remote job. The first headset I received, I had trouble with the microphone not working. I did all of the troubleshooting my computer told me. Then I contacted the seller directly. They also had me do some troubleshooting. Next, they asked me to send them pictures of the model number and serial number off of the box. Once sent, they asked me to try some more troubleshooting. Finally, they said they would send me a replacement and there was no need to send back the faulty headset. I was totally shocked. I had already packed the faulty headset to ship it back. They were very quick with their responses. There was no delay in responding. Then I received my replacement headset in two days after shipping. The new headset works wonderfully. They are so comfortable and I love the sound quality. Tonight I will be using them for the first time for class. So I will be able to find out the quality of the microphone. I highly recommend this product and this company.

source_doc: SHARP. I ordered these scissors because the reviews were good and said they were sharp. They are very sharp I ordered the lefty.  Just a heads up to anyone who is just getting started in grooming your dog with little or no experience take extra care in using these it is extremely easy to cut yourself which I did, the dog wasn't the most cooperative and I got my finger.  I couldn't believe I did that, I thought I cut the dog but luckily I got myself.  Amateur mistake I know but I am an amateur.  My hats off to the professionals out there that do this everyday you surely earn your money!  To all my fellow amateurs good luck and be careful.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a"

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Was really hopeful but my hope burnt out. I bought these for my truck cargo lights as well as my door lights.  When I first put them in I was amazed at how bright they were.  It was amazing and I was excited.  Then about 2 weeks after having them in I noticed one of the cargo lights started blinking.  I thought it might be the wiring in the truck but then shortly after I noticed the other light started doing the same thing.  I had my little daughter push on the brake to see about the brake light and it seemed to still be okay.  So I took 2 of the bulbs out of the doors and put it back in the cargo lights.  It was about 2 days later that both of those started to struggle as well.  Then I noticed the one in the brake light started to flicker as well.  I was so hopeful for these bulbs and am quite saddened that they stopped working so quickly.  I would understand it if was 1 bulb then it could be a fluke but I now have 6 bulbs total that aren't working any longer or flickering really bad.  Thankfully they weren't too expensive so it didn't hurt too bad when I threw them away.

source_doc: Wish I got this fan sooner! This fan was a little bit larger than I had expected. It is still a small handheld fan but definitely bigger than the ones we used to take to theme parks when we were younger.The battery life seems pretty decent. As I was trying it out I kept it running in my kitchen while I was cooking and it ran until I turned it off with no decrease in the air flow.I love the fact that you can bend the legs to wrap around and hook onto things so it’s pretty versatile where you can use it. When I first turned it on, I thought the power was pretty low, but there are actually three settings, and the speed does turn up.I wish I would’ve had this last summer for my newborn son at the time when we went to a theme park! This truly works great and I am excited to hook it onto the stroller this summer for walks, or even set it up outside while the kids play. Not only was a well packaged, but I love the fact that it is rechargeable and it really does seem like it’s of decent quality.

source_doc: Great for Gross Garden Feet! I take baths instead of showers, and I just never cared for bath mats. But when I saw this one is machine washable and has the foot massage nubs and rectangular soft nubby foot-cleaning area, I decided to get it. I work out in the garden a lot, sometimes in clogs that get red-clay muddy (along with my feet!) and sometimes barefooted (even worse), and I can't believe how easy it is to just run a little water into the tub, sit on the side, and scrub/clean/massage my feet. I don't even have to take my clothes off. Easy to drain and rinse off with a sprayer, and then I can fill the tub with water and epsom salts for a nice soothing soak. I even enjoy the feel of the nubs on my butt! LOL! It remains to be seen if this will stain from red clay over time and not come clean, but I don't care about that. I'm the only one who has to look at it.Be sure to follow the directions for flattening it and sticking it down. I put mine on the bathroom floor with a bottle of vinegar on top of the most-curled end for a day or so before using. If you have a smooth floor, you could even use it as a floor mat in front of your toilet so you can massage your feet every time you have to go.

Hodně pracuji na zahradě, někdy v dřevácích, které se zablátí od červeného jílu (společně s mými chodidly!), a někdy naboso (což je ještě horší), a nemohu uvěřit, jak snadné je prostě napustit trochu vody do vany, sednout si na okraj a nohy si vydrhnout, očistit a namasírovat. Nemusím se ani svlékat. Snadno se vypouští a oplachuje sprchovou hlavicí, a pak můžu vanu napustit vodou s epsomskou solí pro příjemnou, uklidňující koupel. Dokonce se mi líbí i to, jak ty výstupky cítím na zadku! LOL! Teprve se uvidí, zda se časem od červeného jílu nezašpiní tak, že už nepůjde vyčistit, ale to je mi jedno. Jsem jediný/á, kdo se na ni musí dívat. Určitě postupujte podle návodu k narovnání a přichycení. Já jsem tu svou položil/a na podlahu v koupelně s lahví octa na tom nejvíce zkrouceném konci asi den před použitím. Pokud máte hladkou podlahu, mohl/a byste ji dokonce použít jako předložku před toaletu, abyste si mohl/a masírovat nohy pokaždé, když si musíte odskočit.

source_doc: Reliable, versatile and an extra 9 string... Decades ago I had to re-learn a new playing style due to a slight HAND-icap. I have found that hybrid sets work best for me. In this time, I have tried many brands, materials and gauges, and still, I keep falling back to Rotosound Nickel Hybrid Electric Guitar String sets (9 11 16 26 36 46). I have a couple fallback brands that are very good...but this is where I land these days. As long as I keep them Clean, they're bright, they maintain their tone over time, and stay in tune. (and you get an extra high E string)To clarify, I'm not a guitar or string snob and I'm not rich, but maybe I may have experience that might be useful to others. That said, my baseline for strings is that <I use the strings I can afford and that get the job done.>I don't have expensive guitars but I have had several for 20 years or longer...and I know how to adjust the neck, string height, properly install the strings on the posts and make sure there's no hang-ups in the nut, yatta yatta. In short, with as much bending and hammering strings I do they, for the most part, stay in tune.

 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a"

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

hypo_0: Spolehlivé, univerzální a jedna 9. struna navíc... Před desítkami let jsem se musel/a kvůli mírnému handicapu ruky znovu učit nový styl hry. Zjistil/a jsem, že mi nejlépe vyhovují hybridní sady. Za tu dobu jsem vyzkoušel/a mnoho značek, materiálů a tlouštěk, a přesto se stále vracím k sadám hybridních niklových strun pro elektrickou kytaru Rotosound (9 11 16 26 36 46). Mám několik záložních značek, které jsou velmi dobré... ale u těchto v poslední době končím. Dokud je udržuji čisté, jsou jasné, dlouho si udržují svůj tón a ladí (a navíc dostanete jednu strunu e navíc). Abych to upřesnil/a, nejsem žádný kytarový ani strunový snob a nejsem bohatý/á, ale možná mám zkušenosti, které by mohly být užitečné pro ostatní. Nicméně moje základní pravidlo pro struny je, že <používám struny, které si mohu dovolit a které splní svůj účel>. Nemám drahé kytary, ale několik jich vlastním už 20 let nebo déle... a vím, jak seřídit krk, výšku strun, jak správně namotat struny na kolíky a ujistit se, že nikde nedrhnou v nultém pražci, a tak dále a tak dále. Zkrátka, i při tom všem vytahování strun a příklepech, které dělám, většinou drží ladění.

I highly recommend you won't be disappointed!

source_doc: Easy to set up, a bit complicated to get full measurements. Since I am spending more time in my basement, I decided I wanted to know more about the radon level there. Several years ago, when the house was rented, a one month radon test was done that indicated above standards radon level, so a radon mitigation system was put in. Lately I have been spending more time in the basement, so I decided I wanted more info on the radon levels. There are less expensive radon monitors, but because of the reputation and history of this company, it is the one I chose. Setup is simple, though you don't get immediate readings for radon (though you do for temperature and humidity. You have to wait 3 days to get radon values. When they started showing up on the monitor, the levels increased over the next few days, but were in the safe range. Since I have a science background, I also wanted to see the detailed maeasurements. Airthings has both an app and a web site (called the Airthings Dashboard). Both are needed to get all the information from the meter. The app gives 1, 7 and 30 day average values, the Dashboard gives graphs over various periods. Since I don't have any other monitors to compare with I can't say how this compares in accuracy or ease of use to other systems, but this seems to be working well and indicates my radon mitigation system is working.

source_doc: Bought for dog chew toy. I have a Australian Cattle Dog AKA "Blue Healer" puppy we got a couple months ago. He will shred through any dollar store toy you give him in a matter of days and I had read another person's review with the same kind of dog that he gave his dog a broken Diaphragm and the dog has been chewing it for over 10 years so for $8 bucks I think it was when I bought it, I said what the heck.Got the thing in the mail and the first thing I noticed was that it gets stuck because of the shape of it if lands with the round part up instead of landing like a dish shape with the edge accessible so I cut it in half and gave half of it to my Father In Law for his dog. So far they both love them and even after ripping and shredding at it, my healer hasn't even scratched it now after weeks of use and seems to really like it I assume because it's similar feeling to flesh. Anyway for the price and what I bought it for it's a great deal. Not sure how it'd be for it's designated use since I have nothing to test it for in that regard but it is heavy duty so I would imagine it would work well for that as well.

source_doc: Beautiful. I love this little bowl and lid!  Two things I wish the makers could change, though.  One is that there is a little crease around the lid underneath.  I wish that was not there due to the difficulty to clean it.  Second, I wish the knob was easier to grasp and hold on the lid.  When this bowl is hot, you have to use a potholder to remove the lid. I have tried to figure out how I can get the bowl out of the microwave, burning hot, rather than using potholders on each side.  I love it for its looks, but I want to use it, too.OK, sad news.  I could not find any way to remove the lid when it was very hot.  I tried gloves, mit's, and little pinchers.  Nothing worked.  I sadly sent it back.

source_doc: I don't game, but this is a great mouse for CAD and every day use. I like it. I CAD and do, like, normal computer stuff for work and personal stuff. Cool mouse. For CAD I map the two side buttons to whichever button is the orbit/pan modifier key, which has been pretty useful for switching between CAD programs. The other button I use as the esc key.I only wish I could pair it with more than one dongle so I can use the mouse on my desktop at home AND at work with wifi instead of bluetooth.

source_doc: Always Have Loved Maple Necks/Fingerboards. I dont "get" alot of these reviews.  I've been playing forty years and have had at least five dozen guitars running the gamut of pricing.  You never know with a guitar, they all are different.  Personally, i have always liked maple necks and fretboards.  It has a soft, easy to play feel.  If it doesn't feel right, NOTHING else matters.  This guitar feels good and makes it easy and fun again, the same can't be said of plenty of guitars I've owned over the years.  I've had cheaper guitars feel great and really expensive guitars feel like crap.  As long as it feels good, i can get a good sound by using pedals.  I was very pleasantly surprised.  The tuning is a slight issue but stretch them good and/or put a new set on it.  The finish I think is great, too.  I like it so much i am going to get another.  That'll be a fun comparison.  Like i said, you never know.  I think it's a crapshoot.  I don't trust so-called luthiers, either.  I've had plenty of guitars come back less-playable.  These were well-respected people.  It's either playable or not.  I like this little thing.

source_doc: It seems to do the job well... I have an existing pedal board powered by Zuma Strymon; I am using this Strich to power the pedals I have in my studio (that are not on the pedal board.)  I am not an electrical engineer, yet I do know the differences between 110v and 220v - how can this pedal supply automatically differentiate the two?  There are no switches to for this setting.  Additionally, I do have one 24v pedal for this power supplier; I must plug in the 24v's transformer into the polarized outlets on the top of this unit.  So far, so good, but...This unit is very light in weight, yet every output had an independent kill-switch to prevent overload.  The outlets on top can power up to a 600v demand. How???As I ease into using this, I am acutely aware - sniffing the air for that burning electrical appliance smell, keeping a headphone partially on one ear so I can hear transformer buzzing (within the unit or through the monitors), and even touching it every so often to feel if it is overheating.  Again, so far, so good, for about 30 hours of use.Regardless of the mysteries, I am impressed thus far.  If it blows up, I will let you know!

source_doc: I don’t think this product was tested. My Indie is drinking gallons of water in her old age so I ordered the 4 gallon size to keep up. Chewy had one cheaper but I liked the idea of filtered water for my dog. At first fill I did notice the water bowl wasn’t really filling with water well. My dog would drink and it would not refill the bowl. So I took the filter out which helped…. But wait I paid more for this bc I wanted the filter! I had accidentally ordered two of these so I had given one to a friend for his houseful of furry paw friends so I called him to see if he had the same issue. He said he did until he modified the holes to be larger so the water could flow better. So, as suggested I drilled more holes to increase the water flow. It worked, I guess. But the water never fills past about 1/2 inch and my indie prefers a deeper bowl. I don’t think this product was tested before production. I might return it but unlikely they’ll give me a refund since I’ve now added 5 more holes to it!

source_doc: Secure and comfortable. I like these better than my name-brand ones I use for my cable machine at home and the ones available at the box gym I used to go to. The reason I like them better is because they are way more secure. The ones I have are all velcro and if you are hooked onto a heavy cable then the velcro has come off before. These ones do not entirely depend on the velcro because they are made with the two metal rings that close and then you clip to the machine with those. Much better and safer. They are padded so they are comfortable. The only thing I don't like is that I can't get the circumference small enough to tightly wrap my ankle so they are loose (I have small ankles). However, that's not too big a deal I still prefer these over the other ones. Additionally, they did come with a chemical smell which I do not like but I will leave them out in the open to air out. If it doesn't dissipate I will report back, but I anticipate that the smell will dissipate.

hypo_0: Bezpečné a pohodlné. Tyto mám radši než své značkové, které používám doma na kladkovém stroji, i než ty, které byly k dispozici v posilovně, kam jsem dříve chodil/a. Důvod, proč je mám radši, je ten, že jsou mnohem bezpečnější. Ty, které mám, jsou celé na suchý zip, a když jste připojení na těžkou kladku, tak se suchý zip už dříve rozepnul. Tyto nejsou zcela závislé na suchém zipu, protože jsou vyrobené se dvěma kovovými kroužky, které se zavřou, a za ty se pak připnete ke stroji. Mnohem lepší a bezpečnější. source_doc: MICROPHONE COMPLETELY UNDETECTABLE. Microphone is completely undetectable out the box! headset itself is perfectly fine, audio sounds real good but the microphone won’t work at all. I was enjoying the headset for a like 30 mins until I joined a party and I was wondering why the mic wasn’t working at all no matter what I tried on my xbox so I plugged it into my ps4 controller but same problem, but the ps4 lets u switch your mic input and output and for output device it shows the headset but for device input the headset wouldn’t pop up that’s when I figured the microphone was undetectable. So I plugged it into my pc and open microphones in control panel and it would pop up either.. I ended up watching videos for 2 hours until I gave up then contacted Amazon support but they count find a solution so now I’m returning this. I feel like it was just the one I got cause no one else in the reviews had my same problem that I know of, I would order it again but Its Saturday and it comes on Tuesday, If I do end up getting it again I’ll update this depending on I get a headset that works this time (her son).

source_doc: Great Faucet - everything else?  Meh. I wanted a Heavy Duty utility sink for the basement.  I liked the look of this. The only positive I can come up with is - the faucet is great - I hope it lasts.  The tub comes with clear and urgent directions on how to assemble it without breaking the tub.  I followed those instructions to the T and the tub broke in three of the four leg attachment locations.  Clearly a bad design.  It's ok though - the faucet seems great so I went ahead and continued the install with the broken - yet still functional - tub.  The p-trap and drain plumbing supplied is hard and brittle.  I needed to cut the drain pipe down about two inches to fit the existing drain - drain pipe shattered not once but twice while cutting it.  Thankfully I was replacing a utility sink so I could use the old plumbing pieces.  There is almost no backsplash on this unit  - so I'm still trying to figure out how I will secure it to the wall - as securing the legs won't help because of the broken tub.  I'm wishing I kept my old tub and just replaced the faucet.  Still looking for a better solution.

source_doc: Nope. I've never used a product like this before, so for all I know they're all like this, but my overall experience was not a positive one.  I tried the Lavender first, which is a hot pink disk, and as soon as I turned the shower on what i got was hot pink coloring all over the shower floor, soaking into the tile grout.  (As instructed, I had placed it out of the way of the main shower flow.)  I was hoping it would all rinse away, but it didn't so I ended up having to scrub the floor.  Not exactly the relaxing spa-type experience I was hoping for.  On top of that, there was  virtually no aroma to the aromatherapy.  The scents of my shampoo, conditioner, and body wash were all stronger, though none of them are that strong themselves.  I was really surprised.  When I was all done--hair dried, etc.--I did notice a hint of lavender in the shower, but nothing while I was actually showering.  All in all it was definitely not worth the magenta mess.

source_doc: Amazing mouse! I bought second hand and after a reset it works great! I own 4 mice, 2 cheapos a Corsair harpoon and this dark core. Only going to compare the corsair mice. The harpoon is light and easy to use. The the scroll wheel is very easy to use. I would rate this mouse excellent if I had never used the dark core RGB. The dark core is heavier which I actually like. And it FEELS so smooth I’m guessing that’s due to the 18,000 dpi optical sensor. The RGB IMO is awesome. I have it set to match my monitor or whatever is on display. The scroll wheel on the other hand is stiff. I find my finger sliding on it constantly. I have to adjust the pressure at what I use to move the scroll wheel. On the harpoon it’s effortless.I am using both wings on the dark core and I enjoy resting my fingers on them. It’s a nice feel/grip.Overall I love this mouse and it’s working great for me. Unfortunately I made the mistake and got them on qi charging version but I like it so much I don’t want to return
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Úžasná myš! Koupil/a jsem ji z druhé ruky a po resetování funguje skvěle! Vlastním 4 myši, 2 levné kousky, Corsair Harpoon a tuto Dark Core. Budu porovnávat pouze myši od Corsairu. Harpoon je lehká a snadno se používá. Kolečko se ovládá velmi lehce. Tuto myš bych hodnotil/a jako vynikající, kdybych nikdy nepoužil/a Dark Core RGB. Dark Core je těžší, což mi ve skutečnosti vyhovuje. A působí tak hladce, což je podle mě způsobeno optickým senzorem s rozlišením 18 000 DPI. RGB podsvícení je podle mého názoru úžasné. Mám ho nastavené tak, aby ladilo s mým monitorem nebo s tím, co se zrovna zobrazuje. Kolečko je na druhou stranu tuhé. Zjišťuji, že mi po něm prst neustále klouže. Musím upravovat tlak, kterým kolečkem otáčím. Na Harpoonu to jde bez námahy. Na Dark Core používám obě boční opěrky a vyhovuje mi, že si na ně mohu odložit prsty. Je to příjemný pocit/úchop. Celkově tuto myš miluji a funguje mi skvěle. Bohužel jsem udělal/a chybu a pořídil/a si verzi bez Qi nabíjení, ale líbí se mi natolik, že ji nechci vracet.

source_doc: Great for the price. I found myself DIYing a new stereo install in a 2015 Miata.  The Mazda engineers seem to have intentionally made everything difficult to get to, or super tight to work around for anyone with big hands.  I ordered this because I don't forsee myself doing much of this sort of thing, so I didn't want to invest in a "I do this for a living" quality product.The plastic is kind of soft, so I don't imagine these would manage to survive much more than a dozen or so cars worth of stereo installs, but for the money it sure as heck beats the more durable options.I didn't even realize it comes with valve stem caps when I ordered it.  That seems like an odd inclusion, but I suppose if I ever need to fill up with air at the gas station and manage to forget to put the cap back on, at least I have spares (enough to derp every wheel twice!)If you're looking for something quick and dirty to accomplish a task, and not looking for something to earn a living with, these are just fine (and heck, for all I know the more expensive ones are just as durable, and I owe these guys an apology)

source_doc: This little tool is fantastic! True confession: I have horrible calluses and cracked heels. They don't bother me during the summer but as soon as winter hints, I start hobbling around, wondering why I never deal with it. The reason that I haven't dealt with them is that using a pumice stone has always made it worse.I got this kit because I thought it might help. I was so afraid that it would do more harm than good, that I avoided even hoping the box. I just found my courage.It's a wonder tool! First of all, it weighs next to nothing. There are two separate roller heads. I think that the rougher one would be too much for my feet in the current state but the smoothe one is perfect. I used it gently and felt the skin before and after and it was so much smoother. I think that if I don't over do it but use it consistently, I might be able to get my feet in summer shape. I'll consider it my New Years' Resolution.

source_doc: Not at all happy with this drum set After a Year! I got this to practice at home so I would not bother anyone in the house a year ago. At first it was great, but as the year went on, it was not so much a great experience. After the first month, the Hi Hat doesn't sense every strike. After about a month of waiting on the warranty, I get the new cymbal. Works alright again for about 3 months. Then the pad of the bass drum tears. So I go through warranty again, still about a month of waiting. I get the new skin for the bass pad, but I realize now I have a sensitivity problem that I had with the hi hat, is the same with the bass drum. So I have to contact again. After waiting again for the Kid Pad. I'm happy to play for about 1 month before the snare issues arrive. Now the warranty coverage is over and the snare is sounding like I'm hitting the rim the whole time. I am not happy with how many issues I've had with this electric drum set. It's too bad because Alesis is a strong brand, sadly, this drum set just had too many issues to praise. I could be mean and just give it 1 star, but I want to give my honest opinion on what I experienced and how I feel it should be rated.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Well made pullover for someone with an athletic build. I ordered this pullover because I was intrigued by Tom Brady's name attached to the item. I didn't know he was endorsing a line of athletic wear. I figured if Brady was willing to add his name to the product, it must be high quality. The pullover is indeed well made with quality materials. It is extremely lightweight, and great for moderate temperatures around 50 degrees. I am in my mid-50s, 5'9" and about 170. I run outside about 4 times a week and do strength training 2 times a week. I am certainly not an elite athlete, and I find myself walking up steep hills these days when out on a run. Usually a large is about the right size or just a little big on me. The large Brady pullover I ordered was definitely meant for someone with Brady's athletic build rather than my middle-aged build. There isn't any give when getting the item pulled over my head, so it isn't the easiest pullover to put on. However, while the fit is snug, once on it worked great for a warmer than usual January run. It kept the wind away and was surprisingly flexible for as difficult as it was to pull on. I would order again, but I would order a larger size.

source_doc: Excellent guitar for beginner intermediate, minimal setup was required. The guitars fit and finish was perfect.  The fret ends were polished and smooth, the action was fine, there were no blemishes.  Upon tuning the guitar, I noticed the intonation was slightly off. Upon further examination, I found the one “holiday” , the setup man went on.  The bridge was pulling up, when the guitar was tuned.  I took off the back plate, the tension screws were tensioned too loosely and unevenly.  Two minutes I had it sorted, and this fixed the intonation.  I have included a picture of my practice setup. It included a Pock Rock, headphone amp, and effects processor(approx 40 bucks on Amazon), an old Fire tablet I had lying around, hooked into the line in, on the Pock Rock, and a pair of Vintage Sansui head phones.  I have a behringer ppa200(also available on Amazon approx 350 on Amazon), that I also use for my karaoke/movie night, senior charity,when I want to Amp the setup(also through the Pock Rock).  I know quite a few chords, but haven’t played in years.  Even though my next door neighbor says I’m not loud, and don’t bother her, the majority of time, I play with the headphones.  This little setup, is loads of fun, and I’m really enjoying it.

source_doc: Very messy.  Needs a better applicator. This mascara went on really wet and clumpy.  I had to grab a cotton swab and use it multiple times to clean up around my lashes.  I feel like the applicator was partly to blame.  I couldn’t get good separation with this style of applicator.  The bristles weren’t very deep or thick.  Luckily, I had a spare applicator that I pulled out and used to clean up and separate my lashes.  Once I cleaned up the mess, my lashes were still a bit clumpy, but looked okay.  This mascara does add length to my lashes.Typically I need to reapply mascara at the end of my work day - and it smudges below my eyes.  With this mascara (if I applied it heavily), I had no smudging and I still had good coverage up to 12 hours after applying it.  If I apply the mascara lightly (in order to control the wet and clumping), it doesn’t make it through the day.  Heavier coverage lasts longer.  I did have flaking towards the end of the day.  It cleans up with soap and water well.

source_doc: Brilliant self tightening design. I bought these chains to "keep in the truck" so I would be legal. Didn't think I would need them with 4x4 and snow tires. Sure enough, ended up in a blizzard leaving Yosemite national park while towing a trailer. Roads got really bad, really quick.  I pulled these out and was pleased with how easily they went on. Basically there's a notch for where your tire meets the ground, so you just slip it around. No pulling forward or backwards.  The chains weren't perfectly centered when I put them on, so I just drove 100 yards down the road and rechecked them. Sure enough, they have self centered and the tightening mechanism had taken up the slack on its own.  They stayed nice and tight and didn't slap around as we drove. Removal was ALMOST as easy as installing.  I was genuinely impressed.  I will be more likely to slap these on early when conditions deteriorate now that I know how easy they are. I will be buying a set for any car I own in the future.

source_doc: I didn't think I'd like this as much as I do! We bought this for my daughter when she was a little under 7 months and I have to admit, I love using it and she loves being in it. We actually seatbelt her into the cushion which gives her some more stability which allows here to reach for the toys I have attached easily without losing her balance since she isn't perfect at sitting yet. I have a Samsung S21 Note and it fits perfectly fine in the phone pocket and I can still use the touch screen while it is in there. I usually put on a YouTube video of nursery rhymes and she loves to have it going while looking around. The pouch it folds into works perfectly for me to throw my keys, hand sanitizer, toy wipes and wallet into since she is where I used to put my purse. Then when. You're done it literally just folds up and goes right back into the pouch. I don't even take the toys off! I have put this all together while holding her myself too when I shopped just her and me. I would definitely recommend. I got the pink elephant one and it is super cute.
