source_doc: Not the best for spices. I bought these to store some of my dry spices however I noticed that the jars had a strong chemical smell when opening them. I did not want these chemicals to seep into my spices. After a bit of tinkering with the jars I realized that the chemical smell was coming from the white styrofoam seals in the lids—once I took them out the jars smelled fine. I choose these jars specifically because they screw shut unlike some others jars that just have a cork/plunger type lid. For my purposes since I use my spices frequently and I don’t live in a very humid climate I don’t need the airtight seals which I took out. With that in mind this was a good purchase for me however it may not be for others who are looking to store spices.Edit————After removing the chemical smelling seals that came with these jars I decided to buy rubber gasket seals online to replace them. Cheap and very effective and now my jars are air and water tight. Unfortunate that I had to go to this extra step but these jars are nice enough for me to go the extra mile.

source_doc: Is not anti-scratch. I don't like anything about this set. There weren't any instructions and I thought it was pretty difficult to put on because of how solid it is. Once the case is on, it doesn't fit. I was worried about scratching my deck or breaking off one of the triggers while pulling the case over the top.I tried to take photos of as many gaps as possible. The solid screen cover is so tight that it rubs across the screen when closing. That is the opposite of its purpose and I'm glad I put the screen protector on first. At first, I thought I may have put it on wrong. Now I don't think so. You can tell in the photo of L1/L2 that I didn't have room to wrap the case around L1. Even if I did it didn't feel safe to try further.If it were to fit, I don't think it would matter. The edges around the triggers are uncomfortable. I wouldn't say sharp, but they could feel that way after a bit of rubbing.I took the case off right after taking the photos and will not be using it again.

source_doc: A lifesaver. I suffer from migraines quite often and I don't know how I would survive without this. There are days where I literally can't open my eyes until I put this on and then I can actually be productive. It is a bit tight for my head, but while I have a migraine, that is actually very helpful. Sometimes I don't pull it down over my eyes and it is still quite helpful. Personally, I need to let it warm up for a minute before I put it over my eyes anyways because if I put it over my eyes immediately, it can make me feel like I have brain freeze. If I were you, I would consider buying two of them, so that when one of them warms up and is no longer helpful, you can just replace it with the one thats still in your freezer.

source_doc: Good Keyboard for a Beginner or Novice. this is a nice keyboard for beginner.  It's not quite the full piano keyboard size but better than a 66 key offered on some.  I am an adult beginner, and this works fine.  There are way more bells and whistles then I need and the manual that comes with it is thick, I hope to get to it someday.  I have noticed that the keyboards and the song playback option are just a bit off.  One or the other is sharp or flat by just a little so it is a bit annoying.  I went with Yamaha because of the name and the PSR-EW310 is near the bottom of their price range, and I am glad I bought it.  It does not include a stand or a bench but the small table I have it on works fine for now, no sustain peddle either.  I did buy some headphones because I live in an apartment and so glad I did because it helps shut out other noises and I can concentrate better.  Yes, I'm a little ADD.

source_doc: Please save yourself the trouble and just skip this one! I can't make this up, I had to buy this headset 4 times before it actually shipped. Not just Amazon, I tried GameStop as well, twice. It didn't ship out until about 2 weeks and when I FINALLY got it I find out all these headsets are BROKEN! Always check Reddit first!!! You can't trust ppl on Amazon or YouTube because they're paid to LIE! I use a stealth 700 and it's not perfect but atleast it WORKS. Not only was the mic completely trash out the box, and I mean like did not work, constant buzz, voice going in and out. I tried messing with settings, restarting it, using the app on PC, Mobile, and Xbox. None fixed the issue. But also I must mention the awful sound connectivity as well. When you speak into the headset the audio starts going in and out and sometimes completely out, you cant hear your game, your music, or your party. The colors are pretty but not at the cost of being able to actually USE the damn thing! What a joke, I really did expect better of Razor. If you like razor I suggest you bite the bullet and use a wired headset. The Kaira Pro is completely unusable and a huge waste of money, will be returning it shortly.

source_doc: Refused to connect. I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I thought I would try to make everything just Kasa.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I thought, well, I'll just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And, guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  So I ordered another Lumiman bulb and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  2 stars is for the old plugs that actually worked.

source_doc: Weak Sandalwood - Not For My Sensitive Skin. I shave my beard but leave my mustache alone.  I have never used beard oil before.  I just apply whatever facial cream is left on my hand to my mustache.  So decided to try this.The bottles are small and as per the label, each one contains 20ml of various oils.  I uncap each one and use my sensitive nose to check the fragrance.  I love sandalwood soap so the first one I checked was the one in the middle - Sandalwood.  The fragrance of this is disappointing.  I can smell a slight presence of sandalwood but there is also something added that turned my nose off.  The unscented is neutral.  I prefer the chemical composition of cedar wood, vanilla, and sweet orange.Each bottle has a built-in dropper.  The dropper design is not pipette tipped but with a small circular tip.  I guess this is their way of measuring a dab of oil.I dropped a small quantity of sandalwood on my skin to test.  I felt a warm sensation at the beginning.  After a minute I felt a need to scratch my skin.  Hmmm, something in this oil my skin is complaining for.  I will not use this for my mustache since the skin around my lips is more sensitive.I cut my hair short and sometimes I can see that it needs moisturizer.  I may repurpose this beard oil for that.

source_doc: Cleans well, no water splashes. This mop cleans well. I wasn't sure if water would be splashing all over with the spinning of the mop head but it doesn't, it is contained in the bucket. I like that this comes with so many microfiber mop heads so I can keep some in rotation until I wash the used ones. It is fairly simple to use once assembled, you just have to flip the lever one way when you are mopping and the opposite way when you are spinning the mop. There is no foot pedal like on the original spin mop, this one works by pushing on the metal pole after you flip the lever to rotate the head that you put in place in the metal basket. The basket, mop head and handle spin and the water splashes out of the holes in the basket into the pail. The only thing I don't like is that as I was mopping I kept scraping the floor with the mop as the microfiber yarns moved to the side, I think they need to be a little shorter and fuller because I don't like the feel or sound of that. It also comes with a scrubber brush that you can attach, instead of the microfiber head, which I have not tried yet.This mop cleans well and I like the color too.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: Not good on my thick, curly hair. This hair mask didn’t work for me. I followed the instructions, first washing my hair then coating with mask and letting sit for ten minutes. Already when applying, I thought it felt like it wasn’t going to provide enough conditioning to my hair. When I rinsed, I was certain. When I tried to comb my hair, it was as if I hadn’t conditioned my hair at all.To be fair, I have thick, curly, shoulder-length hair that requires a lot of conditioner every time I shampoo, but I thought that’s what this product was supposed to be. Instead, I had to put leave-in conditioner on my hair just to be able to comfortably comb thru it.Maybe if you have drastically different hair than I do, this will work for you, but for me, it just didn’t provide much noticeable benefit.

source_doc: Really hoped to love it. Install slightly difficult. I have a 2014 Nissan Sentra SR and this is not my first time replacing a cabin air filter. I was really hoping to love this product due to the longer life and activated carbon, but I'm hesitant to purchase another one.I may have received a defective filter, but the filter I received was not easy to install. I had to really force and maneuver it in the filter compartment. I struggled with it so much that I accidentally ripped the little tag that is supposed to help pull the filter back out later. Hopefully I won't have too much trouble taking it out when it's time to replace it again. I haven't decided if I plan to purchase this again when it is time for another replacement. If I do I will update my review on whether or not the 2nd one was just as difficult. For time comparison.... It took me half the time, if not less, to replace my engine air filter and air intake hose than the cabin air filter.

source_doc: Finally I can see the road. After driving around at night with old foggy zero visibility headlamps for the last ten years, I came across these. Wasn't really interested in high-tech LED lights as they are not in character with my truck. I found the only hard part about installing these was the lower screw positioning which is right behind the bumper, a real pain to get to...  So I improvised I drilled a one-inch hole into the bumper as you can see in the picture, a service hatch, to get to the screw which I will stick a plug into later.  Maybe I got lucky they seem to be in the exact spot, light-wise, so I have not needed to adjust them.  The only issue with them is because they are not two-part lenses like the stock type if you have to remove the indicator bulb you will have to basically remove the headlamp screws and pull the headlamp forward, which I discovered when I noticed the indicator bulb was out. It is also a bit of a tight squeeze to get the headlamps in. Overall for the money, you cannot beat them. And I would buy it again if needed.

source_doc: It turns off, Glitchy, connection keeps cutting off... Bought it about a year and 6 months ago. I first started noticing that the headset would randomly lose connection and or it would turn off. Usually I would turn it back on and that would solve the problem. This usually happened when I would try to connect to my xbox. I also noticed that in the middle of a game it would drop connection even though it was on and I had not moved anywhere. This started to happen more and more frequently about 3 moths ago. Now as of yesterday it kept turning off over and over again and or dropping connection. At first i thought it was because it might be low on battery. I plugged it in for about 1-2 hours. That did not solve the issue. So i thought maybe the cable does not work right. I checked the cable it was good. but just in case i used another cable as well. It still did not work. When i plug the cables in it shows a green light meaning it is fully charged or close to fully charged. Well it is still turning off randomly at intervals of about 1-2 mins. Yes I even tried keeping the cable on (charging) while the headset was on. It would still turn off. I am no longer within warranty. I guess I will go back to my other headset from  2013 lol. Do not buy they are glitchy!!!

source_doc: Comfortable. I am not a woman of color and have very fine hair, but I do have issues with keeping my hair out of the way at night. I usually put it in a topknot when I go to sleep so I don't roll over and pull it. That has a couple issues - the hair band slipping and sleeping with a hard bump under my head, and putting ponytail ridges in my hair. I also thought I'd get this for my daughter who has long, curly, thick, red hair that is often dry and frizzy. I had heard that bonnets help keep your hair moisturized so I thought between us we'd give it a try.The bonnet is comfortable and the band is not constricting. It is easy to put on. Maybe because my hair is so fine it didn't stay on all night, but it seems that it was on most of the night. (when I woke up in the middle of the night it was still on). My hair feels soft and not dry, so I'll try it again. I couldn't get my teen daughter to try it, though I think it would be helpful for her hair and I'll keep trying. My other daughter tried it and she recommends it highly for keeping the cat from chewing on her hair every night!

hypo_0: Pohodlné. Nejsem barevná žena a mám velmi jemné vlasy, ale mám problémy s tím, jak si vlasy v noci udržet z cesty. Obvykle si je před spaním stahuji do drdolu na temeni, abych se na ně nepřevalil/a a netahal/a za ně. To má ale několik úskalí – gumička sklouzává, spím s tvrdým hrbolem pod hlavou a ve vlasech mi vznikají otlaky od culíku. Také jsem si říkal/a, že bych to pořídil/a své dceři, která má dlouhé, kudrnaté, husté, zrzavé vlasy, jež jsou často suché a krepaté. To má ale pár háčků – gumička sklouzává, spím s tvrdým hrbolem pod hlavou a na vlasech se mi dělají otlaky od culíku. Také jsem si říkal/a, že bych ho pořídil/a své dceři, která má dlouhé, kudrnaté, husté a zrzavé vlasy, jež jsou často suché a krepaté. Možná kvůli mým velmi jemným vlasům nevydržel na hlavě celou noc, ale zdá se, že tam byl většinu noci (když jsem se uprostřed noci probudil/a, měl/a jsem ho stále na sobě). Moje vlasy jsou na dotek hebké a nejsou vysušené, takže to zkusím znovu. Svou dospívající dceru jsem k vyzkoušení nepřiměl/a, i když si myslím, že by to pro její vlasy bylo užitečné, a budu se snažit dál. Moje druhá dcera ho vyzkoušela a vřele ho doporučuje – skvěle prý brání tomu, aby jí kočka každou noc kousala vlasy!

source_doc: Excellent to aid in learning. After many years away from the piano I am now retiring and attempting to teach myself how to play once again. I purchased a self-taught program which is very effective and came with an 8 1/2" x 11" picture of the keyboard showing the keys. As I am just starting out once again I found myself frequently referring to the "cheat sheet". I'm sure glad I found these keyboard notes which make it much easier to read music. I expected them to be thin but they are much thicker than I expected. I laid them across the keyboard and like the fact that they are slightly angled up as they rest on the keyboard but far enough to the top so as not to interfere with playing music. They cover the entire keyboard from left to right with letters that are large enough to see quite easily and a photo of the location of the note on a music sheet that is smaller and slightly less visible but that's ok the goal is to help me get started but I don't want to rely on them. These are quite durable, I expect them to last a long time and when not needed can easily be stored in the locking plastic box which they arrived in. I hightly recommend these for anyone learning how to play the piano

source_doc: Great for any wide mouth water storage jug. Since we had my daughter and the ridiculous amount of distilled water we used for her I bought a home water distiller so I didn't have to go to the store all the time to get distilled water.  The only problem was I was only able to do a gallon every three hours and when I was just using it for the kid that was fine but since we have hard water I've started using it for my humidifiers, coffee, tea, basically anything that water quality matters on so I needed to find a way to store it.  I got a couple of empty jugs and an electric pump to get the water out with, the only problem is sometimes I need to charge the pump and I don't want to leave the water open to our air which is why I got these.  They fit on both of my 5-gallon and 3-gallon just fine and keep the air out while I do whatever I need to do.  I don't have any gripes about these and they work as expected.

source_doc: I have owned this now for just over 3 years. So, I kind of forgot where I bought this. I was going through my "buy it again" list to try to remember what something I bought was called, and discovered I bought this on February 23rd 2020.Now, due to the pandemic, I actually spent a lot of time both on the road in both truck and motorcycle. In that time I've used this countless times for both air variation at elevation and temperature due to changing of seasons as well as being high in the mountains. I also use it nearly 3 times a week simply to check my motorcycle tire pressure.I've also used this for various reasons like getting myself or others off the highway, mounting new tires on any of the 3 motorcycles I use and even for limping 200 miles down the highway on my Africa Twin until I got to a shop with the correct sized tire for my bike.Shockingly, this cheap feeling and clunky mess of a product never once let me down, nor did it ever give an inaccurate reading on the pressure I have selected.Honestly, I've recommended this to multiple other riders as well as bought them for several friends and family members, all who have had zero problems with them.10/10 would spend $60 again.

source_doc: Awesome with a Catch... I really hate breaking the wood hotrods and then buying them again, only to break them again. The Kuppmen carbon fiber rods seem to be the answer to this issue. I love the way they feel, and they sound just great on my hi hats when I need less attack but still want to play pretty hard. Rebound from the snare is awesome, and all around they're just a pleasure to play with.BUT... the center rod will eventually fly out! This usually happens mid song, and I usually realize it when I go to hit the snare and I get the crash (12 inches behind the snare) instead. Then I have to use a drumstick to smash the rod back into place and hope it doesn't come out again. I've considered pulling the center rod and putting a dab of superglue on the very bottom of it, but I kind of wish I didn't have to do that, considering how expensive these rods are. I don't mind paying the price, but I expect durability, you know?Otherwise, I love them!

hypo_0: Skvělé, ale s háčkem... Opravdu nesnáším, když zlomím dřevěné hotrods a pak si je musím kupovat znovu, jen abych je zase zlomil/a. Karbonové špejle Kuppmen se zdají být řešením tohoto problému. Miluji jejich herní vlastnosti a na hi-hat zní skvěle, když potřebuji slabší attack, ale přesto chci hrát docela tvrdě. Odskok od malého bubnu je úžasný a celkově je s nimi prostě radost hrát. ALE... prostřední špejle nakonec vyletí! To se obvykle stává uprostřed písničky a já si to většinou uvědomím, až když chci udeřit do malého bubnu a místo toho trefím crash (který je 30 cm za ním). Pak musím použít paličku, abych špejli zatlačil/a zpět na místo, a doufat, že už znovu nevyletí. Uvažoval/a jsem, že prostřední špejli vytáhnu a na její samotný konec kápnu trochu vteřinového lepidla, ale tak nějak bych si přál/a, abych to nemusel/a dělat, vzhledem k tomu, jak drahé tyto špejle jsou. Nevadí mi zaplatit takovou cenu, ale očekávám odolnost, chápete? Jinak je ale zbožňuji!

source_doc: Like my 100W so much I might be upgrading my main tank. I actually got this to warm water change water, but I love the features so much I might get a 300W for my main tank.  Mostly I liked that they external reader tells the temperature of the tank which I wanted so I could tell when my water was ready for changing into the tank.  Now I wish I had that feature in my main tank.  I also like the peace of mind that there is an automatic shut off.  My son lost his whole tank to a shorted heater that cooked his fish.  I hope this will prevent that from happening to me.And the kicker is that I paid about the same for my heater without the temp readout.

source_doc: Not a lot of head pressure. I use this to pump diesel out of canisters into my car. I was hoping that I would be able to place the canisters on the ground and simply pump into the car, which is not very far up. I have been using a siphon, and I wanted a setup that was a little cleaner. To make sure that I had maximum power coming from D cell batteries, I also ordered a set of rechargeable lithium d cells to go with this. The pump does work, but don't have any high expectations for flow rates. If I have the container on the ground and I am filling to a fuel cap near my waist, the flow rate at max is barely more than a trickle. However, lifting the source canister up two or three feet brought the flow to a satisfactory level. Ultimately, I decided to place the canisters on the roof of the car, as I had done with the siphon. That works very well but if the pump falls out of the canister, it can be a bit messy, which is what I was trying to avoid. It is a very slick product, but needs a larger pump or more power.

source_doc: I use it every day. I'm not a great photographer, and it's not like I can capture the "soul" of a water bottle because it's simply a water bottle. However, I am not exaggerating when I say that for the first two days that I had it, practically everyone at work questioned me about it. I'm not sure if it's because I had it full of ice water and everyone was thirsty and saw that my bottle was full of ice cold water and it just made it more desirable or what. I do, however, know that this water bottle has not yet leaked on me. I like how the ml of water is labeled on the side. Oh, and I'm reminded of how puzzled I was when I first tried to open this thing, but now I think it's one of the best aspects. So, when you go to drink, you press a little button in the front, and it flings your lid off. It is both quick and convenient. However, at first glance, it appears to be something that slides up and down. One of my friends told me they tried to drink from it, but they couldn't open it. (Fortunately, I didn't want their lips on my drink in the first place.)So, Basically I LOVE IT

Vím však jistě, že tato lahev na vodu mi ještě ani jednou nevytekla. Líbí se mi, jak jsou na boku označené mililitry vody. source_doc: Excellent USB Hub. I work in IT and needed to get rid of all the USB adapters I carry for one dependable/portable hub. I think I found that hub. This hub is made of metal is looks very durable. Looks to have good ventilation but it is a little on the big size for me. I guess it has to be with everything it does. I connected it to my Surface Pro 7 and away I went. No drivers needed which is very important to me. I tested the VGA port, Micro SD port, USB 3.0 ports, and the ethernet port and all worked flawlessly. I tried to connect my USC-C thunderbolt docking station to the 100w PD port, but power didn’t pass through. I’m not saying it didn’t work, it just didn’t work with what I had. I could buy a 100w USB-C charger if needed but this hub passed my tests for the ports I really needed. Now, I would be willing to trade the VGA port for a serial port. I guess I have to keep carrying my USB to Serial adapter. All in all, this hub rocks.

source_doc: Great Product For Automobiles Or Any Filling Need! I used this product to repair a hole in the front bumper of my wife's car after an accident! I had a hole about 3 inches by 4 inches that was in need of repair. What I liked about this product was that I did not have to put a bunch of materials together or make a big batch for such a small job.I packed the hole with some newspaper; then I left about a half inch depth from the front of the bumper to fill. I took out about a cup of putty from the can with a plastic putty knife and then  added about a half inch line of hardener from the package.I then stirred the material until the colors blended well and applied it to the bumper. I did read where other users added too much hardener and it hardened on them rapidly; but I did not experience that problem with my batch. As a matter of fact, it took around an hour to dry completely which led me to believe I was a little too lenient on the hardener. It worked well though and I sanded it down within three hours and painted it the next day.You really can't tell that the hole was there at all; with the exception of paint difference. I strongly recommend this product for any of your patching needs!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Good but misses keys. I have had this keyboard for a while. About 2-3 months after I got it, I started having issues with the buttons on the far right not working (the enter button, the 9, 6, 3 keys. I have to try to hit them multiple times for them to register. Sometimes my 2 key sticks and does the number twice when only hit it once. And the D key doesn’t always register. It started off mild at first and kept getting worse. It’s now at the point that I can’t deal with the issues anymore. I deal with a lot of numbers on a daily basis and this keeps slowing me down. I need to get a new keyboard. I want to try this one again, but am worried about the same issue happening again. I love the colors and the quickness of the buttons (as long as they work) I would give it 5 stars if I wasn’t having issues with the keys reacting. This keyboard was exactly what I was looking for with speed, sound, touch and responsiveness. Hopefully won’t have issues on next keyboard

source_doc: Bright Lights. Short Length. I ordered these to add some lights under my cabinets. I am currently using battery operated puck lights… which need battery replacement often. I don’t want to keep replacing the batteries or forgetting… and then they corrode. ANYWAY, these were my solution. However, I am not handy, and I have zero clue how to install these. You would think it’s as easy as sticking them up and boom you’re done. But I’m afraid to cut the wire and then they don’t work. My boyfriend is an electrician, and I am hoping he can help ease this process and make it worry free for me… but for now, I’m not so sure what to do. There are detailed instructions, but I am scared to do something wrong… and how do they connect between cabinet spaces? However, I am happy this came with all the pieces necessary for the job. And as you can see the lights actually work and are pretty bright. I can’t blame the lights that I don’t know how to install… but to me, personally, it’s not very user friendly. I “pretend” hung them in my kitchen, and they weren’t long enough any way. I would consider hanging them in my closet, where no cutting would be involved, but I don’t have an outlet in there. Hopefully one day I will be able to provide an update with a more positive review.

source_doc: Overly sensitive - may need therapy! I love the individually programmable key light colors! Granted, the color/brightness varies a little across the keyboard, but most people would not likely notice. I like the volume control, contrary to other reviews. The keyboard is full-size but compact - like a Tardis! With light use, the battery has lasted well. The only thing I don't care for is that the keys are very sensitive - it is easy to mistype with a very light touch. I find myself making corrections or opening windows that I didn't intend. I could use the power cable to keep the backlight from sleeping, but that's not why I bought a wireless model. I wish I could extend the sleep timer. I don't think there is a competitive model with similar features for this price and I highly recommend this Red Dragon keyboard if you can train yourself to use the very sensitive keys.

source_doc: I should have bought this years ago. I love this thing.  I love hard boiled eggs but often don't eat them because of the hassle of making them.  When I do make them, I tend to not eat all of them, or by the time I do, they have lost their flavor.  With this egg cooker I can make them on demand with pretty much zero effort.  I also love fried eggs over medium but it's such a pain to always get out the frying pan etc... I just make medium boiled eggs with this and it's pretty much the same!  I tried doing the poached eggs, but could not find the best amount of water/time to get them cooked right.  I could get the yolk perfect, but the underside of the egg white was still runny.  Added more water and the yolk was almost completely cooked and the underside egg white was till runny.  Not a big deal because again, I get exactly the cook I want with the medium boil and can do more eggs at a time.I would have paid triple for this item it's that good.  I don't really understand the negative reviews about the timer.  It is loud, but not obnoxious and I can hear it anywhere in the house.  The melody is fine, it took me a few times to realize it was the egg timer and not my phone ringing.

source_doc: It’s all about THAT Bass. I recently purchased a Fender Aerodyne Jazz bass.  This particular bass has no fret markers on the fingerboard, which makes for a nice, clean look.  I normally don’t pay any attention to the markers on the fingerboard, so no problem.  Here’s the problem.  I’m visually impaired and I DO rely on the markers that are in the neck of the bass.  The Aerodyne came with tiny , white dots that I couldn’t see while playing.I tried 1/8” inch dots, but they were too small.  I then ordered these 1/4” dots and they are perfect.  They were easy to apply, and seem to stay adheres pretty well to the neck.  Even if I have to replace them regularly, it’s worth it.  I was about ready to return the bass, not because I didn’t like it, but because it was too difficult to play well.  These simple dots saved the day for me as I love this bass!  See picture for details.  No jokes about them not being straight cuz I already told you I can’t see lol.

source_doc: Painful, but maybe it's me. I don't have plantar fasciitis or any particular foot issues, but I could use indoor sandals and thought the massage aspect might be fun. I thought I got the wrong item at first because the (unsealed) box pictures a teapot and herbs, but I guess that's supposed to reference natural healing; the box is actually pictured in the listing. The slippers run about a size small. I would've ordered a size 5 if they had it, but 6 was the smallest and it turns out they are just right. I don't know why the smaller sizes have a rocker bottom while the larger sizes have a flat bottom or why stone is listed as a material. The spikes on the slippers hurt even with socks. It's very hard to endure walking in them. The listing does suggest wearing socks and gradually increasing wear time to ease the pain, so I guess it was to be expected? This kind of thing is new to me and maybe if I had foot issues, I would feel a different kind of relief. The seller did personally reach out and respectfully reiterate that the pain is said to subside by some. That's possible and since I'm not the target audience, I reconsidered that I should remain neutral in rating these. I'll continue trying to get used to these, but if you just need ordinary slippers, don't put yourself through this. They're priced okay at $29.99 plus $5 off.

source_doc: A great dissapointment. The characters are one demensional tropes that I couldn't care less about, the story is bland and predictable and the dialouge is pointless. I feel like I know as much about all of my companions 11 chapters in as I did when I first picked them up and I am A ranked with most of them.The world seems shallow and uninteresting. I have no drive to play the game because I have no feeling of imersion and connection (both important in a story driven RPG) to keep me invested and wanting to fight on.The combat system seems dumbed down and boring. And since, as I said above, the characters are just tropes that I don't care about I don't care when they die beyond losing a unit for battle.Even the character and world design seems lacking.I REALLY wanted to like this game. Three Houses is one of my favorite games of all time, but this just seems like a poorly done nostalgia cash grab.

source_doc: Screw holes not machined well and doesn't fit handlebars or steer tube perfectly. I bought two of these. The first one broke as I was installing it. One of the handlebar screws popped out as I was screwing it in and the threads in the hole completely just stripped out. So I got a refund and wanted to give the benefit doubt to the product so I ordered another. It lasted me roughly 9 months and as I was removing the stem to take my fork off, the bolt hole snapped and stripped out again. For the price it isn't bad. If you don't intend on ever taking the stem off and you carefully install it, I think it could be good. But I travel with my bike and this happened as I was traveling so it nearly ruined my trip. Luckily it was just one hole so I was able to make due with it temporarily but I will not be buying this stem again. Another weird thing about this stem is that it didn't fit my handlebars perfectly and there was a gap between the front plate and the stem. It also didn't fit onto my steer tube very well and it  took a lot of effort to remove/install.

source_doc: SMELLS SO BAD, that’s the only flaw. I bought this car seat because after getting in an accident, I realized I wanted the most safe infant car seat I could find, rather than my previous cheap one with very little padding, that easily pops out of the base. So I got this MaxiCosi after talking with several friends about their favorite brands, and I love everything about it EXCEPT the smell, oh my gosh it is so strong smelling of chemicals, almost a burning plastic type smell, and it makes my baby and her clothes stink so much I bathe her and wash the clothes first thing when we get home. I’m grateful for the extra padding, and that it’s still in a great price range (on the higher end though), but please be aware even after washing & then soaking the car seat fabric parts in borax, it will still be overwhelmingly strong. I also used my Bissell fabric cleaning machine and it still smells… just an FYI, maybe not all of them are like that and I got a defective one, I’m not sure, but if I didn’t absolutely need to have a good car seat in my car right now, I would return it.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: More feel and stability. I took the JumboMax challenge, ordering a full set of grips, re-gripping one club and going to play.  I changed out my 8 iron because I use it a lot, plenty of opportunities for bump and run where I play.Came home, had lunch and re-gripped the whole set.  I find that I was too tight, tense, whatever you call it with the old skinny grips.  With these I was able to swing without clamping down on the club and without having to think about it much.  This lead to much increased feel and more clubhead speed.Around the greens my wedge play  is much improved.  I let one of my regular partners try out a wedge and he showed up the next week with HIS set changed out to these grips too.  So he still scores better than me, not that I mind.I love these grips.  Picking up a regular grip club now feels very strange.  I now understand why I never really had the degree of control I wanted before, even though I used oversize grips.  Oversize does not come even close to the feel of the JumboMax.

source_doc: It did help! I've recently recovered from a respiratory infection. I've had a strong cough, runny nose and was sneezing all the time. At one point, my whole nose was congested and I couldn't feel any smells. I am happy I saw this tea and ordered it. It came super fast so I could start drinking it right away. I couldn't feel the taste or smell of it when was sick but on a third day after drinking this tea I felt such a great relief. I have to say I was getting some medicine and other stuff like garlic, ginger and lemon too but I have a feeling that the tea helped too! Now when I'm fully recovered I can feel taste and smell of the tea. Smells like herbal tea, tastes a little weird to me, but as long as it helps - I am okay with it.

source_doc: Works The Best Of Anything I've Ever Used. I have very calloused feet from wearing flipflops all the time.  My heels are always pretty rough. I have tried lots of methods to get my feet smooth, and I have to say, this glass foot file is amazing!  I used it at the end of my shower, when my skin had softened up.  I soaped up my foot, used the coarse side first, then finished up with the smoother side.  It made my feet really smooth, really quickly.  It works much better than my rechargeable rotary foot file.  I like that you don't have to charge it.  The one I had that you had to charge always seemed to be not sitting just right on the charger and then it wouldn't work when you went to use it.  It is a little big and bulky, but I just put it in the cabinet when I'm not planning on using it.  When I plan on using it, I put the stand right next to the tub on the floor.  The stand seems a little rickety, and I don't want it to tip over and scratch my tub.  The file is quite coarse on one side, and I'm afraid it would leave scratches.  This works the best of anything I have ever used to smooth my feet.  I highly recommend it.  It seems like it will last for a long time too.

source_doc: So disappointed. I am really disappointed. I contacted customer service because the vegan leather on my bag is pealing after just a few months of use. The best they can do is nothing? They said I must be rubbing it on rough surfaces. I am not rubbing or bumping it on rough surfaces. I have had another Itzy Ritzy bag and used it the exact same way and it has very little wear and tear on it after years of use. It was also vegan leather. The surface of the vegan leather is just peeling in places where there is not much friction. I am careful to take good care of my bags. I have really enjoyed being an Itzy Ritzy customer. As a mom of 7, I have carried their bags for years as well as used many other products including toys and pacifiers. I also recommend the brand because of the quality, however I have sadly learned that the customer care is lacking. For an item to peel like this is unacceptable and not normal wear and tear. I guess their quality standards have lowered as well, previous bags did not do this. If they will only stand by products purchased directly from their website and not other merchants such as Amazon, what is the point of selling there? I will no longer purchase or recommend Itzy Ritzy.

source_doc: Good moisturizer, fragrance free. I have been using oil vs lotion on my body for years. Usually almond or grape, but thought I would give this a try. I have heard good things about jojoba. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. It is a little thicker, but absorbs nicely on wet skin. I like oil better as I have dry skin & lotion tends to coat skin on me, instead of feeling like it’s actually getting into my skin. I can keep my dry skin in check, if I use it daily. The Jojoba oil seems to leave a bit of a layer, but only cause it  takes a little longer to absorb completely. My skin definitely feels moisturized & looks healthier. I like it. Other than the thicker texture of the oil, it isn’t much different than what I have used before. No negatives that I notice. Competitively price for the large size. Worth a try.

source_doc: Don't let first impressions fool you! I love to karaoke. I don't sing well, but I still love trying. I was so excited when the machine arrived! I tore open the box and my excitement turned immediately into disappointment! I actually laughed when I saw this little box that was supposed to be my new karaoke machine! I thought I'd been had! Still, I had to see how bad it was going to be. Guess what? It actually works pretty darn good! The sound is really good, and gets plenty loud. We just connected my cell phone with blue tooth, loaded the playlist and I was singing my little heart out! Just like that! I still haven't experimented with all the features, but we did try out the voice changing one and it's hilarious! We had a blast on New Years Eve with this machine! source_doc: Simply Beautiful. I got these lights in with no idea of what exactly I was really ordering. Which is very odd for me because I don’t spontaneously get products without reading every little detail. When they arrived and I saw that the strand was 400’ long,  I was surprised and then a little disappointed in myself for ordering them. Until my brain started to click. I decided to take the forever long, flexible and sleek looking strand and I literally wrapped each branch of my Christmas tree from the top to the bottom and still had plenty left over. They were so pretty, blended right in and had people asking me if my tree was a pre lit. I didn’t have to worry about gaudy light string’s being seen, lights never got hot and I was able to change them from being on steady to blinking, twinkling or fading in and out. I also loved how it came with a remote control as I was able to change the brightness level. I do recommend that If you do use these and decide to wrap them up afterwards, take your time and go slow or you’ll end up with a big birds nest as I did. I was able to get it straightened out but it took some time!

source_doc: Solid basic arm. Honest review! Bought this because i wanted a basic simple arm for my mic. Easy to install and works as advertised. It is a little clunky and the motion is very meh. But for what i paid for it… Come on. I don’t get any metal ringing through recordings if i hit the stand slightly like in some others i’ve had. The medium sized one was perfect for what i needed. The large would have probably been returned. If i had to pick out one thing i love and hate? I LOVE the base that goes to the desk. Very solid and makes me feel confident in it. The thing i HATE? This arm would be 10/10 if they made a simple design change on the mic holder. I want it to be able to turn full radius. Up, down, left, right, ect. It’s a little limited. Up and down only. Now I KNOW i can buy a separate piece to make that happen and it is probably designed for that. But it would be a game changer if it just DID THIS TO BEGIN WITH. 4/5 stars good

source_doc: Finally a mirror that works in my Honda! I was struggling greatly to find a rear facing baby mirror for my Honda Civic.  The reason? All of the backseat headrests are NOT movable! The headrest is part of the seat. Most mirrors with attached straps and gadgets direct you to strap the mirror under the headrest which does not work for my type of backseat. I was trying my best not to purchase a suction cup mirror to place on the window because I knew it would fall off depending on the weather, condensation and so forth. Luckily I came across this mirror, and even with reading reviews, I could not come across anyone who had my same type of backseat issue but gave it a try anyway. I was hesitant because just like the others, it came with straps to go across and under the headrest. Fortunately, I was able to strap the mirror around my attached headrest seat without using the strap used to go under the headrest. I pulled it tight and was able to maneuver the mirror to angle down on my baby perfectly! It works so well and doesn’t move! The mirror is very large so as I looked in my rear view mirror, I am able to see my child fully and clearly! She loves looking at herself too!I am very happy with this purchase- I just wished I bought it sooner!

source_doc: Not for my sensitive skin. I liked the concept of this dry body brush. I thought the bristles would be much harder but they aren’t. After about 10 minutes in the shower I began to use it & still my skin just didn’t like it. I brushed slowly, softly but despite the soft bristles redness was formed & I had to stop. From my personal experience I’d say this isn’t suited for sensitive skin. I feel it would greatly benefit one who doesn’t have sensitive skin. For the price it’s a nice quality brush. I would suggest, due to the nature of the wetness the bristles would get, that if you do use it in the shower that you put it in a location in your bathroom where it can fully ventilate to prevent mold.

source_doc: Game changer for keeping the kitties hydrated! I was a bit leery about purchasing this, but boy-oh-boy am I glad that I went for it! It is better than I even imagined. We have a bit tight living space and I needed something that could fit in a small space. I was tired of carrying a full water bowl over to the cat’s “dining area” to then have one of them nudge my hand and then spilling the entire bowl of water on the floor! Plus I could never seem to be able to tell when their water bowl was empty. This unit has been a blessing. It didn’t take them any time at all to use it—they weren’t intimidated by the new look at all. I also discovered that the lid will screw onto a soda bottle also, so if there is a time when we need to leave more water out for them, I feel confident that I could use a larger size bottle if we will be gone for an extended amount of time. It will also be useful if for some reason the original bottle cracks (which I’m hoping it won’t). I would love to find another stainless food bowl for this unit so that I can have a clean one on standby when I want to wash the included bowl in the dishwasher. The extra ones I have are either too large or too small. This was a great buy!!

source_doc: Really Good Quality. I ordered this sink mat because I am having a new farmhouse sink installed and want to make sure it is protected from day one.  I have seen the metal ones but it seemed to me that those could scratch the sink so silicone makes more sense.  It is also easier to remove to clean it and the sink.  This silicone mat is good quality and feels like it will hold up well.  I like the cutout for the drain so I will be able to use the stopped if I want to without having to remove the mat.  I like the ‘teeth’ on the bottom too that allow the water to drain.  They are a sufficient height.  After I got it, I decided to order another because I realized I could put a drying mat under it to use as a dish drain when I hand wash larger pots etc.  It will also be good as a heat mat for larger casserole dishes.  Good quality and the price is good..

source_doc: It works great for holding towels. I don't have a large linen closet so I've been keeping hand towels and other extras on a shelf here or a drawer there... When I saw these storage baskets I thought they may be a solution and, as it turns out, they are! I was able to hang the baskets on a over-the-door hook on my bathroom door - it can easily hold the weight of the baskets and towels.I have to say that I expected the baskets to look a bit more "straw-like" - more like real woven basket texture... I know they are described as cotton rope, but the word "jute" was also in the description so I guess that's why I expected it to look more like straw. They are still attractive - just not exactly what I expected. Also, the 3rd/bottom basket hangs at a weird angle - it tilts forward (see photo). I tried to adjust it but nothing I did made it straighten up. It's not a dramatic tilt or dip, so I don't think anything would fall out of it, but just something I observed. I removed a star for those two small things (jute in the description is misleading and the bottom basket tilts forward). But those are tiny things I can certainly overlook and I like the baskets a lot - they are a nice looking solution for my lack of linen closet storage.

hypo_0: Skvěle se hodí na ukládání ručníků. Nemám velkou skříň na ložní prádlo a ručníky, takže jsem ručníky a další věci navíc nechával/a na poličce tu nebo v zásuvce tam... Když jsem uviděl/a tyto úložné košíky, napadlo mě, že by mohly být řešením, a jak se ukázalo, opravdu jsou! Košíky se mi podařilo zavěsit na háček nad dveřmi koupelny – snadno unese váhu košíků i ručníků. Musím říct, že jsem čekal/a, že košíky budou vypadat trochu víc jako ze „slámy“ – spíše jako textura skutečného pleteného košíku... Vím, že jsou popsané jako bavlněné lano, ale v popisu bylo také slovo „juta“, takže proto jsem asi čekal/a, že to bude vypadat víc jako sláma. Stále jsou atraktivní – jen ne úplně to, co jsem čekal/a. Také třetí/spodní košík visí v divném úhlu – naklání se dopředu (viz foto). Zkoušel/a jsem ho upravit, ale nic z toho, co jsem udělal/a, ho nenarovnalo. Není to žádný dramatický náklon nebo pokles, takže si nemyslím, že by z něj něco vypadlo, ale je to jen něco, čeho jsem si všiml/a. Za tyto dvě drobnosti jsem odebral/a jednu hvězdičku (juta v popisu je zavádějící a spodní košík se naklání dopředu). To jsou ale maličkosti, které mohu rozhodně přehlédnout, a košíky se mi moc líbí – jsou pěkně vypadajícím řešením pro můj nedostatek úložného prostoru na prádlo.

source_doc: Stays in place all night! I ordered this sleep cap to try to keep my long hair from frizzing since I toss and turn all night. I adjusted the cap to be tighter with the adjustable strap inside. I honestly thought the cap would fall off during the night, but every time I woke up, it was still on my head. I sleep with a pillow over my eyes, so I’m used to something being on my head while I sleep, but having this cap on was still a little different for me. I think I will get used to it quickly. When I woke up in the morning and took off the cap, my hair was still smooth from the night before, so I believe this product works as intended. The cap material itself is really soft and smooth, so I can see why this is gentler on hair than a pillow case. Bonus, if you don’t wash your hair every day, this cap will keep your hair products from rubbing on your face and causing a breakout. I am excited to see if putting this cap on will preserve my curls to where I don’t have to completely recurl my hair the next morning.

source_doc: Sounds Nice But Doesn't Work as Expected (Until I Drank a Energy Drink) **UPDATE** Today, I took 3 of these as suggested again and did not feel the effects as expected, but after I forgot I took these, I had an energy drink, and DANG. This stuff either kicked in or combined with the energy drink, and I was pumped up about 30 minutes after I started drinking my dink. Three hours later, I still haven't finished my drink and am still going.FYI - Be careful if you take these with extra caffeine.These pills have some positive mentions in the way that when I took three pills (Number suggested for use), I felt like I had a cup of coffee or two ~ 30-40 minutes after, but that was all.While these pills are OK, the serving size of everything is based on three tablets, with 90 capsules per bottle. If this had the same amount of ingredients but in only one drug, then this would have gotten a better rating; it seems like too much money to drop on "Energy-Pills/Supplements" for only a 30-day supply when they don't work that well.

hypo_0: Zní to dobře, ale nefunguje to podle očekávání (dokud jsem nevypil/a energetický nápoj) **AKTUALIZACE** Dnes jsem si vzal/a opět doporučené 3 tablety a nepocítil/a jsem očekávané účinky, ale poté, co jsem zapomněl/a, že jsem si je vzal/a, jsem si dal/a energetický nápoj a TÝJO. Tahle věc buď začala účinkovat, nebo se spojila s energetickým nápojem a asi 30 minut poté, co jsem začal/a pít svůj nápoj, jsem byl/a úplně napumpovaný/á. source_doc: I actually doubted I would like this but I do! I have neck problems and had surgery for scoliosis many years back. I have been having issues with pain with sleeping and often switch pillows. I have tried a memory-foam wedge pillow in the past but it was not contoured like this one is. I hated that pillow and didn't use it longI also turn a lot in my sleep and I have the habit of putting my arm under my pillow. source_doc: Can compression socks be soft and comfortable! These prove YES. I have blood clotting issues, which is not a surprising thing since I'm turning 60 this year. Our bodies betray us, and we need to accommodate.I had yet to find compression socks I could tolerate, but when I saw these that leave the toes free, I was like OH YEAH, no crunched tootsies! I was worried they might be scratchy, as most compression socks are, but these are soft and easy to wear. All around, I am so pleased I can finally tell my doctor that yes, I am wearing my compression socks daily, because I don't mind these at all.As for sizing, I am 5'6" and around 140 lbs. I ordered a Large, which is snug but not tight.

source_doc: More than just a vase, this is a piece of art! I was expecting to like this vase but I was blown away with seeing it in person. I was thinking it would be much smaller than it actually is. It's large and so beautifully shaped. I love the primitive look of it. To me it looks kind of like an ancient cave wall drawing brought to life. I love that it's got a really nice, somewhat rough, texture to it. I wasn't sure I would like the black and was thinking I may spray paint it but the black really does work. I'm still deciding how I want to use this piece. It's not really a vase for fresh flowers at all. I have several different types of dried floral and pampas grasses I am going to try out to see which look I like best. I am really happy with this art piece and it's quality and I can happily recommend it!

source_doc: Wow just wow. I bought a Grote 335 style guitar a few years ago and am extremely happy with its quality and performance. Because of its price, I thought it might be a fluke. Last week I decided to buy the LP Grote. This guitar arrived in less than a week. I picked the purple tone. I don’t care that it’s a printed front. It’s stunningly beautiful. I am a guitar tech and luthier but I haven’t done a set up to either Grote’s I own and they sound decent right out of the box. That being said, if you are hitting the road or doing studio work I would recommend doing a pro set up on these guitars. I love the amplified sound of the 335 style Grote I own so I expected the same when I tested the new one. when I plugged in the LP I was blown away at the warmest sound I’ve heard in years. No pedals or effects, just amp. This 199.99 guitar was boasting a 1000.00 sound. I would recommend any guitarist who doesn’t have a large budget to look at Grote. If you have a large budget, still look at Grote and spend the rest of a great amp.

source_doc: Color not the same as description. This does work great for storing a carseat and holds our Graco infant to toddler one perfect. The straps also make it easy to use for traveling or anywhere you need to bring it with you. Having said that, I almost removed a star because the color I recieved is purple, but not dark like I thought it would be. I specifically chose this one for the color, and had I known it would be this light, I would have gotten a black one instead.  For me, this matters as a someone who chooses things by specific colors a lot.  I wanted it to match another item, and it does not. Having said that, I am still happy with the quality of this, and it will definitely still get used. But I struggled to give a full 5 stars for something I was harshly disappointed with when I initially opened. The good thing is, it is super easy to put the carseat in and take it out as well. Other than the color being different, it really has no other issues. I added a photo of what I expected so you can see what I mean on the color difference.

source_doc: You Get What You Pay For. EDIT!!! I increased my rating to 4 stars. I think one of the batteries I received is just weaker than the other. I used one of the batteries to screw down some decking today. I drove about 240 screws and the battery was still going. So maybe I got one great battery and one mediocre battery.Here's my original review:The battery life is terrible. I fully charged both of them before use. I put the first one into an 18 volt Dewalt circular saw and cut some pressure treated 2x4's and 2x6's. I made about 12 to 14 cuts before the battery was completely dead. And even at the beginning, when the battery was fully charged, I could tell that the saw was struggling to cut through the wood. With the factory Dewalt battery that's not an issue.I used the other battery in a drill to drive decking screws. It lasted about half as long as I would expect my factory battery to last.Having said that, a 2-pack of Dewalt batteries costs $200, so for $200 I could buy 2 Dewalts or 11 of these batteries. So I guess these are a bargain. But hopefully you have more than 1 charger, because you'll be constantly recharging these.

source_doc: Choking hazard for some dogs. My Boston terrier loves, loves, loves them. I noticed that many reviewers mentioned that these don't last more than a few seconds when they give them to their dog’s so, I tried to time Phoebe eating them. The first one I gave her, she took about 4 minutes to finish; which I thought was really good but then, the next few she ate quicker at around 2 minutes and it got shorter and shorter from then on. I will say that Phoebe also has those yak hard sticks to chew but now, she really only seems to chew those at night but, anyway, back to this product... One day I gave her one of these sticks as kind of a snack, they are high in calories for a snack but whatever; she must have been really hungry because, I noticed that she was acting like she was having trouble swallowing so, I stuck my fingers down her throat and dislodged almost half of the stick. Phoebe still gets them but now I hold them and she has to take bite size pieces. Phoebe really loves them and I actually do think that they calm an upset stomach so it is worth the grossness of the saliva getting all over my hand; I just wash my hand thoroughly afterwards. :)

source_doc: Fantastic bag. So I wish MR made a 'toned down' tacticool version of this due to the nature of my work. I use this as my primary laptop/work bag. I appreciate how "close" everything feels in the pouches. All of the compartments are very accessible and have the appropriate attachment points so I can carabiner/zip tie the zippers if I am in a pickpocket area. I would recommend this bag to anyone who is on the go for work. It flies through TSA security stuff and has ample room for all of the stuff I need on the go. I leverage packing cubes for all of my stuff and carry a Dell 15" laptop and a USBC Dell secondary monitor, as well as an anker 737 battery and all appropriate cables. I typically keep my glasses case/sunglasses in the outside pouch and in the other, I keep gum and keys I don't put in my pocket. The inside zipper keeps pens (in ink proof cube), passport, immunization card, and some cash. This is a very nice system for the price and very durable construction compared to most of the bags in this class.

source_doc: Nearly useless. After receiving these, but prior to using them, I left a raving review, but now they are nearly useless. I followed the instructions for washing them, which I did, of course, before planning to use them. I placed the lids in the top rack of my dish washer, and when the cycle finished I TRIED to secure the lids onto the bowls. I was able to snap shut only one or two of the four sides in place. The only bowl that I was able to fully secure the lid onto was the smallest. Granted, I have arthritis in my hands, but never have I had this issue with a set like this from another manufacturer. So, here I am with bowls without the advantage of a proper lid. Again, this is the only set of bowls with snapping lids that has not worked out for me. I absolutely do NOT recommend this product. I left a previous glowing review, but that was prior to washing this set and attempting to secure the lids to the bowls.

source_doc: I like it! I had read that COQ10 is good for your heart, blood pressure and cholesterol so I decided to try it. I found the taste was not unpleasant although the consistency was a little thick. I found that after a couple of days I seemed to feel a little more energetic and I felt less anxiety.  I have never taken a COQ10 supplement in a form such as this, but since I hate to take pills, this works better for me. The only thing I dislike is that this has to be refrigerated after opening which makes it more difficult to remember to take.  The bottle is supposed to be used within 45 days of opening so if I miss a few days, the product will still be good.  I won’t know of course if consuming this supplement will help with my cholesterol levels until the next time it is checked so if there is a marked improvement, I will update this review.  In the meantime, I really like this supplement.

source_doc: Very strong. This thing is so much better than the mighty mule I mean I’ve only had it working for a couple weeks now, but it is so much stronger and quieter than the mighty mule. source_doc: One glaring issue for my instance. I really like this. My only issue that I ran into was corrosion on the battery whip side. They do not have any sort of protective heat shrinking where the wire is crimped to the metal connector. I mounted my quick connect to the front diver side of the bumper of my truck this past June and it corroded this winter. I live in Western NY where road salt was certainly a factor. I bought loom to encase the wires and taped it but, never looked at the original wires at the connection point. Luckily, I had enough extra wire that I was able to cut off the corroded wire and I soldered new connections, put dielectric grease on the area where the wires were reconnected and then used heat shrink over the section where the new connection was made. I hope this review helps anyone who buys this. I would buy this again, I would just make sure I used the grease and the heat shrink before I installed it.

source_doc: Great for a toddler. I needed a 2 pack so she can have 1 by toilet and 1 by the sink (she being my 3 year old toddler). For reference, I already own a similar stool by IKEA and it's basically the same stool. I do not have an IKEA locally so would have to pay to ship it, since I didn't have anything else I needed from them I chose to just buy this set on Amazon instead this time. It's exactly what I wanted and I liked that I could get white with gray instead of having to get the white with green, which is IKEA's only color option. If you did purhcase this set in the white with green it'd probably be just like the IKEA stools. I would never use this for an adult but I see in the reviews some people are. This is pretty flimsy and really is meant more for like a 20-40 pound toddler not for an adult or anyone over 90 lbs. That's pretty risky, imo.

source_doc: These may be overkill for what I ordered them for. I'm a little paranoid.  I recently started making my own soap and the first time I did I got a small granule of lye on my foot and got a teeny, tiny chemical burn.  But now I'm paranoid and every time I make another batch I feel like I just bathed in lye and it is all over me.  So I thought getting some good gloves might put my overactive mind at ease.These definitely do the trick as far as protection.  They o all the way up my arms and make me feel ready to take on nuclear waste. I appreciate the elastic on the top to help keep them in place.  Relatively soft and flexible.  I don't have any issues measuring and dumping lye out of the bottle when wearing them, but they do still interfere with my dexterity so I wouldn't want to try and do anything that requires precision and delicacy in them.But as far as providing the protection they are meant to do, two big (blue) thumbs up!

source_doc: Security light. I ordered this since I just moved into a new home and the backyard light it came with provided zero lighting.That said this arrived as described on time and without issue. Conversely, I finally got it installed and it genuinely impressed me.Install was an absolute breeze. I especially like the connector type. Once I plugged everything on, screwed it in place and hit the light switch it exceeded expectations.The difference in lighting is 10x better than the crappy light I had. The options it has for sensitivity and for motion are second to none.I installed it in the evening, sunset had set by 7pm, I finished installed it a bit agter 8pm so it was dark outside.As you can tell by the last picture, I had to adjust the lights to point down more since it really lights up my backyard.What makes it even better is the fact there's an app for it, makes this one of the best lights I've installed, especially at this price point.If I could give this 6 stars I would...Moreover I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it. Excellent product, easy to install, and performs better than expected.In my opinion it's worth it!

source_doc: I was really hoping for more than it delivered. UPDATE...After a lot of trial and error I have found the Mustang Micro to be much better than my original review. I have used it for recording and the results were very good.I have had a Fender Mustang V for a few years now and I record with it often. When I saw this device I thought it might be another recording option. Technically I can record with it. However, in the very short time that I actually tried it plugged into my 1970's era reissue Strat it sounded very overdriven. In every mode I tried. Don't get me wrong, I do like some nice overdrive. But this is too much. To the point of having a crunchy sound. I tried my 2010 Teloecaster. Same thing. Then my Epiphone Dot. Same. I tried other amp models, effects, EQ, different volume settings. All of them super crunchy. Which knocks this down from a possible recording amp to only a practice device. And even then the tone is highly unsatisfying. So if you are curious and you have an extra $120 lying around then give it a try. Maybe it's just what you are looking for. But if you like good tones coming from your guitar then move along. This is not for you.

source_doc: Unplayable. I really wanted to like this game.  Visually its a very appealing game and the background music is good.  However the controls are way too sensitive and combat is clunky.  These are things I think I could have gotten used to over time.  However what I can't get used to is the horrendously long respawn times after you die.  It consistently takes over a minute for the game to load back up after you die.  I even timed it and the load time was 1m 05s 95 seconds.  This is completely unacceptable.This game was free with Playstation Plus, but I will be deleting it because I can't even enjoy it when most of the time is the stupid loading screen.  Months ago, this game was on sale but for some reason I decided not to get it. Knowing what I know now, I'm glad I didn't waste my money for an unplayable game.Thanks EA for reinforcing a decision I made nearly 15 years ago to never buy games at price, if at all.

source_doc: Well made, good value. This one I am keeping. I have purchased other guitars with semi hollow jazz style design. I have gotten rid of all of them, mostly because of feed back and tunning issues. I did spend a lot of time getting the action to my liking. At first I thought I would not be able to accomplish this but I got it. I was tempted to buy the classic vibe model because I already have one in 50's tele, which I really like. However, I really like the simplicity of design on the affinity model in spite of some of the bad reviews I have seen. Did not really find them on this guitar. The neck set up was a bit of a challenge but I got there. I also own an American made tele and strat. Nothing plays as easy or as well as those. This one poses a good competitor at a really substantially lower cost and it is really pretty, The pups are not the greatest but still really ok and I can refine the tone with my modeling style amp. I truly enjoy playing this guitar.

source_doc: A game changer for hunting. I used to talk smack on hunting accessories like this, but now I am older and wiser and want to take ethical long distance shots more often that free hand. I haven't used this to reach way out and hit targets, but I did use it in a stand to take a fox this year. The shot was about 90 yards with a 17 WSM. Could I have done it free hand? Most likely. Was I more confident in my shot placing with this stick? You're darn right.It makes a little bit of noise when adjusting the height with the thumb button. I plan on doing a light disassembly and lubing up the spring inside. Either way, it barely makes any noise. It may scare a deer that's less that 15 yards out, but they normally don't get a chance to get that close to me, so it doesn't affect my hunt at all.I sit in a chair, I am 6'3" and the stick has plenty of adjustability to meet my needs. I have not tried adjusting it to full length to see if I can use it comfortably standing. source_doc: It really works. I was a bit wary of devices to help cool my Series X and finally decided upon this one.  I am glad I did.  I know some mentioned the fan gets noisy, but I really do not notice it.  On my Series X, the temperature has definitely dropped and i like the temp readout on the unit.  It does have three automatic fan speeds with corresponding colours, but it has kept the unit cool enough that it always stays on the lowest speed, despite playing nex gen games.  I really am glad I bought it.  It fits perfectly on the top of the console, I have mine laying on its side and it looks like it came from the factory with this installed.  I would recommend it at this point as I have had no issues.

source_doc: The Strings I Didn’t Know I Couldn’t Live Without. When I first tried these strings I was highly skeptical because they are a fairly heavier gauge than I’ve always used on my stringed instruments.  But when I started playing a friend’s guitar I noticed quickly how incredibly BEND-Y they are!!!  It’s honestly hard to describe how smooth these strings feel.  I ordered some and put them on my favorite Strat, and I loved them so much that they are now on almost every stringed instrument I own!  They last a really long time too because they are pure nickel.  I was ride or die for the vintage nickel fender strings for the longest, but these are BETTER.  I would recommend them to anyone for electric and acoustic stringed instruments.  I like to build and mod guitars for my friends sometimes and I always put these on and even include an extra set because as someone who’s been playing guitar for over 20 years, I want them to experience what I finally “discovered” a couple years ago.  As I mentioned, they last a really long time, but I still subscribe for a new set every month because I like to stock up and I have way too many instruments 🤣

source_doc: Nice, but I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well. I had a really nice electric toothbrush, but it stopped working. I decided to give this one a try. I have super sensitive teeth, so the different vibrations of this one bothered me at first. I guess I've gotten used to it now, though. The bristles are super soft, which I think I like. I don't feel like it cleans my teeth as well as my old one, though. I've had to use this one longer at a time to make up for it, and hope that it doesn't make me end up with cavities. I brush well at least twice a day, floss at least once a day, use a flouride mouthwash every night, and go for my cleanings every 6 months. (I'm also careful with sugar and take vitamins.) Cavities are still a struggle for me, so I don't know if I'll keep using this toothbrush and take the risk. If I didn't have to be so careful with my teeth, I'd be happy with it, though. It works well otherwise and it looks nice and durable. I also love that it comes with 8 replacement heads. Those can get expensive with other brands.

source_doc: Works well for me. I have bought quite a few Camilla  hair barrettes.  I like the rubber on the clasp and I like the way they look.  Nicely made and hold up well.  I think they're worth the extra cost as you get what you pay for.  I do not have a lot of hair, very fine, medium length.  This clip holds my hair in a ponytail and because it's wider than a hair tie, I think it might make it look like I have more hair.  I think it would be too small or people with thicker hair.  They have plenty of 4" clips that would be better for really thick hair in a ponytail.  Of all the Camilla barrettes I have, none have ever come out of my hair, even with my hair being so fine and thin.  I even have some of the bigger ones and they work fine for me, but this size is ideal for my type of hair in a ponytail.  I would really like to see some models wearing their hair accessories so I could get a better idea of what they look like.

source_doc: at 73yrs old, I need to be picky! Just read other reviews and am surprised that some do not like this.  I try many brands of drugstore foundations but hardly ever Almays' which is ironic since I have sensitive, allergic skin!  By chance I tried this one (first I love that it comes in a tube rather than a bottle) (seems more hygenic), and then liked that it has the word "prebiotic" in the name.  I am somewhat on the light side, with cool undertones, pretty descent skin for my age with some wrinkles, no age spots, average pours.  Skin is normal but can tend to be dry if I don't work at it.  I bought the 130 beige because in the pictures it looked like a cooler tone than the 120 color and I am more than happy with this.  It looks natural and very healthy looking and I am picky.  I put it on with my fingers all over my face including my eyelids.  I just love how this looks even out in the bright sunlight.  I would be one to highly suggest mature women like me try this out if you are on the fence, looking for a natural foundation that is hypoallergenic with descent products in it.  I would totally rebuy this a second time.

 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

hypo_0: Ve svých 73 letech musím být vybíravý/á! Právě jsem si přečetl/a ostatní recenze a překvapuje mě, že se některým tento produkt nelíbí. Zkouším mnoho značek make-upů z drogerie, ale téměř nikdy od Almay, což je ironické, vzhledem k tomu, že mám citlivou, alergickou pleť! Náhodou jsem vyzkoušel/a tento (nejprve se mi líbí, že je v tubě a ne v lahvičce, což mi přijde hygieničtější) a pak se mi líbilo, že má v názvu slovo „prebiotický“. Jsem spíše světlejší typ se studeným podtónem, na svůj věk mám docela slušnou pleť s několika vráskami, žádné stařecké skvrny, průměrné póry. Pleť mám normální, ale pokud se o ni nesnažím pečovat, má sklon k vysoušení. Koupil/a jsem si odstín 130 beige, protože na obrázcích vypadal jako studenější tón než odstín 120, a jsem s ním nadmíru spokojený/á. Vypadá přirozeně a velmi zdravě, a to jsem vybíravý/á. Nanáším ho prsty na celý obličej včetně očních víček. Prostě se mi moc líbí, jak vypadá i na přímém slunci. Zralým ženám, jako jsem já, které váhají a hledají přirozený make-up, který je hypoalergenní a obsahuje slušné složky, bych opravdu velmi doporučil/a, aby ho vyzkoušely. Určitě bych si ho koupil/a znovu.

source_doc: Love this grinder and the bag it comes with. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  In the package, you get the grinder, a storage bag, and two cleaning brushes. It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a nice wood knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  It was really easy to grind although I set it for a bit too fine on my first go-round so unless you are old hat at manual grinding you will probably have to play around with it to find your preferred setting.  Cleaning it was a breeze too, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out. What I really like about this one compared to the others I have is it comes with a storage bag so I don't have to keep it in a big bulky box.  All in all, I do really like this and its matte black color looks great.

source_doc: This thing went on so incredibly easy. I never leave reviews but I need EVERYONE to know how easily and beautifully this screen protector went on my Switch OLED. When smart phones and screen protectors first came out, it was like doing surgery to handle them and get them on correctly, and maybe, maybe after three tries you got it right.I am no expert, so when I got my Switch today, the absolute last thing I wanted to do was put the screen protector on. I’ve had the people at the store do them for my phones, because I just worry I’m going to get bubbles or dust under it.But this went on like butter. I used the wet wipe and then the dry and then peeled off the first step layer and I was careful in positioning it (having a case on helped) and then all I did was drop it down gently and it smoothed itself out, and then I pressed gently with my finger to make sure. After peeling the second layer off, it was PERFECT. No bubbles. No dust. I did it on a whim because you can’t let the screen protector see your fear — and I cannot be more amazed at how utterly effortlessly it went on.Plus, you get three for this price and should something ever happen to it, I have backups. I cannot recommend this product enough.
