source_doc: Build Quality Could be Better. I purchased the ES110 based on exhaustive research and reading reviews. I also own an upright Kawai piano. What convinced me to purchase it was the key action and sound quality. I primarily wanted a piano and didn't need a lot of other features.When I set up the ES110 I noticed a fair amount of noise from some keys clacking when released (plastic on plastic). Most keys seemed adequately sound dampened but some were not. I contacted the vendor and Kawai support. The vendor told me to contact Kawai support as well. I never heard back from them.The clacking key noise was driving me crazy so I returned the ES110 and asked a few different music stores what they would recommend. I Purchased the Roland FP30X. I didn't purchase the Roland initially because a reviewer said the keys were a little too heavy and it might not be the best for high speed fingering used in classical music. I've also been very satisfied with my Kawai upright.The Roland keys feel much more solid with no clacking noise. The build quality on the Roland seems better than the ES110. Maybe the key feel is a little heavier but you can adjust the Key Touch to make it feel lighter.I really wanted to love the ES110 and was very disappointed. Maybe I got a lemon. The Roland FP30EX has been great so far.

instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

Nože Condor mám opravdu rád/a. Nedávno jsem si koupil/a Bushlore. Bushlore byl po vybalení ostrý jako břitva, proto jsem si vybral/a tento nůž jako větší nůž na náročnější práce kolem tábora. Za normálních okolností si nový nůž přebrousím podle svého vkusu, takže je trochu přitažené za vlasy tento nůž kritizovat, ale očekávám, že nůž bude po vybalení dostatečně ostrý na to, aby se dal hned použít. Můj Hudson Bay byl po vybalení nepoužitelný! Až příliš tupý. Celkově vzato je to pěkný nůž a jakmile budu mít čas ho přebrousit a naostřit, dovedu ho k pořádné použitelnosti. source_doc: Poor Quality. I am extremely disappointed with this controller. I ordered this and the first one that arrived would lose connection from my Xbox Series X about every 10 minutes. I've tried every troubleshoot with Xbox support, but now they recommend that I send it to them for repair. I am just going to return it and go with a different option. Also, I did not play with the controller to cause the stick drift. I noticed it fresh out of the box, so it was not dropped or damaged and it is not dirty from use. It's literally brand new. Extremely disappointed, I wanted to really like this controller.

source_doc: Perfect exercycle for me! I love this little stationary bike! And the price point is incredibly reasonable!! It's sleek, compact, cute, sturdy and tucks into a corner of my living room. It's SO quiet!! I can't believe it! I can listen to music, TV, read or watch Youtube while riding. My last recumbent bike made lots of noise, so I couldn't cycle if anyone else was around. I love the simple display that gives me all the parameters I need, including pulse - which at my age, is a good idea to watch when exercising. I target my heart rate. I had to have my husband put it together for me because of the few electronic parts. I didn't want to mess it up. I suppose if I HAD to have done it myself, I'd have eventually gotten through it. It really wasn't that hard to do, my husband said. All the parts were clearly labeled, well packed (in spite of the box arriving opened and smashed). Nothing was broken or smashed. Instructions were clear. Seat is comfy. I LOVE IT!! I'd buy it again in a heart beat! :)

source_doc: Love This Air Fryer. I was hesitant to buy this air fryer because I wasn't familiar with the brand. I used to have a name brand air fryer and it died some time ago and I wasn't sure I needed to replace it because I wasn't using it much. I finally decided to try this one because of it's size and price. It's a perfect size for feeding 1 or 2 people. I also like the color. It's a big bigger than I had imagined before it arrived but it fits fine on my counter. This air fryer is easy to use and even easier to clean up; the non-stick interior just wipes right up. I still don't use an air fryer a lot on my whole food plant-based diet but I'm glad I got it. I think the price was reasonable and if you are looking for an air fryer, I highly recommend this brand.

source_doc: Worst piece of fitness equipment I own. Not going to lie, I wanted something for the wife that was just easier than grabbing a bar and bench in limited basement space.  I have all types of equipment down there, and this was just going to supplement workout routines.  I had high hopes when I got this thing.  Then I started to try and out it together.  Let me tell you, the hardware us not marked, the instructions leave a lot to be desired, and holes do not line up (had to ream out two holes). source_doc: Great lighting, excellent key feel. I had a Nighthawk X8 MAX keyboard I loved. It worked for years. Then the coffee happened. I tried many keyboards and eventually settled on this one. The lighting is bright, the keycaps have large letters and numbers, and most importantly, the keys feel "right". I am also pleased that is is a tenkeyless keyboard that still has print screen, etc. I would like for the caps lock indicator to be brighter, but that is the only complaint I have. I actually have two of these so I am ready when the Nighthawk I have at my office finally dies, or when I inadvertently kill the one I am typing on.

source_doc: Good lock for the price. I like this lock so far.  I attached the mount to my bike via the water bottle bolts, but I decided to move it to my bike bag instead.  The mount worked fine, I just missed having my bottle there.  This lock is pretty heavy, which is to be expected.  It is large enough for any bike rack and most poles I would use to lock up my bike.  It is too short for locking down your frame and front wheel to a thick pole.My only complaint is that the coating might end up scratching or wearing the paint on my bike.  This has not happened yet since I don't lock my bike up often, but I really wish there was some rubber on the parts that contact the bike.  I am considering adding some foam tape or something similar to limit the wear.All in all, this is a great folding lock for the money.  I like to budget about 20% of the bike's value for its lock so this falls well within that range for most of my bikes.  I will still use higher-security locks for any very expensive bikes, but that is just due to the higher risk involved.  This lock is far more secure than most cable locks I have seen and is much easier to carry than a U-lock, so this gets my recommendation.

source_doc: So HAPPY with this roll!!  Delighted! I have a Cuisinart Steam Toaster Oven and its very difficult finding pans that fit correctly. They are usually half an inch too long in one direction. Being my only oven, I want as large as will fit.  Before now, I buy a roll of  Parchment Paper and cut it to size each time. The one with already cut sheets are too big. The ones I tear off I always have to adjust and fold over the edges and so on. A real Pain. I cut a piece off this roll to size first and then one a little bigger that goes up the sides a little. Sometimes I only need to wipe it with a wonder sponge and its clean! I am Happy beyond words!  I found once in a while it stains, however, not often. I simply remove it, wash with a Wonder Sponge and its Clean! No grease left over like my other ready made silicon mats. I imagine the Wonder sponge would clean them too. (I only use it for specific things like this.) I have baked several things on the first sheet and it still looks new! Very Happy with this purchase. Just rolled the roll back in the paper and tucked in the ends for the next thing I think of to use it for! Perhaps rolling out pastry?

source_doc: Its a gd enuf substitute. Glad i found this, i really hate to throw away a working Fairywell E11 just bec they do not sell replacement heads anymore. source_doc: No complaints with quality. I got this for an emergency pull rope / strap for the trunk of my car.. 4" did not really register as to how wide that actually is, or how thick this strap actually is, until I got it in.. One of those (brain fartt) moments where you could kick yourself in after thought.. In any case, this is way more then I need for an emergency strap, so I am going to look for another.. I have one that is thinner and not as wide in my one vehicle, and I wanted one for my other vehicle.. If you want one for something like that, this is going to be much thicker and heavier then most people will ever use..With that being said, the testing I did do with it, it worked fine.. But let me be honest when I say.. 16,000 pounds is like towing a semi.. I have nothing that will use or need that kind of a heavy duty strap to tow.. But then again, I have seen smaller one break trying to pull out bushes and stuff.. So better too heavy then not heavy enough and breaking.. Just know, if you are looking for compact, this is not for you.. But from what I can tell so far, it is nicely made and I have no complaints about its quality.

My only issue is the lack or limited instructions of the product! Overall, this product is worth a try!

I bought the "khaki" color but it looks golden to me.  It's gorgeous!! I love the smell of the leather on the handles and the zipper pulls are my fave! I was on the fence about getting this bag until this color came out and I knew I had to have it. I'm so glad that I did because it is my favorite bag I've had (and that says a lot because I'm a "Bag Lady" hahahaha!)

source_doc: I thought I would use it more. This UV light for nails is very lightweight and as simple to use as any I've ever used. I got this for when I do my nails, so I could cure my nails all at once rather than one at a time, and it definitely works good for that when it's the finished nails. I have nerve damage in my right hand,  so I actually find that initial gluing of nail to finger works better for me if I just stick with the single nail at a time. So, unfortunately, this has only been used 1 time. I really thought I would use it more,but it's too hard for me to keep my hand straight long enough to put all nails on then under the light. I just bend them and they come off and it becomes a mess. But, having said that, it is a decent light for anyone who will not have issues like I have. Or great for even curing nail decor that needs UV light after the nails are already glue on. I wish I could have given a better review of this product, but from what I can tell, it does what it says, and works as good as it says. So I am going to give it a 5 star based off it being exactly as stated in the description.

source_doc: It's noisy but there's a cheap and easy fix. For the price it is a great elliptical. The resistance levels are good and I get a whole body workout on this thing. It's sturdy enough for the asking price, but the bolts on the main strut make an extremely irritating noise after a while due to the metal washer rubbing against the metal of the strut. I was pulling my hair out over this for a long time, because for a while I wasn't even sure exactly where the sound was coming from. Eventually I narrowed it down to the bolts holding together the two parts of the main support beam. I tried tightening them, lubricating them with WD-40, but nothing worked. I was about ready to throw the whole unit away until I had an epiphany one day. What if I put some rubber in between the metal washers and the strut? All I did was take a spare koozie I had lying around and cut 1-inch squares out of it. In the squares I cut a slit half way up the center and a 1/4" hole in the middle. I then loosened the bolts and slid the rubber koozie square between the washer and the main support and tightened the bolts again. Now the machine is silent! I couldn't be happier now.

source_doc: Great for making some 'fancy' coffee. I really like this brother.  It's easy to use, and quicker and easier to clean than the frother cups (although, I do love my frother cup when I want heated milk).The frother itself is very nice quality, and the digital display is nice and clear.  I've had it for a few months now, and I haven't had any issues with it.  I've only tried the wisk attachment, because I can't for the life of me find the other attachment. I don't know if I didn't get it, or if I misplaced it.  But, the wisk does a great job at making some fluffy milk foam for my lattes!  Operation is smooth, and it's easy to adjust the strength of the mixer by twisting the little ring with the ridges.I keep this on the coffee station, in front of my frother cup, because I use this one more because of its ease of use when I'm in a rush (which is always).The stand only works for me if I remove the wisk attachment, so that's what I do.Overall, I'm really happy I got this.  It's been saving me a lot of money that would have gone to Starbucks.  Now, I have my own coffee shop in my home.  The price is comparable, and in my opinion this one is a better deal over others because of the smooth operation of it, along with the digital screen.

source_doc: Best sleep ever!!! Okay, so I know this is an "Air Bed" (super-sized mattress) and not a standard or "real" bed but I've tried a bunch of "real" beds and have consistently had lower-back pain when I got up each morning. In desperation I thought I couldn't lose by buying and trying this Air Bed. Changed my life!!! EXTREMELY comfortable ALL NIGHT LONG! As you can see from the pics, I use it differently than most: (a) I found the fabric side with the channels to be less comfortable than the bottom so I inverted it with wonderful results; (b) by inverting the bed, the fabric catches on the carpet better than the smooth side so it doesn't shift when I get on or off of it; and (c) I didn't want to have to deal with fitting sheets so I just bought an inexpensive sleeping bad and it worked perfectly. I have the twin xl version and a double sleeping bag fits just right. I use this EVERY NIGHT and have been doing so for weeks. I do have to top off the air each night for about 10 or 15 seconds as there is a tiny leak. I couldn't find any air escaping so I'm assuming it's getting out through the built-in fan assembly. No biggee, though. I highly recommend this critter!!

source_doc: Worth the price. I hate chapped lips but I'm particular in what I want in my chapstick. Yes, it's cool that treat beauty offers cool flavor options and I really like the gummy bear flavor. However, there are other qualities in a chapstick that I find more important. 1) I hate when you apply chapstick and then it leaves a residual chemical/chapstick flavor on your lips. I am happy to report that this chapstick doesn't do that. It's slightly sweet, but not with a weird chemical taste. 2) I hate reapplying chapstick every 30 minutes or so. For me a good chapstick will linger on your lips until you eat. I drink water throughout the day and I don't want to reapply chapstick every time I take a sip of water. Yes, I know it will wear off, but a good chapstick wear off slower. This is a good chapstick by my standards.Added bonuses are the variety of flavors, cute packaging and huge size. I just ordered more from the treat beauty website because my daughter loves the gummy bear flavor and I told her she could have it.

source_doc: Grainy texture, mild flavor. I wasn't impressed with how the safety seal came right off when I opened the lid. Was it secure? This is a packaging flaw I shouldn't have overlooked, but everything else seemed clean and intact, so I gave it a go.As for the gummies, which I did try (against my better judgment?) they have a mild taste that could be strawberry, but just seemed kind of generic, and have a very grainy texture that I do not enjoy. I wanted to try these in particular because this is a brand I thought I liked, but now I'm wondering if I misremembered.Overall I would not buy again, unless I was assured the packaging issue was fixed. If their manufacturing and packaging practices are truly cGMP as claimed, this seal issue should never have made it to the hands of buyers.

source_doc: Headache relief!! Sometimes I need 2-3 ice packs for my head when I have a bad headache. I usually use the eye mask kind but stretch it across my forehead, but then I can't get relief across the top of my head when I have tension headaches. I just tossed this pack into the freezer. I forgot about it and expected a block of ice, but wow. This head wrap was still soft and pliable, not frozen at all. It was cold like it was frozen though! I slipped the wrap over my head and immediately realized this product is way better than everything I used before. I can get relief in all areas of my head and eyes, unlike all of my other packs. The material is soft and silky like a fancy eye mask. I will be ordering more to switch out since I usually need more than one pack. I'm really relieved to have found a great product to help me deal with my tension headaches.

source_doc: Nice to have on the road. I ordered this because I stay on the road and thought that it would be a good addition to my vehicle. I like the tray that sits up high so that when I’m driving and if I need to eat on a snack in between destinations I can. This extended cupholder makes it really convenient. It’s also convenient when I have multiple cups or bottles that I need to sit in the vehicle. So far it’s worked out pretty well. At first I didn’t know how to tighten it so that it would stay in the vehicle original cupholder but after looking at it for a few minutes, I saw that you actually turn the bottom which expands the sides to ensure a secured fit.  The only issue that I have is that the cupholders and tray seems a little difficult to turn. At first it got in the way of my gear shaft. If you’re not using the extended cup holder, it can seem a little bulky as far as room space . So at times I will take it down if I’m not going to use it in a reasonable time.

source_doc: Cable works great, Operator is clueless. A few decades ago I was a techie and computer programmer.  However management and 20 years in retirement have taken a toll on my knowledge as this stuff keeps getting more complicated.  Before the Quest 2 I had an Oculus Go since it came out.  I finally decided it was time to upgrade with the 2.  I'm struggling comprehending this new adventure.  I probably should have just stayed with the Go.Anyway, I thought tying the 2 to my laptop would do something for me so I ordered this cable as the cableless method reportedly has disconnects.  I found information on line on how to connect and started the process.  I found the required software, App in today's vocabulary, and loaded  it on my laptop.  I had one hiccup attaching the cable since my laptop only has USB C connections and I needed an A.  I tried one adapter and it wouldn't connect.  However, on a second one, it hooked right up.The cable works great as far as linking your PC to the Quest 2.  What you do afterward, I don't have a clue.  I think I need to find a seven year old to teach me or find the Youtube that I haven't found yet.

source_doc: These really work! I took these for the first time and had great results. I chose a night when I was pretty sure I would have trouble sleeping (Sunday night for teachers is the worst and I napped too much on Sunday afternoon). I took one gummy a hour and a half before bed because I wanted to make sure it wore off by morning. I was sleepy within 30 minutes! I made myself wait until bedtime and then slept peacefully. My cat woke me up once and I woke up another time naturally to go to the bathroom. Normally I wake up several times a night, so this was a huge improvement. I also have an issue with eating snacks at night, but I did not eat a single thing that night. I’m not sure if it keeps you too tired to be hungry or if it creates an appetite suppressant effect, but whatever it is, I am pleasantly surprised. I will be reordering when I run out. I will also be taking the gummy closer to bedtime!

source_doc: Takes fabric pilling off sweaters, couches.... Well, I did it.  I read several of the reviews and took the plunge.  Usually I take a pair of old hair clippers and shave my sweaters but that has caused too many snags.  This little shaver DOES NOT create snags.  You charge this little bugger up and in no time you're digging through your closet and bringing out stuff you forgot you had and shaving everything down.  After that now I have sweaters ready to wear and a pile destined for a Lawn Sale.  What can I say... it's the cycle of clothing.  I like just about everything about this shaver.  It's small, rechargeable, fits in my hand well the only thing that I found a tad irritating is emptying out the collection of sweater lint/nubs.  It was really difficult at first and to pop it off I had to ask my husband hoping that he wouldn't break it.  He got it off and we emptied the bin and it was a hard snap back in.  It kinda scared me at the amount of force that had to be used.  It did NOT break (phew) and I've been using it practically weekly.  Overall - I would agree with the reviews and the amount of people who have purchased this item.  It really gets the job done. Enjoy and I hope you don't become a fanatic about keeping your sweaters pristine like I have. (slight nervous laugh).

I’m not sure if that’s why it didn’t stick but I cleaned it and ride it so I don’t see why the sticker did not stay on my wall.

source_doc: Once Upon A Time. Once upon a time I used to stand on a metal box that I place on a chair just so I could reach the light bulb socket.  This light bulb socket is located in the hallway leading upstairs.  So I had to place a chair on steps that was dangerous.  Now that I am older (60 years), weigh more and not comfortable with relying on my stability, I searched for something that I could use to reach the light bulb socket safely.  I am so happy that I found this product.  I did not buy the pole but used a old sponge mop pole which worked just as well.A lot of people said that they had problems with the spiral light bulbs, I did notice that as I was screwing counter clockwise, the standard light bulb gripper also was unscrewing.  I just tightened the screw on the light bulb gripper onto the mop pole and it worked.  I haven't tried any of the other grippers but am looking forward to seeing if it will work on the flood light bulb outside.

source_doc: Does not work... never did. Bought in 2020 didnt use it right away, just wanted to have it on hand when I needed it. When I finally needed it would not turn on... and it has never worked!Ive tried it on a 2006 pontiac G6, 2002 GMC Yukon, and a 2009 Jeep wrangler. It never turned on. I thought it was just me using it wrong. Then I lost it in some boxes. Found it three months ago and tried it in the jeep. It wouldnt turn on.03/11/23 I thought Id try it again in a 2002 GMC sierra... it didnt turn on. Tried it on a buddies s10 and it came on but wouldnt connect.Updated 03/19/23 I went back to the 2002 GMC sierra and started checking fuses. Found 2 blown fuses (cigarrete & DRL) and replaced. Reconnected scanner tool. It comes on but wont connect. Retried multiple times... same results. Next I guess is the drag test... where you use a paper clip to test each pin hole on the vehicles scanner port under the dash.After reading some other peoples reviews of this unit, I thought I should add my review to the list. No pins are broken, none are bent, and plug was pushed all the way in.If I could return it I would its really been no help so far, and a waste of money...

source_doc: My feet don't hurt this morning. I expected these inserts to have an effect while I was wearing them - and they did. I was surprised about the impact the next day. My first steps after getting up were pain free, and I can't remember the last time that happened. I'm definitely sold on these insoles. Though the packaging says it can take two to three days to get used to them, my right foot was completely comfortable immediately. The left not so much. I won't call it UNcomfortable, but definitely more noticeable. That's a "me" issue, though.My feet were slightly more sweaty when I took off my shoes after about four hours, but not annoyingly so. Of maybe I just didn't notice because I live with a teen athlete and anything other than cleat feet doesn't register.I found the template a little annoying. Not enough to knock off a full star, but maybe an eighth of a star. Neither of the shoes I use these in has removable linings. I tried the template on the outside of the shoe, as it suggests, and, to no surprise, it said I needed the full-length insert, which didn't fit in my shoe. I got it right after three rounds of trial and error, but perhaps marking with template with shoes sizes (men's on one, women's on the other) would eliminate a few steps.

source_doc: Find your studs before ordering. I assumed I would not have trouble laying out the footprint I hade in mind. But the studs in my garage walls appear to be irregularly spaced. Two different stud finder tools failed to help. So I had to probe around. I attempted to pop the wall plates off of a light switch and an outlet, identify the corresponding wall stud, and measure in 16 inch increments and higher, and couldn’t figure a consistent interval. So I ended up just using my smallest drill bit with some guesswork until I found enough spots that would work.Wish I had spent some time getting lines down on every possible stud before I opened boxes and stuff everywhere. I made it work by combining some 4’ and 3’ spans (from the 6’ model).Now that I got them up, I’m satisfied with how they look and getting my crap off the floor.

source_doc: This is a compact unit that will work with your existing ratchet wrench or breaker bar. This tool has a solid, compact storage case, and the unit will work with 1/4, 3//8, and a half inch drive.  The unit will display and work with numerous torque measurements and specifically inch-pounds and foot-pounds that I need. To test its functionality I loosened a wheel lug on the tractor.  I then connected the electronic torque tool to my existing click adjustable torque wrench.  I adjusted the electronic device to 83.5 foot-pounds and the click adjustable to 86 foot-pounds.  As I tightened the bolt, the electronic device began beeping at just under 80 pounds.  My initial thought was "this isn't good".  So I next set both to 86 foot-pounds.  The beeping began around 83 foot-pounds but I kept going.  At 86 foot-pounds I heard the click and the tone switched from beeping to solid simultaneously.  Great, I figured out the beep is "approaching" and solid means you're there.  I later went back to the manual and found a "note" explaining the beep means you're within 20% of the target.  So, I like the unit and the audible feedback.

source_doc: I wish I found this sooner. I’ve had my leather couch for about a year and my bulldogs had put a few scratches on it and I knew I had to do something to protect it fast.  I ordered several different kinds of covers and had to send them all back because my cushions are connected to the couch.  This doesn’t move very much and so far I’m not having to constantly adjust it even when I recline it, they go back pretty much like they were.  My frenchie is crazy and she runs and flies onto the couch like a tiger is chasing her and it has stayed put for all those shenanigans so far.  The rubber grippers on the back work well.  I haven’t washed it yet but when I do I will air dry it because I know from past experience that a dryer will ruin them.  I wish I had found this cover and started using it when I first bought the couch but better late than never.

source_doc: Nice Fit and Look but Having to Replace the Washer Nozzle with OEM Disappointing. I really liked the look of this and it was a perfect replacement. I ordered the black version to accent my Black Jeep which I was really glad I did for the look!However there is where my problems came and why I only gave 3 stars. It comes with a paper saying to replace the Washer Nozzle that comes with it with the old OEM version from the one you are removing.YOU MUST DO THIS because The Nozzle that comes with it is terrible and basically squirts a stream of water down the back instead of spraying it. I found this out the hard way.First, because I ordered the Black version it would look real goofy with the Red nozzle on it. That’s why I ignored the manufacturers direction. So I had to mask off and paint my old red nozzle to match black.Second, because the original OEM nozzle was old the plastic was brittle and one of the securing clips molded into it was broken in the process. You cannot buy just the nozzle and have to buy the whole light assembly so I had to do some engineering to make it work.The manufacturer needs to fix this functional nozzle issue and not make Customers have to hassle with this. If it weren’t for this I would have given it 5 stars!

source_doc: Probably my favorite mouse of all time. I had a G502 Hero wired mouse before this one. The way I had my cables routed I was constantly dealing with drag issues. I would leave the mouse still and watch the cursor move as the cable sagged. It's a minor annoyance at best...and I could have fixed it...but I treated myself to a new mouse and I'm not disappointed in the slightest. I'm not really a huge gamer but I do IT work from home and am at the computer for 8 - 12 hours pretty much every day. A comfortable mouse is a must and this is it! The battery seems to last about 2 - 3 weeks between charges. If I ever have to go back to the office, the fact that this is the non-RGB version works in my favor and it won't attract too much attention.The software is a bit on the finicky side. I like to run mine at 6400dpi. The defaults are not great and when the software updates I'm stuck waiting for the speed to pick up again while watching the splash animation play out. I kind of got around this by enabling on-board memory mode but even then it randomly turned down the DPI for no discernible reason. I'm not hitting the buttons either, I have the default DPI up and down buttons disabled as well as the profile select button.

source_doc: Incredible audio and customer service! I purchased this monitor in June of 2021. I use it for monitoring my mom with severe Alzheimer's. The sound quality is amazing! I can hear her breathing from across the room on this monitor. Sunday morning about 2 am, I started getting a notification beep that the battery was about dead on my monitor. I checked the cord, battery, everything. I emailed customer support at 2:30 in the morning on a Sunday morning, I had a response later Sunday. Long story short, they expedited a replacement cord to me and I received it just now (Tuesday morning). Free of charge. Wow!The picture quality is pretty good, just small on this camera, but as I said the audio is amazing. $49 is a steal for this camera! I have purchased a lot of baby monitors to find the best one. This has much better sound pickup than any of the others I tried- including expensive ones. Expensive price is not equivalent to quality. This is a great buy! I can't say enough good about them. Oh yeah, the monitor also will pick up across the street as well. I can carry it over to visit with a neighbor and keep an eye on my mom as she sleeps.Buy it!

source_doc: I LOVE Being Able To Just Unplug The Cable, And It DOESN'T BUZZ! IT'S GREAT! This "LEKATO Instrument Cable with Dual Mute Plug Ends" works quite well!I REALLY LOVE being able to just unplug the cable, and NOT HAVING IT BUZZ!And, I don't know WHY I waited so long, (50 years!), to get a cable with this Auto-MUTE SWITCH Feature!It's quite a flexible cable, and, it has the all-important Gold-Plated Connectors, too, so I won't get any corrosion! It goes perfectly with the gold Pure Tone output jacks, that I like to add to all of my guitars. (THAT WAY, it's gold-to-gold, and I avoid any 'dissimilar metals effect"...)I also like having the right-angled connector on one end, too. It works nicely going into my little Fender Mustang I V.2 Modeling Amp, which I have placed on a chest-high shelf. The 90 degree-end takes all of the strain off of the cable, in that setup. And then, of course, the other, straight-end goes nicely into my Strats, my Teles, my Mustang, my Toronado, my Les Faul... or whatever...BTW, BOTH ENDS of the cable offer the auto-Mute Switch functionality.So, in short, I think it's a pretty good option for an Auto-Mute Switch Instrument Cable, especially for the price.I like it!Have fun.-C(NOTE: I did NOT receive this product through any Promotion, I bought and paid for it myself.)

source_doc: I LOVE This Little Light Of Mine. All kidding aside, I really love this little tactical flashlight.  The light is extremely bright and and versatile.  LED really does make a difference and it seems like the battery life is extremely long after a full charge.  The price is absolutely reasonable and I have been using this little flashlight for over 6 months and oddly, I find myself having to use it more than I thought I would.  I usually always buy those cheapy ones at the hardware store, they don't last very long and aren't anywhere close to as bright as this one is.  The fact that you can recharge is definitely a money saving bonus.  This would make a great gift for anyone as well.  I have since purchased 3 more so that I can keep them handy in different locations like the vehicle, that tool box, my desk and the tackle box.  I highly recommend this one and I hope you find this review helpful!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: Easy to swallow capsules. I purchased a bottle of Surebounty Magnesium Malate 90 count. When reading all the pro’s & con’s about this product, I knew I wanted to try it. The one thing I liked was the fact their capsules are so easy to swallow. That means a lot to me. As I get older I am not able to swallow big capsules anymore. The direction on the bottle says you can take 1-4 capsules a day. I have been taking 2. The reason I do that is because I take other supplements that already has some magnesium malate in it. I am happy to see they do not use any fillers or binders. The capsules are non GMO/dairy/gluten free. So far I am very pleased with this product. I would definitely recommend.

source_doc: Looks Nice, Quality Is Good, But... ...it didn't fit the dog I ordered it for. Did I measure wrong? I don't know, but I usually order a small or medium for my Chiweenie, this time I ordered a medium and it just doesn't fit. It's too small. The velcro straps barely touch when I put it on him, and it's too big to fit my next smaller dog.However, the quality is very good. It appears very sturdy and well made. I like that the velcro area on the strips is pretty big, so it really offers a secure closure, plus the 2nd closure option, the buckle, also feels sturdy.It's not adjustable in the sense that you can't shorten or lengthen any straps, but it is adjustable in the sense that you can adjust the velcro closure to fit.It's mesh and breathable and looks quite nice. The only thing I would see as a con, (instead of a "pro"), at least for me, is that it doesn't have a any stretch like other similar harnesses do. I feel like with a little bit of stretch, there's a little bi of give, so it doesn't hurt him if I happen to pull on the harness. Some owners may not want any stretch, so I guess this just depends on preference.All in all, I do recommend it based on quality, but unfortunately, it just didn't fit. Make sure to measure correctly!

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Vypadá hezky, kvalita je dobrá, ale... ...nesedělo to psovi, pro kterého jsem to objednal/a. Změřil/a jsem ho špatně? Nevím, ale pro svého křížence čivavy a jezevčíka obvykle objednávám velikost S nebo M, tentokrát jsem objednal/a M a prostě to nesedí. Je to příliš malé. Pásky se suchým zipem se sotva dotýkají, když mu to nasadím, a na mého dalšího, menšího psa je to zase moc velké. Nicméně kvalita je velmi dobrá. Vypadá to velmi robustně a kvalitně zpracované. Líbí se mi, že plocha suchého zipu na páscích je docela velká, takže nabízí opravdu bezpečné zapnutí, a navíc druhá možnost zapínání, přezka, působí také pevně. Není to nastavitelné v tom smyslu, že byste mohli zkrátit nebo prodloužit jakékoli pásky, ale je to nastavitelné v tom smyslu, že můžete přizpůsobit zapínání na suchý zip, aby sedělo. Je to ze síťoviny, prodyšné a vypadá to docela hezky. Jediná věc, kterou bych viděl/a jako zápor (místo „plusu“), alespoň pro mě, je, že to vůbec nepruží jako jiné podobné postroje. Mám pocit, že s trochou pružnosti tam bývá drobná vůle, takže ho to nebolí, když za postroj náhodou zatáhnu. Někteří majitelé možná žádnou pružnost nechtějí, takže to asi závisí na preferencích. Celkově vzato to na základě kvality doporučuji, ale nám to bohužel prostě nesedělo. Nezapomeňte správně měřit!

I am giving it to all my dogs daily and I see they sleep better and are more calmed as my babies tend to be anxious and have lots of separation anxiety. My elderly dog has Glaucoma and although it is a condition the vet will most likely need to remove the eye. I noticed that upon giving her the hemp oil, the inflammation of the eye has reduced a lot. I don't know if its helping the pain as my dog can't tell me but I definitely noticed her eye that was about to pop, did sink down a lot. Meanwhile I save for the very expensive eye removal. I give it to her daily in a higher dose than stated as she is most anxious and  has her bad eye. I am on the second bottle and just ordered more.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

Předtím jsem svému staršímu psovi dával/a CBD tinkturu od Medterra, ale 1 oz stojí asi 28 dolarů plus daň a doprava. Drahé! source_doc: I have thought about buying like 10 of these. I am a nail girly - I spend a lot on at-home nail products. So I have spent quite a bit on nail drills that always end up breaking. I usually buy the ones that are around $80-$100. I can honestly say, none of them have ever been anywhere as great as this one. I've had this for a few months and it is still going strong. I am not sure how long it'll last, but my others usually only lasted this amount of time. If this broke I wouldn't be upset, I would just order a new one because it is worth every penny. I LOVE that it is cordless, but ESPECIALLY that it isn't bulky like most cordless nail drills that are attached to a big block. It is legit perfect. Another thing I LOVE that makes this so much better than others, is that it can go fast, but more importantly, it can go slow. Even on the slowest setting every other nail drill was too powerful sometimes, but this one is perfect. Power when you want, but gentle when you don't. I would spend $100 on this and it would still be worth it.

source_doc: As flimsy as paper. I was looking to replace a wonderful bass clef magnet I'd had on my car for many years. I liked the romantic look of this treble/bass clef design, and was excited to get it. It arrived in a regular envelope, and I had no idea what was in it. I almost didn't open it, because the return address was not familiar. When I did open it, the magnet slid out like a piece of card stock paper, and the 2 "dots" that rest on the outer edge of the bass clef were 2 loose little black circles --- not in any way what I expected, and I certainly can't put it on my car. The first rain would wash them off. The extension at the bottom of the treble clef is flimsy & weak. I don't really know what I can do with it. I put it on my refrigerator, because I can't use it for what it was intended, and it won't stick to anything else.

source_doc: pretty good at getting a close shave wherever you choose to shave. I use a popular subscription service, but I keep forgetting to order a new handle. I like to keep 2 handles, 1 in each bathroom. I use it to shave all over, including my face (no, tis a total myth that hair grows back more course). It helps keep my skin ultra smooth, and unless going to a professional, it is the exact same thing as other so called DIY dermaplaning gadgets. I swear, the pink tax on some stuff, some of which is our fault for buying into it all. So until I actually remember to buy another handle, I decided to just grab one of these. I like it enough that I may or may not bother with an additional handle (though I have dozens of razor heads so I may not want to have to add in another purchase). but for $15 or so bucks, I think it is reasonable. Has a good close shave, skin feels soft and smooth, if I take care of the razor head it should stay sharp for awhile. So far so good.

 TEXT:
hypo_0: docela dobrý na hladké oholení, ať už se rozhodnete holit kdekoli. Používám populární předplatitelskou službu, ale stále zapomínám objednat novou rukojeť. Rád/a mám 2 rukojeti, 1 v každé koupelně. Používám ji na holení celého těla, včetně obličeje (ne, je to naprostý mýtus, že chloupky rostou silnější). Pomáhá to udržovat mou pokožku ultra hladkou, a pokud nejdete k profesionálovi, je to naprosto stejná věc jako jiné takzvané DIY pomůcky na dermaplaning. Fakt, ta růžová daň na některé věci – za což si zčásti můžeme sami/y, že tomu všemu věříme a kupujeme to. Takže dokud si opravdu nevzpomenu, že mám koupit další rukojeť, rozhodl/a jsem se prostě pořídit jednu z těchto. Líbí se mi natolik, že se možná s další rukojetí nebudu obtěžovat (i když mám desítky holicích hlavic, takže možná nebudu chtít přidávat další nákup). source_doc: Heavy Duty! This is awesome because it turns your wire rack shelves into solid shelves in seconds.  I hate it when I put something on the shelf and it wiggles it's way off. Or it doesn't stand properly because it doesn't fit across the shelf properly. No more! Now I have shelves that feel like they are solid.My only gripe is that I wish I had done these BEFORE I put stuff on the rack. I had to take everything off. Which was time consuming, BUT no fault of the manufacturer. And truth be told, it was like moving - I got to declutter some stuff that I probably didn't need any more.I'll know for next time. Buy liners BEFORE placing things on rack. If I buy a rack, will order liners before I build it.

source_doc: Very Sturdy. I have bought what feels like a ton of these over my adult life for all kinds of different, practical applications not just for hanging a shower curtain and this one has to be one of the sturdiest ones I have ever purchased.  I wasn't so sure about the black as I normally stick to white, off-white or a light tan but for the purpose of my purchase, I was indifferent because I just needed a sturdier rod in my laundry room.  I use this rod to hang the clothes right out of the dryer and sometimes, the weight of clothes can be so much that a regular, cheaper rod, will buckle under that kind of weight.  I was hoping that this rod would solve my worry about that because I had my other one fall on me, a couple of times by that buckling under the weight of the clothes.  This one is absolutely the answer.  It is really easy to install and extremely sturdy, I can easily hang about 3 loads before I have to put them in their respective closets.  That's a LOT of laundry, and an amount that my other rod couldn't even dream about holding.  The price is very reasonable as well, so if you are in the market for a really sturdy rod, this is it.  I hope you find this review helpful!

source_doc: So Easy. You just put the clips on them and they are ready to learn. I have a liftmaster + security. I looked on the garage door opener for the dangling wire, took the light cover off and saw a red button. This is my learn button. I long pressed II & III until the LED came on and then blinked a bit and went off. Since my learn button was red I clicked the I button 3 times. then pressed one of the different buttons (II or III). Then I pressed the red learn button on the garage door opener and immediately clicked the I button on the new remote. I heard 2 clicks. My light bulb is out or else it probably would have blinked 2 times as well. Afterwards I hit the I button on the remoter and the door opened. Then I hit it again and the door closed. Very easy for me. If what I said isn't clear refer to the directions that are in the box. Plus your learn button may be different. Inexpensive way to get extra remotes or replace broken ones.

source_doc: Almost perfect. Better as a light feature. I tried a few sound machines but this one was the best I found for my needs. I tried the portable frida, VTech soother with the app (similar to hatch), Google mini speaker, or just a fan running. I wanted a sound machine that worked with Google Home, had a reliable app, good sound quality and sound options, and dynamic lighting that I could change colors or dim. The govee sound machine fit most of these. My only issue was the sound options and the speaker sound could be improved. The app had mostly 'natural' sounds like wind, rain, river, fire, and some lullaby options. I just wanted a basic flat white, pink, or brown noise. The closest I found to the white noise is the wind and for some reason the speaker quality didn't block a lot of background noise. I noticed some of the other ones I tried did really well blocking noise because it had better sound frequency range. Other than that this would be perfect. My baby woke up more often using this for sound. The lighting options are really unique so I'll give it that. I like the gaming mode and different lighting combos. I now just use this as a light so I'll keep it.

Tento působí dokonce ještě o něco silnějším dojmem než bryndáčky, které obvykle kupuji, což bývá typ s flísovou spodní stranou. source_doc: Simple Tool Makes for Easy Work! I love these. I have been buying them for a few years. Fret polishing is a task that never goes out of style and these fret erasers make easy work of a tedious task. This is the first time I got the 180 grit eraser so I am really excited to see how that will work on some of the more stubborn scratches and tool marks that I find on frets. They are pretty simple to use, I tape off the fret board and then use them just like an eraser. I go fret by fret with each eraser working my way up from the lower grits to the higher polishing grits. This kit has the 1000 grit which I have already but I would encourage buying the 2000 grit eraser or using a finger nail buffer stick to really nail the mirror shine. I not only recommend, but I use them myself and love them!

source_doc: Absolutely worth it! I needed a replacement table and found this one. I was worried bout some of the reviews, but it came in pristine condition and was very easy to put together. source_doc: Works great for my very fine thin fragile hair, but it's a bit sticky... This TRESemmé Hair Mist Texture Mist works great for my very fine thin fragile, and somewhat curly hair. This spray mist is a bit sticky, but I guess that's what gives it its grippiness.Whenever I go out, I always wear wigs, but at home I sport the little bit of hair I have, as it's just more comfortable. This works as a double duty product. It provides a bit of texture and volume to my natural hair, making it look like I have more than I do.It also gives it more grip for keeping my wigs in place. I'm unable to wear a wig cap, only wig grips. This gives them something more to hold on to than just my wimpy looking hair. When I remove my wigs, I can just spray with water, scrunch, and let my hair dry to revive it.This is not the type of spray or mist that you can easily spray onto your hair, as it actually doesn't create a mist. I just spray it into my hands, rub them together, and apply it throughout.Even though it is not technically a mist, I still like this texture, volume, and grip it provides to my natural hair, and would absolutely recommend it!

hypo_0: Skvěle funguje na moje velmi jemné, řídké a křehké vlasy, ale je trochu lepkavý... Tato vlasová mlha TRESemmé Texture Mist skvěle funguje na moje velmi jemné, řídké, křehké a poněkud kudrnaté vlasy. Tento sprej je trochu lepkavý, ale myslím, že právě to mu dodává jeho přilnavost. Kdykoli jdu ven, vždy nosím paruky, ale doma se ukazuji s tím málem vlasů, co mám, protože je to prostě pohodlnější. Tento produkt funguje na dva způsoby. Dodává mým přirozeným vlasům trochu textury a objemu, takže to vypadá, že jich mám víc než ve skutečnosti. Také jim dodává větší přilnavost, aby paruky držely na svém místě. Nemohu nosit síťku pod paruku, pouze čelenky na uchycení paruky. Toto jim dává lepší možnost se uchytit než jen na mých neduživě vypadajících vlasech. Když si paruku sundám, stačí vlasy postříkat vodou, promačkat a nechat uschnout, aby se oživily. Nejedná se o typ spreje nebo mlhy, který by se dal na vlasy snadno nastříkat, protože ve skutečnosti mlhu nevytváří. Nastříkám si ho prostě do dlaní, rozetřu a nanesu do vlasů. Přestože se technicky nejedná o mlhu, stále se mi líbí tato textura, objem a přilnavost, kterou mým přirozeným vlasům poskytuje, a rozhodně bych ho doporučil/a!

source_doc: Requires you to close your doors into it. I have an older car (Toyota Solara), and wanted this to protect it from the times I can't park in the garage. I've used another cover previously however it has gotten worn down from seasons so I wanted to give this one a try.The good news is that the clips are plastic, which I LOVE. The old cover I used had metal clips, and if one isn't fastened properly, that'll scratch up the car in the wind as it shakes around. I prefer plastic or rubberized clips any day.The bad news, is that they want me to close the doors into this in order to hold it in place. I did not realize that is how it is supposed to work, and I have a major problem with that- The Solara doors don't have a top frame, it is glass against the rubber gasket of the car's top. With material in between like this, you are asking for leaks into the interior of the car around the door seams. I don't like that at all. It fits fine on my other car (Honda Odyssey) but I'm disappointed I can't use it on the car I wanted to.

source_doc: Ryobi 3/8 in. Variable Speed Drill (Renewed) I ordered this drill because funds are tight but I needed a drill to do some home maintenance. It is refurbished. The drill came without a case or any bling which is exactly what I expected. It did come with an instructional manual and a full 1 year warranty which was enough to impress me. I have used it a couple of times and I am not disappointed at all. It has plenty of power for the size of drill it is. I am a 60 year old disabled woman and I was able to fix my own wall that was bulging out due to blown insulation settling. I search high and low to find this Ryobi drill because I still have the 9v cordless I bought about 18 years ago and it is just now dying and no batteries are made for it anymore. Ryobi is a great product line. I wish I could afford 1 of everything they make. Don't be afraid to order the refurbished drill. It was a fantastic purchase choice for me.

source_doc: I LOVEEEEE IT - but not for work. I eyeballed this keyboard for the LONGEST time before deciding to buy it.  I wanted something pink.  I wanted something backlit.  I wanted something CLICKY.  And this keyboard gave me all of that.  I don't like rechargeable keyboards because I never remember to charge them.  So this being wired made me happy.  I use it all the time for gaming and personal work.  However, when I am working I switch back over to my Apple keyboard.  Only because the clicks of the keys are loud and I don't feel like it is professional.  I prefer a muted keyboard when I am on the phone with clients and I'm typing away.  That's just a personal preference for myself.  I'm sure not everyone is bothered by it, it's just who I am.  So I can easily flip between my personal keyboard and my work keyboard.  That made this thing even better!

source_doc: Better than expected. I used this as a junction box on my utility trailer. My trailer doesn't have brakes so I didn't need all the lugs but I wanted a box like this to use in wiring the trailer and didn't find anything like it for a four wire setup so I went ahead and got this one and I'm glad I did. I did add a rubber gasket and I sealed around the wires with silicone RTV where I brought them into the wiring box through the rubber plugs that came with the box.The box itself is pretty stout but the strain relief clamps on the ends of the box could definitely stand some beefing up. It would be a better product if the side enty ports also had strain reliefs.In spite of its shortcomings, I like this box well enough that I bought another one which I intend to use when I rewire another trailer of mine next summer.

source_doc: Not sure if it worked, but my tank was cycled quickly. I watched a bunch of youtube videos and was expecting to get some giant algae bloom or a huge spike in nitrites and then nitrates.  I never experienced any of this. I was so unsure if my tank was cycled. I tested my water consistently, for 2 weeks no change. Then i bought a small rock covered in algae from petco and put it in there. I shined a flashlight that night and saw it had some good hitchhikers in it. Tiny Stomatella snails, and alot of amphipods. I watched them for a week and they were thriving so i knew it was obviously cycled now. Then i bought one fish, a diamond goby. That guy is the best purchase ive made. He is a workhorse and keeps my entire sandbed clean of all extra food. Anyways... he was happy in there. So then i knew it was safe to add more.  My tank is 75 gallons with live sand and dry live rock carib sea. The only wet live rock i added was that tiny one from petco.  I think it works. Still not sure really if it was this stuff or the extra time i gave it.

source_doc: Meh... It's OK for low volume playback. So, I have 2 offices I work out of in my home. My small office has a set of M-Audio AV32.1 to play background music at low volume, but I always find the low end lacking. I run a 10" Monolith sub in my other office, paired with Mackie XR624 monitors and I'm mostly happy with that setup, so I thought I would get another Monolith, but I think if would be way too much sub for the M-Audio speakers. Thankfully, Monoprice makes a very inexpensive 10" sub that supposedly plays down to 20hz. I played with it for a couple of hours, and so far, it's ok. I'm cycling now to break it in, but overall it adds that little depth  I was missing on the M-Audio speakers. I'm sure they'll sound better once they are broken in. I'm still on the fence about this sub, since it lacks authority like the Monolith or the 15" DR. HSU I have for my main setup.  Then again, I haven't added a proper crossover to the small office setup, so the verdict is still out...  For small room, low volume - I give it a 3 out of 5.  If you can afford it or wait for a closeout, the Monoprice Monolith 10" is 10 x better.

Ve své malé pracovně mám sadu M-Audio AV32.1 na přehrávání hudby na pozadí při nízké hlasitosti, ale vždycky mám pocit, že tomu chybí basy. Ve své druhé pracovně používám 10" subwoofer Monolith spárovaný s monitory Mackie XR624 a s touto sestavou jsem většinou spokojený/á, takže jsem si říkal/a, že bych si pořídil/a další Monolith, ale myslím, že na reproduktory M-Audio by to bylo až příliš silné basové dělo. Naštěstí Monoprice vyrábí velmi levný 10" subwoofer, který údajně hraje až do 20 Hz. Hrál/a jsem si s ním pár hodin a zatím je to v pohodě. Teď ho nechávám běžet v cyklech, aby se rozehrál, ale celkově dodává tu trochu hloubky, která mi u reproduktorů M-Audio chyběla. Jsem si jistý/á, že jakmile se rozehrají, budou znít lépe. Stále jsem ohledně tohoto subwooferu na vážkách, protože mu chybí taková razance, jakou má Monolith nebo 15" DR. HSU, který mám ve své hlavní sestavě. Na druhou stranu jsem do sestavy v malé pracovně ještě nepřidal/a pořádnou výhybku, takže verdikt je stále otevřený... Pro malou místnost a nízkou hlasitost dávám 3 z 5. Pokud si to můžete dovolit nebo si počkáte na výprodej, Monoprice Monolith 10" je 10x lepší.

source_doc: Works great on my long haired Maine Coon. I have a Maine Coon cat with really long hair. This comb really helps pull the loose hair out of his coat. I use it about once a week on him and I am always shocked at how much hair I get, between a golf ball size to tennis ball sized clump of hair when I am done. You would think after pulling up that much hair that he would be thinned out, but every week there is more. I think it really helps with the fur ball problem because I don't hear him trying to cough up the fur balls as much since I started using this every week. You just have to go slow, don't pull to hard, and if it starts to have resistance just pull up away from the body. Just watch if he likes it or not, if he is purring I good to go but if I start getting the look and the wagging tail I had better slowdown or back off. He is 24 pound cat that you want to treat right. Afterwards I give him some freeze dried chicken as a treat and he is very happy with me. I like this comb, very happy with it, best out of the five I had prior to this one.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a" 

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Skvěle funguje na moji dlouhosrstou mayskou mývalí kočku. Mám mayskou mývalí kočku s opravdu dlouhou srstí. Tento hřeben opravdu pomáhá vyčesat uvolněné chlupy z jeho kožichu. Používám ho na něj asi jednou týdně a vždycky jsem v šoku/u vyjevený/á, kolik chlupů z něj dostanu – když skončím, je to chomáč o velikosti od golfového míčku až po tenisák. Člověk by si myslel, že po vyčesání tolika srsti bude prořídlý, ale každý týden je tam další. Myslím, že to opravdu pomáhá s problémem s bezoáry, protože od té doby, co ho používám každý týden, ho už tolik neslyším pokoušet se vykašlat smotky chlupů. Jen musíte postupovat pomalu, netahat příliš silně, a pokud začne klást odpor, stačí hřeben zvednout směrem od těla. Jen sledujte, jestli se mu to líbí, nebo ne – pokud přede, můžu pokračovat, ale jakmile na mě začne házet pohledy a mrskat ocasem, měl/a bych raději zpomalit nebo přestat. Je to jedenáctikilový kocour, se kterým si nechcete zahrávat. Potom mu dám jako pamlsek mrazem sušené kuře a je se mnou velmi spokojený. Tento hřeben se mi líbí, jsem s ním velmi spokojený/á, je nejlepší z těch pěti, které jsem měl/a před ním.

source_doc: Bulky. I have large chihuahua so I ordered the medium according to their size recommendations.  I was surprised at how bulky this collar is.  It was a bit larger in circumference than I expected but I was able to size it down fine to fit, some of the lights are now tucked under, but there is still plenty of brightness.  The battery box and the AirTag holder are big though.  I put it on my giant Chihuahua and he was like, "what the heck is on ma neck, lady?" He got used to it quick.  I do really like the light show.  You can choose your color and your blink pattern.  This collar is bright!  Very visible will be the dog you put this on.  You can see in my one of my pictures the width of the battery box controller, and airTag holder which is what I docked the star for.  This collar is holding up well with our rainy winter night walks, but this thing verges on apparatus rather than collar.  Maybe it's just me having a smaller- but still *relatively* giant- dog and not being used to what a big dog might wear.  It came with a seatbelt adapter but I use a dog seat so I gifted that to a friend who likes it. I don't know how safe it keeps the dog but it keeps her out of the front seat!

source_doc: Everyone should have one of these. I went out Christmas Eve (Subzero temps outside) to go to my bother's house and my car didn't start. Fortunately I was home and my neighbor was able to help me. I realized that I didn't want to depend on someone else to keep my car running  so I ordered this. The day after I got this I went out again (now much warmer) and my car wouldn't start again.  I hooked this up, turned it on and my car started right up. It was easy to use and its great peace of mind to know I'm safe if this happens when I am out and about. This is something everyone needs in their car but especially women.  My only "complaint"  is I wish the cables were just a few inches longer. This would make the hook up a little easier.  I have tried several other brands that had good ratings and they didn't work.  This one is great!

source_doc: Hard to say if it's the car or me or this part. I ordered this to replace the crankshaft position sensor in my 2011 Nissan Sentra. It was throwing a code for a multiple/random misfire and I replaced the plugs and all of the coil packs so this was next on the list. After I replaced the sensor I am getting lights on the dash and even more codes then before I replaced it (basically it made it worse). I don't know if it's the sensor, the way I replaced it, or anything of that nature because I am not a professional mechanic, which is why I'm giving it a 'neutral' review. The sensor was definitely brand new and looked fine before installation so I can't 100% say it's faulty right now. After I get everything worked out I will probably update this review.

source_doc: Great, until it fell apart! I am in a nursing home, and I had it sitting on a table at the end of my bed. I reached for it with my grabber tool, to pull it towards me, and the side literally just popped off. There are two miniscule nails holding it together, which are as thick as office staples. As soon as that side came off, the rest of it started to come apart as well. I started to do a return, but it said it had to be returned in original packaging, which of course I didn't keep. Or I could get an exchange, but I what if that falls apart too? I noticed that beside the tiny, insignificant nails, there is a trail of wood glue that is about the width of a human hair. I think if they had used bigger nails or more wood glue, it would have stayed together. I'm just going to try and hot glue it back together. If that doesn't work, I have elbow joint brackets I can screw on to each corner. If not for it falling apart, I would have given it 5 stars. The concept is awesome to store your different sizes of zippy bags in. Just wish it had been put together better.

hypo_0: Skvělé, dokud se to nerozpadlo! Jsem v domově pro seniory a měl/a jsem to položené na stolku na konci postele. Natáhl/a jsem se pro to svým podavačem, abych si to přitáhl/a k sobě, a ten bok doslova prostě upadl. Drží to pohromadě dva miniaturní hřebíčky, které jsou tlusté jako kancelářské sponky. Jakmile odpadla tato strana, začal se rozpadat i zbytek. Začal/a jsem vyřizovat vrácení, ale bylo tam napsáno, že zboží musí být vráceno v původním obalu, který jsem si samozřejmě nenechal/a. Nebo jsem mohl/a dostat výměnu, ale co když se to taky rozpadne? Všiml/a jsem si, že vedle těch drobných, bezvýznamných hřebíčků je stopa lepidla na dřevo, která má šířku asi jako lidský vlas. Myslím, že kdyby použili větší hřebíky nebo více lepidla na dřevo, drželo by to pohromadě. Prostě se to pokusím slepit tavnou pistolí zpátky k sobě. Ten koncept na ukládání různých velikostí uzavíratelných sáčků je úžasný. Jen si přeji, aby to bylo sestaveno lépe.

source_doc: Important to know!! We had a harrowing experience just now Daisy our cavachon ripped apart the monkey and on the floor next to the monkey was a little tiny battery. source_doc: Awesome thermometer. I love this thermometer! I never worried about a thermometer until the RONA hit. The first time I caught it was right before we could get vaccinated and I have Fibromyalgia so even the CDC told us that I was going to have a rougher time of it than my mom. And I did, I fought with a fever for over a week while she never had a fever. (That's just the pertinent symptom here) We had gotten 2 thermometers one for the temple and I got a regular one because I had to be able to use it simply and in the dark and didn't want to fumble with it. But they both used button batteries. Guess what, a couple years later when I got it a second time (proving I was more prone to it because I didn't pass it to my mom as she had passed it to me) Both thermometers were dead and we couldn't check my temp, though I didn't have a fever. So when I saw this one and saw it took normal every day run of the mill always on hand batteries and that it displayed the same as the ones we had I grabbed it right up and it didn't disappoint. And while I don't need it yet, I did try it and it works perfectly. I'm so happy with this thermometer.

I've had no side effects whatsoever.  And I'm not sure, but I think it's helping me lose weight, without trying.  I've also noticed my right ankle and foot isn't swollen so much from the referred pain from multilevel lumbar degenerative disc disease (lumbar radiculopathy).  It will be interesting to see how I feel after using it for one year.

source_doc: Thick, plush & WARM as advertised!! Sir Thomas is a stray ( in pic), roaming the neighborhood; came up missing for a few days; when he did return, he had been in a fight. I brought out the new (still in box) thermal cat mat-pad, folded a blanket throw underneath the Morapet, so he’d be elevated a bit. This fellow didn’t hesitate; it’s as if his name was on it, got right in, laid down and was out like a light. Slept several hours. Outside temp was 47°. I called our Vet, no openings for another 4 days. I’m trying to get him to trust me more, so I can get him fixed, but this injury took front-runner, I can work on trust later. Originally, I had browsed all the other brands of self-warming mat-pads for one of our senior indoor cats, as I needed another self-warming mat-pad for Geno… I settled on this one for it’s plush fabric &  thickness, but when I saw Sir Thomas’ eye injury,  the 3 deep gashes on his paw and small bit of missing fur on his hind area, I felt this warming mat-pad really needs to go to him. Before his injury, he’d just sleep wherever he could.I was so impressed with the quality of workmanship, the thickness, plush & warmth of this product. I will be buying another 1 or 2 to replace Geno’s.  YES I would recommend this product !!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Hustá, plyšová a TEPLÁ, jak slibuje reklama!! Sir Thomas je toulavý kocour (na fotce), který se potuluje po okolí; na pár dní se ztratil, a když se vrátil, byl po rvačce. Vytáhl/a jsem novou (ještě nevybalenou) termopodložku pro kočky a pod Morapet složil/a deku, aby byl trochu výš. Tenhle chlapík neváhal ani vteřinu; jako by na ní bylo napsané jeho jméno, vlezl si přímo na ni, lehl si a hned usnul. Spal několik hodin. Venku bylo 47 °F (cca 8 °C). Volal/a jsem našemu veterináři, ale volný termín měli až za 4 dny. Snažím se, aby mi víc důvěřoval, abych ho mohl/a nechat vykastrovat, ale tohle zranění teď mělo přednost, na důvěře můžu pracovat později. Původně jsem prohlížel/a všechny ostatní značky samozahřívacích podložek pro jednu z našich starších koček žijících uvnitř, protože jsem potřeboval/a další samozahřívací podložku pro Gena… Nakonec jsem se rozhodl/a pro tuto kvůli její plyšové látce a tloušťce, ale když jsem viděl/a zranění oka Sira Thomase, 3 hluboké rány na tlapce a kousek chybějící srsti na zadní části těla, měl/a jsem pocit, že tato hřejivá podložka musí jít rozhodně jemu. Před svým zraněním spal prostě kdekoli, kde mohl. Kvalita zpracování, tloušťka, plyšovost a hřejivost tohoto produktu na mě udělaly velký dojem. Určitě koupím další 1 nebo 2, abych nahradil/a tu Genovu. ANO, tento produkt bych doporučil/a!!

source_doc: Almost impossible to play as it came. The guitar looks beautiful and I was very happy until I realized the strings had never even been tensioned....meaning the neck could easily warp.  So I got to work on it, I'm very familiar and used to setting up acoustic guitars.  First the sound hole hex key adjustment is one I've never seen...bizarre...they provide a very long and difficult to use adjustment hex....and it barely works.  This guitar came with action so high it could not be played really.  I play out fairly regularly and have some very high end guitars, even affordable Alvarez guitars I have came setup and easy to adjust.  I have no idea right now what I was do.  I know a good luthier and will get his opinion.  I'm extremely disappointed.  This instrument is not well thought out in terms of design of the neck tension system at all and the copy I received had very little care before it was taken out of a very beaten up box...perhaps it was one sent back.  But this is unplayable.  I may send it back, I wanted a jumbo that I could take out to play and not worry about a super expensive guitar...I've seen half the price guitars that are better than this one...but the finish etc is nice...what a shame the rest isn't.

source_doc: My very first VR set! So worth the money! I finally decided to plunge into the world of virtual reality — and I’m so glad I chose this item as my first “attempt” at VR! I really liked that any adjustment (minus the strap) could easily be done even while wearing the device without interrupting gameplay! As for the strap, just a simple fix of placing the joycons down, fix it, and bam, you’re immediately back to gameplay. I saw other reviews say it was heavy… honestly I found it to be light!My only downsides to it (which neither have nothing to do with the product itself), are…- The games offered. I wish Nintendo would offer a VR mode for more games- Because I have thick hair, if I moved a certain way, the straps would slide up to the top of my head (due to gripping) and I would have to pause the game and reset it on my head before continuing. But I’ll try wearing a ponytail next time!All in all, I really enjoyed my time with this, and I can definitely see it as a more long-term option than what Nintendo offers!

hypo_0: Můj úplně první VR set! Opravdu to stojí za ty peníze! Konečně jsem se rozhodl/a ponořit do světa virtuální reality — a jsem tak rád/a, že jsem si jako svůj první „pokus“ s VR vybral/a právě tento produkt! Opravdu se mi líbilo, že jakékoli nastavení (kromě popruhu) se dalo snadno provést i s nasazeným zařízením, aniž by se přerušilo hraní! Co se týče popruhu, stačí jednoduchá náprava – odložit ovladače, upravit ho a prásk, jste okamžitě zpátky ve hře. Viděl/a jsem v jiných recenzích, že je těžký… mně osobně přišel lehký! Moje jediné výhrady (které ale ani v nejmenším nesouvisí s produktem samotným) jsou… - Nabízené hry. Kéž by Nintendo nabízelo VR režim pro více her - Protože mám husté vlasy, když jsem se pohnul/a určitým způsobem, popruhy mi sklouzávaly nahoru na temeno hlavy (kvůli tření) a musel/a jsem hru pozastavit a znovu si ho na hlavě usadit, než jsem mohl/a pokračovat. Příště ale zkusím culík! Celkově vzato jsem si čas strávený s tímto produktem opravdu užil/a a rozhodně ho vidím jako dlouhodobější možnost než to, co nabízí Nintendo!

source_doc: Great for Dog Training Gloves. I have learned that my dogs and I both do better when I wear gloves while training them. I have a better grip on toys and tugs, and when my pups see me don a pair of gloves they get excited because it is time to WORK. I have been using leather gloves, and they get gross very quickly.These Manusage work gloves are exactly what I need for training. Obviously, they'd work well for gardening and other things around the house too, but dog training is what I'm most excited about. Slobber doesn't soak through these gloves to make my hands cold or stinky. The gloves themselves dry out quickly so they don't get stinky (leather gloves...ewwwww). The gloves grip things very well so I am no longer dropping slippery slobbery toys and balls. They do actually work on a touchscreen - I tried them out just to see - but I highly doubt I will be using a screen with slobber covered gloves.After multiple sessions of training dogs with the same pair of gloves, I may never need to buy any again...or at least, it will be a couple of years since I have 12 pairs now. The medium size fit as I expected as I typically wear a medium in work gloves.

hypo_0: Skvělé jako rukavice na výcvik psů. Zjistil/a jsem, že mně i mým psům se daří lépe, když mám při výcviku rukavice. source_doc: Good for the Price..But. I have some nice heavy duty solar lights that I want to hang in my yard along the back fence line which overlooks a wooded area.  When I saw these 9ft light poles, I knew it would be the perfect solution!  I was so excited when the box arrived but then quickly disappointed because apparently I did not read the description well enough - I saw the beginning of the title ‘Patio String Lights Poles” and assumed I would be getting two poles.  It does say ‘Pole’ singular further in the description.  So if you order these, you may want to order two.  I cannot hang lights from one pole lol so I will have to order a second one.  Having said that, the price doubled is about what other sets of two cost.  The pole comes in sections that you just screw together so assembly is simple.  I wish it was a little bit heavier duty because I’m not sure how well it will support my lights but it may be fine.  The pole doesn’t wobble much once in the ground with the five spikes.  Overall they are decent quality.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Za tu cenu dobré... Ale. Mám několik pěkných, masivních solárních světel, která chci pověsit na zahradě podél zadního plotu s výhledem na les. Když jsem uviděl/a tyto 2,7m tyče na světla, věděl/a jsem, že to bude dokonalé řešení! Byl/a jsem tak nadšený/á, když krabice dorazila, ale pak přišlo rychlé zklamání, protože jsem si zřejmě dostatečně pozorně nepřečetl/a popis – viděl/a jsem začátek názvu „Tyče na světelné řetězy na terasu“ a předpokládal/a jsem, že dostanu dvě tyče. Dále v popisu se ale píše „Tyč“ v jednotném čísle. Pokud si je tedy objednáte, možná si budete chtít objednat dvě. Z jedné tyče světla nepověsím (smích), takže si budu muset objednat druhou. S ohledem na to je dvojnásobná cena přibližně stejná, jako kolik stojí jiné sady po dvou kusech. Tyč se skládá z několika částí, které do sebe stačí zašroubovat, takže montáž je jednoduchá. Kéž by byla o něco masivnější, protože si nejsem jistý/á, jak dobře moje světla unese, ale snad to bude v pořádku. Tyč se po zapíchnutí do země pomocí pěti hrotů moc nekýve. Celkově mají slušnou kvalitu.

source_doc: Waste of money. Works great... until it stops working. I purchased two for a trip I took last December/January where it was going to be cold. I live in Florida, so I did not have to use them again until another trip up North about a month ago. I packed them along with the charger and when I got up there, found they were not working (the light would not turn on once it was connected to charger). Thankfully other friends packed extra disposable hand warmers. I emailed the company because I purchased this over disposable hand warmers thinking they would last a while, and I only used them for one trip that was a week long. I was two weeks past my 1 year warranty so I lost my money and nothing can be done. They suggested to charge every once in a while when they are not in use and offered to give me a coupon for my next purchase with them. I respectfully declined as I am sure that product would break as well. Would be great if they included that suggestion along with the product, so their clients would know to charge it every so often to make it last longer. Might just stick to disposables for next trip.

source_doc: Bought 3. 1 worked. 1 won't turn on. 1 wouldn't even charge my phone and won't recharge. Seriously. I was pretty excited to find something my wife and kids could just carry in their car that would jump start it in an emergency. So I bought 3 of them. When I got them I pulled them all out of their boxes and checked the charge. The first one was 3 of 5 bars so I plugged it into a usb charger overnight. Next day I tested it out on my RV with a V10 Ford engine that had a very weak battery and it cranked like the battery was new and started right up. Still at 5 of 5 bars.I checked the second one and it was at 5 of 5 bars. I plugged my phone into it and it took my phone to 65% over about 3 hours, and then it was at 1 of 5 bars. I plugged it into the same USB charger I had the other one in and came back a few hours later and it was still at 1 bar. I let it charge overnight and it's still at 1 bar. Flashlight won't turn on and won't start anything.I checked the third one and nothing. No bars of 5. Flashlight won't come on. I plugged it into the charger for a few hours and nothing.
