source_doc: Engine power is reduced? This can be your fix. Ok, another Cadillac story, it has been showing "engine power is reduced" for as long as I got the car as a gift. I don't mind to work on it, and for 2 months I learned a lot. I programmed all the modules that I replaced, still, engine power is reduced...So the last two things I was going to do was to change the fuel, then change the accelerator pedal, since I already changed the throttle body, the accelerator pedal was one big thing on the DTC report. My friends thought I was wasting my money, since how the Accelerator pedal can cause that? Well, that part was under water...so...why not? I took my old pedal out, to my surprise it was really easy to get it out, basically just one screw! Then I opened it, it had some corrosion on it, I tried to clean the chip with contact cleaner and wire brushes, didn't work. So I waited till next day this delivered, replaced it. Turn on the car, the "engine power is reduced" message is gone!! I ran GDS and it didn't show any DTC code, so this was a successful fix!

source_doc: I wish I bought this years ago - worth every penny! I suck at soldering. My hands are really shaky and I don't do it often enough to get the practice. I can't believe how much of a difference this made over the cheap stuff (which have thousands of 5 star reviews!) I'd been using. It flows where I want it to go, very easy to use, low temp..For years I've been thinking about trying this, but the price compared to others is significant. I had tried a little tube of it awhile back and didn't like it at all. I didn't know I had brought the wrong type  (the naming of various solders is a bit confusing)  I finally broke down a few months ago and bought this. I was getting so frustrated soldering I started buying in stead of making.  It is absolutely worth the price.It's not a miracle tho - I still suck at soldering, I just suck less now.

source_doc: Tore My Skin - Also NOT Returnable. Sadly this “gentle” tape stuck too well. After changing my bandage only twice my skin tore as the tape was removed. I do not have thin skin. I’ve used a variety of tapes over the years, and yes skin can tear after multiple bandage changes, it happens, the skin just gets worn down. But I’ve never had it happen on the second change. The tape was really really stuck after just four hours on my skin. I slowly removed the first piece, when that gave me trouble I tried soaking the second piece. It didn’t work. I definitely don’t recommend using this product if you DO have thin skin. And I would think twice about getting this if you’re going to have to change the dressing multiple times.Worse, I had bought two different widths of this tape. When I went to return the unopened one I learned that it is not returnable. If you look at the return policy on the side bar it says it IS return or replaceable. But when you actually click on it the message pops up that says you can’t return it. No, I do not usually click on it when I see you can return it. I guess I will have to do that from now on since it is misleading to say the least.Lesson learned.

source_doc: I Want To Learn To Play The Drums. I literally just told my mom I want to learn to play the drums. I'm old enough to get those senior citizen perks and looking for something new. So when I saw this on the vine list I giggled and ordered. I love how quiet this is even when I'm really pounding away. It has a nice pad on the back to keep it from scratching and also helps dampen the noise. When I learn the basics I'll move on, but for now I love my new drumming pad. It came with two sets of sticks and a zippered case. I love that I got it from Vine but would have paid what it cost. Can't wait to get good enough for a real set of drums! I'm signing up for a drum therapy thing to get going. Vine is an Amazon program where you get things free in exchange for your honest review. I will update this one to let you know when I get good enough to have broke a drum stick. Five stars because it's so inexpensive, well thought out and a great way to learn the basics.

source_doc: White Light=Bright White. I have used several different Chemical Guys detailing products. Some I like better than others and this is one of them. I have a white metallic vehicle and I wanted to see if I could find a product that really makes the white “pop.” I tried a few different things and even though they looked good, I never got the “pop” I was seeking. Also, many of these other products are magnets for dust and even though I don’t drive anywhere near dirt roads or live in a particularly dusty area, my car would would coated with dust just days after I detailed it. I did not find that issue with White Light. In fact, it hasn’t rained in a week since I detailed my vehicle and it doesn’t have much dust sitting on it at all. The white is bright and crisp and has a deep shine. I will definitely continue to use Chemical Guys White Light for my white vehicle.

source_doc: On the Fence….Good Microphone With Flaws. My wheelhouse is electronics and security so I have used my share of microphones either in security equipment or setting up electronics for a band. The problem I had with this was volume. Maybe it was the App I tested it with, maybe it bugged me that there was no way to monitor the volume. I don’t do YouTube, so maybe this can be tweaked in editing but this did not give me enough volume for the App I was using even at max. I gave it a generous 4 stars because the sound I heard I guess sounded good but I would not use this anyway as it has to be unplugged to hear what you recorded. I don’t know why anyone would go through that pain. Points for quick set up and instant pairing. I guess I’ll leave the rest to the professional YouTubers but I see no use for this unless you are a pro blogger or something. I thought it would work on calls and I could clip it on and walk around but does not work for that. A niche product for video bloggers.

source_doc: A life saver. I’ve been suffering from migraines for eleven years and I’ve been taking acetaminophen for so long even more to just make sure I don’t get them, sometimes 4-6 a day, I finally needed fast relief and after some searching I found this product on YouTube and so I decided to try it out.Just a few minutes before writing this review I had gotten a bad migraine, mine are mainly in the eyes, they make me go blind and all I see is a gray screen, these migraines have kept me from trying to get a drivers license for so long, but right when I lost my vision due to the migraine I grabbed this tool and found where to put it and applied some pressure feeling the pain I couldn’t believe it.4-6 minutes later I had gained my vision back and didn’t even have a headache afterwards.My hand hurts a little but considering that the migraine is gone I am so glad.I recommend this to anyone who’s been suffering from migraines, don’t think about buying this, make the step and purchase right away.Control you’re life, don’t let the migraines control you.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Undecided on these stirrups. I bought these for an overseas riding trip in Ireland. I will be riding cross country and jumping. The place where I ride will outfit you with the horse and saddle, etc. however, I've brought my own stirrups and leathers before and just swap them out. The climate is pretty wet. I specifically bought these because when I ride there, my boots are always slipping off the stirrups due to the wetness of the land we're riding through. I have mixed thoughts on these. I like the light weight nature of the stirrups. I normally ride in MDC sport stirrups and they are quite heavy. I like that my feet don't slip out of my stirrups when my boots are wet. I don't like that they're hard to get your feet back in if you lose a stirrup because they lie flat against the flank of the horse. I'm not sure if they're more comfortable. I have been trying them out during my normal riding and lessons. I will keep the stirrups and take them on the trip but I think I'll switch back to my MDCs for normal riding.

source_doc: I feel like I was ripped off for the bracket… I’m unclear what is happening?  I’ve come back to post about the mounting bracket I bought, not about the light, but about my feelings that the ad was deceptive.  But I can’t even find the link to the bracket. The link that I had in my “orders” take me back to the light only. No bracket.  I can’t find the mounting bracket on Amazon?  Let me just say what happened,  I ordered a second “mounting bracket“ so I could share the light between two bicycles… It was I think $11.  And for $11 my brain assumed I was buying a “mounting bracket“ not “a single 1/2“ of what would be the ability to mount the light on a second handlebar… so now I would have to buy another bracket bringing my total over 20 dollars to have a complete second bracket, which is nearly the half the price of the light… with two more rackets!  But as I said, I guess it’s gonna post under the light and not under the bracket, because the two have been merger something?  The light works fine, would be better if it had some waterproofing. But what’s up with his bracket problem?
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

source_doc: Love this... and so does my soon-to-be 19-year-old Kitty! I purchased this on December 17th, 2022....  Came on the 19th.  I plugged it in and placed it in my elderly kitty's soft basket on top of his blanket.  At first he was hesitant, but I plopped him in there.  He had been slowing down and cold, and I had moved his basket next to the heater in the kitchen and he was happy.  Well, he has not left his basket since.  He loves this heating pad.  I have set it to No. 4 bar.  I have never turned it off and it's still working.  I am surprised.  I figured it would have burnt out, but so far so good! (Fingers crossed!!!)  He is walking better and so happy!  He loves it.  I haven't washed it yet.  I just turned it over.  I can't get him out of it to wash it.  I feel bad.  I did vacuum it.  LOL!  Now, it doesn't look all plush like in the picture, mind you, but it is soft.  As long as he is still alive, I will replace it if it burns out.  I think it helps him feel better.... Heat is good for old joints for all of us :)

source_doc: Is okay - not good for long-term. I bought this because I wanted a clicky keyboard for when I WFH (I know - a silly reason but I prefer the aesthetic of it). It wasn't hard to set up - The mouse and keyboard function with a USB inserted into the computer/laptop and no batteries are involved. The downside to this is having to re-charge your keyboard every so often. The first time I charged the keyboard (using the cable they provided) it worked fine and I was able to use it for a couple days (maybe 3?) There's no real indicator that tells you how much battery is left - if you turn it on and the battery symbol is red that means it needs to be charged again but other than that nothing. The second time I tried to re-charge it I had plugged in the wire and had it charging for 12 hours. When I went to go unplug and use it though it was completely dead. I figured that the wire might have been faulty so I tried again with another micro-USB I had in the house that I knew worked. Still nothing. Because I couldn't replace batteries or resuscitate it really I had to toss it, which was unfortunate because the mouse was still fine.

source_doc: Great auto feeder for those that work long days! This is a great auto feeder for those that work long days! I just changed jobs recently, and I'm now working 12 hr shifts. I was worried about how I would keep my 2 small dogs on their feeding schedule, as I leave before their breakfast time and get home after their supper time. This has been a lifesaver knowing my little fur babies are being fed on a regular schedule. It is simple to set up and very simple to use. The portions that dispense are perfect for my dogs. Now I can control when and how much they eat when I'm away working. I also love the fact that I can watch them and speak to them. Although they get a little excited when they hear my voice, I see disappointment when I am really not there. So I keep the speaking very limited. But sometimes they want to fuss with each other when the food comes out, so I can tell them to stop, and they typically will at that point. All that said, this is a great auto feeder with many features and will provide peace of mind knowing your little fur babies are getting their food, and seeing how happy they are when they do. I highly recommend this feeder.

source_doc: Work great. Good quality. I switched my trailer axle from a 7500 lb to a 2000 lb axle. I just don't need that big of one way overdone. I went to a couple local places to try to get the u-bolts in the plates but just couldn't find the right size.These are for inch and 3/4 round axle. I think I'm going to need to replace the leaf springs because there's four leaf springs. I need a little softer ride. The trailer is only going to be maybe 1500 lb so I need to switch out those as well.But what I'm getting at for the leaf springs is it fit around four leaf springs and the axle?. After I cranked and tighten the bolts, the bolts are nylon. No washers. But the fact that I have four leaf springs. The bolts barely make it through the nut. Just kind of flush with the top so once I replace the springs I should have a little bit more thread on top of the bolt. I think it would be fine even with three leaf springs.As for quality, definitely quality product, the u-bolts the plates, the nuts, even the coupler that goes between the shock leaf and the axle high quality. I definitely recommend it but it again it is for a inch and 3/4 axle or the 2000 lb load?.If this fits your axle, it's a good product. Get it.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a"

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

The trio is $45.60.

source_doc: Strange angle of mouthpiece. I think I've played just about everything that has keys or strings - even a theatre pipe organ - and I was looking for something different that was fun to play.  I did play the recorder a number of years ago, but again, I wanted something unique.  And that, is when I came across the ocarina.  I didn't want to invest a lot of money, but wanted something that had a good tone.  A little research on line brought me to the Night by Noble.  And I love it -- but my right wrist Does Not.  The mouthpiece just seems to be at an odd angle.  I did a little comparison to other brands and sure enough the angle and length is a bit odd.  Again, I really like this particular instrument, but might consider another brand with a longer and,more importantly, more angled mouthpiece, in the near future.Update - I purchased an STL Aria ocarina yesterday.  What a huge difference!  The mouthpiece angle is perfect and definitely longer.  And it gives me a great finger wrap for the balance needed in high notes.  It was three times the price of the NbN, but you pretty much get what you pay for.  I got a thick velvet carrying bag with the NbN, but wanted something more protective for a ceramic instrument.  Ended up finding a camera case that was just the right size.  I'm happy, my wrist is happy, so all is well!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

Před lety jsem sice hrál/a na zobcovou flétnu, ale opět jsem chtěl/a něco jedinečného. A právě tehdy jsem narazil/a na okarínu. source_doc: I couldn't consistently keep the remotes charging. I was really excited to find this product! I have the old Wii system and I have several remotes and I thought this was a great solution to be able to use that system again. However, the product was cheaply made and it seemed to be a wobbly docking station. Once everything was plugged in and remotes were set on the charger the slightest movement stopped the charging process on some remotes. I would mess with the remote on the station and it would start charging again. But, whenever I went back to check it always seemed like a few of them were not charging again. So, I would readjust it to get it charging again only to come back and find that some were charging and some were not. After 15 to 20 minutes of this I decided to return it. I have no idea what triggered it to stop charging. But, the slightest movement seemed to disrupt the whole base. And if you left it alone it still had issues with the position of the docking station and where the charger sat. it was too much of a headache. So I returned it.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: Very beautiful. This pool cue has no flaws, and is very beautiful. The brown has an almost tigers eye look to it under the light, which makes it that more stunning. It has a nice feel in your hands, and is pretty good quality. I was surprised I liked it even better than I thought I would. The case is also pretty well made and I see no flaws with that either. The cue fits nicely in it without any issues. For the price, I did not expect it to be one of my favorites, but alas, it might just be my favorite pool cue to date, mostly due to the look, yes, but the fact it also has a nice feel, and works as good as any as I've used, plays in that as well.  I will note I am not an avid pool player, but I have played with a league team (as a stand in) previously, and have some experience beyond being new to the sport or just messing around. So I am only giving my review as an in the middle player, not a professional. Regardless, I think this would be a nice addition to any players collection, be it a beginner, or all the way to a pro.

source_doc: Great Upgrade from HF Cheap Spray Gun! I will start by saying that I am not a professional, really only a weekend woodworker so my experience with HVLP spraying is limited at best.  I bought a discount big box store HVLP sprayer to dip my feet in the waters, only to find that it did not come with a nozzle wrench. After using it a few times and using channel locks to remove the nozzle for cleaning, etc. I decided it was time to buy a wrench, however just finding one is a chore and they tend to cost as much as another HVLP sprayer, so when I found this set I thought "Why Not?" since it comes with a wrench and a couple of other tips.Upon receipt of this gun, I decided to give it a try because I struggled with my cheap gun to get a good finish when spraying polyurethane. All I can say is there is a night and day difference. This gun is easy to set up and the spray pattern is SO MUCH BETTER!!! Not only that, cleaning it seems to also not be as tedious, not sure why because it basically has the same parts. If I ever need to replace it, I will order another one and recommend it to anyone looking to jump into the world of HVLP spraying.

source_doc: Super impressed, I love this bra! I love this bra way more than I originally thought I would. Bra is also really soft compared to another nursing bra I have. All in all I would definitely repurchase!

source_doc: Works well, seems well made. Ok, I hate cleaning my shower. I mean it's not gross, but it's not spic-and-span either. I was glad to receive this and as soon as I got it, I plugged in the included charger and charged it for an hour or so. (It shows a red LED when charging that flips to green when fully charged.) As the pic shows, it consists of the head, where the brushes attach, along with 2 other sections, one of which contains the battery, the other is an extension piece that also telescopes to provide more length. You also get 4 brushes of various sizes.After charging it up, I sprayed down the shower with a soap scum cleaning spray and let it sit for about 5 minutes. Then I went to town on it with this little baby. I made the mistake of trying the large, flat brush, and I quickly realized the large rounded brush is a much better option for shower cleaning. Otherwise, it's a little hard to control and it dances around a bit.It worked well, and made the job simple - no awkward bending, reaching, standing in the tub, etc. Glad I purchased it. I've not tested the battery duration yet, but it didn't slow down, and still had plenty of power after I used it.

source_doc: Great product! I am very glad I ordered this product! I have lots of clear organizational types of jars and containers on my counter, which look very cute when displaying things like pasta and grains. I wanted smaller jars to display spices, such as peppercorns. These small jars are perfect for display. There are many jars to cover every spice I own, and additionally, they come with tons of labels. Some labels were pre-printed, and some were blank so I can write on them myself! They even included a pen for convenience. These glass containers will be easy to clean, easy to display, easy to stack, etc!When I opened the package, I was looking at the jars and noticed that the lids were off-center from the container. At first, I was irritated at the poor craftsmanship, but then I realized that the lids just needed to be adjusted to look right on the container. It was simply a matter of moving the lid around to make it look better. I thought I would include that note just in case anyone had the same thought!

source_doc: Day 3 and I am Hopefull. I was skeptical because for a year, nothing had worked except LOTS of medication to control the pain from the herniated disc that was causing severe sciatic pain. I have spent hundreds of dollars on pillows, creams, braces, etc and nothing has worked out.I see this on here and I decide to give it a chance. I figure if it didn't work, I'll send the sucker back. I put it together and use it for a few minutes and almost immediately, the pain was less. I do it again a couple of times the same day for just a few minutes. With each time, the pain was less and less. By the second day, I only took the Meloxicam and had alomost no pain through the day. I used it twice the next day and I had no pain. Day 3, I am not even taking the Meloxicam and I am having no pain. I am NOT saying to stop your medications! Do what your doctor says but I personally think that this is worth a try if you can afford it. It doesn't have to be this brand. There are cheaper and conversely, more expensive versions, but this partiicular one is sturdy and does what it says (for me anyway).

source_doc: The shrimp are healthy! The shrimp are beautiful and healthy and so fun to watch.  DO NOT put them in a tank with a betta, guppies or Harlequins.  I have 2 tanks, and at first, I thought it was the betta that was eating them, so I removed him to my second tank. They still kept disappearing, so I removed the harlequins, because after hours of observation, I saw them get aggressive to the helpless shrimp. All that was left was guppies, and they still got eaten. I loved the shrimp so much, they were so fun to watch, but if I try again, I will have them in their own tank with nothing else.  They all arrived alive, healthy and very active.  Their color is so striking.  I feel terrible the research I did online was wrong.  I do wonder if you can keep different colors of shrimps together?  The red and white ones are so cool, too.  So learn from me, people, and don't put them with other fish or they will become a very expensive appetizer!

source_doc: Took me a long time to figure this out, but happy with it now. I was eager to try this as a way to record from my guitar onto a Macbook Pro, but was totally new to this type of device.  I understood that I would need to download 'digital audio workstation' (DAW) software, so I read about a few options and decided to go with the free version of Waveform. After downloading it, and connecting my guitar to the BOMGE, and connecting the BOMGE to my laptop (all of which were simple and quick), I spent an unsuccessful hour trying to achieve a recording. Then I downloaded Audacity software and retried, but was again unsuccessful. At that point, I had no idea whether the trouble was the BOMGE or just me not being able to figure this out. Turned out it was me. I returned to Waveform, re-watched a couple of its Youtube tutorials (which I highly recommend for beginners), and eventually got the hang of this. (With the guitar plugged into port 2, make sure that the 'inst' button is set on, and in Waveform, set the input for the recording track to 'input 2.') After that, the info page that came with the BOMGE was meaningful, and I have found the device to be just what I hoped for. It is compact in size and provides a fine sound quality for my amateur level.

source_doc: Fit well and actually work! When buying these I was a bit skeptical because they were so much cheaper than pants from an actual motorcycle store. However, I got a jacket from a store and was trying to save money so I decided to purchase these pants. Unfortunately I got into a motorcycle accident a couple weeks ago; however, I found out the pants actually work!! There was rain on the road, I had to make a sudden stop, my bike lost traction, slid on its side, and threw me off once it hit a car. I must have slid 15ft on the asphalt, got up and was completely fine besides a few impact bruises. On top of me being fine, the pants are also fine, no rips or tears. I will continue to wear them once I fix my bike. After this experience I had to write a review because I did not see any that mentioned wearing them in a accident.A few reviews mentioned upgrading the padding inside, which I could definitely see and probably would have helped with the impact bruises. But overall these pants are WELL worth the price and I would highly recommend. Saved me from some really bad injuries!Will try to upload pictures when my phone is fixed.

source_doc: Useful Microphone For Making Social Media Content. I have enjoyed using this set of microphones to make small videos for social media.  I am not super experienced but I wanted something to be able to more clearly narrate the videos I was making.  I found this set to be super user friendly.  Right out of the box, I was able to figure out how to use them.  I was a little bit apprehensive but these are really just plug and play.  The sound quality is good, probably not the best there is, but I think better then using only the microphone on my iPhone.  I didn’t use them at a distance so I cannot comment on that.  I think if you are looking for a something to get started with, at the price of  $24.99 this is a pretty good place to start.  A few of my friends have seen me using it and have even inquired about where the can pick a set up.  Definitely recommend.

source_doc: Not Just for Babies! I always like to sleep with some sort of sound going and I usually like the sound of a fan noise blowing however, when I go away which is a lot, I never have any sounds I can take with me besides what I get from an app on my phone. When I saw this popup in my feed, I knew this would make the perfect addition to my travels.The product itself is small and compact. I can throw it in my suitcase and use it when I get to my destination at night in my bedroom for when I sleep. There are about 5 lullabies you can choose from and also nature sounds which is what I use to help me fall and stay asleep.

source_doc: Very useful, built in metronome is nice. As a person who has been playing bass for almost 16 years now, I tend to try to get whatever equipment I can. For years I had been looking for a metronome, but never really found one at a price point I wanted. After seeing that this tuner has a built in metronome, I decided to give it a try. I charged it with the included cable and first tested it as a tuner. I used the included (piezo?) sensor on the headstock of my acoustic and it seems to be just as accurate as any other tuner I've used in the past. Afterwards, I played with the metronome for a bit, adjusted the tempo, changed up the rhythms, and was quite surprised with the variety of beats I could get out of it. If I didn't already have a designated tuner pedal, I'd probably use this at my local church where I play bass. Display is pretty good, and easy to read, too, so there's that.Overall, I'm satisfied with it. I give it a thumbs up.

 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Buckwheat pillow for life! I have no other buckwheat pillow to compare this to, but I can say that using this pillow has eliminated neck and shoulder pain. I have not woke up with strain in my neck since I started sleeping on this pillow. Feels odd at first, as the granules collect in places and lump up, but I got used to having to shift them around to create the areas of support I need when I first lay down. Once you shift and mold the pillow to suit your neck and head, it feels like a supportive hug whilst you sleep. I use this pillow on the couch as well, as throw-pillows do not seem right after using this. There was extra buckwheat that i had to remove and I am going to make an airplane pillow out of it so I do not wreck my neck whilst flying.. BONUS!!

source_doc: if you use festool, with makita vac…it’s a must. it has taken me a long time to work with multiple tool platforms.  Not having a money tree and moving among trade work, construction, and wood working it is also a fact that festool doesn’t make every tool under the sun.  I like the makita vacuum and have really enjoyed it, but bouncing back and forth between AWS gear and plugged in festool devices I got the idea to get this product and velcro a festool power chord to it.  Now when I use my festool planer or sander, I swap hoses (which is easy unlike other extractor or shop vac platforms) and attach the one with the chord.  No it’s not the festool system, but it works for me and has made my desire to get another dust extractor not be a hot button issue.  The older I get the more conscious I am of what I am breathing in.  I can’t say I gave much thought into sanding walls in my fraternity house 30 yrs ago. What I can say is that while I work alone in a job, I will have several extractors, but as far as I am concerned this hose has at least temporarily saved me $900.

source_doc: So much more than I expected. Ok, so I open my package and my heart sinks. I see this tiny little thing about 1/3 the size I imagined. So charging took about 2 hours and I was on pins and needles waiting for it. So fully charged connect it up and BOOM! Wow! So much more sound quality than I expected. The distortion and clean are exactly what I would expect. The bluetooth let me jam along with a backing track AND since BT and INPUT both have separate volumes you can mix it in perfectly. The delay AND delay time is precious and then you still have gain and a 3 band EQ! I can’t wait to run this into my Valve JR head and out my 2 12” cabs. Oh oh I wonder how harmonica sounds through it? Damn, gotta wait till tomorrow to “GET LOUD” I can’t turn this up more than 1/4 if I want to be able to turn my guitar up. So much louder than I expected… I might just have to call this thing a great affordable Christmas present for all my music jamming friends!

source_doc: Didn't Work !!! I bought this Jump Starter in summer because I  knew I might have problems with my car during the winter time and it happened. I didn't use my car for couple of day's and my battery was dead and it was really cold outside. So I decided to jump start it. I connected the jump starter per all the instructions and it didn't help. Unfortunately I came to the conclusion after I googled some info that it's a waist of money. It won't start your car when you have dead battery. Fortunately I asked my neighbor to jump start me and he had a really powerful portable jump starter that started my car in seconds. And I don't have old car, it's from 2017. I just don't drove very often. You can still use it as a portable power bank to charge your phone and light and that's about it. To expensive for a power bank.

source_doc: Mind blown. These were easy to get setup. Fill water to the fill line then drop one of the tubes in and stick the sprayer in and twist tight until you hear it click. It's fun to watch the concentrate go in the water. Each one has its own scent and are for certain areas and materials. It suggests spraying the soiled areas and let them soak for 10 minutes. Then I take the color coordinated cloths that came with them and wipe up the mess. It literally works really well. So far I've used the kitchen one my countertop. I purposely left my cupcake mess from the night before and just cleaned it and I could not believe how easy it was to wipe off( and there was hard frosting on there). Then I used the glass and sprayed the mirrors. I've always used a foam and paper towels but I used the cloth and I seriously couldn't believe it. There were NO streaks and I didn't have to go back over the areas. The last one I used tonight was the shower. I didn't go all gung-ho on the shower but I sprayed it on some areas that get build up quite often and let it sit for a little bit. Again, I couldn't believe how easy the grossness comes off. Tomorrow I'm tackling the bathroom with a blacklight and will update with video!

source_doc: I didn't think I would love it. I honestly wasn't expecting to love this game.  I was waiting for Frosthaven to arrive from the kickstarter and was jonesing for a card game fix that was easy to set up.  Then I saw the reviews for this and figured I'd give it a try since I had a gift card to burn.  Well glad I did, I put 70 hours into it before the credits rolled and I'm waiting for all the DLC to get released before playing it again on new game plus. I'll be honest I haven't had a game tickle me like that since DBZ: Kakarot a few years back.The game loop is nice; get cards, get powers, and make friends.  The combo of it all worked perfect for me, and I was telling my wife dumb stories from the game about blade and captain marvel cute romance or the book club which I found hilarious.  Also one of the first times I've liked captain America.  Or I should say I got him in a way the movies/comics never worked for me.  I still don't like Tony, but that's not a surprise he's a terrible human being.I'm excited for the DLC and what they add since I figure I'll be putting in another 40-60 hours easily to platinum the game on my NG+ run.

source_doc: Perfect for small pet food cans. The wet food that I feed my cats comes in small cans and these lids are perfect for saving any leftovers in the refrigerator. They fit perfectly and create a good seal which keeps my refrigerator from smelling like cat food. They’re very easy to wash with soap and hot water. I believe they can even go in the dishwasher but I’ve never tried it. I just wash them when I wash the cat food dishes every night. I’ve had these for nearly a year and they still look and work like they did when I first used them. I highly recommend them for any pet owner that needs to save leftovers.I should mention that I took one of these over to my Mom’s house after Thanksgiving because she wanted a top for leftover canned cranberry jelly (you know the type of gross wobbly cranberry stuff in a can that is somehow a staple of Thanksgiving every year) and she hasn’t returned it because she really likes it. I can’t fault her for that so I guess I really should buy another pack of two. Life is easier when you have more than one of these so I suppose what I’m trying to say is that you should buy more than you think you need. :)

Prostě je umyju každý večer, když myju misky od kočičího krmiva. Mám je už skoro rok a stále vypadají a fungují tak, jako když jsem je použil/a poprvé. Vřele je doporučuji každému chovateli, který potřebuje uchovávat zbytky. Měl/a bych zmínit, že jedno z nich jsem po Dni díkůvzdání odnesl/a k mamce, protože chtěla víčko na zbytek konzervovaného brusinkového želé (znáte takovou tu hnusnou, třaslavou brusinkovou hmotu v plechovce, která je každoročně nepochopitelně základem Dne díkůvzdání) a ještě mi ho nevrátila, protože si ho opravdu oblíbila. Nemůžu jí to mít za zlé, takže si asi vážně budu muset koupit další balení po dvou. Život je jednodušší, když jich máte víc než jedno, takže se snažím říct, že byste si jich měl/a koupit víc, než si myslíte, že potřebujete. :)

source_doc: Awesome product for the $18 I spend for it. Especially since I have a 44 oz thermos. This was one of the few insulated pocket carriers for drinks that I could find in the 44 oz plus. The short story is at my local Ross I bought a number of drinking thermoses because I do a lot of rollerblading, hiking, and outdoor activities. Yet, it's rare that I can find an insulated carrying case for such drink containers. I felt very fortunate when I found this particular product for its price. I appreciated this product so much that I purchased one for a friend and gave it to them for Christmas and I purchase one more for myself so that I had one on my camping bag and one on my rollerblading bag to carry my insulated drinking container.

source_doc: Comparable to other standard wipers but is definitely not premium. I was fortunate in the fact that I got to utilize the wipers in the rain and slush right away on a 10 hour drive across state (California 2/24/2023) and it happened to rain 9 out of those 10 hours too. The wipers I would say were very quiet and I did not hear any noise from them what so ever, however they do bend a bit at the top tip when moving across the windshield which makes me question its longevity in terms of quality. The wipers were also labeled as premium and they are definitely not. I did get steaks on one of the wipers as it moved back into the down position and it did it every time throughout my drive but while going back up, it cleared it. For the price, I would say its worth buying and should last through the season I hope. Would I buy them again?... I most likely would not. On a side note, I did buy three sets for all my cars and none of them came labeled with the sizing so I had to measure the lengths to determine which was for which vehicle.

hypo_0: Srovnatelné s jinými standardními stěrači, ale rozhodně nejsou prémiové. source_doc: This continues to be very popular!  Three dogs, and they love it. I was dubious about how this would hold up, or that it would keep my dog's interest, but after three months it is still a hit!  I mean, I know it's the FOOD that makes them interested, but they all will keep moving around, finding every last piece of dog food out of it.  It takes some time to load, but I've found that I can just sprinkle regular dog food (small bite sized) while I'm spreading apart the folds and it goes pretty quickly.  I expected that with two puppies and an adult dog that they'd start chewing up the polar-fleece type fabric, but they haven't done that at all.  It's big enough that it doesn't slide around, since they're typically standing on at least part of it, and I like that I can just fold it and then roll it up, with the built-in strap holding it together like a small sleeping bag.  When I want to use it, I just unroll, load the kibble in, and then I let the dogs in from outside and watch them just go at it!  They're busy, busy, busy, with their tails wagging the whole time.  I love it!

source_doc: I love this brand. So i actually bought the white one last year and i loved it but the keys where so loud but overall i loved it. I am a gamer, and the mouse did start to miss a few clicks so i decided it was time for a new keyboard and mouse. I decided to go with the pink one this time because white is hard to keep clean and i just didnt want to do the black since my mouse pad and mic are black. Anyways i actually love the pink one a lot more and the keys are a lot quitter, and the lights are more fun and easier to control and there are so many more options with this one then the one i had before. The only issue that i have is the space bar is a little harder to hit. And while that isn't a big deal for just typing it can be when you miss a jump in a game. Other than that, yeah i would buy this keyboard and mouse again. the mouse is perfect so far and I haven't missed a click.

source_doc: Color match is terrible. I read so many amazing reviews so I had to try this; and I was so excited to try it!! Unfortunately I was matched with 010 “light beige” and it literally looks like I put orange costume makeup on my face, and it’s not a very pleasant texture. It breaks up and feels kinda chalky. I’m VERY fair/pale skinned but the colors online aren’t true to how they look in person. Online it said I could return it but once it arrived they said they don’t allow returns. I tried to return it before I even opened it because I could tell this was WAY too dark for me. Very disappointed. I’m going to give it to my mom who has a deeper olive complexion. I want to try this brand again in the lightest shade but I won’t purchase until it goes back on sale. Gosh I really I wanted to love this.I’ve ben looking for good foundation for literally years. I might just have to go to a higher end brand.

source_doc: Very easy to use. I bought this for my front door because I noticed light and cold air leaking through where the door meets the frame.  I must admit that I am not very handy and a bit of a diy dunce.  I really thought this would be a good temporary fix until I could call a handyman.  Much to my surprise,  it actually works great and I didn't need any help at all with it.  The whole process is fairly simple,  but don't skip the preparation steps.  Simply measure out how much you need and cut it to size.  Clean off the area first.  I used rubbing alcohol because it dries so quickly.  This helps the adhesive stick to the surface without getting messed up by dirt or dust.  Peel off the backing and stick it in place with a fair amount of pressure.  I let it cure for 24 hours before I used the door again.  That might be excessive,  but I wanted to be extra cautious.  The D shape is really neat because it expands into the little gaps.  Nothing is getting through now.

source_doc: I'm obsessed. I bought this because I was of course influenced by Tik Tok... and I'm so happy I was. I don't like going to the gym & my yoga studio closed in my neighborhood, so I really needed a way to get some exercise in. Keep in mind I also live with 2 roommates so I needed something I can do in my 10 ft by 10ft room. This is AMAZING. It's a great workout-- I definitely feel the burn! It comes with the resistance bands, great to strengthen arms, I even use weights too. It was so easy to set up, didn't even have to do much. It even comes with a screen to keep track of time, calories and steps. This took a couple tries to figure out how to manage the screen, but easy once I got the hang of it. I couldn't recommend this enough!!

source_doc: My teeth squeak all the time now. My teeth squeak all the time now. Not in a cheesey mouse way or a "squeaky clean", but whenever I eat anything they start squeaking. It is the most uncomfortable thing ever and I only used two of the packets (one of the rapid ones and one of the normal) two weeks apart. Basically feels like the equivalent of nails going down a chalkboard but with your teeth.My teeth were never very sensitive and I would die for them to be super white so when I saw the deal on Black Friday, I HAD to cop. I was super excited to potentially see results, but after the two I used that obviously had no results, I was hoping that I could at least keep using them to try to get them to lift. However, for some reason a few days after my last strips I craved almonds. And that is when I first found out how teeth squeaking feel like. I thought I was going insane and looked it up and sure enough, almonds do make some people's teeth squeak. But it wouldn't stop after that. Just eating certain foods will make my teeth squeak and it made life a little more unenjoyable. Literally would have felt a little better if my teeth lifted a little bit. Thanks, Crest.

source_doc: It's perfect 💕 I love the look of this basket. The color the pockets are deep. My dog seems to like it. I started a return on this purchase because I thought it was just to big. Then I couldn't get the walls to stand up. I didn't understand that at all.  To top it off the basket was touching my tire without my dog being in it.  I was very disappointed. I read the description on the site and thought I measured it right. I got up the next morning determine to make this basket work.  I just loved the look of it especially the color  Ok, the side walls...the openings are hidden up under the Velcro. Which you wouldn't know unless you was really looking.  Once I figured that out the basket was sturdy. Then I tried it on my bike again. You have to pull all the straps up and make it as tight as you can to make sit right. After doing this, the basket no longer sat on my tire. I put my dog in the basket and it was a perfect fit. I'm so glad I didn't return it. I'm in love with all over again. I see my dog and I doing a lot of riding. I just love it💕

source_doc: I can't believe how cheap this was. Because it certainly doesn't feel or look cheap. It looks higher end than it is.I've been using it for a little while, before deciding to write a review, and I love it just as much now as when I first got it. The keys are clacky, in a pleasing textile-ish kind of way, if you like that, but also not obnoxiously loud at the same time. I did notice the space bar is a bit springier sounding than the other keys like others have said, but I honestly don't even think about it when I'm using it anymore. The contrast of the white keys against the stainless is very aesthetically pleasing. I wish it had dedicated volume buttons, but I'll live. Because the keys are raised, I find it very easy to dust when cleaning--it even includes a cleaning brush to get between the keys, which I thought was a nice touch. The different light modes are fun, though I usually just keep them stationary. It just makes my work area a little more playful, and I love that because it's so me. I don't know much about gaming keyboards or what actually makes a keyboard a **gaming** keyboard, so maybe those who are more hardcore might be able to pick it apart. But I bet a kid would absolutely love this. I'm 38 and I sure do!

source_doc: Not a fan. I liked this keyboard at first.  I work from home and although my employer happily provides me with a keyboard that functions just fine.  I don't like cords.  My old Logitech wireless keyboard was still going strong but I wanted something you could actually see letters on the keys on, I'd worn the writing off of most of my keys.  So I picked this one, I didn't notice that it was rechargeable until after it arrived.  I thought oh that's kind of cool no more batteries.  Then about day four middle of a phone call with a client my keyboard just stops working.  I tried quickly plugging it in to my phone charger hoping it would allow me to keep typing, but no it didn't. There was no warning that it was about to run out battery life 🔋, no battery power warning or anything.  I tried it again after being plugged in for a while and it worked again.  However I can't have my keyboard just stop working mid work day.  So I returned it for something without flashing keys and something that ran off batteries.  In the 5 years my Logitech was in use I only put a new battery in it once.  If you can remember to charge it daily it might be great.

I've walked over each piece on each stair back and forth multiple times to get as much pressure on every point of contact and they just won't stay stuck. I don't know what to do other than maybe some contact cement around all the edges.These are cheap and look alright. I'd be more upset if they were priced higher but I should have figured this would be the outcome for what I paid. I guess I was just hoping that the reason other reviews say they damage stairs when they're removed is because they stick SO well. Not the case, actually.

source_doc: Great replacement and easy to install - All tools were included. I've had my Aeron chair for nearly ten years. I picked it up used to replace my crappy old chair from one of the big box stores when it finally gave up the ghost. So recently I heard a "crack" and saw that the back frame of the seat had finally worn down and broken.I was beside myself. I didn't want to buy another chair, so I looked for repair shops in the area. One of the shops referred me direct to this product page and said, "order this, and if you want, I can install it." So I did.Fast forward and, still sitting on the broken seat, busy with work, I decided to look up what the repair entailed. I found a tutorial on youtube. Four bolts for the seat. Two nuts to transfer the j-bars. I figured I could handle it.This replacement seat kit came with the hex wrench needed to undo the seat, and a fitted wrench and a T25 torx driver to quickly transfer the j-bar. It took a few minutes, and a bit of leaning in because the bolts were really in there, but the replacement was easy. I literally didn't take out my toolbox because I had everything I needed in the kit.Really well designed chair and replacement was super easy. Five stars.

source_doc: Pretty good vs regular melatonin. I use melatonin sometimes when I'm having issues sleeping so when I saw this was 20 mg I decided I would have to try them.  When I was setting down for the night I popped one of these pills and waited for the magic.  It took about 15 minutes and I was out out for the night.  I did notice the next morning I wasn't as groggy as I had been with just plain melatonin (guess that's the magnesium)  so I like these more that the usual melatonin I get.  The taste and smell are n/a to me as I just open it and pop it in with a drink of water.  The pills are a bit big so I would use water with them.  All in all, I like these for sleepless nights and they will be my go-to from now on.

source_doc: Awesome keyboard for those that loved the IBM Model M. I have been looking for a new keyboard for a while. I have been using a Logitech model that supported 3 computers. It was OK, but the keys were very mushy. I downsized to one computer so I thought why not switch to a new keyboard too. I knew I wanted something similar to my old beloved IBM Model M keyboard, but something without the large size and also had wireless capabilities. After MUCH searching for a decent mechanical keyboard, I focused on the Royal Kludge models. Mostly for the excellent price, as some mechanical keyboards can be costly. I got the 90% model, and I couldn't be happier. The feel is very similar to the Model M, but definitely quieter (although not exactly silent.) What I love most besides the feel is the magnetically attached wrist rest. That feature alone is pretty neat. There are plenty of other options I have yet to explore of fully utilize, such as the lighting of the keyboard. I have yet to play with many of the key mappings either. But I mostly just type, so these features aren't very important to me. Note: I am running Linux (Pop! OS to be specific), and the keyboard works great with Linux out of the box.

source_doc: Super soft exactly what I was looking for. I bought this bc I have a hole in one of the cushions of my couch and I just don't have the money to buy a new couch. Anyway. This cover is really nice. It feels super soft like a brand new couch and super stretchy. I got a large for my couch and I think I could've used an extra large since my cushions are very big. I'm 8 months pregnant and i got it on by myself in maybe 10 minutes after I figured out how it was supposed to go. It's mostly walking circles around your couch pulling on it until it doesn't look weird. I also obviously didn't care too much about that, it covered a hole. I got black because it was the cheapest, if you don't like obvious pet hair or dirt marks, obviously black is a bad choice for you, be aware of that. Overall it's super nice and I'll probably buy more to keep rotating until I can buy a new one but I'm super happy with this. I haven't tried the water resistant factor but even if it's not, I'm not mad about it.

hypo_0: Super hebký, přesně to, co jsem hledal/a. Koupil/a jsem ho, protože mám díru v jednom z polštářů na pohovce a prostě nemám peníze na novou pohovku. Každopádně, tento potah je opravdu pěkný. source_doc: Exactly what I needed. These are great! I started woodworking and whittling as a hobby and the gloves are the best. I recently burnt my thumb while cooking and was still worried I'd stab my thumb while working. Sure if I intentionally tried to make the knife go into the glove it will happen, it's cut resistant not stab resistant. I have accidentally stabbed a few fingers but there was enough padding for it to cushion it so I didn't bleed or get seriously hurt. I mainly use whittling knives, though.The bumpy grip stuff is great. I have arthritis in my hands and sometimes things slip my grasp, but not with these.Make sure to order a size down because like the other reviewers say: they run big. I would fit a medium by the charts standards but I fit into a small. I have no problem with the finger length since I have "piano player length" fingers. Your hands will get sweaty if worn too long but isn't super horrible, I wear them for 3-5 hrs at a time.They don't wear down too fast. With what I do and judging by the one month I've had them, I could see them lasting 3-4 months before needing to replace them.I give all 5 stars cause it's exactly what I was looking for.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

Nedávno jsem se při vaření popálil/a na palci a stále jsem se bál/a, že se při práci bodnu do palce. Jistě, kdybych se záměrně snažil/a, aby nůž vnikl do rukavice, stane se to, je odolná proti proříznutí, ne proti bodnutí. Omylem jsem se bodl/a do několika prstů, ale bylo tam dostatek polstrování, aby to náraz utlumilo, takže jsem nekrvácel/a ani se vážně nezranil/a. Používám však hlavně vyřezávací nože. source_doc: Decent, feels like you need a lot though. Thus works a lot like your average face masks. You definitely see a brightness to your skin immediately after use. I want to add, that it seems like I need a large amount the couple times I have used this, and I'm not sure if this is just me and battling the different texture it is, or that I really do need more than I do with other masks. Still, it does work as good as your average ones. My face feels and looks radiant after use, so for me, this is a value for price review. The amount I get and use vs the price compared to other masks, is a bit steep for my liking. I have found 8 dollar ones of different brands that have 3 times more, and work the same as this, so the value just hits in the middle for me. This is something I would definitely order again, if it came in higher quantity, but until it does, I can save money by shopping in store for other brands that give the near same effect. This will be something I definitely will check in on to see if I can get a deal ever though, so it's better than some out there.

source_doc: The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom that it could eventually rip. I have a 30 oz. insulated water bottle that I strive to fill 3X with water to drink throughout the day.  I take it with me when I drive, positioning it in the cup holder.  However, there are times when I walk that I wish I could take my water bottle with me.  I ordered this 2 pack of Tainehs Water Bottle Holders because I figured my bottle would fit inside it based upon the product page's measurements: 7.4" X 3.5", and my boyfriend could use the other bottle holder when we go hiking.  I like the rectangular shape to fit keys, a Chapstick, a protein bar, etc.  I could slide a credit card, money, ID, etc. in the front zipper pocket, in case we stop somewhere to walk and shop.I think these water bottle carriers are handy. The nylon material feels durable. The inch-wide strap is adjustable.  My only concern is the stitching.  The seam is so close to the curved edges at the bottom of the black one that it could eventually rip and come apart at some point.  The pink one isn't as bad.  (See photos.) The current price of $16 might be a bit high, IMO, but you do get 2 of them.

source_doc: Learning How To Play at 66! I have loved Gospel Music since I was 18 years old!  I vowed that I would learn to play it at some point in my life. Well that point is here and after looking for the standard organ in Black churches, I decided that I didn’t need a Hammond and Leslie in our house.  After researching dozens of keyboards and reading hundreds of reviews, boom!  Here I am with this keyboard in my house and me practicing scales with proper finger placement!  This is an amazing keyboard. It is amazing how accurate the instruments are and it has organ voices that emulate the Hammond and Leslie, which is the main reason I bought it!  I am so excited about the feel of the keys and the ability for it to run off of AA batteries!!Now that I have no excuse, it is on to the included DVD and booklet and YouTube instructional videos for playing Black Gospel music and finally my next purchase of full size base pedals that plug into it. Yes, I have a headset so that my wife doesn’t need to endure what we endured when our kids were learning instruments. I highly recommend this amazing instrument. Top quality and design and a definite value for the money.

source_doc: Skunk odor shampoo. This product did not work. It was night of course when my dog got sprayed by a skunk. I did not have this shampoo,  so I did a quick Google search on how to remove the skunk smell. It was recommend to use peroxide,  baking soda and a drop of dish soap. I left my dog outside,  and grabbed a bucket. I quickly mixed solution in a bucket and grabbed a rag. I gave my dog a sponge bath outside with this solution. I left it on for about 15 minutes and  then brought her inside to shower to rinse off. I applied some conditioner,  then gave her another good rinse. It really worked well. I could barely smell any odor. I then ordered this shampoo. I received it 2 days later. I gave my dog a bath again using the shampoo straight from the bottle on dry coat, I then added water and began lathering it up well. I let it sit on for 10-15 minutes. She now smells like a skunk again,  I was very disappointed,  I am returning the shampoo,  waste of time and money.

source_doc: Maiden voyage success. I was looking for an affordable sleep system that didn't frustrate me like the perpetual tangled mess I was in my mummy bag but that would still be cozy and warm. I'm a toss-n-turn sleeper from side to tummy to side and mummy bags are too tight around the legs and don't let you roll over. I tried this for the first time tent camping at Valley of Fire in late December and it worked out great. Temps were in the mid-'30s to low '40s and I was plenty warm with this and my r4 sleeping pad. I did pull it up over my head for added warmth during the night when it got windy. (I'm 5'7", 155 lbs) It has slick fabric on both sides so that was the only minor drawback. It slipped off my body when I rolled over but I was wearing silky long johns so I will revisit my sleep clothes for future trips. I swapped the compression sack it came with for one that has four straps and was able to decrease the packable size. I didn't wear it as a poncho this trip but I'm heading to the Grand Canyon in late Feb so I may use it to hang around camp.

source_doc: Highly recommend! I absolutely recommend this product and this company! Now that I have it, I'm so glad I finally made the purchase and the price is much more manageable than the stroller company options. This bunting bag is so soft, warm, and cozy. My daughter loves snuggling up in her stroller with this and it keeps her warm on super cold days/evenings. Liya from customer service reached out to me right after I placed my order to find out what kind of stroller I have to make sure this bunting bag was compatible with it. She also confirmed that I ordered the right size. She was quick to respond and super friendly and helpful. Thanks to Liya, the item arrived a week earlier than it was supposed to. When I received my item, some of the velcro stickers weren't as expected. Again, Liya was very quick to get back to me and send me the correct patches. She also added extra holiday stickers that my daughter loves. I really appreciate the attention to customer service and the quality of this product!

source_doc: Not just a pregnancy pillow! I had 2 major abdominal surgeries and was absolutely struggling to find a comfortable way to sleep. When sleeping on my non surgical side, I rolled to my belly in my sleep waking me up in terrible pain. I gave this pillow a go. I wish I’d have gotten one of these years ago! It comes vacuum packed, I tossed it in the dryer on air fluff for about 30 mins and left it out to form as suggested and washed the cover in my sensitive detergent (dried cover on very low heat because of the fabric type). It formed beautifully! I couldn’t wait to try it out. I did add a bit of extra poly fill on one side to make it more firm only because I wanted a firm barrier to prevent me from rolling on my belly. It worked perfectly! I never rolled on to my belly once. I’ve been using this all week now and I have noticed that my incision sites aren’t anywhere near as painful and it’s even helped with painful joints from fibromyalgia. I wish I could give it far more stars. It wasn’t flat like many other pillows and their reviews, it was truly perfect. This is a fantastic investment. Now I just have to work on getting the hubby to stop resenting my pillow for replacing him lol

source_doc: Great office chair! This seems like a nicely made computer chair. I am not very good at putting things together, but I managed to get this chair together all by myself! I just couldn't get it in the right spot because I needed two hands to screw the bolts in. It took awhile, but I got it!The chair is very sturdy and the seat is very comfortable! The neck support is nice. The only issues I noticed were some of the wheels wouldn't roll as I pushed it back to my office. I assume with use, these wheels will start working. Also, I had planned on using it for my bar-height desk, but it is a few inches too short, so I will have to find another use for it. I think I assumed it would adjust that high, but I should have looked at the measurements.

source_doc: Who owns a Karaoke machine? This guy! (Woohoo's with glee!) I have always thought that I would never have any reason to own my own karaoke machine, but now that I do, I can tell you that I can find a reason to own one almost every week. It is a party machine. I would say that is the biggest valid reason to own your own karaoke machine. If you sing, and love to sing in front a crowd, but you still don't have a recording contract, then this machine allows you to increase your odds of landing a contract by increasing the volume of your voice. I mean, it can't hurt, can it? Sing loudly and sing proudly. This machine is well made and has not had a single problem since I received it 6 months ago. It has been to the beach and back it did well. It sounds good, it gets loud, and the two microphones that it comes with are a cinch to use. They are up and running in less than a minute after I power up the speaker. It comes with a smartphone holder so that you can display a song's lyrics as you sing. The speaker rolls on two wheels, and it has a pull-out handle like a rolling suitcase. I have had a lot of fun using this machine and I have had zero problems with it. If you are looking for a karaoke machine, this is a good choice.

source_doc: Didn’t Work. I bought one of these quite a while ago and never installed it. I finally got around to installing it. The concept is great, mine just didn’t work. I tried it on two different Leviton switches thinking that perhaps the contacts just didn’t quite line up on the first switch I tried to install it on. I made sure the switch (on the SnapPower faceplate) was in, power was in to the switch, and I covered the sensor/switch to test it. Nothing. I removed the SnapPower faceplate, inspected it, and tried again. Same result. I tried another switch, and same result. I had an extra Leviton switch, so I checked to see whether the SnapPower contacts line up with the screws. They do, not perfectly, but certainly enough to make adequate electrical contact that they should work. So either my SnapPower face plate is defective, or it doesn’t work if the hot and return wires are connected to the switch using the push-in connectors rather than the connector screws? It has been too long for me to return this one, so I’m stuck with an overly expensive spare faceplate. I’m pretty handy and technically savvy, and these are ultra simple, so it’s definitely an issue with the one I bought.

source_doc: Works as well as the name brand. This product is very similar to the name brand purple shampoo and conditioner that I had been using. The shampoo seems like it is a clarifying shampoo and leaves my hair feeling a little rough, after I use the conditioner it is soft and moisturized. The directions are to leave the shampoo and condition on 3-5 minutes each. When I was using this I felt there was no scent to this product, no perfumes or unpleasant scent. It smelled like nothing at all. After I read reviews stating that it smelled of peppermint I went back and smelled it while in the bottle and I guess it does small vaguely of peppermint.The results are the same as the others, soft hair, but can't tell if either is doing anything. For reference, I had natural red hair, and the front is quite white, while the back still has red (dye) coloring at the ends, the new hair growth is dark, not red like when I was young. The white part of my hair is not brassy at all, nor is the new growth, and I have been using purple shampoo about once or twice a week. So I can't say if it's the shampoo or not, but my hair does feel moisturized with this shampoo.Very purple coloring, does not stain the shower or shower curtain.

source_doc: A solid and well-made gate. I have pretty much the same gate (different company) but without the cat door. I didn't know they even made gates with cat doors! I was thinking of all sorts of different things I could do to create a safety barrier but not lock the cats out. I didn't want to actually have to install a door and then cut a whole and install a cat door. I was excited when I ran across this product, and was hoping it was something of good quality (like my other gate). I was pleased when this arrived as it was quite heavy (a good thing) and is made with some sort of solid metal (can't be bent). I like that the cat door can be left open, or it can be locked. I admit when I installed my first gate it was a bit confusing as I wanted to get it right, but the manual that this came with is really helpful in it's detail and pictures. It helps I've already made an installation like this before, but even if I hadn't I appreciate the instructions. I will still use them. I don't remember how much I paid for the non-cat gate, but it was definitely more expensive than this. I'm glad they make a product like this!

It’s possible to pull it down over your eyes or leave it above your eyes, whatever best suits you. Personally, when I have a headache, I want the cooling relief over my eyes.Since it’s winter here and was below zero when my package was delivered, even though I took it from the drivers hand, the head wrap arrived cold. I’ve realized it always feels sort of cool to the touch, but I keep in the freezer as I like it colder. I haven’t tested it in the microwave since I don’t intend on using it that way.

source_doc: Really Works to Prevent Color Bleeding. I usually separate my whites from darker clothing out of fear that the dye from the dark clothing will stain the white. So I was excited to try this product.Basically the sheets look like fabric softener sheets, only they're meant for "grabbing" the color shed by darker clothes and preventing them from bleeding onto the lighter ones. I dropped 2 sheets in my load of laundry, started the machine, and added detergent.To test the product, I threw in a pair of burgundy colored corduroy pants that explicitly said "Wash separate from light colors" and even stated "dye may bleed." I threw them into the same wash as my lighter colored shirts and socks.After the wash was done, I saw that the two "color grabber" sheets had turned gray (they were originally white). They had absorbed the color and when I checked my clothing, I saw no color "bleeds."Now, I haven't tested it with a hot water wash, but for the cold water wash, they definitely work. I love it. Usually I have to separate the whites from the other clothing and it wastes money because the all-white bundle is usually small and could easily fit with the rest of the clothing's washer. But I had always had to separate. Not anymore! I can toss one of these sheets in and it will prevent any color bleeding.Great product.

source_doc: DIY, Save the mony. The detailer's wanted $1300. I watched 15 different YouTube Videos then decided on Adams. I do have a Quick Jack which made it a bit easier with the car lifted. It was easier than I thought ( I did do my homework). I took my time, started in a less noticeable spot and off to the races. I did have another advantage the car was freshly painted, I waited 3 weeks for the paint to gas off and I was done in 4 hours. It is a Miata MX5 a bit smaller than most cars. I left it in the garage for 24 hours before driving it. The first wash left beads of water and I dried the car with a 550 CFM leaf blower. Didn't even need a towel. I save me some big bucks and felt really good doing it myself.

source_doc: Deathadder without the wire! I've tried different brands/models of mice but have cumulatively used a Deathadder for over 7 years. I've always been too scared to pull the trigger on wireless mice because I had a bad experience with one and I'm not a fan of charging things constantly but the feel, the performance, everything, is amazing. I absolutely love it! It's exactly like my Deathadder Elite but without the wire.The only thing I will say is that I was disappointed with the battery life. I game much anymore and just casually hang out on my computer on days off from work. I also have the power saving mode set to 5 minutes because I'll go AFK to clean or hang out with my dogs often, so I'm not using it a ton. I guess I just expected a little more. The product advertises a "70 hour life", which I know is on the high end, but I expected more. Overall, I love this mouse and don't mind charging it for the convenience of not having a wire anymore.

source_doc: Skeptical at first, but I will not play without them again! I had just seen these grips on social media when a friend who had a set  recommended I give them a try. I was skeptical at first, but after my first three-hour gaming session, I will never play without them again.I play Fortnite almost every night, often for a few hours at a time. Usually my hands get sweaty after about an hour or so, but that did not happen with c2 Gripz, even after three hours. I bought the mediums, and my hands fit perfectly around the contoured grooves. This helped separate my fingers and naturally placed my hand over the controller. The ridge at the bottom gave my fingers support and being above the controller also gave me better control.I have also noticed less strain on my hands after long gaming sessions. I have carpal tunnel, so sometimes I get flare ups during longer sessions, but I have noticed a big improvement with less strain on my hands and forearms since using C2 Gripz.I have been using them for almost two months, and I will never play without C2 Gripz again. Oh yeah! As a bonus, I like how the controller can stand on its own because of the base of the gripz. This is a perfect added feature for people who like to use their controller as a tv remote. I highly recommend this product 10/10.

source_doc: This is going to take some practice for all three of us! After getting a second puppy in our life, I wanted the ability to take them both out for walks together and have at least one hand free  When I saw this I thought how fabulous this would be!  It arrived and I hooked the three of us up.  My older puppy is fairly good at leading alone.  The puppy, is even better!  She is a natural heeler!  I thought it would be a breeze!  Yeah, didn't go as I expected.  I quickly felt like I was the monkey in the middle with dogs going every direction and pulling me in the middle!  Then the fun, I stopped to get them under control and they each wrapped around me like some kind of insane doggie butterfly cocoon!  I managed to get control of the beasts, unwind myself and grabbed those broncs by the short handles of those leads!  I proceeded to walk ourselves home to get the regular leashes and I will use the regular leashes on this fanny pack until they get the hang of it better.  I think it was the extra bungie stretch they had that allowed them to go insane!Positive note:  The pack, the leads and all components held up great to the insane dance these dogs put me through!  I like being able to carry their treats with me and the other pouch for potty bags, keys, etc!

source_doc: Quality feels well made. This feels sturdy and strong. I love how tall it is so I don’t have to bend over to get this out like a my other baby gate. This does come with some wall caps that screw in but they aren’t necessary so I didn’t use them that way I can move it if I want to. The gate is easy to open for an adult with a button on top of the handle and below that have to be pushed at the same time so a baby wouldn’t be able to open it. I had my husband help me set it up but I could’ve installed it alone but easier with two people. The gate also can be left open which I like as I don’t always need it closed. I’m happy with this gate I just need two more I can close off my main living area.

source_doc: Going back to knipex. Long story short, I tried to use these, and they weren’t for me. After cutting what turned out to be a hot wire thanks to sloppy wiring in the past, I discovered these after watching a video recommending them.  I thought the pliers would be sort of a two tools in one for my tool belt.  If I need to cut a heavy gauge wire, the button would give me additional leverage without going back to my tools or carrying one more tool around.  What happened instead was the 85% of the time I was just cutting 10, 12 or 14 ga romex that the pliers were awkward in my hand and about half the time locked shut.  It would turn  a no look grab from tool belt, cut and return to tool belt into a grab, fiddle, cut, return.  I don’t have small hands but I am certainly not palming basketballs either (typically size L glove). The wihas were bulkier than my knipex cutters. The difference was a tool that took little thought was replaced with a tool that just didn’t fit or feel right.  When I was removing some old chain link fence, I appreciated the extra leverage but how often do I do that.After trying them for a month, I finally just went back to my knipex cutters.  Maybe I didn’t give these a fair shake, but I really don’t like using tools that offer me no benefit.

source_doc: Wow was I surprised when I opened this! I purchased this but thought maybe I should have bought glass instead. When I saw it it looked so much like glass and even felt and sounded like glass. It wasn't just me I bought one as a gift for someone else and she couldn't believe it was not glass either but best of all, it fell off the counter the other day. I was sure it would crack or something. Instead it bounced! That sucker hit the ground hard on a hardwood floor and not even a scratch. I don't know about the floor though LOL! I highly recommend. If you're going to make triple layer cakes go for something a little taller but it is great for a double layer cake and I use lots of fluffy whipped cream icing. Fits right over the top and I also cover the bottom with the cardboard cake rounds. I don't know if that's necessary but I figure if I ever want to use the bottom as a charcuterie tray I don't want to mix my meats and cake so as a precaution I use the cake rounds. Excellent item!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: Awful Taste, no noticeable positive results.... I bought these, despite the reviews on how bad they taste.  I thought I could hold my breath and chew it.  I was wrong.  These are the worst thing I have ever tasted (vanilla probably makes it worse) and they do clump up in your teeth.  I barely got one down and would not try a second.  I blended two more to a smoothy and drank it (in the evening).  I have to admit, I slept quite well that night, but no help after that.I then ended up crushing the rest with a meat tenderizer and put them into capsules myself.  I had to take quite a few at once, but I could swallow them.  I did not notice any improvement with sleep, anxiety or energy after taking it this way.  I will not buy again, as I am not convinced they help with any of the things I needed them for.I would like to add that my not liking this particular product would not prevent me from purchasing from Dr. Berg's shop in the future.  I trust his advise completely and get a lot of valuable information out of his videos.
