source_doc: Back to basic, it’s what works! Who ever said newer and more technical is better was wrong. When I had my daughter 20 years ago we used the basic bulb sucker at home but this style in the hospital where I worked as a nursing student. I had my second child this year and saw that nasal aspirators had advanced, they’re electric with lights and sounds now. I of course got one immediately but when my baby got his first stuffy nose I came to realize they don’t offer very much suction and it was more work than it was worth. I tried a few others before going back to the basics. I remembered the one at the hospital working better than my bulb sucker so when I saw this I decided to try one more. This nasal aspirator works great! It has wonderful suction and I like that you control just how much. There aren’t a ton of parts that need cleaned afterward and nothing has to be done before using it in the middle of the night with a scared crying baby. You can tell it’s made with quality material and the little etching of the bunny is a cute addition. I’m very happy with this purchase and relieved I have a way of helping my baby breathe easier.

source_doc: Best value for the price. I like the Old Mother Hubbard minis.  They're the perfect size for rewarding my dogs (I have large dogs).  I appreciate that the ingredients are better than many of the comparable treats, such as Milk Bones, and yet the price is more reasonable than brands like Blue.  My dogs are eager to be treated with them, so they must taste good.  As I stated, I have large dogs, so we do go through them somewhat quickly.  For this reason, I buy the 6lb boxes.  I get more for the cost.  I do feel like these could be better packaged.  The box isn't tightly sealed, just taped along the middle.  The biscuits are in a large plastic bag inside the box which isn't sealed either.  I do worry that these could easily be contaminated by their surrounding environment.  It would not be difficult for a mouse to crawl under the flap of the box and get inside the bag of biscuits.  Definitely something I think the manufacturer should consider.  When I get mine, I fill the treat jar and then store the remaining in the deep freezer until I need them.  (My German Shepherd is allergic to storage mites, so this helps me negate that issue.)

(Můj německý ovčák je alergický na skladovací roztoče, takže mi to pomáhá tento problém eliminovat.)

source_doc: Not a fan of the built in XLR cable. The boom stand itself works great. It is a good value for the money. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the built in XLR cable it comes with. I am an Electrical Engineer and I tested this cable myself and can see that using a 150 ohm XLR preamp test on my desktop setup, I can see that my whole setup puts out a noise floor of about -100dB, which is extremely good. But it wasn't until I plugged in the XLR cable that my noise floor went up about 20dB. That is a lot for a cable and when I turned my gain up all the way to see if my hypothesis was correct, it was picking up radio interference from a local radio station, but barely could hear it. This means that the shielding on the wire itself has a fault somewhere or the wires themselves aren't balanced and not twisted pair. After I plugged in my own XLR cable that I had from a good source, I immediately saw my noise floor jump back up to -99dB and could hear no interference anymore. Just letting people know, that if you do expect to use this boom stand, make sure you also buy an XLR cable that is good quality. Now, I don't know if maybe I got a faulty cable, but it is something I wanted to warn people about.

source_doc: Didn't know I needed one till I started using it. I've been stressed out quite a bit lately with work and my home so I've decided I need to take some time to relax through the day so when I saw this I figured I would give it a shot, and I was glad I did.  It came packaged well with no defects I could see.  In the box are the eye massager and a USB c cord.  It charges via USB C which I like and didn't take all that long to charge.  Putting it on I did have to adjust it a little bit but that wasn't too hard.  I kicked it on and let it run a preset on my eyes.  Let me tell you it feels wonderful.  It does have a bit of pressure but nothing uncomfortable.  I let it run its cycle and ran another one because it felt so good.  If you are looking for a way to relax and block out light this thing is amazing.

source_doc: Silky finish, covers decent. It was hard for me to get a clear picture, of the difference but this works just like mixing your foundation with lotion. It has a nice silky feel after, but it covers better, and without making the fine lines pop out worse. I only used one squirt and it was enough to do my whole face. It is a little on the pale side, but i honestly could mix this with a darker shade of foundation and I think I'd be just fine. I was pleasantly surprised at the coverage and the overall ease of application. I literally just rubbed it on like I would sunscreen and i did not need to do anything else. If I took the time to apply it, I think it would look even nicer and I would be even happier. This is definitely a brand I personally would be interested in seeing what other products they have, because I was immediately impressed with this, and I usually can not say that when trying new products. I am extremely happy with this, and definitely will be ordering more when this bottle is gone. Took a photo of the color it is, as that was a question I had  before ordering. Hope it helps.

source_doc: AMAZING OIL - Smells much stronger when used then in the bottle. This essential oil has thoroughly impressed me. When I got it and smelled it out of the bottle I didn't think it had much of a scent at all and was disappointed but I read the insert saying it would be stronger once used and then I gave it a try. WOW!!!! I used the included nozzle and sprayed it about 6 times in my room hours ago and now my entire unit (700 sq ft) is filled with this wonderful fragrance. I cannot believe how long it has lasted and even that it traveled through each room so that when I came back from walking my dog and opened the door I immediately smelled the clean fresh scent of Gardenia Lily. I am a home fragrance fanatic and have tried many many products but this one has surpassed them all. I usually use a room spray and within half an hour the scent is completely gone so for this to last hours is amazing. Now that I know what this can do, I know I will only need a spray or two so this bottle is going to last a very very long time. I was wondering why this bottle of essential oil was at this price point but now I know. It's also 100% pure essential oil with no water. I can't wait to try it in a diffuser.

source_doc: Great tissue holder! I really like these tissue holders!  I put one on each of my family's drivers side visor.  I DO think that it should come with at least two of this manufacturers small tissue packets though.  It would not cost that much more to include them with the tissue holders.  I DID end up purchasing refill tissues to fill up these holders.  I AM VERY PUZZLED as to why this company does NOT make these tissue holders the 'standard' size of tissues!  What I did do, is I took a stack of regular sized tissues and I cut them to fit these holders.  That works and cutting regular size tissues will save me money in the future when I need to refill my tissue holders!  I am glad that I purchased these holders, as these holders will prevent us from searching for our tissue boxes that we normally have in the back seat.  That task can be distracting at times, and that is not good when you're driving!

source_doc: Probiotic toothpaste. I am a huge fan of using probiotics for all types of products, so I was happy to try this product. It has a more delicate flavor than the toothpastes I’m accustomed to using, from America. There’s a subtle mint and sweet flavor, I found it refreshing. I don’t expect it to whiten my teeth… I use whitening strips for that, and even with those, it requires regular use for my teeth to get whiter. I like using whitening toothpastes though, sort of as daily maintenance. But I’ve never tried a whitening toothpaste on its own that actually made my teeth whiter.One thing I did notice is that I have a sensitive spot on my teeth that I started feeling after using this for a few days. I normally use Sensodyne because of tooth sensitivity. And the sensodyne definitely keeps that at bay. So I probably wouldn’t repurchase this for that reason, and also because it’s pretty expensive (currently $49 for a 3.52oz tube). But I did enjoy the other aspects of this toothpaste.

source_doc: It’s okay. It’s a starter kit, so it will give you what you need for a quick start up. I purchased Quick Start and Stress Coat+ instead of using the conditioner provided with the tank and they worked very well. Within a few hours of adding those in and running the filter, my water was ready.I’m not a fan of the filter at all, it’s loud, creates a strong current, and it doesn’t do the best job of cleaning the water (the sole thing a filter is supposed to do). Based on previous reviews it’s not reliable so within a week of having it I decided to replace it with an inexpensive, but much more reliable, sponge filter that doesn’t create a current. Happy water, happy fish.The lights are decent, though I wish they were dimmable. There are cheap options for dimmable lights with a timer that can be submerged, and I will be using those instead.The instructions for this tank mention a provided heater. There isn’t one provided, which I think is better as I found a heater that reads the water temperature and it’s keeping my betta very happy.Overall, the tank is decent and a huge upgrade from the 2.5 gallon I had before. With the money I spent, I could’ve purchased a bigger tank since I replaced everything else but now I know for the future.

source_doc: Inexpensive, but with cheap construction. I got this shelf/rack for my basement exercise room. It was inexpensive which is good because it is also somewhat problematically constructed.The first one they sent me had a piece soldered upside down. So I wasn’t able to assemble it. The second one had all the pieces soldered correctly but when I hung them up, the one side was longer than the other. So I couldn’t make it level. I had to Jerry rig it to make the bottom racks be level. (Second picture) I also had trouble with the mollies they included—they were super weak so I wasn’t able to successfully hammer them into the wall even after I pre-drilled holes. I got them partially in and then the top would just cave in and I had to cut them off.I found the installation instructions difficult to follow and incomplete. Thankfully I’m handy enough to figure out how to do it. But it took a fair bit of time. So just prepare yourself for that.Because it’s attached with six screws, it feels pretty solid. I think it’s going to do the job well.

source_doc: Refused to connect. I had a lamp I wanted to use Alexa with and I have other older Kasa smart plugs that work fine.  My other bulbs were Lumiman and I thought I would try to make everything just Kasa.  So I ordered a Kasa smart bulb but it refused to connect.  I thought that maybe it was because the lamp was one of those metal swing-arm things, so I thought, well, I'll just get another Kasa plug instead and ordered a used set of 2.  They both refused to connect.  Thinking it was because they were used, I ordered 2 more new ones.  And, guess what, they refused to connect, too.  I tried everything with all of them.  Multiple tries and resets, moving the lamp all over the house and even right next to the router.  None of them would connect.  So I ordered another Lumiman bulb and, lo and behold, it connected right away with absolutely no issues.  2 stars is for the old plugs that actually worked.

source_doc: Easy to install & just work! I had cages on my pedals, but I was primarily riding my bike on a trainer.  I used the cages because I figured my feet would slip, but I didn't want the clicky shoes since I wasn't convinced I was going to ride enough to spend the time finding something that fits...I unhooked my bike and now its going on the road for real.  The cages are just not going to work for me, so these are just right.  I wanted something durable and at least decent looking for my cyclocross bike.  Like I said, I'm not hardcore, so I just wanted something with regular pedals - these fit perfectly and work as I had hoped.  Look cool and have plenty of grip for when I'm casually riding around.  Very satisfied.

source_doc: Seems like a good collar. My cats needed new collars and I thought I'd give this one a try.  I ordered the cloud print and it's cute.  No issues with sizing the collar to what I needed and I did try pulling apart on it to ensure it would "break away" if need be and it did come apart with a fairly good tug.  My cats are indoor cats so I doubt it will be put to the test, but would want to make sure it would just in case.  I do have to say I don't care for the bell.  My cat's last collar had a bell and it really wasn't noisy unless he was really running.  This bell is very noisy.  It's a smaller sound, kind of a tinny sound.  But I could tell my cat did not like it.  At least for the first few days he was constantly messing around with his neck like he was trying to find the bell.  He never did that with his last collar.  I was actually getting ready to take it off but it's been about a week and he seems used to it now so I'll leave it be for a bit longer and see.  But I do wonder if it's still driving him nuts.  I may still remove it at some point.

source_doc: English bully-approved. Great harness for English bullies.  Sizing is spot on, I got the large for my pups that range from 25.5-27 inches.  Quality is great too.  I do want to say that my bullies aren't 'pullers' and are pretty chill, so I can't say how durable it is in regards to more aggressive dogs.  But, I've taken them on their walks with this, and I don't feel like it may break or anything like that.  I have been using this harness for a few weeks now exclusively for one of my pups, and I haven't seen any fraying or rips on the harness.Most importantly, my pups like it.  They're pretty picky when it comes to harnesses, when they don't like one they make a point of running away when I would take ones they didn't like out, or try biting it off their bodies.  This one has passed all the tests!  One of my pups even TOOK A NAP with it on.The leash is just okay.  The handle is nice since it has the plastic piece, but I already have a leash that I like so I'm keeping this as a back up.  I mainly got this for the harness.It's a crazy good price, especially when you compare it to the name-brand ones.  This is a fraction of the price.  My pups and I are glad that I got it.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Schváleno anglickými buldoky. Skvělý postroj pro anglické buldoky. Velikost sedí naprosto přesně, pro své psy s obvodem hrudníku mezi 25,5 a 27 palci jsem pořídil/a velikost L. Kvalita je také skvělá. Musím podotknout, že moji buldoci netahají a jsou docela klidní, takže nemohu posoudit, jak odolný by byl u agresivnějších psů. Ale chodím s nimi na procházky v tomto postroji a nemám pocit, že by se mohl rozbít nebo něco podobného. Tento postroj používám už několik týdnů výhradně pro jednoho ze svých psů a nezaznamenal/a jsem na něm žádné třepení ani trhliny. Co je nejdůležitější, mým psům se líbí. Pokud jde o postroje, jsou docela vybíraví – když se jim nějaký nelíbí, dávají to jasně najevo tím, že utečou, jakmile vytáhnu ten neoblíbený, nebo se ho snaží ze sebe skousat. Tento prošel všemi testy! Jeden z mých psů si v něm dokonce i ZDŘÍMNUL. Vodítko je celkem průměrné. Rukojeť je sice fajn, protože má plastovou část, ale už mám vodítko, které mi vyhovuje, takže si tohle nechávám jako záložní. Pořídil/a jsem to hlavně kvůli tomu postroji. Cena je neuvěřitelně výhodná, zvláště když ji porovnáte se značkovými produkty. Tohle stojí jen zlomek jejich ceny. Moji psi i já jsme rád/a, že jsem ho koupil/a.

source_doc: Defective Tool From The Start. The first time I used this wrench to torque some wheels, it locked up and displayed gibberish on the final wheel. I rebooted the wrench and it seemed to work. I used it again and it seemed to work so I just took a mental note. I recently used it and the display locked up again and rebooted itself in the middle of trying taking a measurement. I finally accepted that this torque wrench was defective. I called the manufacturer who referred me to a company in WV. They said to send it and they would fix or repair. At this point, I wanted to switch brands. I didn't feel like shipping on my dime so I contacted Amazon. They said they would do a one time refund since it had been 4 months. I was ecstatic. I printed the UPS label and shipped it. I was then notified of the refund amount which was $30 less than the purchase price. I researched and found that you only get 80% back if the return is over 1 month. My future large purchases will be from local stores and I won't buy another Gearwrench torque wrench.

source_doc: Easy to swallow vitamin E. I have tried in the past various Vitamin E products. I was looking for one where I only had to take 1 a day. I came across a company Kala Health that has a Vitamin E Ultra Tocopherols 1000 IU and you only need to take 1 a day. So I decided to give it a try. Since I had never ordered from them, I was anxious to see how big the capsules were. To my suprise they were long & slender caps, which made swallowing easier. The main reason I wanted to take Vitamin E was for my skin. As I have gotten older, it did not matter how much lotion I used my skin was still dry. So far I have to say my skin seems to be some better. I am going to keep taking this product. The price I paid was very reasonable. I would recommend this product.

source_doc: Type of refund. I purchased this product and the second time I used it I could tell I was allergic to it. My scalp itched excessively and my scalp was red. When I asked for a refund I was told it had been more than a month since purchase. I explained that I could not return it sooner because I wasn’t having the symptoms right away. I thought that rule shouldn’t apply because of the allergic reaction. She did not care and told me to stop using it for 2 weeks and then try again. This caused some concern because she isn’t a trained medical person & by suggesting I use it again was careless. I am a cancer survivor & lost all of my hair. It was years ago but the effects of he chemo are still alive and well. I persisted that I wanted a refund to my debit card. That I was days ago and I got no communication from her about it. Could you please look into this for me?  Thank you! Diahn Cossar

source_doc: Very useful and best of all, small and light. Talk about timing, this battery came just in time for when I was due in a VR meeting and I forgot to charge the headset.  The battery fastens very easily to the side of the headstrap, but I wonder how long the battery strap will last.  I pulled it tight to prevent sagging, and it seemed like I might stretch out the strap holes and eventually it might break apart.  Aside from that, the battery worked perfectly.  I was in VR for two hours using this battery, but I will say that I think it charged my HMD very slowly.  I didn't think to look at the battery status until it had 94%, and it seemed like it took forever to get to 100%.  Then again, I was using it at the same time so maybe that's normal.This battery is light and small, much unlike the 3rd party batteries that I used to have to wear for the Quest 1.  I would highly recommend this battery to anyone who needs one for their headset.

source_doc: DO NOT BUY THESE. these are absolute garbage unless you just want to play by yourself. they are so buggie i have to keep going back in and play with the audio settings in my XBOX series x MULTIPLE TIMES per session. I have 2 accounts on my Xbox and i use the same headset for each (for a high level and low level character in a particular game that won't let you have multiple characters), this screws up the headset every time i switch back and forth (others can hear me but i can't hear them, so i have to go into xbox settings and start over). then there's an annoying occurrence where if i play alone the audio is really decent- not great but decent. as soon as my wife invites me to a party her voice is super loud and i can't hear the game. these headphone lock you out of the normal chat mixer and force you to use the volume dials on the headset- but the problem is the volume doesn't change. I have my wife screaming at me and i can't hear the game, the games music or my guns shooting- so i smashed these pieces of garbage on my table. total garbage. the XBOX official ones were the same price, but they were not available so i got these, that was a hundred bucks i really regret spending.

source_doc: Looks can be deceiving.... I really hate this clock.I'll start with what I like about it (which isn't much).It looks beautiful, very elegant and classy. Nice and large, easy to see from a distance.It keeps the perfect time. Doesn't make a sound.That's it. That's all I like.Now what I hate about this thing...It's super flimsy! I thought it might shatter just by putting two AA batteries in it.It's made of acrylic which is no big deal, it just makes it really lightweight. I doubt anyone who sees it on your wall would know that it wasn't real wood, but still feels like cheap plastic to me.The pendulum.... ohemgeeeee I really HATE that thing! It doesn't move AT ALL! I have tried everything under the sun to get that thing moving and nope, it just sits there staring at me like it's claimed it's victory by not budging. It honestly makes no sense, it only goes on there one way. And the pendulum is the only metal component in this clock. Everything else is plastic.Overall, it makes me mad just looking at it. I'm glad I got it on the vine because I definitely wouldn't have paid $50 for it. That would have been an instant return! It's all plastic, super flimsy, but looks really nice and does keep time. That's the only reason I gave it two stars. You can definitely find something much nicer for the same price elsewhere.

source_doc: Finally, the perfect heating blanket! I've been looking for a heating blanket for my bed, when I found one, I really liked it. However, the middle of the blanket would not warm up. I sent the blanket back and asked for a replacement since I reasoned that there might just be a problem with it. The identical action was taken by the second blanket. I subsequently bought another blanket, but I didn't like it because the coils only allowed it to heat up in the middle, not on either side. Even when I bought a fourth heating blanket, it still would not become hot enough. I was about to give up when I decided to give this one a last go.I am very happy I did. Only setting number medium  on this heated blanket keeps me toasty. It becomes unbearably hot if it’s on high. . Not only is the temperature control excellent. It's incredibly soft. I sincerely hope you enjoy the blanket as much as I do and my four-legged luvies.

While it is compatible with a variety of devices, including tablets and mobile phones, I found that the stand itself was not as solid as I had hoped.The foldable design and adjustable features are nice, and the anti-slip surface is a plus. However, I found that the stand itself was a bit more flimsy than I was expecting, and I had concerns about it tipping over or not providing enough stability for my Steam Deck during play.  Good if you want to use it for a phone desk holder, but those can be picked up easier and cheaper.While I am a big fan of JSAUX products, I have to say that this stand was not up to the same standard of quality that I am used to. I was hoping for something more solid and sturdy that would provide the necessary support for my device during gaming sessions.Overall, the JSAUX Stand Base for Steam Deck is okay, but I was looking for something more reliable and secure. If you're looking for a basic stand that is compatible with a variety of devices, this one may work for you. However, if you're looking for something more substantial and durable, you may want to consider other options.

AND, they also contribute to the cause of my choice. That's better than what Amazon did with their "Smile" program, which they greedily discontinued.This is a no brainer - which is probably why I screwed up the first time around.Anyway - this is truly a great product that does what it claims.For that, in this age of deception and greed, I am very thankful.

source_doc: Just as described! My machine was delivered Feb 4th. I started using it that day. Easy assembly. Only took 30 min. I use it about 3-4 times a week. 1st couple days I didn't use any bands to get used to the machine, then I started using 1 of them. I rotate excercise, 1 day I do 200 squats with only 1 band. Next day I do 50 squats no band, 50 with 1 band, anther 50 with 2 bands and back to 1 band to complete my 200 squats. I hit my zone minutes but can get used to it very easily which is why I keep switching up the routine. I am on a calorie deficit and this is the only exercise I do. I plan to try using the deadlift "feature" of this machine this week to add more workouts. I love it. Worth the purchase to me!Editing to add: I started using the deadlify feature this week and definitely will continue using it.  You can feel the burn where the squats wasn't!!

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Photophobia no more. I am extremely sensitive and picky when it comes to lighting. If a room is too bright I can't stay in there for too long as I feel like a fish in a tank and can't think. A perfect room has a range of dimmable light options but unfortunately my desk space didn't. Desperate to find a solution that kept me from leaving my work space, I stumbled upon this simple modern looking option. I have used it everyday since receiving it. I hardly ever turn on the lights to my room and instead opt to use this little lamp instead. I love all the different options I can choose from depending on what I am feeling. I also love to use it to do my makeup as one of the settings resembles daylight. This versatile lamp is very worth it for the price point. I am glad I took a chance on it!

They asked me to cut the cord & send photos of that.  I don't have the original box, so I can't return to Amazon.  As of now, I just unplug it and don't leave it on when not in use.  I guess I'll buy a different brand so I have something to use until they respond.  The way the manufacturer is giving me the run around is the reason for the 2 stars.

source_doc: Bought 2, here’s my opinion. So I bought two when it was on sale for $18 each. I bought one as a gift and one for myself. I asked the other person how it was and he said it worked great. I had mine in my car for over 6 months and I just used it last week. I noticed the low air indicator light was on so I plugged it into my car. I noticed it has three different setting of pressure. I put it on psi and it showed that it was low. I let it run till it got to my cars psi recommended level and turned it off. There is only one caveat, I’m not sure how accurate it is. I also had a handheld pressure tester and it was old and it showed a different number. When I got into the car and drove for a little the tire indicator was off. So in essence it did its job. And well worth the investment.

source_doc: Awesome Poor Man's Peloton. I purchased this about a year ago to use as a cheap alternative to a Peloton. Assembly was super easy. I added a bluetooth Wahoo cadence tracker, my Apple Watch for heart rate, and my iPad fit perfectly on top to stream the Peloton app. The only thing I cannot replicate is the resistance and I just go by how hard they say it should be, it works for me. I love it. I have a quiet room it is tucked away in that I can work out in and have had absolutely zero problems other than the infamous seat squeak which only happens if I fidget. I am just at the point that cages are getting annoying and I am going to put clipless pedals on but the cages worked fine. For reference, I am 5'1", 200lbs, and have never broken a pedal standing to ride or had any clunking noises. I do feel like I could use one more tiny click lower on the seat to perfect the alignment, or farther forward but not to the point it is uncomfortable.

source_doc: This gadget is freaking amazing! As it would happen, if things can go wrong, they will.  The day before I received a positive COVID test that not only knocked me on my ass, but the very next day the master bath toilet backed up.  I plunged and plunged, and plunged, and plunged to no avail.  So, I turned to Amazon and found this gadget. I thought it would be a rinkydink, use a couple of times before tossing into the garbage but to my surprise I was wrong.  I’m rarely wrong :).  In my now full on COVID ravaged body I easily assembled, pumped it up (29 pumps to be exact) shoved the gadget into the tank.  I kinda felt like Rambo as I pulled the trigger!  Yes, there is actual trigger.  To my surprise, the recoil felt like a shot a baby shotgun!  What I didn’t know is that I should have tried to cover the bowl because along with the recoil, a bunch of toilet water splashed back on me and the floor.  After I got over that shocker, I flushed and Wallace.  Whatever was stuck was gone.  It probably got blown to smithereens!  Run, and don’t hesitate to make this purchase!

source_doc: I put this thing through the ringer. Reviewing "Wahl Color Pro Cordless Rechargeable Hair Clipper & Trimmer – Easy Color-Coded Guide"I'm a gym rat / exercise buff with bodybuilding background that puts this thing to full-body use.  I've now bought four of these things over the past 3-5 years (same exact one I'm reviewing here), and it's fantastic.  I keep the blade cleaned and oiled, and I *always* keep a blade guard on it when not in use so as not to scratch or full the metal blades.  My main point is that if you take care of it, it will last pretty decently.  The reason I've bought four or five of these is because I use them like crazy (yes, full body shaving, including haircuts).  Compared to older products that I bought in my youth, I like the wide blade for greater surface area (faster job done), and the variety of guard sizes (as I also cut the kids' hair).  Oh, as to why I've bought several of these it's because they don't sell just replacement blades--at least not that I can find.  Therefore, for the cheap price, I just go ahead and buy a new one.  Anyway, I like them and recommend them.  If you're a professional barber, you probably would use something else, but I wanted battery powered so no cord.  I also try not to get water into the mechanism.

source_doc: Just What I Needed. I was looking for a bread cutting guide that cut all the bread the same size, easy to store in a small space and easy to clean.  I did not want the lovely bamboo guides because  they were spaced to accommodate 3 sizes of slices on a somewhat small grid so then I would have to move the bread after every so many cuts in order to have them be the same size.  The key word I was interested in is "easy".  With this guide if I want thicker slices all I need to do is skip a space -- easy! Used this bread cutting guide today and am quite happy with it and would purchase it again. It cleans up easily -- just a quick wipe with soap and water.  However it's crumb catching ability is not great. I just place it on a jelly roll pan and cut away.  If one is giving this item as a gift it, comes in a very nice box.  If you order a white bread guide do not be alarmed if the box shows the red guide on the outside.  I think the red guide just shows up better on the box.  This guide is so much better than the Presto one I had before. I would purchase this guide again.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

hypo_0: Přesně to, co jsem potřeboval/a. Hledal/a jsem kráječ na chleba, který by krájel všechen chleba na stejnou velikost, snadno se skladoval v malém prostoru a snadno se čistil. source_doc: Amazing Powder for the extra coverage I need! Airspun Loose Powder Translucent Extra Coverage- I’ve found a gem with this powder. At first I thought it would be too light for my skin but it’s not the case at all. Other powders I’ve used in the past have been beige. This powder amazingly blends into my skin beautifully. After my morning routine of cleansing, toning, vitamin C serum & moisturizer I then use L’Oreal Magic Erase Primer which is the only primer that controls my very oily skin. Once my face is set I apply this powder. This sets my face for an entire day! I apply it before 7am & it’s still looking great at 7pm. Liquid foundation has never worked for me due to my oily skin. I also have scarring from acne I had when I was a teenager into my 20’s. This powder falls nicely into place eliminating the look of this on my face. I love it! There is a lot of powder that comes in this container. For the price it’s amazing. A puffer comes with it but I use my makeup brush to pick the powder up to apply it. Yes, there is a scent to it. This doesn’t bother me but if you’re sensitive to fragrance this wouldn’t be for you. Otherwise I’d say with the low price it’s worth trying. From my personal experience I definitely recommend it!

source_doc: Amazon lost package, I never received it. Eden's garden = quality product. The package that this was in was lost by Amazon. As the Vine member I am required to evaluate it but I never received it.I guess my evaluation would be how much I wanted to try this! I have tried numerous other Eden's gardens essential oils and essential oil blends, and my evaluations have always been four and five star. I was looking forward to this because I have a difficult time with sleep and I was hoping it would help.One thing that Eden's garden always does is send a tiny little sample oil of a different blend, so that's a nice thing that they do.Based on what I was expecting I would rate it five stars, but take into consideration that I haven't actually used it. I was looking forward to it.

source_doc: Looks and feels great. I thought I'd try these in my old, 2010 Prius after having replaced the original leather with  cheap vinyl seating elements. The vinyl was cheap but professionally installed. It looked ok, but did not wear well. So, I thought I'd give these a try.  Now, I wish I'd known about Karcle before I replaced the original leather.  I'm more than pleased with this product; I actually learned something from the experience.Because my Prius has heated seats, installation was a little more difficult. I went through contortions securing the elastic ties that go beneath the seat and hold the bottom element in place. But if your seats aren't heated and there aren't a lot of electronics under them, you won't have this problem. In any case, after a brief struggle, I got both pieces on. source_doc: Please don’t try and use these for more than a few months. These have been great, I got a set , then had a another set gifted to us for our daughter less than a year ago. They stain with some pasta sauces which I thought was the only downside. If you’re using a dishwasher DISPOSE OF THEM AFTER A MONTH OR SO!! I noticed my daughters requests for dinner changed. She went from eating everything I made, steak, chicken, pork, spinach, quiche, to over time she would eat just pb&j or soup. I tried one of her spoons and they’re either porous and they hold on to the dishwasher chemicals or they’re leeching themselves. Like burns your throat. DO NOT USE THESE THINGS IN A DISHWASHER.I use cascade in a 2 year old Frigidaire dishwasher, I don’t use high heat so I’m not cooking them a couple times a week. It isn’t the only way I wash these utensils, it’s 50/50 with hand washing but something is not ok. Please ONLY use these short term. I thought I was doing something good getting a recycled item but I feel like I screwed up getting these.

Dělají se na nich skvrny od některých omáček na těstoviny, což jsem považoval/a za jedinou nevýhodu. Pokud používáte myčku, PO MĚSÍCI NEBO TAK NĚJAK JE VYHOĎTE!! Všimnul/a jsem si, že se dceřiny požadavky na večeři změnily. Přešla od jedení všeho, co jsem udělal/a – steak, kuře, vepřové, špenát, slaný koláč – k tomu, že časem chtěla jíst jen toust s arašídovým máslem a džemem nebo polévku. Vyzkoušel/a jsem jednu z jejích lžic a buď jsou porézní a drží se v nich chemie z myčky, nebo se samy rozkládají. Úplně vás z toho pálí v krku. TYTO VĚCI V MYČCE NEPOUŽÍVEJTE. Používám Cascade ve dva roky staré myčce Frigidaire, nepoužívám vysokou teplotu, takže je několikrát týdně nevařím. Není to jediný způsob, jak toto náčiní myji, je to tak půl na půl s ručním mytím, ale něco je špatně. Používejte je prosím POUZE krátkodobě. Myslel/a jsem si, že dělám dobrou věc, když kupuji recyklovaný produkt, ale mám pocit, že jsem to s jejich pořízením zvoral/a.

source_doc: It’s fun and enjoyable. I’ve never picked up a guitar in my life until this was delivered so I can’t attest to playability or quality. I did swap out the strings when I got it but more because I wanted to learn how to do it than any perceived problem with the strings that came with it. I can say I have enjoyed experimenting and learning with this guitar.  I paired it with an “Orange” amp and despite not having a clue what I’m doing have been able to replicate sounds like ‘old school’ heavy metal to clear/clean tones that could pass for country or blues if played by someone who knew more than 2 cords. I suspect in trained or experienced hands this guitar would be a good, but not great, guitar.A few things I did notice…1. There are some exposed wires coming out from under one of the pickups and the middle pickups are not level. 2. There is some discoloration on the body of the guitar  3. The tuning peg for the high E is finicky and sometimes feels unresponsive which can make tuning a pain.For what I paid, I didn’t expect perfection, and I have no idea if the uneven pickups impact playability or sound quality, the remainder are cosmetic or just frustrating. I think this probably represents a solis starter guitar or a good rehearsal/travel guitar for more experienced players.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

Po doručení jsem sice vyměnil/a struny, ale spíše proto, že jsem se to chtěl/a naučit, než kvůli nějakému vnímanému problému s původními strunami. Mohu říct, že mě experimentování a učení se s touto kytarou bavilo. Spároval/a jsem ji s aparátem „Orange“ a přestože vůbec netuším, co dělám, dokázal/a jsem napodobit zvuky od „old school“ heavy metalu až po čisté tóny, které by prošly jako country nebo blues, kdyby na ni hrál někdo, kdo zná víc než dva akordy. Mám podezření, že v trénovaných nebo zkušených rukou by to byla dobrá, ale ne skvělá kytara. Pár věcí, kterých jsem si všiml/a... 1. Myslím, že tato kytara pravděpodobně představuje solidní startovací kousek nebo dobrou cvičební/cestovní kytaru pro zkušenější hráče.

source_doc: Excellent lunch bag! When shopping for some type of lunch bag item, I stumbled across the Eco-Friendly lunch bag. I liked everything I read about it so I decided to order. I cannot begin to tell you how much I LOVE it. First I was amazed how big it actually is. The depth is so nice. One of the reasons I bought this was because I needed something to keep my Grandson’s milk & juice when we are out running errands. To tell you how much you can fit in the lunch bag. I had 2 bottles of milk, 2 bottles of water and a 16 oz soda in the main section. On the inside upper lid there is a section (with a zipper to close the section off) I was able to put 2 small box juices and a small ziploc bag of grapes. If needed I could have placed more items in that section along with a outside zip storage where you can keep your phone etc. The whole inside is lined with what looks like aluminum foil that keeps items cold or hot. Also if u should spill something, all you need to do is wipe it off with a damp cloth or paper towel. To bad something like this wasn’t around when my 2 were growing up. It is so light weight and the outside material reminds me of denim. I truly believe you will love it as much as I do!

source_doc: Saved my back and knees! Hurray! I am at that age where sometimes I have to put off chores because I've used up my back or knees or feet for the day.I probably should have gotten something like this a few years ago.  This really is super usefule.  We have a small shower stall, but it was still super hard to get down to clean the floor.  Last time, I sort of tipped over after crouching down to scrub, I was kinda like a turtle on it's back, my leg muscles spasming as I tried to get up.This is so much easier, so far, I have only used the more abrasive scrubby attachment, I pour a little soft scrub, then cleaned the floor while leaning against the wall.  It was probably the most lazy shower clean I have ever experienced.The scrubbie is good at flat surfaces, but if you really need to get at a corner, you have to press really hard to get in there.  I don't know what the solution to that is.  After I was done cleaning the shower, I cleaned and rinsed the attachment and set it  on the top of the washing machine to dry before I put them away.The soft shamm-y attachment is a real conundrum.  I guess it could be used to clean mirrors or windows.  I will give a whirl next time.

source_doc: Capstar. I have 6 cats and they all came down with fleas. Considering they are all indoor cats and I live in a building they have no option to escape. Either way, we have fleas! 2 of my boys recently went to the vets. I think that's where they picked up a flea or 2. I didn't realize it until this week. That's when I went into action. 3 of my cats are semi feral and I have no ability to put drops on them. So I opted for an oral flea killer. I just gave them a dose tonight. Unfortunately I opted for a food that is heavily gravied,  next time it will be a pate. I used a pill crusher to mask the pill. I think that one of them did not get a full dose. He ateat least 85% of his dose. What he didn't finish the rest of his food his sister did, she has fleas too. Now, I'm just waiting to find dead fleas. My adults get drops tomorrow so I'm not worried about them. It's almost bedtime so I don't want to find fleas jumping off the cats and onto me! Bad enough I had 1 bite me inside my eye muscle. I guess my eye got in the way of its jump. LOL

source_doc: WOW. I am no longer a Sacrete guy. I set a 4x4, 8 foot post using this product.  I made a hole 2 feet deep, 7 to 8 inch diameter.  One package of this stuff nearly filled the entire hole with the post centered in it.  Mixed it exactly as the instructions dictate. I was initially disappointed because the liquid I poured in only filled up a couple of inches.  I was using a 2-foot level to confirm the pole was remaining vertical and then I looked in the hole and it was more than half-way full up with foam and I could see it rising. In perhaps 5 minutes more, it was nearly completely full up on all four sides.  After 15 minutes I removed the straps I was using to hold the post in place, and light pressure on the sides of the post showed no give in the foam, it was solid enough to leave standing alone.  Incredibly easy compared to how I used to have to mix a bag of sacrete by hand and carry the 30 or 40 pounds around.  Wish I had another project needing another bag of this stuff so I could do it all again, it was well, "fun".

source_doc: Outstanding ironing board! I never thought I would use ironing board and outstanding in one sentence, but this one definitely stands out.I was hesitant to order it because of the higher price. I never paid anything near this much for an ironing board lol.So why did I order it?First I saw the nice attachment with the little compartments. I immediately thought I could use it for scissors, tape measure and pins since I usually cut fabric on my ironing board due to lack of space in my craftsroom.Then I read that the ironing board is extra wide, another plus for cutting fabric or doing other crafts.I also noticed that you can pull it up to 36 inches which is counter top height and is easy on my back when I'm ironing.Of course I also read the positive reviews and eventually decided to order it.After unpacking and admiring the awesome attachment, the great quality, the sturdiness and the extra cover, I set it up in my craftsroom.I noticed that it was a little wobbly (it's our floor) so I put a piece of styrofoam underneath one of the legs.I read the description which came with it to make sure I didn't miss anything and guess what!The feet have built in stabilizers which are adjustable so no need to put anything underneath!It really can't get any better!An outstanding product for sure!5 stars from me. ☆☆☆☆☆

source_doc: Fantastic reading glasses. I usually use bifocals but for some things just reading glasses are ok since the bifocals are expensive. I like to keep reading glasses all over the place, since the reading is more of an issue really and what I need help with. Having some cheaper reading glasses around is a great solution for that problem. When I saw this 3 pack of reading glasses I figured not much to lose.I was VERY impressed with these however. For one the design is actually very similar to what I have in my own bifocals which is great. They are not super high end but actually very nicely made. They work really well and the glass / plastic works really well for when I need them to read or whatever else I am using them for at the time. I have to say these are a great find and for that price I will probably get more for other places I need to have some in case I forget my regular glasses, which is all the time really.

source_doc: Fender Mexico Surprised Me. I have another Mexican Starr I bought many years ago but this is a huge step up in quality. It seems many higher end manufacturers are moving some of their production to Mexico which I think is driving competition. I bought this as used but in very good condition. Very pleased. I had bought the same guitar from Musicians Friend which they sold as a New instrument which was returned. That one was abused so I returned it and was happily surprised when Amazon had one left. The finish is great and I find no faults in quality so far. I also have several American made Strats which surprised me that Fender had an anniversary model made in Mexico but don’t let that fool you. The only big difference I find is this doesn’t have the nitrocellulose finish. I wish they had shipped it in a hard case but I’ll get one for it anyway. The gig bag is their better one but I prefer to protect my favored guitars. Overall I’d say this was a great purchase!

We decided to use a pair of scissors, instead of a knife, to make a small cut and then slowly tore open each package.  I let the velvety-soft sofa bed rest, unzipped, while hanging over the top of a Lazy boy chair. The thick, supportive foam felt good, and it was the perfect size, after all.  I'm glad I ordered one.

source_doc: Amazing quality for a low price. I tested this lavalier microphone on a Zoom call where I wanted to stay connected with audio but leave the room completely. I was connected to the meeting through my cell phone, which I left in my office aimed at a chart when I roamed around my house. (Of course, I could have carried the phone with me during the Zoom meeting, but I was testing the audio at various distances.)  My Zoom meeting partner reported I sounded like I was sitting right in the room. Installing the receiver and microphone was a snap - the receiver plugs in to the charging port of the iPhone, and the light on that receiver blinks red until the microphone is turned on. When paired, the light on the receiver is a steady red (not blinking), and the microphone shines a steady green. The foam windscreens aren't necessary in the house but can be left on if that's the look you want. I am looking forward to using this lavalier when I record voice-over on my next PowerPoint lecture using my iPad.

source_doc: Excellent quality and lovely zippered case. I think another reviewer said these weren’t made of real memory foam, but when I compared it to my other memory foam pillows, it was definitely the same quality.I also like the fact that they were no offgassing smells when I resuscitated the pillow from being compressed in a small box.The thing with these pillows, and I have been using them for years from different  companies, is you have to try them for yourself. There are subtle differences in the dimensions of each one, and our bodies are differently designed, so you just have to experiment.I tried it with, and without the inner insert, without the insert it was just a little too floppy, even though it felt comfortable to lie on.The only other thing I want to mention is the case, while it is really beautiful quality and aesthetically designed, is a little too long for the actual pillow I received. When I see a little, I mean about an inch.This doesn’t really affect anything, so I didn’t take any stars away for it, it’s just some thing you might wanna know when events. I think it’s very good quality and looked as if it would last a long time. That said, you can find less expensive models that might do the trick for you, but I doubt they will be queen-size, they will probably be standard size.

source_doc: GREAT PRODUCT. This is a great product. I couldn't be happier with my purchase. I only gave it 4 stars for sturdiness because even though there is a metal support under each wooded step... the wood itself feels a bit vulnerable. It feels pretty good under my 22O pounds... but if I were closer to 3OO I think that they might possibly crack or split under such weight. I am sure that the metal will hold 5OO pounds... but I am not sure about the wood itself. Which could be replaced by something a bit thicker if necessary. But otherwise I am so happy that I bought this unit rather than any of the others. As this unit looks great... works great... and I can easily pick it up with one hand... if I want to move it and use it elsewhere in my home. This unit can also be easily painted if desired.  I have a lot of Elfa shelving over my full bed lengthwise for my large CD collection. These steps allow me to easily step up onto my bed mattress to access my CD's. For children at a sink... or pet's accessing a bed... it would be perfect... as it is for my needs. This is a great product at a really very decent price. Somehow it is both light weight and sturdy at the same time. Buy with confidence as this is definitely a quality product which will last.

source_doc: LOVE. I saw one like this listed on Lowes for like $250 so when I saw this I knew I wanted to try it out. I really love incline walking and I didn't want to get something with the bulkiness of a normal treadmill that most likely for the price wouldn't have incline. When I read manual I was hesitant but now that I got it all set up (easy by the way) I love it! Once you get the oil on there its like skating on ice & I have tried it with and without shoes and I would say it is MUCH easier with shoes on in my opinion. Anyways, for the price, the weight & size, and the way my calves and thighs are burning ..... makes me believe again its great!

source_doc: Works great for me! I have tried many vitamin C serums in the past, but I have to say I like this one the best. I could not detect any fragrance whatsoever. I really appreciate the dropper bottle which makes applying this very easy. There was a slight stickiness after application, but I let the serum dry for a few minutes and then applied moisturizer. I have not been using it long enough to notice if my dark spots are getting lighter, but I did notice a reduction in the redness in my cheeks. I felt absolutely exhausted and could barely stay awake a couple of hours each day. I was pretty sure I would need to go on insulin very soon. Then I tried these capsules!What a change! In literally 10 days, my glucose has gone down. From the mid-200s to 120+/- is unbelievable to me but it’s true! I am also doing intermittent fasting 16:8 which I was doing on its own before with no real effect to my blood sugar. I’m convinced doing 16:8 plus taking the capsules is what makes the difference for me. I now have a ton of energy from the B vitamins in the capsules, I don’t take daytime naps and blood sugar is getting better by the day. It is a night and day difference in just 10 days!My advice - stick to it for at least a week or two before giving up on it. I had no noticeable change until day 3. That’s when the capsules seemed to “kick in” and start working. I will try to update this in a month or two on my progress.

source_doc: Very sturdy! I have high hopes for the longevity of this dish drainer. What do we moved to a smaller place I decided to use just a draining mat figuring I would roll it up between uses. So 2 and 1/2 years later there are still always dishes on the mat so I decided to just get an actual dish drainer like I should have done when we moved okay. It helped with the decision that every time my daughter's boyfriend helps wash dishes he breaks something from making a leaning Tower of Dishes.When I took this out of the box I was surprised and pleased at the weight of it.  There is no flex in it, the metal is strong and sturdy, stainless steel not plastic coated cheap metal.There is also the added advantage of extendable arms on either end so you can position it over to the sink to drain directly into the sink. I'm not sure I will use that aspect very often, but I am very pleased with this product.It is a little smaller than I expected, but that's on me because I didn't check the measurements before I ordered. Just a heads up to check the dimensions.The only thing that I don't love is that the silverware caddy is a bit shallow.Great product, highly recommend!!

Also, I saw that one person gave a low rating, stating that the massager hurt scalp and tangled hair. I massaged my scalp gently and it felt SO GOOD! I love the massager! I will send an updated review if/when I try on my wet kinky/coily hair.

source_doc: Excellent mid-size carrying case. The reason I got this case for my Steam Deck is I wasn't happy with the velcro on the JSAUX case and had a couple other issues with it where I didn't feel like my deck was properly secured. This fella however solves all those issues. First, this case is a LOT bigger than the JSAUX case, the top is as wide as the bottom. There's a massive top pocket that you could shove a small Nintendo Switch carrying case into but otherwise it's perfect for batteries, controllers, docks, etc. I really wasn't expecting it to be that spacious! The bottom compartment isn't quite as big as the JSAUX one but I was able to cut out a slot for my charging brick using a boxcutter so no big deal, the interior material cut very easily. The protection for this felt wayyy better than the JSAUX case. The straps are excellent and the velcro is very good. The interior is also a bit padded which feels nice. It has microsd storage slots as well as fullsize SD storage slots. I was worried about the microSD's falling out so I kept them in their SD adapters anyways. The only feature I couldn't quite get working was the kickstand strap so I just shoved that down in the bottom and put a different kickstand in the top storage so I have one if I ever need it.

source_doc: This is the leash I never knew I needed. I bought this to use with my dog's therapy dog vest - I need a 4' leash when working.  I also wanted the short loop so I could have the dog fully in control.This is very nice.  It's quite light, but strong.  Excellent quality clasp. My dog is on the small size (18"), and this is just perfect for when I am working him in places where I need really close control.  I usually use a 6' leash, held in my right hand, with the left controlling the shorter length.  However, the second handle just makes it much simpler - one less thing to juggle and more solid control.My dog's vest is red with black, so the black leash with the red flashes looks sharp.  I use it with the vest (like harness), with his standard collar, but also with a Gentle Leader when we are doing therapy work.  The light weight is important with a small dog with the Gentle Leader - I did not want to put weight on pressure on his delicate nose. I may change out the clasp for a slightly lighter one just to relieve some of the weight.Good product for a working dog - light but well made, well designed, and it seems durable.

source_doc: Great item for the money fixed up my oil leak! I purchased this and was concerned about the low price.  I cleaned it out thoroughly looking for debri before proceeding with install and found none.From reading other "cheap" replacement oil filter housing reviews most folks advocated for replacing the oil and temp sending unit.  The last thing I want to do is strip the engine down as far as I did for one of those.  I went ahead and bought auto part store senders and replaced what was on here.  It may have worked fine I just didnt want to dig back in to the engine for them.You have to take off the upper and lower initakes to get to this.  I found over a quart of oil sitting on top of the engine that I had to clean out.  Once replaced and everything re-installed I am happy to report that I have used my inspecting camera and a simple "dip stick" to try to find oil under the intake and it has come back clean.  I put this in before Christmas so as of this review over a month and so far so good.Very happy that my oil leak is finally solved!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a"

source_doc: I use the conceal and perfect foundation and.. So I wanted to love this. I was like "ooh yay, a peach colored product for my eye bags". I had Hope's it would work as well as the LA Color one I use currently. I'm kinda disappointed because this was too sheer and not peachy enough.For reference I wear 2 Natural in Milani's conceal and perfect foundation. I LOVE that stuff. It's amazing. I wear NC25 in MAC.This was far too sheer. The applicator is ok but you're going to want to use a brush to pinpoint areas if that's what you're looking to do. Look.. I know hollows can't be fixed unless I get a bleph or filler. I don't have the money or sucrose father for that yet. So color corrector and concealers are the best I have. But this might be best for someone with very mild darkness and doesn't need a lot of makeup.

source_doc: You're paying less for a reason. I've used wood glue many times. But in the past I've used gorilla glue, which has never disappointed me.  When I found myself needing wood glue again and saw this at half the price and with great reviews, I thought I would give it a try.  I learned the hard way that there is a reason it's so inexpensive.  It simply doesn't hold for very long.  I'm talking days.  The longest hold I was able to get was a couple of weeks, but only because I avoided touching what I had used it on for a majority of that time.  I'm grateful it was only about $5 that I wasted as this will be going in the trash when I finish this. And I just purchased gorilla glue .... which I should have done in the first place.

source_doc: Excellent protection, no white cast, but sticky. I put Zinc Five-O Baby Mineral Sunscreen to the test against the mid-afternoon Arizona sun which is still super strong, even in winter. I can verify that it provides excellent sun protection with spf 50. Considering it is a zinc product I was surprised it didn't leave that tell-tale white cast that nobody likes but everybody puts up with to get that great protection. The product is thick, non-irritating, and has no real scent to speak of. After applying, it doesn't absorb into the skin (typical of zinc sunscreens), but it leaves a somewhat oily and sticky film that I found super annoying. Because it was a windy day, my long hair was blowing around and sticking to nearly every surface that I had applied sunscreen to. I also had some blowing sand and dirt stick to my arms. Despite this, the sunscreen provided excellent protection for the entire 60 minutes that I was outdoors. The second time I used it, I applied the product only to my face and neck and I followed up the application with a face powder to cut the stickiness, which seemed to do the trick. Because this is a sunscreen for babies, I imagine parents could apply corn starch afterwards if they find the stickiness to be problematic. I, however, will save this product for use poolside this summer because it provides excellent protection and that is really what is important.

source_doc: My dog loves them. I have a dog with heart disease that usually does not mind taking his pills but at times one may be too bitter so I got him these. As far as flavor, I have not tasted them but I can say that the hickory ones are the most liked by all my dogs. When I give my sick dog the pills, the others want the soft chew too, so I give them one  as a treat when they see me. Before I used to buy the chicken flavored ones and only my sick dog took them. The rest were not interested. They didnt smell. The hickory ones smell strong and like real human food. I almost want one from the smell. I like that they are soft and moist and do not crumble. For bigger pills, I cut them and put them in there and I can remold the little ball. Have not tried the peanut butter ones but I will stick to the Hickory as all my dogs love them.

source_doc: It worked great till it didn't. I have to say I don't have any complaints about this unit, except for the tire inflator. My first one I received wouldn't hold a charge and was sent back. The new one was perfect. I have had it for exactly 2 years. The only problem I ran into is that I have only used the inflator maybe 6 times. I pumped up a basket ball, my sons bike tires a few times, and my two front tires. Unfortunately in putting air into my tires it stopped (main reason for buying). I pumped one tire, let it rest, and started the other one. After about a minute, the compressor was running, but no air was going into the tire. It just stopped, not to sure what happened. This unit is still like brand new, and has been well kept. Everything else still works, and I can use it as an alternate power source. I am not happy that it doesn't inflate anymore, but I can still find uses for it as another power source. So there is that.

source_doc: Okay, this filter is no joke. When I first found this filter, I was skeptical. A good filter, for a 75 gallon tank, that's under $30? No way. Not when we paid $100+ for our AquaTech. I was on the phone with my husband and he almost laughed when I told him the price and that I was going to try it out. He told me not to get my hopes up, there's no way it could be good. I was doing a partial water change and I knew I'd be disturbing a lot of sediment and our old filter was on its last legs, so I decided to take a chance.Y'all. When I tell you this little thing WORKS. It cleaned my filthy tank water overnight. Within the first hour I could see a massive difference and by morning? Almost crystal clear. All the filters were filthy within a day from just how much crap they'd sucked up. Oh, and the output is so strong I had to use the little L adjuster pipe to aim the output flow at the side of the tank, because it was creating too strong of a current for my littler tetras. This thing is amazing. I'm buying another one just to put two in my tank to keep it even cleaner. Please note, I've had this thing for almost three months now and it's still going strong.

source_doc: Nice, Slim. I had my doubts.  But I like these.  The one I use most is holding olive oil.  I like the very thin spout, I have good control of how much oil I add to the pan.  The slim design makes it fit nicely into my cabinet and I like the way it feels and fits in my hand.  The little gravity stopper is very nice, I must say.  No dribbling, the top is always back on as soon as you tilt the bottle back up, not sitting in an oily puddle on the counter.  The other we use for my kids mouthwash. They were having problems opening the locking caps and this is perfect.  I was worried they'd destroy it immediately, I really was hesitant about having kids handle it daily, but it holds up just fine, it has resisted their destruction so far.  The glass seems fairly thick and it has a silicon boot to keep the bottom from chipping, thank goodness. This set includes two adorable little shot glasses meant to fit atop each bottle.  Obviously I don't need the one from the olive oil bottle so I use it to start plant cuttings, but "someone" in my house was enjoying it as a liquor shot glass before I co-opted it for horticultural use.

source_doc: Awesome oil. I for years I used to use only the Subaru synthetic oil in my 2018 forester. After reading reviews and friends telling me about this oil I tried it out.It is a little more expensive that the Subaru oil but I wanted to try it and I was willing to pay the price 1x. So for a little background my forester with clean oem oil was getting 14-15mpg city and my oil temp was 210F. When I used the royal purple I immediately noticed that the engine was running smoother and I was now getting 20-21mpg city and the oil temp was at 190F.This oil definitely paid for itself through the savings at the pump and the smoothness of the engine. I took the averages on both oils after I put 1000mi on.I will update if there’s any changes. On a side note it does say it’s a once a year oil but that’s only if you drive freeway. I drive stop and go in the city so I still plan to change it out in 5 months. I’m also going to put it in our HRV.Thanks royal purple!!

source_doc: This made me extremely nauseous. I read the benefits of taking 400mcg of folic acid & decided to entail this in my daily vitamin regime. This may work well for some. For me I had a very bad reaction to it upon taking it the first day. Within 4 hours I became very nauseous. I had to leave work. I knew it was due to putting this new vitamin in my body. I’ve researched folic acid since & wanted to share that there can be side effects from taking it. In some cases one may experience nausea, black stool, constipation, loss of appetite, bloating or gas. I spoke to my Doctor about it. There was no type of adverse reaction with the other vitamins I was taking. It was simply my body didn’t like it. He did ask if I took it with a full glass of water & food, which I did. He said this was important. So a heads up if you’re considering to purchase for the first time. This may not be for you.  I do respect this brand of vitamin. Unfortunately I can’t receive the nice benefits gained by taking it.

source_doc: Cute but slows gameplay. These are so cute but unfortunately they do affect how I interact with the Joycon buttons. This might not be the case for everyone (hence the good reviews), But I found after nearly a week of using these buttons, they did noticeably impact my gameplay. The buttons themselves do not feel bad, they are smooth enough that they are not uncomfortable on your fingers, but because they are hard plastic, they change how quickly you can press down on the Joycon buttons. I did not realize they were hard plastic until after they arrived, I ordered them thinking they were silicone button covers. I put them on anyway because they were really cute but after several days, I noticed that when I would press the buttons on the right joycon, the reactions with my switch were slower. Even worse, when I pressed down on one of the arrow buttons on the left Joycon, the hard plastic button cover would push down on multiple buttons at once. So if I used the down arrow on the left joycon, my switch thought I hit the right arrow instead. It actually changed how I played games on my switch.

source_doc: Works well while I work. I love this treadmill so much. I use it with my standing desk while I work. The only two things I wish were slightly better are 1- I do wish it had even a small incline option and 2 - I do wish I could store it standing. It seems to potentially want to stand while “folded” but it doesn’t for me at least. Luckily, I have room in my office for it to sit out of the way flat. But I will say it arrived quickly, was easy to get unpackaged and going, and has worked very well. I keep my remote in a container on my desk to prevent losing it and it’s all going well. Super happy with this purchase.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

source_doc: This thing is Awesome!!!! This air fryer is absolutely wonderful. I have to admit, I didn't think the steam option would be of much use, I was wrong!!! I have found more uses for using steam to cook and reheat with than I originally thought. It makes stale biscuits and rolls like they were fresh from the oven, and for reheating cooked foods it is phenomenal. When I bought this I got it for 64 bucks and change, and it was worth every dime. I had considered getting an air fryer from the competition, but I didn't need an air fryer with 2 compartments. It was just to big and more air fryer than I needed.I am pleased with this to say the least. It gets to temp fast, little time for pre heating. It cooks like a dream, and once you get used to using the steam and air fry combo feature when cooking you are going to love it. I was skeptical at first, but now I am glad I took the plunge and bought it!!!

source_doc: Does not fit well - too short. The quality is very nice, but it's not long enough to fit the key fob.  Because it's too short, I had a heck of a time putting the post on the end to keep the cover closed.  I finally got the pin through, but it's at such an angle that I cannot put the metal piece on the back end.  I had to leave the metal piece off and secure the pin with the key chain loop only.  It's a shame because it's a really nice cover.  I have a second one on order that I will end up returning because I suspect that the fit will be off as it is on the first one I received.UPDATE:  I ordered two of these, one of each color.  The review above is for the first one.  The second one was shipped from overseas.  After I received the second one, it turns out that the pin I mentioned above is much longer on the second one and it fits great.  If they had provided the correct pin on the first one, I wouldn't have had to alter it to get it to fit and I would have given them 5 stars.  Because I am stuck with one that has a short pin, I leave my original one star rating for all the time I put into it to make it work.  Apparently, you roll the dice when ordering these.

source_doc: Magical! I would give this a million stars if I could! About 10 years ago I switched from normal lip balm to 100% lanolin and swore I'd never go back. Unfortunately, I can't find my brand for sale on Amazon anymore so I decided to use all the lip balms I had laying around before I purchased anything new. What a mistake! A week into it, my lips were dry and just seemed to be covered in wax from the lip balms (for the record, I had all kinds - fancy, organic, "regular" .... You name it!) source_doc: Couldn't tell any difference in my curls.. I've heard so many good things about Olaplex so I thought I'd give it a whirl. Given how expensive it is, I was expecting a drastic change and moisturized curls. I literally could not tell any difference in my hair. I have 3a curls, shoulder length. I washed my hair like normal and followed with Okaplex. I even kept it on for about an hour (each product) then rinse and style as usual. My curls weren't moisturized, shinier, and weren't as defined as I was expecting. I used the products twice to make sure and followed instructions from a few YouTube tutorials. No luck. I ended up returning both products because I didn't want to waste $63 on hair products that didn't even work. I don't recommend for tight curls - it might do better on straight hair or waves.

source_doc: EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS. A friend suggested I purchase this pair of hand warmers before a ski trip I had planned with my family. In the past, I would typically buy disposable single-use "pouch" style hand warmers but wanted something that was reusable and would last longer. Boy was I impressed with these. As I was putting on all my ski equipment, I fired these up and put them in my boots. When I was ready to put my boots on, they were already nice and toasty so I moved the warmers to my jacket pockets and zipped them closed. Once I went outside the lodge into the cold, I put my hands in my pockets and they were nice and warm. I had the warmers on the lowest setting and they kept my pockets warm all day. It was great to take my gloves off on the chair lift, stick my hands in my pockets before each run, and it made the day a much better experience overall. I highly recommend these if you're a skiier, hiker, go to an outdoor sporting event, etc.!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

hypo_0: PŘEKROČILO OČEKÁVÁNÍ. Kamarád/ka mi doporučil/a, abych si koupil/a tyto ohřívače rukou před lyžařským zájezdem, který jsem plánoval/a s rodinou. V minulosti jsem obvykle kupoval/a jednorázové ohřívače rukou v podobě polštářků, ale chtěl/a jsem něco, co se dá použít opakovaně a vydrží déle. Páni, tyhle mě opravdu nadchly. Když jsem byl/a připravený/á obout se, boty už byly příjemně vyhřáté, a tak jsem ohřívače přemístil/a do kapes bundy a zapnul/a je na zip. Bylo skvělé sundat si na lanovce rukavice, před každou jízdou si strčit ruce do kapes, a díky tomu byl celý den mnohem lepším zážitkem. source_doc: Really happy with these pump dispensers. I wanted some nice soap dispensers for my sinks because I got tired of the expense of buying the much more expensive individual soaps I have gotten for several years. I saw these and I really liked the simple look of them. I like that they are actually glass and not plastic. They came with a silicone funnel which I really didn't need since they have a large enough opening to easily fill with the large soap refill I got. The pump works really well and I am completely happy with this set of two. The labels that come with them are really pretty but I chose not to use them so I appreciate that you can use them or not. I wouldn't want ones that came with labels already attached. I can easily recommend these.

source_doc: Pretty good just watch out for the fleshy parts of your feet they can get caught. I have intermittent dry soles on my feet where I can just peel strips off (woo boy this review started well)  so I got this to help me get all that gunk off my feet.  It comes with the machine, 3 heads, and a charger (a double barrel charger I wish it was USB c but oh well).  The first charge took about 2 hours so that wasn't too bad.  Before I fired this up I looked at it and it has a small flashlight on the bottom so I guess that's good if you are working on your feet in the dark.  It has 3 speeds 0 (does not move), 1 (goes at a decent clip, and 2 (really gets going.  I decided since it was my first rodeo to use 1.  IT works pretty well and stripped the dead skin off but I did notice if I got to a fleshier part of my foot it could catch and that didn't feel the greatest.  I chalk that up to my not being careful.  All in all, if you are looking for a way to pamper your feet or just take off dead skin this works pretty well.

source_doc: So far, so good. I hesitated quite a while before I bought this.  I don't have spam that often, but when I do I could never get the slices evenly cut.  Shouldn't be that big of a deal, but the thinner sides would always get overcooked while I finished the thicker sides.  This little gem has solved that problem.  Plus, all the picture I had seen had sliced the spam across the long side, giving smaller cut pieces.  I prefer slicing it the other way to get a piece that fits in a sandwich better.  I wasn't sure if I could do that with this slicer, but I can.  It's a tight fit, but it can be done.
