source_doc: Didn't think I needed it until I got it ... I have an organization problem.  No matter what I try, I always seem to lose track of things, only to discover them weeks/months later.  This happens with small things mostly -- things that have a tendency to disappear behind other things.I use processed American cheese for grilled cheese sandwiches mostly -- it melts better than anything else and tastes great (I grew up on it, so ... ).  I especially like the individually wrapped variety as it stays fresher longer.  That is, until I lose track of the last few slices in a package and find it months later as part of an unintended science project in the back of the fridge.Enter this little box.  And that's all it is, really -- a cute box made to fit exactly the individually-wrapped slices of cheese.  I simply put the slices in the box, the box in the door of the fridge, and I know exactly where it is.  No more errant slices hiding in the far corners of the fridge.It's sturdy, well made, nice hinge, and a slight "snap" to the lid so it doesn't come open until I want it to.Just about perfect, really.  Glad I purchased it!  Solid 5 stars: it does what it's supposed to do, does it well, and has proven to be of benefit in helping me stay organized.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a" 

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Nemyslel/a jsem si, že to potřebuji, dokud jsem to nedostal/a... Mám problém s organizací. Bez ohledu na to, o co se snažím, se zdá, že vždycky ztratím přehled o věcech, abych je pak objevil/a o týdny/měsíce později. Stává se to většinou u malých věcí – věcí, které mají tendenci mizet za jinými věcmi. Tavený americký sýr používám většinou na grilované sýrové sendviče – teče lépe než cokoli jiného a chutná skvěle (vyrostl/a jsem na něm, takže...). Zvláště mám rád/a ty jednotlivě balené, protože vydrží déle čerstvé. Tedy dokud neztratím přehled o posledních několika plátcích v balení a nenajdu je o měsíce později jako součást nechtěného vědeckého projektu v zadní části lednice. A v tom přichází tato krabička. A to je opravdu všechno, co to je – roztomilá krabička vyrobená tak, aby se do ní přesně vešly jednotlivě balené plátky sýra. Plátky jednoduše vložím do krabičky, krabičku do dveří lednice a vím přesně, kde je. Už žádné toulavé plátky schovávající se v nejvzdálenějších koutech lednice. Je robustní, dobře vyrobená, má pěkný pant a mírné „zaklapnutí“ víka, takže se neotevře, dokud nechci. Opravdu téměř dokonalé. Jsem rád/a, že jsem ji koupil/a! Solidních 5 hvězdiček: dělá to, co má, dělá to dobře a ukázala se jako užitečná v tom, že mi pomáhá udržet si pořádek.

source_doc: A very nice inexpensive Irish whistle! I have some experience with Native American flute but am new to the pennywhistle. The first thing I looked at was craftsmanship; this whistle was flawless from what I could see; solid paint job on the brass tube, no little scratches, etc; holes were drilled cleanly; mouthpiece well-formed.  The first time I played it there was a lot of screeching; I was trying to overlay how I play NA flute onto this new little whistle. The second time I played it I tried to let go of my NA flute experience (except the basics like making sure all the holes are well-covered) and let nature find it's own way re breathing, ... ; here came the solid and clear notes! Since I do have a few other Irish whistles to compare to, I can say that this Feadog Pro D definitely has it's own voice, and it's a very pleasant one. I'm glad I added it to my instruments; it's fun to play.

Podruhé už jsem se snažil/a oprostit od svých zkušeností s indiánskou flétnou (kromě základů, jako je ujistit se, že jsou všechny otvory dobře zakryté) a nechal/a jsem dýchání volný průběh... a vtom se ozvaly plné a čisté tóny! Jelikož mám pro srovnání několik dalších irských píšťal, mohu říct, že tato Feadog Pro D má rozhodně svůj vlastní hlas, a to velmi příjemný. Jsem rád/a, že jsem ji přidal/a ke svým nástrojům; je radost na ni hrát.

source_doc: “High density” does Not mean that it is hard enough. I attached a photo that some might find helpful about ways to use this block. I’m a yoga teacher.  Speaking from a place of experience and a certain kind of conditioning I prefer hard blocks. I have felt three inch (as opposed to four) lightweight hard foam blocks that are amazing. Such a block is great for a high amount of pressure that is therapeutic. Still trying to find a brand other than Manduka. So here I learn that “high density” doesn’t necessarily mean that it’s hard enough. I tried this block and i will return it. It is flimsy when using it on high height in something like the supported shoulder bridge which you can see in the attached image. I think I remember as a beginner I liked soft blocks because it felt more comfortable. Then I learned. So I hope that is helpful. Maybe everyone reading this is the type of beginner that doesn’t want a hard block. I have gotten off-brand cork blocks here which cost a bit more but have perfect density and hardness.

source_doc: Good value. I bought this in January, 2023 and have been playing it for 3 months now. I am a beginner so I didn’t want to invest too much in something if I didn’t stick with it. The threads aren’t rounded off but don’t stick out too much on the sides. The strings were a bit rusty from the warehouse but I didn’t change them out in case I wanted to return. I finally changed them out the other day after 3 months averaging 8-9 hours a week of playing.  Sounds much brighter and louder now with fresh strings. The tuning pegs turn smoothly and after the strings stretched they hold tuning fairly consistently. I decided it was time to get it a case and today received this case today. A perfect fit. Crossrock Hardshell Arch Top Wood case fits OM, Martin 000 Guitars-Vinyl Tweed(CRW600OMTW)If you’re a beginner, I think this is a good one to go with. I really like the tone of it compared to others I have heard. My music interests are Dixieland and music from the 30’s so the tone fits that era well.

source_doc: Best Travel Acoustic. Great Sound. I am planning a trip and I have my guitar, as I will be playing for a family gathering outside.  So, I need to travel on an airplane with it.  I need portability to the outside venue and I need a good sound.  After reading so many reviews, and looking at options for several hours, I finally decided on the Mark III.  I received it yesterday.  I have been playing it for several hours and I have to say, I love this guitar.  If you plug into a decent amp, the sound is great.  It does not have the full sound of my Fender.  It's a solid body, and it's better than I expected.  Also, it feels the same. With headphones, it is very quiet. I highly recommend the Mark III.  I am also using the Donner Mini Guitar Amp for portability.

source_doc: My preferred pick, I like both the nylon and ceramic. I have been using these picks for a little over 30 years.  Picks are a personal preference so I can't say these are perfect for everyone.  i am always trying out other picks, but I still haven't found anything that i like better.  For me I find these to be the easiest to hold onto, they don't slip around in my fingers as much as other picks.  I like the points on these too they work best with my picking style.  I play a lot of rhythm metal on guitar, and metal and rock on bass.  I like the .7mm for guitar and the 1.0mm for bass.  I jump between the nylon and the ceramic depending on how I am feeling.  They hold up well too I find they show less wear than most other picks too.  I would say they last about 2 or 3 times longer than other picks, especially on bass which can really chew up a pick.

source_doc: I wonder about the quality. The connector should work ok for lighter duty applications.  I dont think I would use it on a car or truck.  The contact surface at the base of the black knob is nowhere near the contact surface of the battery post connector, although it is about the same as where you would connect the cable.  the connector is two parts with just a plastic bushing/insulator between the two parts.  I was able to move the two parts some, but did not try and seperate them, but I think I could if i used more pressure.  The square headed bolt is too small to self hold as it is designed to, or the ridge designed to hold the flat side of the bolt is to far away.  The square head will spin and not hold against the flat side as you can see in the pictures.  The unit does appear to be brass or at least a brass alloy.  I did file a small amout off one edge and got the same color underneath.  The cable connector end has a short area with threads but I tried the clamp bolt in there and it fit but was a really sloppy fit.  When I install the switch I will most likely drill out those threads and just clamp the battery cable eyelet with a bolt and nut.

source_doc: Too Much Fun! When I first ordered this drum I didn't know what to expect, I mean I saw people playing it and it looked cool but now I know.  I LOVE sitting on this box and just banging away! I think it's therapeutic.  You learn how to play it as you experiment with it. There are different ways that you that you can hit it the drum, or cup your hands differently that gives you different types of sounds.  To let you know how solid this box is, I weigh 250 pounds and this drum holds me up with no problems. I don't feel like it's going to break underneath me. I would say it's commercial grade, and the fit and finish is wonderful.  It really is fun to play, and even my adult kids want to play on Dad's drum.  When I'm not using it I use it as a small table for a one of my speakers. It is well worth the money and something that I could see lasting forever if not abused. I highly recommend!

source_doc: Only includes 1 round banister piece. I bought this for the top of my stairs where there are 2 round banisters. When I started installing I noticed there was only 1 round spindle piece. It came with a note saying if we want a second round spindle piece we need to contact them. So I tried emailing them using the email from their customer service website but that email address doesn't work. source_doc: Works great, no problem pairing but your camera App might not allow external microphones. If your video App allows you to select an external microphone, this will work very well. Any problems I had with this were the result of my smartphone, and the included Camera App and, not the fault of the product. When I first plugged this in and powered up the microphone, the two immediately paired. However, try as I might, I could not get my phone to use the microphone. Yes, my Motorola G7 has OTG and has worked with other products like endoscopes, Wallabot and other products. However, when recording video, the phone always used my internal microphone.Today I found out that the problem lays with my Camera APP that came with the phone. So, I downloaded an App called "Open Camera" from the play Store and, there is a selection to use internal or external (if plugged in). Once I selected "external" this wireless microphone has worked flawlessly.  I walked to the edge of my property (about 110 ft) and it clearly picks up me whispering and, the sound quality is as good, or better than my internal microphone. The nice thing about this particular app is that there are no adds at all so far.It took a bit to figure out but, I am now totally pleased. I just wish I did not have to use a different App to video something.

source_doc: Giving it a try. I just started using this. It arrived unsealed and the box damaged in transit, but I was confident by the look and feel of the pump that it hadn't been used. I'm using this as a toothpaste, but I may share it with others who have appliances. I think it is meant to replace toothpaste. It doesn't include fluoride though. One pump generously covers the toothbrush. Although it's mostly air, it does feel like enough product to do the job. The foam has an unpleasant alcohol-menthol taste. I didn't find it that intolerable though, and it dies down over the two minutes. I also think it helps give that clean feeling afterwards. Instructions are to use this 1-2x daily, expecting results in 1-2 weeks. I'm surprised that I think I feel slight achiness after one use, so I'm going to see if I can do once a day for a few days. I'll report if I see whitening. To be fair though, I've been using a lot of whitening products lately and am not sure if I can expect more progress from products. This claims to be up to a 4 month supply which seems improbable, but then again, it does dispense a lot of air. If it lasts nearly that long and works, it's certainly worth $12.99.

source_doc: These are great! I ordered these when the time changed (we live in an area that does Daylight Saving Time) and it started getting dark by 5:00pm. I didn’t like pulling up at home after work and getting out in the dark, so I got these bulbs to put in the fixtures on the front of our detached garage. They work like a charm!! I was so pleased the next day when I came home and had lights on! We’ve had these all winter now, and I purposely waited to write this review so I could be sure of how well they work. They come on at dusk and go off at dawn - just as advertised! I actually like that they stay on all night because then they function as security lights. I have absolutely no complaints about these bulbs, their brightness, their dependability, nothing. They are fantastic and I wish I’d bought them years ago. I would certainly recommend these to anyone.

source_doc: I have owned 7 house bunnies in a row!!! In about thirty years I have owned 7 bunnies, all who have lived inside and been treated very special.  Sometimes I have owned two at once, but in those thirty years never gone without at least one.  Obviously I am doing something right since several of mine have lived to be about 12-13 years old.  So in say that, I highly recommend this grass mat that I use inside their huge open door cage where I also have pet fur mats on the floor along with one of these mats where I sit there bowl of TIMOTHY pellets.  I notice that the bunny I have now will ignore it for awhile and then one day just start shredding it to pieces, so I make sure to keep buying them for her since she really doesn't play with any rabbit toys I buy her.  Except for loving empty toilet paper rolls this is her fav fun project!  I always make sure anything I give my bunnies is safe and healthy (note, always use timothy pellets, give them just the tiniest bit of fruit, no other carbs and tons of green vegies daily).  Rabbits love to eat but anything sugar or sweet will mess up their stomachs real easily...but back to this product, it is a big yes and I will continue buying them when needed.

source_doc: Pretty good lemon flavor, better when mixed with water. I've been trying to live a bit healthier lifestyle and have been trying drops like this as I see them so when I saw this I thought ok ill give it a shot.  The package came just fine without any leaks or cracks in the bottle.  Opening the bottle it doesn't really smell like anything and I was a bit worried but I shouldn't have been.  I took the dropper and put a couple of drips on my tongue and it was a sweet lemon flavor, kinda reminds me of lemon drops but didn't linger.  I tried this mixed with water also and with 2 drops per 8 oz I couldn't even notice the flavor at all so keep that in mind if you aren't 100% sold on the flavor.  As I have just started trying it I have not seen any results but I have not seen any negatives and that works for me.  All in all, if you like sweet lemon and want to try it in liquid form this is pretty good.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a" 

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Docela dobrá citronová příchuť, lepší po smíchání s vodou. Snažím se žít trochu zdravějším životním stylem a zkouším podobné kapky, jakmile na ně narazím, takže když jsem uviděl/a tohle, řekl/a jsem si, že tomu dám šanci. Balíček dorazil v pořádku, bez jakéhokoli úniku nebo prasklin na lahvičce. Po otevření lahvičky to nijak nevoní a měl/a jsem trochu obavy, ale ty byly zbytečné. Vzal/a jsem kapátko a kápnul/a si pár kapek na jazyk a byla to sladká citronová příchuť, trochu mi to připomíná citronové bonbóny, ale chuť rychle odezněla. Vyzkoušel/a jsem to také smíchané s vodou a při 2 kapkách na 250 ml jsem tu chuť vůbec nezaznamenal/a, takže na to pamatujte, pokud nejste o této příchuti stoprocentně přesvědčen/a. Jelikož jsem to teprve začal/a zkoušet, nezaznamenal/a jsem žádné výsledky, ale ani žádná negativa, a to mi vyhovuje. Celkově vzato, pokud máte rád/a sladký citron a chcete ho vyzkoušet v tekuté formě, je to docela dobré.

source_doc: i think it is great and fits my needs really well. for this price i was surprised that this sounds as good as it does. here is my use case: i live in a townhome so i had the idea for my band to plug into a mixer (e-drums used) and everyone wears headphones. that way we can crank it up and not anger the neighbors. lots of headsets, wires, headphone amp... i put some time into planning it out. what i did not account for was the guitars sounding like hell - i am running a line out from the headphone out of the amps directly into the mixer. so i started researching cab simulators, IR loaders, etc. to try and replicate the sound of a mic'd amp. the sonicake does this really well - it sounds authentic. i wasn't expecting a lot for the price, but i was happily surprised. if you have similar needs to me, i would highly recommend that you use the XLR out on the sonicake. i noticed a large difference in sound quality between that and the 1/4 inch out.

source_doc: I WANT TO WEAR THIS LIKE A BURRITO IT IS SO BRILLIANT GET IT GET IT!!!! Okay, I can't believe I am reviewing a blanket - but this one deserves it.  A bit of history - I love blankets and the supersoft thin ones made out of recycled coke bottles or whatever are all over my house.  But my favorite blanket has always been a BERKSHIRE one I got years ago and I went on Amazon looking to see if they had similar by that brand and found this.  I cannot believe I lived without this blanket for so long it is sheer perfection!  Both lightweight and super warm - I have been wrapping myself like a burrito at night while I read and I am perfectly warm and content.  I may never leave my house again.  Just brilliant - love it!! Mine hasn't been shedding which I see others say - but that may be because of the color?  I don't know.  I am buying more.  I will spend this winter as a happy warm burrito.  You should too!

source_doc: Can I give this 3.5 stars? I wish I could. I really wanted my cat to like these. They came well packaged, in individual pouches. The ingredients list is impressive. My cat is getting on in years and the bone/joint support sounded promising. My cat is finicky about her food - she loves her greens, her Fancy Feast Medleys and her Temptations treats. But she also LOVES her Churus, especially the Chicken and cheese flavor. I thought this would be a great substitute for Churus and so I tried to entice my cat 2 ways: I placed a pouch of this (like I would her Churus) in a bowl and placed it where I put her treats. She tried it… and quickly dismissed it. I thought maybe I should have mixed it? But I tried again and was still unable to grab her attention. I then tried this as what the brand indicates- as a topper for her food…and my baby didn’t even touch her plate… and it was her FAVORITE canned wet food flavor. So although I wanted to like this, kitty didn’t like it and so I’m stuck with several pouches of a topper my cat will not eat… Serving size is 1 pouch for up to 8lbs cat weight. Price at the time of this review is 47 USD, which is inline with the quality of the ingredients but for my cat not in line on flavor.

source_doc: The flies sure seem to like it. Wow. I mixed up a small batch of this stuff and dumped in a maybe half a dozen fruit flies from a store bought culture. I've got loads of flies now. I'm going to need more spiders.I put maybe a quarter cup of powder in a clean quart size plastic container that previously contained soup from Costco. I added boiling water and stirred, adding more water a little at a time until I had a mixture that would generally keep it's shape but would flatten out if I banged the container on the counter. While it cooled, I cut a roughly 1.5 inch square in the lid of the container. When the mixture was cool, I added the flies and put a coffee filter on top of the container, followed by the lid. Then I just set it aside and waited. It took maybe a week and a half before I saw new signs of life. Now I have a very active colony (swarm?) of flightless fruit flies. I've added new members from another store bought culture to perhaps improve genetic diversity. I don't know if it'll do anything. All I know is I had a few flies and now I have a zillion.

source_doc: Nice, small rack.  Screw holes are not 16" apart and thus cannot be attached to studs. This is a review of "touekeng Garage Storage Tool Organizer,Garage Organization Wall Mount Rack Hanger,Super Heavy Duty Steel Garden Tool Organizer (3 Hooks, 1 Rails 16 in).”I hung this organizer today.  It’s not quite 16 inches long.  The furthest apart screw holes were not 16” apart - more like 15”.  I was close enough to the studs that I hope the screws caught some of the wood, but I couldn’t tell.  I may have to rehang it using the drywall anchors.  The padded hooks are nice, heavy-duty and versatile.  I like that I could configure them however I liked.  I couldn’t figure out what the rubber gasket was for, so I didn’t install it with it.  It was loose in my packaging.  I’ve tried to reinsert the gasket, but it's too hard to get it in now.  I don’t really think it makes much difference.It’s a nice small organizational piece for my garage.  I’m happy to have all the organizational help I can get!  I reduced the rating by one star because the screw holes weren’t 16” apart.

source_doc: I used these to protect my chicken runs. These are great!  I actually bought several after the first one impressed us.  Last year, my first year with chickens, I got expensive, opaque, heavy plastic and put around the runs (I have 4).  It did the trick, no issues there, but I had to staple it on.  Taking it off was tedious since I wanted to save it, given the price.  I saw these and ordered one to see how we liked it.  The rivets meant we could screw it into the wood (or use cable ties on the wire runs), making removal and reuse next year much easier.  The little "block" design allows more light inside the runs, which is great because the chickens do need light to stay healthy.  It's a toss up - light vs. keeping wind and elements down so they don't freeze.  I feel like this does a good job at both.  The tricky part came when I had to use them side by side because, while the screws were fine, the cable ties left a gap. I fixed that by using Gorilla tape, which sticks well in inclement weather.  Overall, very happy to have found these and I got them at a good price, which is awesome since my pet chickens cost more than any other animal I've ever had in my life!  They're spoiled, but I wouldn't have it any other way.

source_doc: Not Worth Purchasing. I am a 52 year old hobby drummer and am not a rough player. I figured these would be cheap but thought that with my easy playing they would be good enough to last a year and save the $20-$25 for Vic Firth Rute's or Promark Hot Rods. I sent these back after playing with them 3x. The first time I used them I noticed after about 10 minutes that the rods started coming out. I would push them back down but then they were uneven. Play a little more and push them down. It only became worse with each time playing so I sent them back.The rods themselves seemed just as durable as the more expensive ones but I will never know for sure since I returned them. All they have to do is put some glue in the end piece before putting it on and the rods would stay in place. I have had a pair of VF Rute 606's for over a year and they are still going strong. The rods have never moved and they show only a little wear. The ends are spreading out some but it just makes them quieter. I guess there is a reason they cost more and I will not mess with the cheap one's in the future. Save your time and money, unless you want to mess around fixing these yourself.

source_doc: Great value for a cheap starter kit! This is the first time I've tried to pull dents out of anything but I have seen it done several times. So that being said, I think this is a very cheaply made kit, it's not meant for professionals at all. It is a good beginner-starter kit though. I used it on my clothes dryer where "someone" stepped on the lid and left a large dent. I used up an entire stick of black glue. I had better luck applying glue to the dryer lid first. When I applied it to the puller tab first it would stay stuck on the dryer which made the whole process much harder.  There's no replacement for experience though. The puller contraption itself is easy to use but made of very cheap metal so I'm not sure how long it will last. The glue gun works, but it heats up pretty slow. Cleaning up the glue that didn't come off the metal was a huge pain. Like I said before that can be prevented some by applying the glue to the metal surface first instead of the pull tabs. I did not get the dent completely pulled out but it does look a lot better. I just wanted to try it out on something besides a car first. I didn't need the little pry tools for anything yet, but I do a lot of car projects so I'm sure they will come in handy eventually.

source_doc: SHORT style great for people 5’9” or taller DID NOT SWIVEL & WOBBLY. Preface: I am female…weigh more than I care to say…(229lbs)…and I am 5’7”. I purchased this for guitar practice as I have read many, many people have. So let’s cut to the chase……Maybe I received a dud…who knows. I do know that 1) it was wobbly with no means of adjusting it. Well…I guess I could put a matchbook under one of the legs to level it out…you know, like in the old days! 2) Maybe my definition of “swivel” is different than most…seat barely even moved when I wasn’t even sitting on it and had to strong arm it. 3) I researched like crazy to find the “perfect” stool. I read several reviews that stated it’s good for people 5’7”….. um…nope. I couldn’t put a foot on the floor without sitting so close to the front that it was quite uncomfortable on my woman parts. Again…I might have received a defective item. I have learned through all my research that roc-n-soc is extremely well made and very popular. I just purchased the r-n-s nitro drum throne so I’ll let ya’ll know how that one is. I’m super stoked!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: KRÁTKÝ styl skvělý pro lidi od 175 cm výše, NEOTÁČEL SE A KÝVAL SE. Úvodem: jsem žena… vážím víc, než bych chtěla přiznat… (104 kg)… a měřím 170 cm. Koupil/a jsem si to na cvičení na kytaru, protože jsem četl/a, že to tak dělá opravdu hodně lidí. Pojďme tedy rovnou k věci…… Možná jsem dostal/a vadný kus… kdo ví. Vím ale, že: 1) kývalo se to a nedalo se to nijak seřídit. No… asi jsem mohl/a pod jednu z nohou podložit krabičku od sirek, abych to vyrovnal/a… víte jak, jako za starých časů! 2) Možná je moje definice „otáčení“ jiná než u většiny… sedák se sotva pohnul, i když jsem na něm ani nesděl/a a musel/a jsem na to jít hrubou silou. 3) Hledal/a jsem jako blázen, abych našel/a tu „dokonalou“ stoličku. Četla jsem několik recenzí, kde se psalo, že je vhodná pro lidi měřící 170 cm….. em… to tedy ne. Nemohl/a jsem dát nohu na zem, aniž bych seděl/a tak blízko předního okraje, že to bylo pro mé ženské partie dost nepohodlné. Opět… možná jsem dostal/a vadný kus. Během svého zkoumání jsem se dozvěděl/a, že značka Roc-n-Soc je extrémně kvalitní a velmi oblíbená. Právě jsem si koupil/a bubenickou stoličku R-n-S Nitro, tak vám pak dám vědět, jaká je. Jsem super nadšený/á!

source_doc: Good inexpensive Shower Bench. This is not exactly what I wanted, but I needed a shower seat for the roommate immediately due to his recent leg surgery.  The roommate reported that it’s the perfect height for him, and that he likes it better than the adjustable bar stool he used previously.  (The stool began to rust.)  The shower bench is very sturdy with two bolts in major stress points, is easy to assemble and comes with an extra parts— an extra of everything except the hex wrench.  It even has an extra plastic no-slip cap for the leg bottom.  I was truly impressed by this foresight since one of the grommets didn’t allow the machine screw to go all the way in; I swapped it with the spare and presto— assembled.  The bench doesn’t wobble or shake; it’s a steal for the price I paid.  I have no idea about longevity, but I plan to replace with a stone bench if/when I find one since I was looking for a stone bench that would allow me to use a steamer ia the shower prior to this immediate need.  I almost purchased a bench 2-3x the price; I’m glad that I chose this one.  I will update this review in the future if my opinion changes over time due to longevity issues, but keep in mind it’s low price.  See the pictures for size and the box it arrives in.

hypo_0: Dobrá levná sprchová stolička. Tohle sice není přesně to, co jsem chtěl/a, ale spolubydlící okamžitě potřeboval sedátko do sprchy kvůli nedávné operaci nohy. Spolubydlící říkal, že výška je pro něj ideální a že se mu to líbí víc než nastavitelná barová židle, kterou používal předtím. (Ta židle začala rezivět.) Sprchová stolička je velmi robustní, se dvěma šrouby v hlavních zátěžových bodech, snadno se sestavuje a dodává se s náhradními díly – od všeho je tu jeden navíc, kromě imbusového klíče. Má dokonce i náhradní plastovou protiskluzovou krytku na spodní část nohy. Tato předvídavost mě opravdu ohromila, protože jedna z průchodek nedovolila šroubu zapadnout až nadoraz; vyměnil/a jsem ji za náhradní a presto – bylo sestaveno. Stolička se neviklá ani netřese; za cenu, kterou jsem zaplatil/a, je to skvělá koupě. Skoro jsem koupil/a stoličku za dvojnásobnou až trojnásobnou cenu; jsem rád/a, že jsem si vybral/a tuto. source_doc: Love it! Very sturdy little stool. I hate to say it but I am 420lbs and getting one of these I was worried I would break it when I sat on it but this little handy dandy stool is pretty darn sturdy. I work as a after care teacher in early education, I have a bad knee and plantar fasciitis in for feet so standing for to long sometimes is kinda difficult. I have to sit with my leg extended out so holding any of my weight up off the stool isn't something that happens. Also my kiddos at school are always wanting to sit on it and of course they try playing with it and it's held up very well! As for comfort, I mean it doesn't have a cushion so it's not like super comfortable but it gives me a place to sit and it holds me up so yeah its good enough. Another good thing is is that i am a tall girl and this isn't so short like other stools like this one where I snap crackle and pop when I go to sit down so that's definitely a plus. It's most definitely worth the money if you need a portable stool.

source_doc: These are perfect for me. I am a guitar hobbyist. I like to play for a couple hours at a time and know only a few songs. I love to experiment and just goof around. Since the 80s, the biggest irritation has been guitar cables.. Whether I am tripping over them, snagging them, or the connections get loose and the awful static sound ruins whatever I am trying to play. I hate cables.This is my first set of wireless connectors and I have to saw that I think they are Awesome! No more cables and I can walk around while I play. On top of that, when the wife wants some quiet time, I plug in my headphones straight in to the transmitter and can keep playing. The sound is pretty good and I like the distortion effect the most as it has a slight delay effect. The other effects are good too, but I really like the distortion. I do wish that the sound were a bit louder like my old headphone amps were, but for this price, I am happy with the connectors, just the way they are.

source_doc: Cute. Ok, I don’t think I completely “get” ice rollers. Why not just use an ice cube or a cold stone? Why put fruit and things in your ice if the rest of the ice cube is just plain water? I don’t get it.None of this confusion was helped by the lack of instructions. The two molds came nested and I was trying to figure out - do you fill the inside one or the outside one? Do you fill the outside so the inside is like an ice-covered hollow mold?  I had to find the listing to figure out what to do.I like them, as far as I understand them. I still don’t get why this is different from just grabbing an ice cube. But whatever. They’re easy to fill and use. The chick one is really cute and I don’t know why I enjoy that as much as I do. The bigger one seems like overkill and I stilll haven’t figured out if I’m supposed to scrub my face with the ice inside, or use the cover as a scrubbie and then use the ice. Idk. In any case, they seem to do exactly as advertised.

source_doc: Had to return controller but ordered another because I love the controller layout. So I love the controller and the buttons on the back are in the best spot on any controller I’ve used. Unfortunately, I had to return the first one I ordered. When I plugged my headset into the controller and talked to teammates in any game I played, my teammates would say that my voice was coming through awful and I sounded muffled. I tried to find any solution by playing around with game settings, system settings, and troubleshooting the controller but to no avail the issues with voice communication remained. When I plugged my headset into other controllers, my headset and voice were perfectly normal so I knew it had something to do with the powerA controller. I returned the first one I ordered and have ordered a new one hoping it was just a lemon. I love what the controller has to offer just need the mic problems not to happen! Fingers crossed with the next one I’m waiting to be delivered.

source_doc: Can’t get enough of this stuff. I’m not a BBW customer until NOW. I picked up some other scents on a whim without even smelling them. I fell in love with them until I found Fairytale! I still like the others a lot and will use all the products I bought, but I took another leap of faith and ordered some of this discontinued scent from the description and adorable packaging. I LOVE this stuff and stocked up like a maniac because I know when it’s gone, it’s gone. The scent is fruity without being childish, floral without being cloying. The vanilla and amber make it perfect. I swear I could eat it. I love these products and they came on time and packed well.

source_doc: Exactly what I wanted. I am not a big fan of water. I can’t explain it, I just never really like it unless I’m severely dehydrated. Since I don’t drink sodas or sugary drinks, that means I usually just drink coffee or tea all day. Not exactly the best choice as that’s a lot of caffeine. So I determined that I’m going to drink more water. I swear the water tastes funky to me if it comes out of stainless steel containers. I can only tolerate drinking water from glass or ceramic vessels. Plastic is out of the question to touch my food or drinks.  I know- I’m picky. I couldn’t find any large volume glass water bottles locally, so I turned to Amazon. I completely love this water bottle. I’ve been throwing some frozen fruit & chopped cucumber in there & filling it with filtered water to infuse. It has been a game changer. It’s also easy to use, easy to clean, no leaks, and you can use the straw or not depending on your preference. Yeah, you have to be careful not to throw it around since it’s glass, but the carry handle is very sturdy. I love everything about it!

source_doc: Like that I can feel the water. I have a set of speedo hand paddles and I wasn't sure if I had made the right choice as I just started swimming again so I wanted to try these out as well.I wasn't sure what size to get because I have bigger hands and the information didn't really explain what size to get so from what I read I decided to try the medium. These were a little tight on my hands but comfortable. I did like the bigger hole in the middle so I could feel the water, the speedo ones have a really small hole in comparison.The big difference for me between these and the speedo ones is that these are flat and the speedo ones are slightly curved. It turns out that I prefer the slightly curved ones as a beginner but I have a feeling these flatter ones are going to prove useful the more I use them.

source_doc: Perfect for portioning out my slabs of salmon. I buy a big $40 slab of salmon at a club warehouse every time I go, then use a nice set of heavy duty kitchen scissors  to portion it out, so I can freeze what I won't use right away. Recently the selection has not been what it was, and getting it skinless isn't always possible. I needed a knife that would slice through that salmon like butter, not only to portion but also to remove the thin skin (I think it makes the fish taste fishier).This knife feels good in my hand and yes, slice through and gets the skin off like it's going through butter. I didn't know I needed this knife, but now that I have it, I can't imagine working in my kitchen without it.  I also see that there's a Mama's Great bread knife and oh my, I think I might need it too.

source_doc: Pretty Good. The first time I started looking for something like this, I just gave up due to too many options.  Since I had the chance to try this, and I figured it met my first requirement of not being plastic, I was happy to give it a try.It fits the bill pretty nicely.  It saves a bit of room by getting some of the tiny stuff off the cabinet floor under my half bath sink, and then gets some of the larger bottles cleaned up and in one place as well.As I suspected, for every bit of space you gain, you also gain some complications - and I'm sure this is true for almost every device like this unless it was engineered specifically for your EXACT cabinet.For example, I like that it pulls out, but then I have to leave some space in front of it so it can do so.  And then I can't put anything too tall on the top because those things could hit the top of the door and stop it from pulling out all the way.  So it helps, but it's not making an astronomical difference under there.  I still like it.  I wouldn't bother with almost any of the plastic models.  At least this does NOT seem cheap or flimsy at all (anything cheap and flimsy trying to help you save space always makes more problems than they solve).

hypo_0: Docela dobré. Když jsem poprvé začal/a hledat něco takového, prostě jsem to vzdal/a kvůli příliš velkému množství možností. Jelikož jsem měl/a možnost tohle vyzkoušet a usoudil/a jsem, že to splňuje můj první požadavek, aby to nebylo z plastu, byl/a jsem rád/a, že tomu mohu dát šanci. Účel to plní docela dobře. Šetří to trochu místa tím, že to dostane některé drobné věci z podlahy skříňky pod umyvadlem na mé toaletě, a také to srovná některé větší lahve na jedno místo. Jak jsem tušil/a, s každým kouskem získaného prostoru získáte také určité komplikace – a jsem si jistý/á, že to platí pro téměř každé takové zařízení, pokud nebylo navrženo speciálně pro vaši KONKRÉTNÍ skříňku. Líbí se mi například, že se dá vysunout, ale pak před ním musím nechat trochu místa, aby to bylo možné. A nahoru pak nemohu dát nic příliš vysokého, protože by tyto věci mohly narazit do horní části dvířek a zabránit úplnému vysunutí. Takže to pomáhá, ale žádný astronomický rozdíl to tam dole nedělá. Stále se mi to líbí. S téměř žádným z plastových modelů bych se vůbec neobtěžoval/a. Tohle alespoň vůbec nevypadá levně nebo chatrně (cokoli levného a chatrného, co se vám snaží pomoci ušetřit místo, vždycky nadělá víc problémů, než kolik jich vyřeší).

I got it because it is designed for the headset to lay horizontal so there is no chance of the lenses getting damaged by light or scratched. Overall, I do not like this dock very much. I have a few aftermarket headset accessories that the dock doesn’t work well with. The controllers setting in the middle which means I have to adjust my strap piece to get my controllers in the charger.The biggest issue I had is my controllers don’t even charge. I thought there wasn’t an indicator light for the controllers, but it ends up they weren’t charging at all. I left my headset and controllers on the dock for a couple days thinking everything was charging but when I powered up the controllers were at 40% battery life. I even heard my controllers click into place. I never did get them to charge but the headset charges fine so I think my product may have been defective.

source_doc: THE MEASUREMENTS/SIZE GIVEN ARE NOT CORRECT but a nice cover for the price. I purchase alot of car covers.  I usually purchase Budge because they are economical for what I need them for.  This review is not against the seller but the mfg.  I followed directions and measure this car from front to back, I also went online to confirm the length....204" or 17'.  I ordered 2 covers that the mfg states are 228' or 19" for extra caveats to the car itself.  Mind you I know this is a universal fit, the fit overall for a sedan is fine, however, this cover is not 19' long so I am very disappointed.  I cannot return because it was such a tight fit a small corner ripped.  I also used this cover on another car of same dimensions, it did not fit.  This is a lightweight cover which I knew that is fine.  Not happy spending $64+ dollars for something that didn't cover 100%.  Again, not made at the seller, just the mfg and to let people know that Budge misrepresents the measurements.  This is the first time this has happened to me on their covers.

source_doc: I’m very happy with these hammocks. The only reason I’m giving four stars is because we’re I live at it’s so cold that our windows are very cold so the suction won’t stay on the windows. That to me that would not be a product issue. It’s just where I live at. It’s very very cold! It does indeed hold two cats each on each hammock. I have three indoor cats but right now I’m babysitting my best friends cat so I’m up to four cats so I can say it does hold two cats a piece.Every time I try to take a picture of any of the cats on the hammock they see the camera and then they jump off! They were very easy to put together, and they are very sturdy because two of my cats are pretty big and pretty sturdy! If I get any of the cats to stay on the hammock, when I have my phone out, then I will indeed take a picture and add the picture at a later date! I’m very happy with this product and I do believe my three cats plus the one that I’m babysitting is very happy with these hammocks! I was very surprised when I open the box and seen that there was two hammocks. I just assumed that was only one. They’re fantastic and again I’m very pleased with them. Thank you for letting me review these hammocks.

source_doc: Absolute Garbage. These things are absolute garbage. I have had two now, one which I just threw in the trash last night, was a black HZ model. I bought two roughly same time frame about 5 years ago. The black one cracked one of the ball support tabs, so I wrapped string around it and glued the string in place to make a kind of splint. That got me about another 8 months then yesterday I see the snark on the floor all discontorted, I picked it up and saw it cracked at the jaw, so I threw it in the trash.Today I remembered when I bought them, I bought two at the same time, so I should have another new one essentially since I haven't used it. Well this picture is the second one, it's 5 years old yes but never even been taken out of the box til now and one of those tabs is cracked. Unbelievable. It's going in the trash and I'll never buy snark anything again. Done.On a side note, not sure what the material they make these out of but this blue one, which has never had hands on it, is sticky. I keep it in a box with guitar strings, plus it was in it's original box, and the little bag. My guess the material over time, off gasses, and the material just becomes weak and cracks or something.

source_doc: It works fast!! Awesome product. My dog had these raw dark splotches in the creases by her legs. She was constantly licking. It was driving me crazy, plus making her miserable! I already had her on allergy supplements,  so I tried mixing organic coconut oil in her dry food. And putting pure aloe gel on those areas. All she did was want to lick it off(aloe is non-toxic but still). I also started bathing her weekly myself with an antifungal shampoo. But I think it's because of having the heat on, and blankets and the creases are where she sweats(I assume). Or air doesn't get to that area enough. I ordered this stuff as a last resort before a costly vet bill, and I was floored. Not only does it smell great, immediately after spraying those areas, I could tell she felt immediate relief!! She has never once even tried to lick the area. She doesnt like me fussing over her, but when I go to spray her, she pulls her leg back so I can get to it better!! lol which tells me she knows it is helping. I've only used it for 3 days. One side has cleared about 70%, the other about 50%. She is no longer miserable, she's back to playing. And I'm only on day 3 twice a day. Pretty amazing. I'm so thankful that I found this, I immediately just ordered more. Game changer!!!

source_doc: Best on the market. I am ridiculously happy with these under-mount rechargeable lights! I recently updated my master closet and installed two of these lights. They are perfect for what I need. The motion sensor is very sensitive. They turn on immediately as I walk in, remain on as long as I am there and shut off about 30 seconds after I leave.  The brightness is adjustable. There is a switch to turn it on, off, or automatic. The little metal discs that the light magnetizes to are simple to adhere to a myriad of surfaces. I applied them to a melamine shelf so I’m not worried about removal should I want to move them. I would be cautious of applying to painted surfaces unless you plan on it being permanent.These have been perfect in my closet for low light for nighttime or early morning when I don’t want the brightness of over head lighting. I love them so much that I am getting more under cabinet lighting in the kitchen. They would also be perfect for a dark cupboard or linen closet that doesn’t have its own light. Honestly, I need them all over my house!The battery life seems to be long lasting and charging them are quick and simple. You can’t go wrong with these lights!!

source_doc: Excellent so far. The box came in good condition. There were not a whole lot of pieces to assemble. I put this together myself in about 30 minutes and only because I did not look at the directions as carefully as I should have. I always look at the pieces in the box compared to the directions of what is to be be sent in the box. What I didn’t notice was the fine print that said some of those pieces came pre-assembled. I scratched my head at some of the other directions, but if you think it through, it will make sense.This machine is smaller than a magnetic rower and the arm motions are like rowing on water as opposed to just pulling back and forth. I used it the first time last night after putting it together. I could only take the number 1 setting in the tension as I have gotten out of shape except for indoor biking. I ended up using my VR headset to play Holofit and lost track of the time. It ended up being about 40 minutes. Today, I am sore all over, but a good sore. This machine really works the arms, back, and legs. After a few months, if this machine is as good as it is now, I will give it 5 stars.

source_doc: Stay away unless you are short. I loved the way the windshield looked on my 2020 rebel 500 but, when I went above 50 mph the wind hitting my helmet made it vibrate so bad that it blurred my vision and gave me a headache. I tried different riding positions but nothing worked unless I stayed ducked down. I am only 5’8” so I’m not that tall to begin with. I tried to return the windshield and they declined the return stating that since I used the windshield they wouldn’t accept it back. I only had the windshield attached for one week So buyer Beware. If I was only riding in town and never over 50 mph then I would recommend it but since I am more of a daily driver going 40 miles one way and the average speed is 60 mph there is no way I would recommend this windshield to anyone. Plus I would not recommend this seller for any purchase since it looks like they will find any excuse to not refund. This is my two cents on this product so take it or leave it.

source_doc: Fluffier than expected. It is hard to order something online and know if you will like it or not, even if you base your decision on the reviews. I must have spent a week almost daily searching for a comforter. So, I took a chance on this one because my old comforter was flat and faded. And hello, I like being spoiled by two day shipping with Prime!The comforter arrived in a vacuum sealed tight bag and looked pretty thin. No weird smells, either. It was late and I wanted to use it that night, so I overlooked the instructions and tossed it into the washing machine. (The instructions state to air it out over a 24 hour period outside, but it is winter here and I have nowhere to safely hang it or leave it.) I washed it on "warm" on the delicate cycle and the tag said to "line dry" but seriously, who does that anymore? Being the rebel that I am, I forego the instructions and shove it into my regular sized dryer on "medium" and waited. Well, it took about 2 hours to dry. When it was done, it smelled great and was very fluffy! I put it on the bed and loved the look and feel of it. I slept great that night snuggled up with this wonderful, and did I mention fluffy? new comforter. I'm very happy with my purchase.

source_doc: Check the comb for metal shards! One safety issue that I found concerning was that I found metal shards in-between the combs.  I found 3, removed them, and rinsed and soaked the removable comb piece in soapy hot water before even using it to be safe.This is an extremely cheap alternative to the popular FURminator descending comb, so I wanted to try it out.First thing difference I noticed was that this comb doesn't have the button to push out the hair like the FURminator.  That button you see on top is only to remove the metal de-shedding comb.For $3, this de-shedding comb is a fantastic deal, and does the job of de-shedding your pup like it's supposed to.  I do find it annoying that I have to grab the hair out after a few brushes instead of being able to use a single button to do it, but again for $3 bucks, I can deal.  I follow up with a brush down with my regular brush to catch all of the loose hairs that this tool doesn't pick up.It's a cheap tool, and I'm happy I have it.  I probably will purchase the FURminator again down the line, because I really do miss that button.

source_doc: I just wanted it to tell time with a red display. The first one I got was defective. It would not power on when plugged in. I returned it without issue and was sent a replacement. Second one was just fine. Simple to set time, I like that it has a red display. It isn’t too large but still able to see it from across the room. I purchased it so I could tell what the time was in the middle of the night without having to turn on a light or expose myself to blue light. I have a very difficult time sleeping and any other color display would be too stimulating and keep me from sleeping. I have to take medication at particular times during the night. I don’t use the alarm function but I do like that if I needed to, it has the ability to have a softer or louder alarm option. It also has a battery backup option. Simple, effective at telling time without being too bright or stimulating in the middle of the night. Bonus, my husband can see the time without looking at his phone and lighting up our bedroom. So nice not to have that happening anymore. Hopefully it lasts a long time.

hypo_0: Jen jsem chtěl/a, aby ukazoval čas s červeným displejem. První, který jsem dostal/a, byl vadný. Po zapojení do sítě se nezapnul. Bez problémů jsem ho vrátil/a a byl/a mi zaslána náhrada. source_doc: Cheap upgrade. I am fairly new to the sax and I bought one of the cheap Eastar $200 altos. I won't knock my Eastar, I LOVE that in 2023 there's such a thing as a $200 saxophone (didn't exist when I was a kid), but I COULD NOT hit those altissimo notes! Obviously I assumed it was because I was a beginner and I needed to practice my embouchure, and I could hit a very squeaky high F# maybe 30% of the time (the lowest altissimo note). It's been a couple months now and I was starting to get the feeling that the problem wasn't me, it was the hardware. I just got this Yamaha 4C in the mail today, plugged it onto my cheap sax, and hit a perfect high F# first try! I swapped back and forth between the mouthpieces and the Yamaha notes sound noticeably smoother and clearer.TLDR: If you've got a cheap sax then this is a cheap way to instantly improve your playing.

source_doc: Great for smaller mums but. So after almost a month trying this product, I have a love hate relationship with this item. It runs on USB-C which is great since i bought a power bank to charge these on the go after I used them.  It's easy to clean.  I use odorless baby bottle soap to clean it so it's not masked with heavy soap oder.Now like others have mentioned, its not very quiet. I mean I really don't mind, but if a baby is sleeping and baby is sensitive to noise then it's an issue. Also I'm a 36FF. I even tried to micky mouse and place a different suction funnel to it to accommodate my large chest but to no avail.So I had a friend use it for her new baby and it helps her. source_doc: Beautiful flute, but… This is a very beautiful flute and I was so excited to get it. I hadn’t played in about 30 years and wasn’t sure if I could still play. I was pretty good way back when and really wanted to start playing again.When I started playing, I thought some notes seemed sharp. Well, as I said, it had been a while and I thought it was me. I continued to practice and did not see an improvement in the sharpness. In fact, the flute just got more out of tune as time went on. No amount of adjustment would correct this. Sadly, I was unable to continue to play this flute. It was too hard on my ears. I have returned it and will look at an intermediate flute to purchase. I am glad I tried it however because it sparked that part of me that always loved to play.

source_doc: Love these so much!! Let me start off that I haven't used the decals. My walls are textured, so I already know they probably wouldn't stick. The shelves look great even without the decals though so I'm not worried about it. I know they were for a nursery, but I didn't need them in my son's room. So I put them in my bathroom behind my sink area to hold my lotions and perfumes. I love that they have the bar infront to hold things in, easy to clean, the perfect size for what I needed them for, and SOMEWHAT easy to put together. The only reason I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the reason why I said somewhat easy to put together. I had one end piece that the holes were not done correctly for the bar piece. So could only use one dowel to hold it in place instead of two. Which shouldn't effect it at all, but you expect something to come in with no defects at all. With that being said, I would get these again in a heartbeat and highly recommend them.

source_doc: Great option for small spaces! I got this because I don't have enough under counter space to install those typical paper towel holders, and I didn't want a tabletop one.  I was worried that it wouldn't fit in the space that I was intending for it, but it fits!The quality of the holder is great, nice and sturdy.  And the most important part: the magnet is strong!  It slapped down onto the side of my fridge and it doesn't budge without putting a good amount of force into it. It's absolutely worth it's value, I honestly feel like it's a steal because of the quality and versatility in placement compared to the typical paper towel holders that you have to screw down.I would like to note that I prefer this one over another magnetic holder I have because the rod that holds the paper towel roll isn't screw-on, it's one whole piece.  The other one I have had a tendency to unscrew itself over time, so I had to gorilla glue it, because I found it annoying.  Get this one!

source_doc: AMAZING! It literally melts my press on nails! I’ve never been able to get professional acrylic nails because all that filing of the nail bed to prep, would traumatize my nails to the point of creating pockets of fungus. Then I discovered press on nails and with some trepidation I tried it. I took them off after three days to make sure that my nails were clean and to my relief there was no sign of trauma. A whole new world of beautiful nails  just opened up to me! I came across this little gadget and I thought I tried it. I had nothing to lose because if it didn’t work as expected, I could always return it. I followed instructions and then soaked my nails for 5 minutes. When I took my hand out I couldn’t believe my eyes! They fake nails had just disappeared! I didn’t even have to use the scrapper. I used a cotton with acetone to finish taking what little was left. Then I soaked them again for an additional 3 minutes and I was done. I rubbed tea tree oil on my nails to help with the dryness and prevent fungus. This little thing is worth every penny. Healthy nails  have no price. Now I can safely become addicted to beautiful press on nails.

source_doc: Better than I thought. I got this microphone for my phone to cut down background noise mainly for zoom meetings but also for a bird identification app called Merlin as traffic is very loud. I am usually a stickler about apps but this said it didn't require one. Much to my surprise it actually does not require an app or anything. I have a galaxy S22 ultra and I plugged it in and it just worked. I didn't have to change any settings or anything. It worked for every app even ok google. While playing with it i did open a decibel meter and took notice of how much of the background noise was being cut out. I live full time in a Class A RV so the noise level can be pretty high inside. I put 2 screenshots in to show it does decrease the background noise a bit. I think the actual bonus comes from the microphone being much closer to you though. I only used it on my phone so not sure about the other things.

source_doc: A remake that feels more like two steps backward than a step forward. I grew up playing the original Diamond and Pearl, and besides the notoriously slow engine run, I had really enjoyed those games and looked forward to the remakes. I found BDSP faithful to a fault, while not introducing enough new spins to qualify as a breath of fresh air. The Grand Underground held my interest for only a brief amount of time. Everything else feels stale, rigid, and uninspired. I’m not a fan of the chibi aesthetic, which I’m especially disappointed about since I liked the direction the new games were going with more detailed and realistic models. I have played Pokemon since I was in preschool, over 20 years, and this is the only Pokemon game I have not finished. I stopped playing after getting the eighth badge and couldn’t feel bothered to continue any further. (I did, however, help my sister beat Cynthia on Brilliant Diamond, and I appreciate that they’ve made the notoriously difficult Champion even more difficult. From the remastered music to the competent AI, hands down the best battle in BDSP.) When Pokemon Legends Arceus came out, I dropped Shining Pearl like a hotcake and didn’t look back. Arceus was the breath of fresh air I was craving.

source_doc: I Love This Shampoo! I am always hesitant about purchasing beauty products online. I stumbled across this Biotin because I was looking for something with a nutritional value instead of just stripping my hair of oils. I had been using Suave for years and noticed my hair was breaking much more. My hairdresser recommended that I get away from shampoos with sulfates. I switched the following week and I noticed a HUGE different in my hair feel, texture and VOLUME! I have received so many compliments on how healthy my hair looks. The only thing I changed was the shampoo. The video shows a guy squeezing a lot of shampoo on his head. My hair length is below my shoulders and I only use about the size of dimer amount. A little goes a long way.I have been convinced that this is the only shampoo for me. I will be adding the conditioner to the hair care lineup.

During the 'repair' process, it prompted me to search for the synapse.msi file but couldn't find it saying the file doesn't exist. This shouldn't be that difficult. I have 'gaming' peripherals from numerous other companies and never, not once did I ever have an issue connecting one of their devices. They are recognized immediately upon connection but not with Razer. Razer forces me to jump through all these hoops and it still doesn't work. So, I no longer spend hours upon hours trying to get their products to work. If they don't within five or ten minutes of troubleshooting it's being sent back. I should have remembered when I tried to connect one of their headphones and had the same issue. I remember even uninstalling the application back then and reinstalling it and it still didn't connect.

source_doc: Water tastes great! I love this filter! I’m new to RVing and I noticed all the neighbors have this on their water supply so I researched it and I knew I needed one! I immediately noticed the chlorine smell was gone. I use bottled water but I occasionally run out and I hated using tap water because of the toxins it contains. I also worried about giving it to my dogs to drink. The installation was a breeze but there were no instructions that mentioned the black water that comes out at first. I was alarmed but I found their website and read that it’s carbon from the filter and it isn’t harmful. I made my first pot of coffee this morning (without my regular dread) and it was far better than regular tap water! The only thing that I don’t like is that it leaked from the water source. It comes with a rubber ring but it didn’t work for me. Luckily I had others on hand and now it doesn’t leak. Best purchase I’ve made in a very long time!

hypo_0: Voda chutná skvěle! Tento filtr naprosto miluju! S karavaningem teprve začínám a všiml/a jsem si, že všichni sousedé ho mají na svém přívodu vody, tak jsem si o tom něco zjistil/a a věděl/a jsem, že ho taky potřebuju! Okamžitě jsem si všiml/a, že zápach chlóru zmizel. Používám balenou vodu, ale občas mi dojde a nerad/a jsem používal/a vodu z kohoutku kvůli toxinům, které obsahuje. Měl/a jsem také obavy dávat ji pít svým psům. Instalace byla hračka, ale nebyly u ní žádné pokyny, které by zmiňovaly černou vodu, která teče jako první. Vylekalo mě to, ale našel/našla jsem jejich webové stránky a dočetl/a se, že je to uhlík z filtru a není to škodlivé. Dnes ráno jsem si uvařil/a svou první konvici kávy (bez svých obvyklých obav) a byla mnohem lepší než z běžné kohoutkové vody! Jediná věc, která se mi nelíbí, je, že filtr kapal u zdroje vody. Dodává se s gumovým kroužkem, ale ten mi nefungoval. Naštěstí jsem měl/a po ruce jiné a teď už netěsní. Nejlepší nákup, jaký jsem za velmi dlouhou dobu udělal/a!

Okamžitě jsem si všiml/a, že zápach chlóru zmizel. Používám balenou vodu, ale občas mi dojde a nerad/a jsem používal/a vodu z kohoutku kvůli toxinům, které obsahuje. Měl/a jsem také obavy dávat ji pít svým psům. Instalace byla hračka, ale v návodu chyběla jakákoliv zmínka o černé vodě, která vyteče jako první. Vylekalo mě to, ale našel/našla jsem jejich webové stránky a dočetl/a se, že je to jen uhlík z filtru a není škodlivý. Dnes ráno jsem si uvařil/a svou první konvici kávy (bez svých obvyklých obav) a byla mnohem lepší než z běžné kohoutkové vody! Jediné, co se mi nelíbí, je, že filtr u zdroje vody protékal. Dodává se s gumovým kroužkem, ale ten mi nefungoval. Naštěstí jsem měl/a po ruce jiné a teď už neteče. Nejlepší nákup, jaký jsem za velmi dlouhou dobu udělal/a!

source_doc: What is going on with these keyboards? My daughter got one of these keyboards for Christmas. The 1st keyboard we had types randomly into text boxes on the screen. Just random characters. It was freaking them out so I contacted the mfgr. They said that I should update the software. I downloaded the tool to do so, but it's all in Chinese (I assume)? I don't know which button is update and which button is identify but I poke around and figure it out. The SUCCESS/FAIL text box is also not in English so I don't know the status and the window doesn't close. Either way, nothing fixes it. The company sends out a new keyboard and this one turns off randomly while in use. Since this is a gaming keyboard, you KNOW that can't happen, or GAME OVER. They suggested I update the software, but we had already plugged in the old keyboard in the meantime. I finally get the chance to do that and now the thing is dead. Like dead dead. I plug it into another computer, still won't light up. Uninstall/Reinstall/Repair/Update software, hardware (in DevMgr), restart over and over and over...and nothing. Now it's just a brick. Guess we're stuck with the ghost keyboard. Side note: Customer service was responsive in their attempt to help, but they couldn't solve the problem. Ended up offering a $20 credit, but I didn't purchase it, so that didn't make sense. I just want something that works!

source_doc: I would describe the fram brand as barely adequate, if that. The build quality feels just really cheap. Everything about it is cut rate. It's pretty funny but I haven't seen that to be really true at all like I said above I haven't seen proof about it. Anyway yeah I'm just not going to use filters this cheap and low quality.

Předpokládám, že k tomu by došlo, kdyby se z ní odlomily nějaké kousky, celá se nějak rozpadla a začala ucpávat olejové kanálky. Ale z toho, co jsem viděl/a, nikdo nikdy nedokázal provést důkaz, že se to stalo. Tím neříkám, že se to nestalo, jen nemám čas dělat nějaký rozsáhlý výzkum. Ale všechno na nich je prostě levné. Netuším, jak dobře filtrují. Za pár dolarů navíc můžete mít něco, co působí opravdu kvalitně. Takže jsem se rozhodl/a, že už nebudu používat levné olejové filtry, a tyhle jsou pro mě nepřijatelné. Jak říkám, nebudu tvrdit, že ničí motory, protože o tom nemám tušení. Vím, že se jim přezdívá „oranžová plechovka smrti“. Je to docela vtipné, ale jak jsem uvedl/a výše, nezdá se mi, že by to byla vůbec pravda, protože jsem pro to neviděl/a žádné důkazy. Každopádně jo, takhle levné a nekvalitní filtry už prostě používat nebudu.

source_doc: Blender, frother or shaker bottle works best with this. In adding 3 scoops to my 12 oz coffee, I found it didn't mix thoroughly. Next try, I added 1 scoop to my coffee and it mixed up a little better using just one scoop. I then added an another scoop to a 1/3 cup half & half (yes, I like a little coffee with my creamer lol). I used my cordless frother and it mixed up fine. I am not sure 2 scoops in the creamer would have worked as well. I'm ok with only using 2 scoops a day; it's better than nothing.  The flavor was nice, but I also add flavored syrup to my coffees as well.  Next day, I put 3 scoops in a blender bottle (with wire wisk ball) along with 12 oz of milk and half a packet of chocolate breakfast drink mix. Then, shook and shook and shook. It mixed up great and tasted awesome.  I removed a star only because I didn't feel this worked as well as I thought it should in hot coffee. It's better than some, but still not awesome.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Mixér, napěňovač nebo šejkr na to fungují nejlépe. Když jsem přidal/a 3 odměrky do svých 350 ml kávy, zjistil/a jsem, že se to úplně nerozmíchalo. Při dalším pokusu jsem do kávy přidal/a 1 odměrku a jen s tou jednou se to rozmíchalo o něco lépe. Potom jsem přidal/a další odměrku do 80 ml smetany napůl s mlékem (ano, mám rád/a trochu kávy ve své smetaně lol). Použil/a jsem svůj bezdrátový napěňovač a rozmíchalo se to dobře. Nejsem si jistý/á, jestli by 2 odměrky v té smetaně fungovaly stejně dobře. Nevadí mi používat jen 2 odměrky denně; je to lepší než nic. Chuť byla dobrá, ale do kávy si přidávám také ochucený sirup. Druhý den jsem dal/a 3 odměrky do šejkru (s kovovou pružinovou kuličkou) spolu s 350 ml mléka a polovinou sáčku čokoládového instantního snídaňového nápoje. Potom jsem třásl/a a třásl/a a třásl/a. Rozmíchalo se to skvěle a chutnalo to úžasně. Jednu hvězdičku jsem odebral/a jen proto, že jsem měl/a pocit, že to v horké kávě nefunguje tak dobře, jak by podle mě mělo. Je to lepší než u některých jiných, ale stále nic úžasného.

source_doc: great for walking, a bad back makes it harder to move. I use this daily while watching TV.  My other half uses it to keep moving on rainy or otherwise lazy days.  I love it.  The remote came with a cheap and possibly old battery - it died quick.  Replaced it with a new and expensive one and it is happy as a clam.  Invest in a good battery if you want it to work with only one button push. I have a bad back and I was hoping I could move it easily, but that was to much to expect of my back I think.  But, I can get it out of the way if I have to just not daily.  It folds easily though. When not in use, it stays in the living room, folded up and covered with a towel to discourage interested cats.  They think I purchased a very expensive cat bed, so that didn't work but the towel keeps the cat hair off it.  Someday I will make a cover that fits it and matches the rug.  I have not paired it with my phone and downloaded the app, I just bring it slowly up to my speed and walk as long as I can.

source_doc: The discovery "does show that in other planetary environments organisms might be able to use other elements to drive biochemistry and that the 'standard' set of elements we think are absolutely necessary for life might not be so fixed," commented Charles Cockell, professor at the Planetary and Space Sciences Research Institute, Open University, in Milton Keynes, United Kingdom.

source_doc: Bright, Easy to Aim, Easy to Install. These plug in linkable lights are a great answer to any dark corner in your garage or shop. I know they have fixed MY dark corner problem. I really like that these lights have "petals" that can be aimed any which way I need. And they stay once I have aimed them.One of these lights was dead on arrival but the manufacturer was quick to respond to the issue and make sure I was satisfied with their resolution.So these lights are BRIGHT. Did I mention that? It is relevant because I cannot look directly at them. Not that I'd want to, but that gives you an idea how bright they are. Also, conveniently, I was able to link these lights to existing shop lights I have that also have a two prong outlet. I flipped the switch on these to "on" and left it because the outlet everything is plugged into is on a switch I can reach. Having to switch these lights on individually each time just wasn't practical but I appreciate the option.These lights are really an easy way to improve any lighting you are missing not to mention the manufacturer that cares about their customers. Truly a win all the way around!

source_doc: Tire marks..avoid this sealer! I purchased with high hopes based on excellent reviews...sadly I've had nothing but issues since I sprayed it on my paver driveway. I applied the product as per the instructional video and after waiting 48 hours, I parked on the driveway. Over the past several weeks I've accumulated over 20 tire marks on my once clean driveway. I tried to scrub off with soap and water, but it made little difference. I contacted the manufacturer and they told me that the tire marks must have been on the driveway before sealing (definitely not the case) and after submitting several photos they sent me a .pdf explaining how black tire marks will happen with this time of "film forming sealer." Their recommendation was to soap/scrub and then pressure wash the marks off. I sealed my driveway so I wouldn't have to scrub it and pressure wash it frequently...but this low rate sealer all but guarantees I will have to repeatedly power wash on a regular basis to get rid of the tire marks that keep appearing. If I had a time machine I would go back and warn myself not to put this sealer on my driveway no matter how good the reviews were. Avoid this product for your driveway unless you enjoy frequent cleaning and the depressing feeling that you just paid nearly $300 for a product that will make your driveway more of a headache to keep clean. Zero stars if I could!

Koupil/a jsem ho s velkým očekáváním na základě vynikajících recenzí... bohužel od té doby, co jsem ho nastříkal/a na svou dlážděnou příjezdovou cestu, nemám nic jiného než problémy. Přípravek jsem aplikoval/a podle instruktážního videa a po 48 hodinách čekání jsem na příjezdové cestě zaparkoval/a. Během několika posledních týdnů se mi na mé kdysi čisté příjezdové cestě nahromadilo více než 20 šmouh od pneumatik. Pokusil/a jsem se je vydrhnout mýdlem a vodou, ale pomohlo to jen minimálně. Kontaktoval/a jsem výrobce a ten mi sdělil, že šmouhy od pneumatik musely být na příjezdové cestě ještě před nanesením tmelu (což rozhodně nebyl tento případ), a po zaslání několika fotografií mi poslali PDF soubor s vysvětlením, že u tohoto typu „filmotvorného tmelu“ k černým šmouhám od pneumatik docházet bude. Jejich doporučením bylo šmouhy namydlit/vydrhnout a poté opláchnout tlakovou myčkou. Příjezdovou cestu jsem impregnoval/a proto, abych ji nemusel/a často drhnout a mýt tlakovou myčkou... ale tento nekvalitní tmel prakticky zaručuje, že budu muset pravidelně a opakovaně používat vapku, abych se zbavil/a neustále se objevujících šmouh od pneumatik. Kdybych měl/a stroj času, vrátil/a bych se zpět a varoval/a sám/sama sebe, abych tento tmel na svou příjezdovou cestu nedával/a, bez ohledu na to, jak dobré recenze měl. Vyhněte se tomuto produktu na své příjezdové cestě, pokud si neužíváte časté čištění a depresivní pocit, že jste právě zaplatil/a téměř 300 dolarů za produkt, kvůli kterému bude udržování čistoty vaší příjezdové cesty ještě větší noční můrou. Kdybych mohl/a, dám nula hvězdiček!

source_doc: Best Wipers I Ever Owned. My 2004 Toyota Avalon XLS had squeaky wiper since the day I bought it. Car is in excellent condition and I replaced the wipers originally with something like Bosch. They still dragged and squeaked horribly. I thought perhaps the motor was bad so I replaced the wiper motor, still squeaked. I bought another "Silicone" type wiper blade and they squeaked. I though maybe my wiper linkage was bad so I replaced the entire mechanical arms. Still squeaked. I lived with this for about 2 years and driving to work in the rain one morning, my wipers were squeaking when I noticed that about 8 inches of the passenger wiper blade peeled off from the frame. The wipers instantly stopped squeaking. Crazy.I ordered the "Rain-X 830124 Silicone Endura Wiper Blades", which is a bit misleading because it is only one blade. I assumed there were two since the cost was enough for two, but it was only one. I ordered the other blade as well and these things are buttery smooth, no squeaking at last!Highly recommended.

source_doc: Finally, I found the right ones! I was asked to find and order wind screens for the microphones in the drive-up window at the bank I work at.  I never thought it would be so difficult to find the right ones.  The mics we have are very old, so I wasn't like I could go to the manufacturers website and order replacements.  They don't make the model.  I Googled over and over and tried many different sites and searched on here.  Just measuring didn't do any good.  For one thing, the ones we had were missing the tops (did someone chew them off?) and they were stretched out, and it was hard to tell what size they really were.  I tried measuring the size of the mic and trying to figure out what would fit.  I looked at pictures, descriptions, measurements, all of it.  And I ended up with several purchases that didn't even come close. It seemed that most of what was out there was designed for lapel mics, which I guess would be very small, and gaming headsets, and most of those looked too big or two small. Finally I ordered these.  And they fit!  They seem nice, I mean they're just little pieces of foam-not much to screw up there.  Now I can quit looking and move on to the next odd thing they ask me to order.
