source_doc: ---Buyers BEWARE they don't stand behind WARRANTY-- Very rarely have I had issue's with sellers warranty.After 2 months the temperature light stopped working. It did work atill I put another Thermometer in the tank and adjusted the correct temperature. A couple month's later I had to adjust again. I had to keep changing it  to bring up the 70 to 78 degrees temp. At 4 months I contacted the company about there 1 year warranty.  They did repond and I told them i appreciate that they responded.  First off they offered 50% coupon.They raised there price. Even at 50% I said I could find one cheaper last longer.  Now there respone send it in to repair.Wait what??It's winter and my tank would be without a heater. That just funny. I've already lost a snail. I live in the high desert so our temperature changes 115 to below 0. My house stays 62 to 80. Yes this heater needed to function for the changes.I bought a higher power for the size of the tank thinking this heater would be the best for my tank for the area.When I purchased this heater it had 5 stars.I hope I helped someone to stay away,because company 12 month warranty only works if you send it in.What a joke. Buyer BEWAREI paid for this heater with my own monies no one paid me.

source_doc: You need your own adhesive to use these. I knew these did not come with adhesive when ordering.  They are priced as such coming in roughly half the cost of self sticking versions.  Very fairly priced.  I figured the next time I go to Home Depot I’d pick up some adhesive.  I ordered these Jan 1.  It’s now Mar 1 and they are still on the floor in the corner of my drum room.  I’ve been to Home Depot five times (house project) since then and have forgotten every single time.  The two times remembered and planned on buying, by the time i was done shopping, i had been there so long I’d forgotten again.  I know i can order adhesive but i kind of wanted to see what my options were as first time buying such a product.Although I’d normally wait to write a review until I actually used the product, i thought I’d share my status with these for the guys out there that are forgetful like me, or procrastinators or whoever;  it might better to spend the money and get the self sticking kind just so you can get them hung and be done.  I’m hoping to get there, Hung and Done, soon.  Good luck

source_doc: Works very well. Works very well to track steps, calories, distance and work outs. Data is accurate and battery life is excellent. I wear it 24 hours and the sleep data has been very helpful. I also use the smart wake feature so an alarm doesn't wake my partner since I get up a couple hours before him. The smart wake sends vibrations which buzz the arm. It works surprisingly well. Even though there is a water lock to allow user to wear in shower or swimming, I have not tried it yet, but plan to. The sensors on the sides are easy to use for the EDA scan and heart rhythm scan. I would prefer to have the apps in a different order but that is just a personal thing. The only other issue I have had is the phone app occasionally acts up and won't allow me to sync data. It self resolves but can be annoying. I chalk it up to consequence of having so much tech these days.  I am glad I chose the 5 over the 4 version for the built in GPS & water lock capabilities. I also recommend getting the fitbit premium account if you are serious about getting your health better. It has additional insights and data analyses that you won't have access to without it. Overall extremely happy with the Fitbit 5 and I do recommend it.

source_doc: Works well on my very fine, thin, and fragile hair. Not a mist... I love TRESemmé products, and this TRESemmé One Step 5-in-1 Volumizing Hair Styling Mist it's no different, other than one thing. It is definitely not a mist, and cannot be sprayed directly on the hair evenly. I spray it into one hand, rub my hands together, and then apply it to my hair, starting at the root area. I don't have a lot of hair, so it works well for my fine, thin, fragile, and rather curly hair.Whenever I go out, I wear wigs, but I still want my natural hair to look halfway decent at home. Not only does it work well on my natural hair it also helps to keep my wigs in place. For what little natural hair I have, it doesn't take much to do the job. If I blow dry it, it gives it quite a bit of volume, but most of the time I let it air dry. It starts out a little crunchy, but once I finger comb it out, it has more volume and looks much thicker.I wish the product sprayed out in a mist as its name suggests, but I still like it for my natural hair, and for my wigs, as well. For those reasons, I would definitely recommend it!

source_doc: What a relief! I didn’t know that such a device existed, however, I will now share my new discovery with friends! For many years I found myself constantly readjusting my seatbelt while driving. I added a pad to the belt hoping it would project my neck from the rubbing seatbelt. It only reduced my discomfort slightly.This product appeared as I was looking for something to help me install a dog booster seat in my car. It was a spontaneous purchase. While I’ve only used the device for two days, I am pleasantly surprised by the comfort it provides. The seatbelt now feels like a good, personalized fit for me and my atypical body.I marked down the “ease of use” because I am still trying to figure out how to keep the device on the seatbelt when I leave the car. The belt doesn’t fully retract when I leave the device on the belt. My hunch is that I need to develop a new habit of consciously tucking the belt beside the seat as I’m leaving the car so I don’t shut the door on the belt.My biggest regret is that I didn’t discover this device years ago when I was doing more cross-country road trips!

source_doc: Keyboard is too tall? Never thought I would have this complaint about a keyboard, but this thing is way too tall. I have had a Corsair K70 for the past 10 years and I am at a point of needing to replace it. Thought I would give this one a try and see if I liked the optical linear switches which I do really like.The problem is the actual height of the keyboard itself. It sits at least twice the height of my old mechanical keyboard. I tried adjusting my chair but found that it was a big enough difference between my mouse and keyboard that my armrests had to sit at two separate heights. Doing this hurts my shoulder and ruins my posture, but if I keep my armrests even like I would normally my wrist is bent just enough to cause pain.If you really cannot live without this keyboard for whatever reason, I would recommend raising your mousepad to match the height of the keyboard. I am tempted to do that just to keep this keyboard, but this is just dumb design in my opinion.

source_doc: Use force and don’t touch with skin when applying adhesive pads. I applied mine to wood paneling and some kind of dropped ceiling material as well as drywall. These were all freshly pained with an eggshell finish.The part that may help you- Given other reviews I was aware of adhesion problems so I made sure not to touch them with my skin AT ALL. I removed the pad from the sheet with tweezers (leaving the backing on the one side) and placed it on the fattest part of the butterfly body where the magnet is. I then pressed it on hard using my fingers, thumb on the pad and the rest on the other side of the body. And I do mean hard. After doing them all my fingers really hurt. After this I then removed the paper backing and applied them to the surface and pressed HARD repeatedly. A few of them I heard a crack because I pressed so hard but not sure where I cracked as it wasn’t visible.I have had 3 fall. One after 2 days, another after a week, and then another 3 weeks later. I put each of these back up using superglue.Other than that, haven’t had any problems. I believe that using force and avoiding getting skin oils on them was helpful.

source_doc: I love the storage! I have a little chiweenie so these are very necessary for him to be able to get on and off the bed by himself. I have tried another style of these type of stairs and this style is a lot better. The other style wasn't as sturdy and they weren't all connected to each other. I like this design how they completely detach from each other. It makes traveling with them or storing them a lot easier. I like the soft material on these. It seems better for my dog too, that way he doesn't slip as easily. What's really nice about these too is the storage you get. I like to put his treats, shampoos or any other supplies I use for my dog in here. The reason I only gave it four stars is because of the velcro design that is used for the lid. One of the stairs has the velcro coming off already. Also, I have to make sure to push on the velcro to secure it and even then it seems like one side isn't secured. It's held up though for now but I'm not sure how long it will last. I'm sure at that point I can figure out a way to fix it though. Other than that these are great and I would definitely recommend them to anyone with small dogs. They have made my life a lot easier.

source_doc: Serious Stomach/Gas Issues. I purchased my bulk unflavored canister directly from the Armra website about 4 weeks ago. I took it once a day for a week and then twice a day (morning and night). The main positive effect I had was that I slept more soundly through the night and my Fitbit recorded more deep sleep and REM sleep.  I agree with the commenters who find the taste of the unflavored product similar to powdered milk - I thought it was fine.  I was pleased enough with the sleep improvements to want to continue using the product, but I developed serious stomach pain and gas issues on my left side in the area of the pancreas. The pain was severe enough across several days to consider going to the doctor but I finally remembered I had started this new product and I stopped taking it during week 3. Fortunately the pain and gas eased within 24 hours and was gone in 3 days. I rarely react to foods and supplements so this was unexpected. I checked the ratings here and see a small but notable group of users reporting similar gastrointestinal issues. I don’t know why some of us have such a significant reaction but it is something to be aware of.

source_doc: This is my second purchase of these. I originally purchased this belt when I had an iphone 8+ back in 2018.  I used it every other day when I ran.  I constantly pulled my iphone out of the belt 2 - 3 times a run (for pictures).  When I purchased an iphone 13 pro max I was happily surprised that it still fit in my old belt.  The belt fit me fine (I wear size 8 women's pants) and never "bounced" during the time I used it (although from time to time I did have to tighten it a bit as it sometimes came loose).Finally after many years of service, the zipper broke in December 2022.  I purchased a replacement and the quality is still as good as the original.  Not planning to upgrade my iphone any time soon, but I hope this still works in future.I highly recommend this product for those who don't like to carry their phones in their pockets when running.

source_doc: They've screwed up! They changed the design and have ruined the cups! I have ordered MULTIPLE sets of these cups over the last 4 years for my grandbabies. I LOVED them!! They were well made,came in fun colors, and are made from recycled material here in the USA. What's not to love?! I recommended them to a dozen people. They loved them too. Well, fast forward to a month ago when my niece bought some from Target. She took them home and tried them out. She told my sister I was crazy for thinking they were so great. Hers leaked. Well, she had bought me 3 the same day...and they leaked too!! Some from the spout, some from the edge of the lid. I took an older one from the cabinet and compared them. Well, the continuous thread has been replaced with these weird tabs which apparently keep the cup from sealing properly. I am so sad such a great product has been ruined. I even tried ordering another set from Amazon in hopes it would be the old style. No such luck. Every single one of them leaked as well. I guess I will just have to guard my old ones with my life and never allow them to leave the house. I once would have told you to buy buy buy...now I say skip them. So disappointing.

source_doc: Cover about 28 vents, and about its efficiency I will tell more when I know. I recently moved into an apartment complex that was supposed to be pest free and smoke free… Couple of days after moving in we started smelling a lot of cigarettes smoke and weed as well. We first thought it was coming from the door or windows, since people would go to the balconies to smoke, but nope… we learned that our next door neighbor smokes inside and the smoke smell comes from all the ac vents and the bathroom vent when the AC is not running. I got this “filter” to cover the AC vents. I sprayed the filter with odor ban to see if it helps. I will let you guys know more about its efficiency after couple of days.I decided to cover the vents from the inside, so I could still redirect the vent from the outside, and because of that I used a lot of the fabric. I live in a 1 bedroom apartment, so I only have 3 ac vents to cover. I covered all of them and have enough fabric to change all of them once more with a little bit to spare, but if you cover from the front I would say you should have enough for a good 28 vents.

source_doc: Thin and lightweight. I first started sleeping on a memory foam pillow some 20+ years ago. It radically changed the way I sleep. Though I fell asleep on my side, I always woke on my back. It was so much more comfortable for me that I won't use anything else. I got this pillow so I would have a spare. I was a bit taken aback by how small, thin, and lightweight it is compared to standard bed pillows. Even so, it is pristine, with a very nice quilted zippered case that can be removed for cleaning. It is firmer than the pillow I am used t, and I had my doubts that I would like it. But I slept on it last night and it was great! It will take a few more nights to determine if this is my new pillow of choice, but at the very least it will be a close second and will certainly be the one I take along when traveling!

source_doc: I chose DAY LIGHT so it's bright. I argued for years with hubby as he prefers the softer white bulbs and I find them too yellow and need the BRIGHT. I finally made a believer out of him. He's 85 so he's entitled to his opinion I just know when it's my space I need the white light. Don't consult just do it and he then is fine. Ask or try to discuss it with him oh best not. After 51 years together yeah I've got this part of relation side figured out. Usually...lol. All in the lights are BRIGHT. Should have bought a bigger pack or at least two. I would by more but they do not state if they can go inside enclosed lamp fixtures or sealed ones. So for that I didn't buy more. But happy with them and replaced some LED spot lights in sewing room fixtures we bought at hefty price a few years ago but Hubby snuck in 2 yellow lights in there...they look yellow when the 8 track plus 2 more lights most are bright white day light versions and two were the soft white. So these are so bright they are wonderful and I quickly used the remaining two about the house too. I do wish they all would come out ready to be stable in enclosed fixtures though. I can't deduct because I knew that when I bought them. And they weren't put in enclosed fixtures.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Great mic. I'm kind of new to the podcasthing thing and at first I was disappointed with the sound quality. It was only as good as the $5 desktop mic I replaced. Then I figured out that I had to speak directly into the mic rather than just having it to the side of me on my desk. If I speak directly into the mic the sound quality is amazing. I was really hoping not to have to move the mic directly in front of me each time I recorded, so I started looking for some type of arm that I could connect above me so I could just bring it in when I needed it but I can't seem to find any clamp that fits the mic since it's so wide. Even the ones that say they work with "blue yet" are too small. I've tried two already; neither fits. Other than that, I love the mic.

source_doc: Advantage 2 For some reason my indoor cats keep getting plagued with fleas (my BFF thinks it's from the vet). I ordered Advantage 2 for my socialized cats and for my ferals I ordered an oral medication. Once I put the Advantage 2 on my adults, shortly afterwards I started noticing that one of my cats started scratching alot less. He seemed to be the one most plagued anyway. I read from another reviewer that it will take a while to break the cycle. In the meanwhile make sure all laundry is done, floors are cleaned, etc. I don't have rugs, so that's a plus. I use blue Dawn to mop my floors (it kills the fleas on contact). I just recently bought RAID for fleas too. Seems that it kills fleas on contact according to another reviewer (I agree. No sooner I sprayed the RAID I noticed that the fleas stopped biting.) Will be spraying all surfaces that I can't wash. It surely pays to read other reviews!! You learn alot from it. I don't buy anything unless it's a 4.5 stars review or better.UPDATE: 2 weeks later and I see my cats scratching again. I'm disappointed 😞.

source_doc: Neutral Lip Mask. I was kind of confused when I saw this product.  I am aware of and have been using facial masks. For lips, we have lip balms. Is this a facial mask or a lip balm?  My ignorance made me curious and made me keep reading the details. Found that masks for lips do exist.I have to try this product if it will do wonder for my lips. The product comes in plastic with two sets of lip masks. Each lip mask is on its separate small carton box. One of the things I noticed is that the product has no safety seal. Neither the box nor the tube is sealed. Please see the photo I posted.  The instructions provided are in Korean and English.I squeeze it and applied it to my lips. I did not notice any fragrance or after-taste. I did not feel any weird sensations. It is not oily nor greasy, unlike the two products I currently use. Please see the photo for comparison. I felt a little sealing effect almost similar to when you apply a mask on your face. I kept thinking that this maybe is sealing the lip moisture. So far so good. I need more time to see how this will improve my lips. I will update and report the result here. For now, I will apply this before bedtime and will keep using my current lip balm during the day.

And other glass ones I have tried had this awful loud hum/screaming sounds that are hell for my sound hypersensitivity.Ok, enough of the negative - Here's why I love this diffuser: you can control the diffusion rate (HELLO! source_doc: Love the ladder hardware, screws are horrid. Love the hardware, the screws are worthless.  I used oak sides and rockler steps.  (Saved enough on the rolling hardware I decided to splurge on the steps).Be careful planning the alignment of the top rail as the wheels only clear the mounts at the operational angle.I read how bad the screws were bug figured I could be careful.  They're horrible.  I predrilled, new bit, gently installed, and the heads still stripped.  I complained and was sent smaller screws.  I ended up replacing them with others from Amazon.  Pain in the neck because I had to use an easy out on 3.The wheels and rail are fairly straightforward to install.  I built my ladder, then put it up to figure out where to screw the top in.  The hardware seems fairly well made.  I did have trouble putting the caps on the rails and between the rails, the o-rings wanted to tear themselves up the fit was so tight.  That was annoying and I replaced one, but I ended up deciding they weren't that important and didn't worry if the others tore.Would have preferred that the bottom locks, but the ladder rolls smoothly and I'm really happy with it.I replaced the screws with:https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00GI8BVKG/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00

source_doc: Easy to use, feels professional. I must admit I was skeptical about buying this because of it's price! I wanted this model because cortado is one of the presets, and I had red good reviews about the milk recipes.My previous machine is a Nespresso latissima plus, which I still think it makes decent coffee, and maybe more coffee crema that I have been able to get with this Gaggia.Can I go back to nesspreso... So many options to try now.. I like that!A more manual espresso machine may give you better taste or more crema...... Maybe.. I do not know and I do not plan to find out, manual is just too much work! I think this is a great combination of quality and ease of use.I'm saying goodbye to nesspreso.

source_doc: Great pillow for neck pain. I wasn't sure about buying this pillow mostly because I am not a back sleeper. And while I don't think it has made any difference with my snoring, I do love this pillow. I always thought I loved feather pillows, but after getting this I realized it was because I could bunch them up to be high or low where I wanted. But they don't stay that way... I like this pillow because it is firm but not overly firm and there are various heights. So while I'm on my side, I sleep on one section but if I roll more to my stomach, I can move my head to a different section. And, surprisingly, I do actually enjoy relaxing on my back with my head cradled before I go to sleep. I still don't sleep that way but it's very comfortable to initially wind down

source_doc: Surprisingly discouraged. I am disappointed. Ohora has the most incredible selection of colors… So I am bummed to discover such poor quality. I have tried many semi cured gel strip brands. I’ve been wearing them for a year consistently. I change my sets every two weeks, usually because I just want to change my manicure, very rarely do I have any shipping or peeling. With this brand I find they crack and ship far more quickly than any other. This set has already had two nails that chipped so I took them off & replaced. Now I have three more chipped nails.  I think I’m just going to give up and take them completely off.  I have other Ohora sets in my drawer that I won’t let go to waste but unless I’m pleasantly surprised by the others I try in the future, I would not recommend this brand again.  So sad bc the color options are for sure the best I’ve found.

source_doc: Good for kids (and very good for adults ears) These are very, very light weight. I was desperately looking for foam mallets because they just sound nicer on steel tongue drums and mid class vibraphones. I bought these, not caring that they looked like a lollypop( probably not a good thing because it may entice little ones to chew on it) So I gave them a try and even though the foam was the density that I was hoping for, the handles are so light that I can’t get the sound I want, without whacking really hard,,,,and then all you hear is the thudding and no music. I thought the handle might be hollow and I that I could somehow add some weight but the ends are sealed ( I may chop it off & see if I can add weight and then sand the ends, so they’re smooth. Hmmm….may have to update later.Pros: For parents, whose so called friends, have gotten the kiddies a xylophone, this may save your sanity…Even though the munchkins may bang away, at that thing,,,the sound will not pierce a hole in your eardrum & make you long for their 18th birthday..lol

source_doc: You get what you pay 4 I'm just getting back into playing the cello after many years, so when I committed to lessons at the beginning of the year I had to move quickly to find an instrument. I found what appeared to be a good beginner cello for a great price. The instrument arrived the next day and was packaged immaculately. However the good stoped there. On first inspection everything seemed normal as I set up the bridge. However, as I started to tune the cello I noticed the tuning pegs would very easily slip out of place. Then I noticed the fine tuners for the D string on the tail piece was bent. I disassemble the bridge and strings to correct it and it just popped backed into the wrong place again. When I took my cello to my first lesson my instructor immediately noticed several things off about the instrument. The nut and bridge were too high, making the strings sit up too far away from the finger board. These physical issues made it very difficult and next to impossible to play. Save your money and go to a licensed string instrument seller. It might me a little more pricey but at least you'll get a quality instrument. I know I did.

source_doc: Do not waste your money. I had high hopes for these pads & was impressed by looking at them when they arrived. They are a great size & cover a lot of area. They are nice & thick & seem to be of a much better quality over thin pads I’ve gotten previously. Unfortunately that’s where the good part ends. They work horribly. I have a senior dog who is incontinent so I use these where she lays. She wears diapers but has leaks. I was hoping to have an added layer of protection by using these pads. I tested them by pouring a small glass of water on them & waiting a few minutes. The floor under the pad was wet. Not damp, but wet. I felt the top where the pad would have contact with the person or pet’s skin & it was also sopping wet. I double checked to make sure I had the correct side up and it was laid down properly. These pads are no different than laying down a towel. Very disappointing. I’m wondering if all these great reviews were done prior to actually using them. If I had rated on initial looks alone without testing; I would have given this an excellent review. Because of their thickness if you have to double them up for them to work, it is going to be uncomfortable to lay on. I wanted to love these but they were a complete disappointment.

source_doc: Teachers, this is a game changer for your students. I am a professional cellist and teacher. I had the mother of my 6 year old student order this for our little cellist. I have not been impressed with other products in the past, but this looked like it was worth a shot. It's much easier to assemble and lighter than a similar animal themed product- hint, hint. Despite the bulk, it was comfortable in my hand and in her tiny hand. You can pop it on and off with ease. I will never use the beginner thumb on the ferrule bow hold again. I will forever start my students with this gadget. In her 30 minute lesson she graduated to a "real" bow hold with and without the grip aid. I could see the instant change from her fingers to her elbow and shoulder positioning. Hallelujah!! I am ordering one or two for my studio. I think it will be a wonderful aid for my experienced students struggling with bad habits they developed before getting into private lessons. If I was still teaching orchestra in the public schools I would purchase a classroom set. I will definitely be recommending this to my Youth Orchestra cellists.

hypo_0: Učitelé, tohle pro vaše studenty zcela mění pravidla hry. Jsem profesionální violoncellista/ka a učitel/ka. Nechal/a jsem matku své šestileté studentky, aby to pro naši malou violoncellistku objednala. V minulosti na mě jiné produkty neudělaly velký dojem, ale tento vypadal, že stojí za vyzkoušení. Sestavuje se mnohem snadněji a je lehčí než podobný produkt se zvířecím motivem – nápověda, nápověda. Navzdory své velikosti byl pohodlný v mé ruce i v její maličké ručce. Dá se snadno nasadit a sundat. Už nikdy nepoužiji držení smyčce pro začátečníky s palcem na kování. Své studenty už navždy budu učit začínat s touto pomůckou. Během své třicetiminutové lekce přešla na „skutečné“ držení smyčce s touto pomůckou i bez ní. Viděl/a jsem okamžitou změnu od jejích prstů až po polohu lokte a ramene. Haleluja!! Objednávám jeden nebo dva kusy pro své studio. Myslím, že to bude skvělá pomůcka pro mé zkušené studenty, kteří bojují se zlozvyky, které si vytvořili předtím, než začali chodit na soukromé lekce. Kdybych stále učil/a orchestr na státních školách, koupil/a bych sadu pro celou třídu. Rozhodně to budu doporučovat svým violoncellistům v mládežnickém orchestru.

source_doc: In anticipation of using, I'm going to say it's right up there with Hydroflask. My family owns too many water bottles and most of them are hydroflasks. We've got a few eco vessels and a few generic throw around ones. But I wanted to be different so that I would know it's mine... My wife might try and claim it as hers like she did with another hydroflask bottle I bought.I really like the size and the wide mouth opening and the chug cap. The wide mouth when you have the chug cap off makes it super easy to fill with ice and drink. It's wider than the hydroflask wide mouth bottles. The chug cap is really easy to take off. It has a grippy edge to it.Having had the handle cap for the hydroflasks, I think I can honestly say I like the yeti design better. A solid shape as opposed to having it swivel. I prefer the solid shape.Even though I haven't used it yet I have no doubt that it will perform as well with hot and cold as the hydroflask bottles. I plan on using this for travel and of course those hot summer days on the golf course.The picture doesn't do the color justice. It looks better than the picture. I'd definitely get another so I can have 2 in a rotation... Just a different color.

source_doc: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L  Transfer case switch perfect  replacement. I was stuck and put my truck 4low, and a service 4wd light came on. Once I was no longer stuck, I shifted it back to 2wd hi, and the dash said I was in 4 hi. So I wanted to see if it was in 4wd. I put my truck in my yard and stomped it, and of course, I was actually in 2wd. I placed it in 4wd and stomped it I was in 4w drive. My truck is a manual floor shift for the transfer case if that helps anybody, which means no electronic actuator to replace for 529.00, just a sensor (Dorman 600-555 ) for 83.00 at Autozone or 60.00 at amazon. I would purchase it again and I suggest going to Harbor freight tools for a 1-1/2-inch spanner wrench or the spanner wrench set for 65.00. the Spanner wrench would fit in the space much better than huge combo wrench. it took only 25 minutes to remove and install please use dielectric grease in the switch plug to keep water out.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: 2012 RAM 2500 ST 6.7L – Dokonalá náhrada za spínač rozdělovací převodovky. Uvízl/a jsem a přepnul/a náklaďák na 4low a rozsvítila se kontrolka servisu 4wd. Jakmile už jsem nebyl/a uvízlý/á, přeřadil/a jsem zpět na 2wd hi, ale na palubní desce svítilo, že jsem ve 4 hi. Takže jsem chtěl/a zjistit, jestli jsem opravdu ve 4wd. Najel/a jsem s náklaďákem na dvůr a šlápl/a na to, a samozřejmě jsem byl/a ve skutečnosti ve 2wd. Zařadil/a jsem 4wd a šlápl/a na to, a byl/a jsem ve 4wd. Můj náklaďák má manuální řazení rozdělovací převodovky na podlaze, pokud to někomu pomůže, což znamená, že nemusím měnit žádný elektronický člen za 529,00, ale jen senzor (Dorman 600-555) za 83,00 v Autozone nebo za 60,00 na Amazonu. Koupil/a bych si ho znovu a doporučuji zajít do Harbor Freight Tools pro 1-1/2palcový klíč na matice nebo sadu klíčů za 65,00. Tento klíč se do toho prostoru vejde mnohem lépe než obrovský kombinovaný klíč. Demontáž a montáž zabraly pouhých 25 minut, do konektoru spínače prosím použijte dielektrické mazivo, aby se dovnitř nedostala voda.

Chtěl/a jsem tedy zjistit, jestli pohon všech kol opravdu funguje. Najel/a jsem s autem na dvůr a šlápl/a na plyn, a samozřejmě jsem byl/a ve skutečnosti jen na pohon dvou kol. Zařadil/a jsem pohon všech kol a šlápl/a na to – a byl/a jsem ve 4wd. Koupil/a bych si ho znovu a doporučuji zajít do Harbor Freight Tools pro 1-1/2palcový plochý klíč nebo sadu klíčů za 65,00. source_doc: Used for cabinets, WATER DOWN YOUR PAINT. I have never sprayed paint before and I bought this for a laundry room project to paint unfinished Home Depot cabinets.At first I hated this thing, it only has 1 PSI setting and it blows HARD. First pass with sanding sealer was a nightmare and resulted in large bubbles and all of my (quickly applied) masking tape and plastic getting blown off.Then I switched to paint and I kept getting speckles and not enough paint. I was about to give up and just roll the cabinets with paint, but after a huge mess and lot of trial an error I found that watering my paint down MUCH more than recommended worked great. You'll still see speckles or even globs of paint, but they dry fine and are not noticeable at all.I was using .5cup of water with the paint inside of the container (Sherwin Williams cabinet paint) of the gun and what I found to work perfectly was about 60% paint, 40% distilled water in the container. I had much better results and after 3 coats with sanding in between they looked awesome.I finished the cabinets with 2 coats of Minwax Polycrylic and they came out great. There are some remaining drips from my first coat of sanding sealer that I missed when sanding so I would just be careful to not apply too much and test a lot on cardboard.

hypo_0: Používá se na skříňky, ROZŘEĎTE BARVU VODOU. Nikdy předtím jsem barvu nestříkal/a a toto jsem si koupil/a na projekt v prádelně na nalakování nedokončených skříněk z Home Depot. První vrstva se základním tmelem pod lak byla noční můra a vyústila ve velké bubliny a odfouknutí veškeré mé (rychle nanesené) maskovací pásky a fólie. source_doc: Genuinely Emotional. I can't even begin to describe the wonderful feeling I got when I first used this serum &... Zero Contact Dermatitis!!! None, not even a single red mark. I almost cried! I was SO nervous...I spent months in hell before I figured out I was allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid... I was exhausted, my life was a mess & I had no idea what was causing it or how many products I owned that contained it (topical AND consumable) or were cross contaminated with it (Curology, my Electrolyte Powder, my Vitamins... I was heartbroken)! Ever since discovering my allergy, I've felt like I was on the same exact skincare odyssey I went through in my mid 20's only worse. It's been stressful & filled with a lot of disappointment plus wasted money.But to find THIS product.... Who was the BEAUTIFUL human that thought of this? Bless you!!! There aren't ENOUGH hypoallergenic options in general, but let me tell you... There are almost NO hypoallergenic Vitamin C products!!! They are RARE... & This is one of them. If you're allergic to synthetic ascorbic acid like I am, buy this. Your skin will thank you & you'll feel the deep sense of gratitude that SOMEONE out there cared enough about us.

I appreciate caution, but THIS PACkAGING NEEDS TO BE REVIEWED AND REVISED. I have had throat cancer and cannot swallow the large-sized pills that I have taken for many years,  at my doctors’ recommendation. I would prefer chewables (I am NOT a fan of gummies) but I cannot find the option of chewables. However, the “safety cap” (which as an adult I don’t feel that I need) is IMPOSSIBLE to open. This situation NEEDS SERIOUS review. I doubt that I am the only person with arthritic hands who has experienced this difficulty. I DO HOPE someone of concern and decision making powers will see this review and address this situation. (P.S. I am NOT a child NOR am I a mentally incapacitated adult who needs “society’s protection”!)AMENDMENT to REVIEW: This product is UNRETURNABLE … THEREFORE, I AM STUCK WITH A BOTTLE OF GUMMIES THAT I CANNOT OPEN‼️‼️‼️

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a"

source_doc: Love it! My old knob had been slipping on my genuine leather Wheel Skins cover, even though I used the optional rubber strips. I replaced this cover with a wonderfully plush, inexpensive leather-like cover. The ad for the XL spinner urged me to measure before I ordered. Out of laziness, I did not, and I had to return the regular-size knob for an XL. Installation was a bit of a hassle because the supplied small L-shaped Allen wrench had to be used upside down and out of sight. I wished I had a tool like a screwdriver handle with an Allen wrench attached. I think I did the final tightening by attaching the Allen wrench to a vice grip. I am male, but I have never been as strong as some. I love the XL knob! It operates so smoothly, like a precision instrument with ball bearings. The large, flat head provides secure, excellent control. It does NOT slip, and I wouldn't hesitate to bet it never will. This product is the cat's pajamas!

source_doc: Just what I need. I have just gotten it all set up in our bedroom, so haven’t had a chance to really see how it is in the long run, but I am hopeful. We both use CPAPs and of course living in the Midwest, the furnace has been running for months, and it is dry as a bone in the house. I also have Autoimmune Dry Eye Disease, with an overlay of moderate TED (Thyroid Eye Disease), so the dryness is kind of a big deal.I got a different one last year and after I got it i went over instructions. Dear sweet Jesus, it was the most picky, intricate, PIA humidifier-thing I have ever seen. Use special water (not just distilled), and fill this other hole with whatever-the-hell (more special c**p) and be sure to run this, flip that, push this and dance around it in goatskin chaps in hopes of getting humidity.I have very high hopes for my dry, scratchy eyes, mouth so dry my tongue has to be peeled from the roof of my mouth, cracked lips, dry skin, and itchy face and hands. I haven’t had it long enough to to fall to my knees in joy and say “OMG it is the miracle I was looking for” but I bet I will in about two-four weeks.Humidity for EVERYBIDDY!!!

Mám opravdu velká očekávání ohledně svých suchých, pálících očí, úst tak vysušených, že musím jazyk doslova odlepovat od patra, popraskaných rtů, suché kůže a svědícího obličeje a rukou. Nemám ho ještě dost dlouho na to, abych padl/a na kolena radostí a zvolal/a: „Můj bože, to je zázrak, který jsem hledal/a,“ ale vsadím se, že tak za dva až čtyři týdny se dočkám. Vlhkost pro VŠECHNY!!!

source_doc: Good starter keyboard. I have never owned or played any type of musical instrument. So I can't really attest to the quality of the sound. In my opinion,  this is a good starter keyboard. I decided on the 61 key option. I didn't want to buy an expensive one seeing as I am a beginner. I was worried I might not use it as often as I was thinking of in my head when I ordered it. I don't see that you can add a sustain pedal to this one. See my photo. But I am having fun learning on it. I think it is overall pretty good for the price.

source_doc: Hard to press keys. I bought the newer black widow on Dec 23rd 2021 and had it until I bought this one in October of 2022, due to the black widow having a sticky spacebar situation and whenever I hit keys around a and a itself, it would constantly add an a next to the other one to look like leaaving, laake, the like... you probably get the drift.Now only having had this one since October and the other one only lasting 10ish months before I went crazy enough to replace it, the keys on my Ornata are really hard to press down on at times. I can't just do a normal soft typing, I have to force it down with effort when trying to type and that's like half my keys on this keyboard... I didn't spill anything on this keyboard either. I don't know why it is like that. It is driving me crazy though.I am pretty disappointed in razor. I used to recommend them, but two keyboards in a row that aren't making it a whole year? One not even barely half a year? I can't recommend their keyboards anymore. For that I am sad.

source_doc: I do love this water bottle. I found this water bottle at a great deal when I was looking to add a new one to my collection. I love the colors - and there were a ton to choose from. The motivational writing on the sides is cute and I know works for some people. I don't necessarily follow them strictly during the day, but they do help to keep you a bit on track for water consumption. The outside has a good grip, even if you have melting ice trying to form some condensation. The handle is also great for carrying it around. It fits into most cupholders in the car or even in a backpack side pocket. The lid has been great for keeping the water inside the bottle and not leaking. I love the ease of pressing the button and having the spout pop up. The only thing I'm not a huge fan of is it is a little difficult to clean the straw. I haven't tried to force it from the lid because I don't want to break it. But I don't think you can detach it from the lid. I'm just extra vigilant about regular rinsing and soaking in hot soapy water and hoping no mildew or mold ends up growing in there. Overall a great water bottle and probably one of my favorites from the many I have tried.

source_doc: Love the scent. First thing I do on any new shampoo or conditioner is smell it to see if it smells nice.  Both the conditioner and shampoo passed with flying colors.Shampoo first.  I like a squeeze bottle over a pump.  I just feel that I can utilize the entire bottle over a pump bottle.  Shampoo did lather nice.  Again, I liked the smell of it as I was washing my hair.Rinsed off and left my hair feeling clean.  Not the dry squeaky type of clean.  A nice soft clean.I then put on the conditioner before I washed up so it would sit in my hair for a few minutes before rinsing.  Like the shampoo, I loved the scent.Nice thicker conditioner.Rinsed off and towel dried my hair.  It didn't get every tangle out but I could tell I had less tangling.  I have very long hair so it's close to impossible to not have a few tangles.My hair felt soft and smelled so nice.  Even after blowing it a little dry, it felt soft.Once I straightened it, my hair feels like silk.  I love it.Price is a little on the higher end.  But ,the bottles are large and with not having to use as much as some other hair products this should last quite awhile.  So price can be comparable.

source_doc: So glad I found this!!! I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Tak moc rád/a jsem to našel/našla!!! Již více než 20 let trpím bolestmi ramen a krku. Dávám to za vinu především velkému množství práce v zákaznickém servisu a letům telefonování se zákazníky před příchodem náhlavních souprav (kdy jsem musel/a telefon držet ramenem u ucha). Neustále hledám dobrou vyhřívací podložku a masážní přístroj. Používal/a jsem standardní vyhřívací podložku (obdélníkovou), ale byl/a jsem nesmírně nadšený/á, že mohu vyzkoušet tuto. Líbí se mi, že je vyrobená na míru přímo na bolest ramen. Jakmile si ji nasadím, obepne mi záda, krk i ramena a dodává úžasné teplo. Teplo je distribuováno rovnoměrně a má několik nastavení, aby mi poskytlo přesně to, co potřebuji. Líbí se mi, že tato vyhřívací podložka pokrývá celou oblast, se kterou potřebuji pomoci. Vřele doporučuji každému, kdo hledá skvělou vyhřívací podložku na horní část zad, krk a ramena!

source_doc: i waited a little while to see how they would stand up - good. I used these spikes a little differently than most as I wanted to use them to string power up into a light and get it high in the air so I could use my ride on lawn mover underneath.  They assembled very easily and are sturdy and weighty.  I'm 6ft tall and even with my hand in the air as high as it could go i was several inches down from the top so they really are very tall and kids wouldn't come anywhere near to the top.I put it in the ground and in the two months or so since I put them up they haven't moved an inch.  they still look great with no signs of rust or any defect.  I think these are a great item for stringing lights and cables and work really well.  I would say it obviously helps if you have solid ground to put them in and I also liked that it came with retention straps so you could secure it to a fence or post.  I didn't need then for my application and they are just freestanding.  but like I said, very good product and well made.

source_doc: This is your sign to BUY THIS NOW! Especially if you’re a RESELLER! I thought I bought an amazing fabric shaver back in 2020. I figured some of the pills and bobbles that it didn’t remove were just something I couldn’t fix. But when it stopped dropping the shavings into its chamber and remained stuck on top, resulting in me having to empty and clean it every 10 seconds, I had enough.O M G. This thing is AMAZING! I will say I was upset when I first got it because I thought it was rechargeable, but the wire it comes with is long enough where it is not any trouble to use.When I first used it on a silky satin dress that the other shaver refused to remove little pills on, I thought for sure I was doing something wrong! It worked IN AN INSTANT. I thought I surely was just not seeing the pilling that was just there, and moved it into another light. Nope, it was gone! And it didn’t ruin my silky dress either!I am so in love with this and only regret that I didn’t buy this sooner

source_doc: Okay cheap grinder. I've been getting into whole bean coffee here recently and I wanted something that I could fine-tune better than an electric grinder so I got this.  It came packaged just fine and I didn't see any defects or dings on the grinder.  It is basically 3 main pieces the handle which has a plastic knob, the grinder which has all the guts, and the collection bin which catches your grounds.  I got a whole bean that I hadn't tried before and loaded it up and got to grinding.  The grinding while okay didn't feel that great and I had to put a bit more muscle behind it than I had to for my other grinder.  Cleaning it was a breeze, it says not to get it wet so I took it most way apart (I left the grinder guts in) and took my electronic duster, and just blew it out.  For how cheap this is it does its job well I'll probably take this one with me when I go on trips because if it gets lost or broken eh no big deal, but if you want one for home I would spend a couple of bucks more.

source_doc: A simple lamp that brings beauty! Since receiving & writing my original review of the defective lamp I received the seller contacted me & offered a replacement. This lamp fully functioned! My picture reflects its beauty! The lamp is easy to put together. Instructions come with it. First you put the lightbulb in & then you tighten the top on. The cord has a flip switch on it. The cord is of a generous length. I have a warm low voltage lightbulb in the lamp as you see. I’m happy I was given a chance to appreciate this lamp’s beauty. For the price it is of quality. I now do recommend!My original review: I was looking forward to using this lamp for the top of my desk. With excellent reviews I thought I found a gem. Unfortunately upon placing a lightbulb in it it wouldn’t turn on. I thought the lightbulb was dead but sure enough a new lightbulb didn’t work either. It was defective in some way. For as much as I loved it’s beauty I returned as defective. I didn’t trust purchasing another one. A disappointment. I don’t recommend.

 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

source_doc: Good for quick cleaning. This electric spinning scrubber is really good for quick cleanings. I'm not a fan of cleaning the tub and this helps to move things along. Getting pretty good at it now! :-) I have used products from SereneLife in the past and have been happy with them, so I chose these. Nice case/heater combo. Well thought out. Easy controls.

source_doc: So awesome probably for everyone. I just started to learn how to play. I bought this back in august and it has been amazing. I find it easier to learn to play a song if the guitar sounds like what I’m attempting to emulate. There is no sound this thing can not produce and with the preconfigured sets that users put out it’s an endless supply of sounds. From Hendrix to Freddy Fender. When I purchased it I thought it was the 100% cordless one. It was not so I just went ahead and bought that smaller one too. I hate cords, and with my wireless sender / receiver and the smaller spark it’s going to be so freeing to go anywhere. Now if you’re new like me you will love this I promise. I matter who you are. If you’re a pro I am not sure but I am sure you would probably enjoy this as well. Also for such a small amp it packs a hell of a sound. Must buy.

Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a"

hypo_0: Naprosto skvělé asi pro každého. Teprve jsem se začal/a učit hrát. Koupil/a jsem si to v srpnu a je to úžasné. source_doc: Good for GI issues. I decided to try this food for my APT, who was having intermittent diarrhea.  I initially thought it was related to NSAIDs, as she needs them daily for arthritis.  At wits end, I tried stopping the NSAIDS as a last resort, as I also tried MANY supplements and changed her food, with still no signs of her loose stools resolving.  Chicken and rice helped the most, but I knew she couldn't stay on it forever.  My dog's only symptom was diarrhea.  Her appetite and energy were normal (both over the top) and she would have formed stools as often as diarrhea.  Her weight remained unchanged.At the time I switched to Dave's dry food, I was feeding our dog Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon dry food and white fish wet food.  I didn't realize these were grain free, as I was focused on the "basic" part of the food.  In chatting with a vet, I learned that sometimes grain free diets in dogs can lead to intermittent diarrhea.  After  much research of good quality and affordable dog food for sensitive systems, I came across Dave's Pet Food and decided to try it.  Within a month our dog was back to having consistent formed stools, even while taking her NSAIDS.  I would highly recommend this food for dogs with sensitive systems and GI issues.

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Skvělé na gastrointestinální potíže. Rozhodl/a jsem se vyzkoušet toto krmivo pro svého amerického pitbulteriéra, který trpěl občasným průjmem. Původně jsem si myslel/a, že to souvisí s nesteroidními antirevmatiky (NSAID), protože je potřebuje denně na artritidu. Už v naprostém zoufalství jsem se jako k poslední možnosti uchýlil/a k vysazení NSAID, protože jsem také vyzkoušel/a MNOHO doplňků stravy a změnil/a jí krmivo, ale stále se neobjevily žádné známky toho, že by se její řídká stolice upravila. Nejvíce pomohlo kuře s rýží, ale věděl/a jsem, že na tom nemůže být věčně. Jediným příznakem mého psa byl průjem. Její chuť k jídlu a energie byly v normálu (obojí na rozdávání) a formovanou stolici měla stejně často jako průjem. Její váha zůstávala nezměněná. V době, kdy jsem přešel/přešla na suché krmivo Dave's, jsem našeho psa krmil/a granulemi Blue Buffalo Basics Salmon a mokrým krmivem s bílou rybou. Neuvědomil/a jsem si, že jsou bezobilné, protože jsem se soustředil/a na slovo „basics“ (základní) v názvu krmiva. source_doc: Versatile and the perfect size, I wish the keycaps were transparent. I really like this size in a portable keyboard. It's small enough that it'll fit easily in a backpack but big enough to have cursor and function keys. All it's missing is the number pad and I can always get a standalone one of those for the occasions that I need it.This keyboard connected very easily with the included cable, dongle and also over Bluetooth. I noticed no typing lag in any mode, but I wasn't using it to play games. The dongle slips into a little pocket underneath the keyboard to reduce the chance that it gets lost. The included instructions are brief but comprehensive.The keys feel great to type on. You can definitely tell you hit the key but it's not super loud like some other mechanical keyboards. The spacebar makes a different and louder sound, but I like that too.There are plenty of backlighting options, and the keyboard remembers the last one you set. My biggest complaint is that the keycaps are not transparent, so it's harder to identify the keys in the dark. A minor quibble is that I don't like the side-by-side notation for shifted keys, I prefer when the shifted key shows up over top of the non-shifted key.Overall, I think this is a great portable keyboard with a lot of versatility in connections. I only wish the keycaps were transparent.

source_doc: I keep coming back to this foundation. I’ve tried other foundations over the years but seem to always come back to this one. I have fair skin and use the L1 ivory color. My skin is also sensitive and I honestly find this somewhat soothing.No fragrance, not too thin (I do like some coverage for my uneven skin and some minor scarring) but not too thick. It actually glides on very smoothly with my make-up sponge. It easily smooths into the hair line and blends well over the chin-to-neck area. No obvious borders from skin color to make up, so I know it’s a good color match for me.I like the pump feature for ease of putting on my sponge (I never apply foundation with my fingers), but I do hate leaving product in the bottle when it gets low. I typically save a “low” bottle and then when my next bottle gets low, I stand one on top of the other to hopefully drip down into the bottom bottle. There is still some waste, but at least I’m getting the use of more product. I think there are even small make-up “spatulas” out there, so perhaps I will try that.I dislike spending money on high-end make-up, and I find this is a quality brand and good value. I highly recommend.

hypo_0: K tomuto make-upu se neustále vracím. V průběhu let jsem vyzkoušel/a i jiné make-upy, ale zdá se, že se vždycky vrátím k tomuto. Mám světlou pleť a používám odstín L1 ivory. Moje pleť je navíc citlivá a upřímně mi tento produkt přijde tak trochu zklidňující. Bez parfemace, není příliš tekutý (mám rád/a určité krytí pro svou nejednotnou pleť a drobné jizvičky), ale ani příliš hutný. Pomocí kosmetické houbičky se nanáší opravdu velmi hladce. Nerad/a utrácím peníze za luxusní kosmetiku a tohle považuji za kvalitní značku za dobrou cenu. Velmi doporučuji.

source_doc: Good keyboard for the money. This keyboard feels really good for the price point. I like the somewhat stiff action and the quiet clicking sounds. I enjoy using this keyboard and I use it all day. I have not tried it for gaming yet but for the everyday tasks that I do while working. My son tried it out with some games and he said it was pretty good. The RGB lights are fun, but they do not add a lot for me personally. I may just be too old to enjoy that stuff. ;)  I have two things that I wish were different. First, the indicator lights that show Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock are not very bright. They are white labels with white lights, and I can barely tell if they are on or not due to the reflection of my overhead lights. With all the RGB on the keyboard, I wish these indicator lights were bolder. Also, I was excited about having a keyboard for my PC that had mute and audio controls on it. Unfortunately, I have not found any way to invert the function keys so that I can use the audio controls without also holding down the FN key. The FN Lock just locks the whole keyboard which isn’t all that helpful on a desktop compared to its usefulness on a laptop, if those two items were fixed, I would give this keyboard a five-star rating.

source_doc: Absolutely Luxurious. I have been singing the praises of Andy Pandy diapers for six years and you could not have paid me to use anything else. Until the size large were out of stock for months. I had no choice but to find something similar and I did when I came across Eco Boom. Then for a reason I cannot recall I was on the hunt again. These diapers were on sale and oh how I wish I had been able to purchase more because they are the best diaper I have ever put my hands on. The feel absolutely divine, almost too good to be something a little human poops on. I have had no issues with leaking and they hold pee just as well as the other bamboo diapers I have mentioned here. They are out of my price point but if I they ever go on sale again I will be back. If you can afford them, I highly recommend these diapers.

source_doc: Great. I haven't put together many things in my life and I did this so I would say it was fairly easy.  It was harder logistically to get it together than it was to figure it out (getting the screws in odd places and holding bars until I could get the screws on and tightened enough that things weren't falling).  I read some reviews about not tightening all screws until the end and that helped.One thing I found odd, when I went to tighten the screws, the metal frame bent from the force of the screws.  I'm not all that strong and didn't torque on them as hard as I could so I didn't expect that.  I was a little nervous that I had messed up (I still am), but I loaded it up with weights and it seems OK.  It's not super strong, like I can push on it and feel it move a little, but it's not wobbly so I'm hoping it's OK.

source_doc: Seemed great until I realized how off it was. I thought this would be the best thermometer ever because it can quietly read a sleeping child’s temp or easily read another child’s temp without contact. We have had this thermometer for 6 months and I thought it was reading accurately the whole time (we have used it maybe 10-15 times) and battery is still great. But when I took my 6 month old’s temp it kept saying 98 or 99 and I just KNEW she felt hotter than that. So I got our the trusty rectal thermometer and sure enough it read 4° higher! I understand it being a decimal off but FOUR DEGREES? That’s unacceptable. I wish I would have done this test months ago so I could have returned it! I got this thermometer because it had thousands of great reviews!

source_doc: Better than the Toyota factory links. My elderly Toyota had a rattle that I had a lot of trouble pinning down.  It would happen as I went over some bumps but not others.  It would act up so intermittently that I couldn't figure it out.  After a lot of driving around and head-scratching I finally narrowed it down to a worn out front sway bar link on the passenger side.The factory Toyota links are non-greasable.  Mine lasted almost 200k miles which is certainly a good track record, but when it came time to replace them one of the reasons I chose the Moog parts is because I can grease them.Yeah, I know suspension grease nipples have gone the way of vent windows and manual door locks.  Modern suspension components are Lubed For Life (yeah right) and last a long time.  Except when they don't.  Besides, I don't mind hitting a dozen fittings with the grease gun once every few months.So I bought the Moog links, installed them, and pumped them full of grease.  It's been a few years and almost 100k miles and the Moogs are still going strong.  I think I've lubed them twice in all that time (so much for those grease fittings) but they're as quiet and slop-free as they ever were.If I ever manage to wear out the links again, I'll buy another set of Moogs.

Jo, já vím, že maznice na podvozku dopadly stejně jako větrací okénka a manuální zámky dveří. Moderní podvozkové díly mají doživotní náplň (no jasně, určitě) a vydrží dlouho. Tedy kromě případů, kdy tomu tak není. Navíc mi nevadí jednou za pár měsíců vzít mazací lis a promazat tucet míst. Takže jsem koupil/a tyčky Moog, namontoval/a je a napumpoval/a je vazelínou. Je to už několik let a téměř 100 000 mil a tyčky Moog stále skvěle drží. Myslím, že za celou tu dobu jsem je promazal/a jen dvakrát (tolik k těm maznicím), ale jsou stále stejně tiché a bez vůlí jako na začátku. Pokud se mi někdy podaří tyto tyčky znovu opotřebovat, rozhodně si koupím další sadu od Moogu.

source_doc: Nothing special. I had never tried this scent before, but I read about it. I found the history aspect of it interesting. It was cheap enough, so I ordered it. Once I smelled it, I tossed it in the trash. I would say the scent is familiar, but not sure from where. The scent is not terrible, but I don't find it pleasant. I smelled my wrist a little while later to see if it would grow on me, and the smell wasn't even there. So not only doesn't it smell great, it doesn't last an hour. I would not recommend buying this unless you have smelled it in person. I was going to see if one of my family members wanted it, but I was actually so confident that nobody would like it that I tossed it.

source_doc: Batteries. So far I do like this wet vac. I've discovered that if I don't run a dust mop over the floors first, the "suction pipe needs cleaning" command is given. If I dust mop first, I totally avoid needing to stop, dump dirty water, flush out dirty water tank, and then resume. If I don't dust mop first, I need to rinse the "suction pipe" maybe 4-5 times. After self-cleaning, I do take a rag and hand dry the rollers, they're pretty wet! Also, I find every time that there's material that needs to be wiped out of the roller compartments, and where outlet where the dirty water is conduited into the suction pipe of the dirty water chamber. I have a question in to the seller as to how to change out the rechargeable batteries. I looked everywhere, called Amazon, and they gave me a link to do this. All that being said...it's STILL steps above my old mop and pail! I am not regretting the purchase, which was made a couple of months ago...

source_doc: So far this bed is awesome! At 5'9" with a model like frame, I had to get help with the box b/c it's weighs more than I do.After that, opening it and placing it on the platform was easy.  As soon as I removed the plastic, the bed started to inflation. It took 24hrs to get to its full size. The smell dissipated once the bed fully inflated.It took my body about three weeks to adjust to it.  I thought it was too firm at first but it turned out to be just right.I have a metal platform frame and it sits well without sliding even though I have additional space on the frame.  Pics will come soon.  I had the bed for about 6-8 weeks and I love it.  I also noticed that I don't have back pain or feel stiff when I wake up.The price was exceptional.This is a great buy if you follow directions to the T.  Check back for an update in April 2023.

source_doc: Stopped working after a the first time using.  I paid for shipping on the replacement. I got this as a present so that I can have radio with my partner whilst biking.  I received it for Christmas and live in a winter wonderland so I only tried this once and it worked fine.  Then the weather finally got bearable to bike and low and behold it did not work.  It was passed the time to return it to Amazon so I had to try to get a replacement from Senna.  After a few weeks of back and forth I finally received an RMA but I had to pay shipping.  Maybe this is standard but it is really disappointing that I have to pay out of pocket for a product that is defective.Sound quality is not good but I guess I should have expected it.  No base and only really good for the spoken word.  It tells you to download the app but the only thing the app is good for is the instructions.The helmet itself looks nice and fits comfortably.If I could do it all again I would choose a different company.

source_doc: Woks well for fine, straight hair. This is one of the better hair masks that I've found at this price point for my super fine, straight hair. While I wouldn't say it makes a hugely dramatic impact, it's noticeably stronger than regular conditioner. It adds a bit of shine, detangles, and makes my hair more manageable overall. I really struggle with volume, so the fact that this smoothes without flattening is a huge win for me. I also like that I can see its benefits while sticking to my extremely basic hair care routine. I use my normal shampoo and conditioner beforehand and simply comb and air dry afterwards.It does work a bit slower than similar treatments I've used, so I always make sure to thoroughly saturate my hair and leave it on for at least 7 minutes. If I rinse it much sooner, I don't notice the full effects. A little goes a long way though. I start with a small glob to avoid wasting it and usually add a little extra to my ends, as they tend to dry out. It doesn't magically fix split ends, but they do seem to occur less often when I use this mask a few times a week. One tub lasts me several months that way. I think it's a good value overall and will continue purchasing it!

source_doc: Can I give these more than 5 stars?! I love the convenience of using a Swiffer for quick clean-ups.  I have four rescue dogs and foster frequently too so I definitely use my Swiffer a lot.  But let's face it, the Swiffer doesn't really do a great job of cleaning.  In one area of my house, I have tile that was put down years ago before it became more popular to use the larger tiles (my tiles are probably only 12" tiles so I have lots of grout).  The Swiffer doesn't seem to really get down in the grout to clean.  I bought these reusable pads mainly because I thought they would be cheaper in the long run.  An unexpected huge bonus was finding how much better they actually work than the disposable Swiffer pads!  These pads are thick and absorbent.  They make it a tad bit harder to push your Swiffer around but the results are so much better and worth the extra effort!  I haven't tried to wash them yet. I have only just rinsed them off and reused them but will wash them soon and update if I have any issues (but I don't anticipate any problem with them). They do come with instructions telling you not to use fabric softener on them - just an FYI. So glad I ordered these and I will definitely order more!

hypo_0: Můžu tomuhle dát víc než 5 hvězdiček?! Miluju pohodlí při používání Swifferu na rychlý úklid. Mám čtyři zachráněné psy a často také dočasně pečuju o další, takže Swiffer rozhodně používám hodně. Ale buďme k sobě upřímní, Swiffer ve skutečnosti neuklízí zrovna skvěle. V jedné části domu mám dlažbu položenou před lety, než se stalo populárnějším používat větší dlaždice (moje dlaždice mají pravděpodobně jen 30 cm, takže mám spoustu spár). Nezdá se, že by se Swiffer dostal až do spár, aby je vyčistil. Tyto opakovaně použitelné utěrky jsem koupil/a hlavně proto, že jsem si myslel/a, že z dlouhodobého hlediska vyjdou levněji. Nečekaným obrovským bonusem bylo zjištění, o kolik lépe ve skutečnosti fungují než jednorázové utěrky Swiffer! Tyto utěrky jsou silné a savé. Sice se s nimi Swiffer tlačí o trochu hůře, ale výsledky jsou o tolik lepší a stojí to za tu námahu navíc! Ještě jsem se je nepokusil/a vyprat. source_doc: Just what I wanted. I had a jump rope but I didn’t like the super light jump rope cord on it. I needed something a little heavier that I don’t have to spin at a thousand miles an hour to make it track straight. This kit is fantastic, I trimmed the medium cord (the black one) to the size in needed with the included tools and took off using it like I’ve owned it forever because it felt so natural. The medium is perfect for me but I will also trim the other two cords to the same length so I can mix it up now and again. I have nothing but good things to say about this set, the handles are comfortable and spin well, the quick release system works well, all three included cords seem high quality and the case is nice. The extra set screws and Allen wrench were a nice touch and the cable cutters are so nice they are going right in my tool box after I get my other two cords sized. In my opinion this jump rope set is a great value and I can recommend this without reservation.

source_doc: Perfect fit for SRX 2012 13582688...Why I remember this number? Because this was the BCM number in my SRX, and I had a hard time finding it new. That was also before I learned EEPROM...anyways. I saw this one, and it was reasonable, I tried to google to see if it will work, no clear answer. I finally contacted Cadillac and they told me yes it fits, then I purchased it. I did have hard time to get the car start even after programming the part, then I copied the EEPROM from my old BCM, wrote that in the chip, it showed "EEPROM PROGRAM INCORRECT". So what to do? I just ran SPS2 and reprogrammed the BCM again, then everything worked. Car started fine, most of the error message is gone on the dash. That was great! Then I purchased ALLDATA subscription, and under the BCM replacement, it showed this one as the only one fit for my car. So happy!
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

To bylo také předtím, než jsem se naučil/a EEPROM... ale to je jedno. Uviděl/a jsem tento díl a cena byla rozumná, zkusil/a jsem vyhledat na Googlu, jestli bude fungovat, ale žádná jasná odpověď. source_doc: Just what I needed. incremental degrees of lighting is helpful. I needed a lamp for my desk, so I was pleased to try this gooseneck lamp. It clamps onto the desk securely via a spinning C-clamp (as opposed to one you pinch to open). Since it can be tightened and loosened it is quite stable. I tried this lamp in different positions so I clamped it and reclamped it with no issues until I found exactly where I wanted it.I REALLY like that I can increase the light output incrementally (10 levels) from quite dim to nice and bright. There are also 3 different light modes: warm light (2700K), warm white light (4500K), and cool light (6500K). Each of these modes also can be increased/decreased incrementally. Really nice for helping prevent eye fatigue.The neck/arm is 24" and the light strip is 11". source_doc: A complete waste of time and money!! Do yourself a favor and look at other tankless rv units by OTHER manufacturers! The listing says that it will fit and opening but this is false! I originally purchased this to go in a travel trailer but it was entirely too small to fit in the opening. I never installed it but decided to hold on to it for my next RV. I recently purchased another RV and the existing water heater was shot so I got this unit out and placed it in the RV. The first time that I used it, it worked great!! I was pleased. The next morning when I tried to do dishes I kept getting an error code and the hot water would immediately shut down. When I very first turn the water on the sensor says that the water is 199 degrees so the unit thinks that the water is too hot. So, now I have to order and install a new temp sensor after using this unit 1 time! A ripoff. I can get no support or warranty repair because I purchased it 2 years ago even though it was kept in the box in new condition I have no support! A complete waste of time and $600.00.

source_doc: I bought a bunch of these and so far, so good. I bought an air purifier for each bedroom in my house and I have a big Winix downstairs to help combat our outrageous fur and dust issue. I like these little ones because they are really really quiet on low. The high setting is a little much sound-wise so I have to agree with other reviewers that there should be a medium setting to move more air but still be quiet. But I do keep them on low and they seem to collect plenty of stuff so I can't complain too much. The color is a little odd, but pleasant if you like blue. I can't comment on the sleep mode because I never use it. I just leave them on low at all times instead. I don't use the light up function either because I like my bedroom dark when I'm sleeping. Overall, I think that for the price, they are a good deal and every little bit helps in my house full of cats and dogs. I also like that you can get filters easily and it's made by a big name brand instead of a small company overseas that could stop offering filters at any time. I think this a good buy and I like them.

source_doc: Is not easy to assemble! I have had a pack and play in the past, easy to set up and take down.  I wish that I had that one back but I sold because I thought we were done with grandchildren.  To our surprise we have a new grandchild so I purchased the Dream On Me, because of the reviews.  The ease to set up and take down does not happen with this unit.  It took three of us to get it into a locked position so that we could lay the baby down.  I now am afraid to take down because I may not be able to get it set up again especially on my own.  I would look for another brand.I wish I could return however I didn't have a need to use until the child was 4 months old and I purchased right after her birth.  Not happy.

source_doc: So perfect, except.. I love so many things about this bag, but I didn’t end up keeping it because while it is beautiful and functional, I don’t feel like it will stay beautiful for long haha. The inside is a white satin - so pretty - but I have a 3 yo and 1 yo and my diaper bag is regularly filled with crumbs and wrappers and other things they throw in there on occasion, but to keep it short, I don’t want to stress about my beauty diaper bag getting dirty when it is my messiest season of life.Here are some things I absolutely loves though:- so pretty, obviously- so functional. I LOVE the inside space and how easy it is to see everything. I wish so much I could duplicate it on a less luxury bag lol- the hidden magnetic closure on the side pockets to keep them minimal when you’re not using them- the little front pocket for easy access to my keys/phone, though the opening kind of tight and hard to get intoOverall I love it, so much. But I can’t justify the spending for something that will ultimately be more or less trashed by the season of life that I’m in, and I don’t want to be stressin about the appearance of the inside of my diaper bag lol. hopefully one day I can come back for it :)

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Tak dokonalá, až na... Na této tašce miluji tolik věcí, ale nakonec jsem si ji nenechal/a, protože i když je krásná a funkční, nemám pocit, že by krásná vydržela dlouho, haha. Vnitřek je z bílého saténu – tak nádherný – ale mám tříleté a roční dítě a moje přebalovací taška je pravidelně plná drobků, obalů a dalších věcí, které mi tam občas hodí. Zkrátka a dobře, nechci se stresovat tím, že se moje krásná přebalovací taška ušpiní, když zrovna procházím tím nejšpinavějším obdobím svého života. Zde je několik věcí, které naprosto zbožňuji: - samozřejmě je tak krásná - je tak funkční. MILUJI vnitřní prostor a to, jak snadno je v ní vše vidět. Hrozně moc si přeji, abych to mohl/a zkopírovat na nějakou méně luxusní tašku, lol - skryté magnetické zapínání na bočních kapsách, díky kterému vypadají minimalisticky, když je zrovna nepoužíváte - malá přední kapsička pro snadný přístup ke klíčům/telefonu, i když otvor je trochu těsný a těžko se do něj dostává. Celkově ji naprosto miluji. source_doc: Least irritating shave I've had in a while. I didn't think there could be too much difference between these and the other razors I've purchased and have been using. While shaving, these seemed as good but no better than a new blade of the other brands I have. What surprised me, was afterwards when I was applying alum and expecting the burn I typically get there was none. I looked these up and the only thing I could tell that is different (from the details in the listing) is that the grind angle is different than other blades might use. This really does seem to make a difference as the next time I used them I experienced the same thing, and I know for a fact that burning is from the micro cuts you are getting when shaving. Alum on shaved skin exacerbates that burn, but with these so far there has been no burn. Hopefully I keep having the same luck, but I highly recommend these as a result!

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

Během holení se tyto zdály stejně dobré, ale ne lepší než nová čepelka jiných značek, které mám.
