source_doc: So convenient! My old pill organizer broke so I needed a new one. After comparing so many, this was my choice and I have been very happy with it. I don't actually take meds 3x daily, but in the morning I take vitamin C and biotin that are both chewables. So I put those in the center compartment. I love that the containers can be removed for travel when I might not need to pack the entire week's worth. I have had to come up with a way to easily fill these with my pills which is a little less convenient with the individual containers, but still worth it. I actually purchased 2 of these so that when I am filling them, I do both at the same time and don't have to deal with it as often.

source_doc: Best travel teacher bag ever. I spent years looking for this bag, I only wish it came in more colors.As a teacher I carry laptop, pens, planner, notebooks, snacks, and water bottles.  This is the only bag I have found that stays upright with my Stanley water and coffee cups.When I travel I want laptop, I pad, books, phone, purse, snacks, makeup, medicine, charging cords and cubes plus water bottles. Oh and the strap to put over suitcase handle that velcros when you don’t use it. I’m pretty sure I could use as a weekender or gym bag too.I Haven’t come close to using all the pockets.  I love the key lease in one of the big upside pockets.  Smaller two zip pockets perfect for phone. My large iPad Pro fits in outside pocket.It comes with a baby pad my cat sits on and a cute cloth wipe I clean my screen with.  I imagine those are awesome for diaper bag use.

source_doc: Nice to be able to order the buttons without the entire assembly... I use Straploks on all my basses. I have three straps, and each one has the male portion of the Straplok system. source_doc: Does not stay on well. I need to preface this review by saying that I am new to doing my nails at home. I have always been a nail biter and picker. So, before spending money on going to a salon and have my nails professionally done only to tear them up, I thought I would try it at home. I used this gel in particular to attach nail extensions to my natural nails. I then used a dip powder to polish them. During the entire process three nails came off very easily. I simply figured I had not used enough of the gel and replaced the nails using more gel. However, once all was said and done, and I was finished with the manicure, the nails still popped off quite easily. So in my very unexperienced opinion, this gel does not seem to stay on your natural nails very well. I still gave it three stars because it could entirely be user error on my part.

source_doc: Definitely worth a play at a discounted price. Feels like a PS2 era game in regards to voice acting and hack and slash combat but, it’s actually pretty challenging to master the combat in this game. You can actually do some pretty neat things with the gum and katana strung together. You can also hit and then guard cancel into another attack to save animation frames, the game never explains this but once you get a hang of the combat it’s actually a lot of fun.The huge issue I have personally for the game is that it is somewhat too difficult. I have played the game about 7 hours and beaten a couple of bosses and I understand the gameplay loop and how to play, I just feel the checkpoint system makes the game too challenging. The game itself is difficult, but I genuinely enjoy the combat and the challenge to some extent, I just need more checkpoints after completing a challenging area. Often times I will play through a 5-10 min section of the game, just to die and have to replay it, over, and over again. I feel like I really do enjoy how tough the combat feels because overall it feels fair, but it’s hard to not make many mistakes through the long combat sections and overall I ended up losing interest in the game prior to finishing it. I don’t want the Combat to be easier, I just need more checkpoints.

source_doc: Lasted longer than I thought. I teach a sport that requires me to pack food for 14 hour days on the weekend. I try to pack as lightly as possible because everything has to be transported with my on a bus and then into schools, it's a whole thing. Since I'm on a special diet I bring all my food for the day but I try to fit it all in one lunch bag. That was not really possible with those hard plastic ice packs that I would typically use. However, with these, they don't take up as much space and they still lasted me at least 8-10 hours and still felt cold.Do I think these will work well for more than 8-10 hrs? I don't think so. But if you are using these for school lunches I think they would do the trick. Because of their size they don't take up a lot of room so I was able to use both of them to make sure I could be near more than one item in the bag.I'll keep trying these each weekend and see if I can narrow down exactly how long they last but if they're well frozen and in a decent lunch bag you should be good to go.Also, I love the color of these. :-)

source_doc: Love them. I just purchased for a second time.Pros:I like these because they have a size 0 that is wide. These nails are durable and lasted me two weeks. (Of course that depends on how you apply your nails.)They come with a lot of nail sizes, which I like. I have wide width nail beds and their size 0 fits great. (Since I repetitively use the 4 & 5, I wish you could just order your sizes versus having extra sizes I cannot wear, but I get my money’s worth by using the extra nails to practice designs.)FYI, I use gel polish so it definitely makes them look professional. I did crack a nail after I took them off, but this was me putting a heavy object on them. Please do not think these nails are unbreakable, because they can. They are still very strong (not fragile) and did excellent for the two weeks.Lastly, I did not have any issues where I had to contact customer service so I cannot speak to that, but the product is good. I will buy again.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a" 
 2. for adjectives, e.g., "rád/a", "naštvaný/á", "veselý/á" 

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.  

 Example 1: "I am happy that I bought it" -> "Jsem rád/a, že jsem to koupil/a" 
 Example 2: "I never saw or heard it" -> "Nikdy jsem to neviděl/a ani neslyšel/a"

hypo_0: Miluji je. Právě jsem je koupil/a podruhé. Plusy: Líbí se mi, protože mají velikost 0, která je široká. Tyto nehty jsou odolné a vydržely mi dva týdny. source_doc: So far, so good. I received this yesterday, so I cannot speak to its long-term reliability.  However, I would like to make a few points.  It is smaller than described. About 4 inches wide instead of the 6.3 inches in the description, which fits nicely on my dash.  I chose the "warm light" color.  Gold really, and this fits well with my other dash lights.  The more popular green would have looked much more like an added, non-factory accessory.  It started working right out of the box; however, I did charge it further before installing.  It took about two hours.  Yes, the instructions are poorly translated  from the Chinese.  As with many other consumers, I wish that the Chinese manufacturers would simply find a native English speaker to write their instruction manuals.  Too proud, I suspect.  In any event, If you have trouble with the directions find a 14 year-old to do it for you.  I'm 72 and I managed.  I set it so that only the time shows.  I would have included the temperature, but it will only show that in Celsius.  I don't need the date and year, so I passed on that, too.  My car does have a factory clock, but it is small and poorly placed.  This does the job.  I'll post a follow up in a year or so if I have any further comments or problems.  If you don't see a follow-up then so far, so good.

source_doc: Bought ultra healing in lieu of regular version due to availability/pricing. Same overall quality of the ultra healing product vs the regular Curel moisturing lotion.  The former's viscosity is a little thicker, so as you apply/rub it on, there is a less fluid/liquidity feel to it as the regular Curel.  I would not characterize it as 'tackier' application feeling but definitely thicker and not as smooth/slippery.  If this bothers you, get the  regular blend Curel.  I don't have any comment (yet) if the ultra healing works any better/quicker than the regular moisturizing version as this is my first/earlier use.  I will say the regular version works fine, so I expect to have improved, quicker results from the ultra healing.  I love Curel as I have very low oil and very dry skin.  I apply the lotion in the morning and in the evening, and it resolved some significant skin cracks (actual severe that had some light bleeding) and fingertip ends very rough/dry/abrasive skin in about a week.  So now I use it regularly twice a day and have had no recurring dry, rough, or breaks in the skin.  I don't perceive either ultra or regular Curel as oily or leaving a long-standing film.  I just rub and spread it thoroughly over the skin and in a minute or two I don't even think about whether my skin is greasy, don't notice it.
instruction:
Translate the English text into Czech. Make the gender of the author inclusive by combining both masculine and feminine endings using slashes.
 
 Follow these formatting rules strictly:
 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings 
 1. for past tense verb participles, e.g., "koupil/a", "napsal/a"

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Koupil/a jsem verzi Ultra Healing namísto běžné verze kvůli dostupnosti/ceně. Celková kvalita produktu Ultra Healing je stejná jako u běžného hydratačního mléka Curel. Viskozita prvního jmenovaného je o něco hustší, takže při nanášení/roztírání působí méně tekutým/vodovým dojmem než běžný Curel. Neoznačil/a bych to za „lepivější“ pocit při aplikaci, ale rozhodně je hustší a ne tak hladký/kluzký. Pokud vám to vadí, pořiďte si běžnou směs Curel. Zatím nemám žádný komentář k tomu, zda Ultra Healing funguje lépe/rychleji než běžná hydratační verze, protože toto je moje první/počáteční použití. Musím říct, že běžná verze funguje dobře, takže od Ultra Healing očekávám lepší a rychlejší výsledky. Curel miluji, protože mám velmi málo mastnou a velmi suchou pokožku. Mléko nanáším ráno a večer a asi za týden to vyřešilo poměrně výrazné praskliny na kůži (skutečně vážné, které lehce krvácely) a velmi drsnou/suchou/popraskanou kůži na konečcích prstů. Takže ho teď používám pravidelně dvakrát denně a už se mi neobjevila žádná suchá, drsná nebo popraskaná kůže. Nevnímám ani verzi Ultra, ani běžný Curel jako mastný nebo zanechávající dlouhotrvající film. Jen ho důkladně rozetřu po pokožce a za minutu nebo dvě už vůbec nemyslím na to, zda mám mastnou pleť, ani si toho nevšimnu.

source_doc: I buy for convenience. I buy this strictly for the convenience factor. I do a lot of cooking from scratch and many recipes call for bell peppers. I have a smaller refrigerator and I’m tight on space. This can is huge, so I poured it into a 2.7 Quart Lock n Lock container. As you can see, there’s plenty of room leftover. I could probably fit it into an even smaller container. So while the can is huge, there is significantly less product than I expected. I realize it’s sold by weight, not volume.After the initial shock of a half empty can, I can say I am still happy with this purchase. I’ve always got peppers available now; no last minute shopping trips to the grocery store to finish making a meal. The smell is that of fresh peppers and the taste has been very good in every dish I’ve made with them. I’ve used in meatloaf, soup, poultry dishes, and even omelets. For omelets, I let them sit in the egg mixture for 5 minutes or so with an additional tablespoon of water before adding to a hot pan. Peppers are pretty expensive these days, so I think this is a good value and I’ll definitely buy them again, especially when they’re on sale.

hypo_0: Nakupuji kvůli pohodlí. Tento produkt kupuji čistě z praktického hlediska. Hodně vařím od základu ze surovin a mnoho receptů vyžaduje papriku. Mám menší lednici a bojuji s místem. Tato plechovka je obrovská, a tak jsem ji přelil/a do nádoby Lock n Lock o objemu 2,5 litru. Jak můžete vidět, zbylo tam spousta místa. Pravděpodobně by se to vešlo i do ještě menší nádoby. I wouldn't have even attempted it if I was just cleaning as I was that sure it would break. we just didn't need it so I didn't care if it broke.

But yeah, not too impressed with the hot glue.  I keep meaning to write to the seller about it.

source_doc: BEST PAIN RELIEF PRODUCT I’VE EVER TRIED!!! I have lived with multiple pain sites in my body for 60 years: Severe neck and lumbar pain as well as shoulder and leg pain. I have tried dozens of topical products including creams, lotions, sprays and CBD preparations. I have never found one that I was even marginally happy with. I will admit that I am quite often unhappy with these products because of their odor; I simply cannot stand anything that smells like BenGay or Mentholatum. These odors are so pervasive and make my pajamas, my sheets and my pillowcase reek—one use and the odors refuse to dissipate until I shower and wash all my bedding! The other thing is that I dislike anything that causes sensations to my skin—burning, cooling or otherwise.Now let me tell you about my experience with Theraworx: NO odor whatsoever; NO burning, cooling, prickling sensations; and NO sticky, unpleasant residue on my hands. I can use it at my bedside without having to get up and wash my hands before going to sleep. But, of course, that is not the best part. The best part is that IT ACTUALLY WORKS—every time, at least for me! I highly recommend that you give this product a try. I am so glad I did!

source_doc: Holy smokes! (Or holy flame?!) Geeze very few times have I actually bought something especially on Amazon and I’m blown away with the quality and price. (I’m not getting paid for this review but I should). This little thing packs a hell of a punch!!I have a Kamado joe grill and also a solo stove so I figured a propane torch would help speed things up. I tried the welding torch I have but it has a check valve and it’s a super small flame. I bought a cheap one off Amazon for 30 bucks and it failed on arrival. I waited a while and saw grillblazer. I really wanted that long one they got but no way I was shelling out 200 bucks and still need a kickstand for it to stand on its own.So glad I saw this and watch’s several YouTube reviews on it. Figured I’d give it a try and so glad I did. Now I can use my charcoal grilled just as fast if not faster than my propane grill on weekdays/nights :)

source_doc: Well ... if it's all you've got, it's better than nothing i guess. I really wish I'd taken photos of this after i used it the second time. I was hacking at a relatively small branch of a tree for my pet squirrel's habitat. It was the second time i used it and up until this use, i felt it was pretty sturdy and durable. I aimed and struck about 4 times and the ax head just broke right off the handle. I definitely wasn't expecting the head to just fall off. I'm hoping it was just an issue with this one ax and not the entirety of them. Like, maybe i just got a defective or a bad one ? Not going to pay more money to find out though. I hope you have a better experience with yours than i did mine if you do purchase one.

source_doc: Good keyboard for Mac. I have an apple wireless extended keyboard and I like the simplicity but was never happy typing on it for long periods of time. hypo_0: Dva kusy! Lze použít oba najednou, nebo jen bederní opěrku, případně jen podsedák. Před několika měsíci jsem v rámci služby podnikl/a 4587 mil dlouhou cestu autem. Ó, jak moc si přeji, abych to tehdy měl/a! Ten, který jsem měl/a předtím, se při každém nastupování a vystupování z auta posouval a klouzal a – ztratil své polstrování. Bolavý zadek! Naprosto se mi líbí, že si mohu vybrat, zda použiju pouze podsedák, pouze bederní opěrku, nebo obojí současně. Velmi pohodlné. VELMI pohodlné! Ve svém CRV sice mám bederní opěrku, ale tohle poskytuje ještě pevnější oporu. Mým největším problémem byl můj zadek po několika hodinách jízdy na dlouhé vzdálenosti. Tento podsedák je ÚŽASNÝ! Díky několika detailům neklouže sem a tam, když nastupujete a vystupujete z auta. Protiskluzové výstupky na spodní straně s materiálem, který neklouže. Také oddělený prostor pro každou nohu. Každý díl má elastický popruh, který lze připnout kolem sedadla. V den, kdy mi to přišlo, jsem absolvoval/a 3 hodiny dlouhou cestu (6 hodin tam i zpět). Žádná bolest. Žádná únava. Žádné klouzání a posouvání. S touto oporou se rozhodně cítím mnohem méně unavený/á. Tohle naprosto miluju!!! Potřeboval/a jsem to už před lety! Jsem rád/a, že to konečně teď mám. Vřele doporučuji.

source_doc: Great versatile lamp that gives off plenty of light. I mostly got this lamp because I wanted something we could use when the power goes out. We have high winds where I live and usually a few times a year they end up making the power lines where I live go down. Amazingly enough two days after this light arrived our power went out for about 3 hours. I was so happy I had charged this little lamp and had it to use. It gave off all the light we needed. I even put it at lower light to make it last longer since we had no idea how long the power would be out. The only thing the least bit negative is that it takes a long time for it to fully charge. I set it to charge as soon as I opened it and probably 4 hours later it was still glowing with the red light so I ended up leaving it on for the night. It was fully charged when I got up the next morning but I really don't know just how long it took. So far we have used it for maybe 5 hours all together and it's still going strong. I'm really happy with this light and I'm even thinking of getting another one to keep on hand for the next time we lose power. Definitely recommend this light.

source_doc: Good Soap; Very Fragrant. I got this dish soap specifically to take to the office. I work in a shared environment where dish soap is provided by the workers, not the organization, and I have seen a variety of soaps of varying quality run through. I have had good success with Amazon's store brands, so I had good expectations here. It's good soap that gets the job done. The most notable aspect of this soap is the fragrance.In use this soap works as well or better than the rest of the soaps I have seen in the kitchen. It clears grease and it gets dirty dishes clean, There's no mystery there. It rinses off well and I have not had problems with residue after using this soap.The fragrance is the most noticeable feature of this soap. It has a strong lemony smell to it that doesn't smell like fresh lemons, exactly, but it is much stronger than that of most soaps I have used. It's a pleasant fragrance and it actually makes the kitchen smell nice when I use it.This is fine dish soap that works well and smells nice. It's at least on par with name brand soaps I have used, and it is very fragrant. When it's gone, I will buy more.

source_doc: I love everything about this, except for the price. I'm 32, acne prone, with combination skin (oily tzone, but dry around my chin). I don't use social media at all, but I am in Korea and my family gifted me some of this. I've been here a month and just finished a stick of it (well there's a bit more, but it's at the bottom and I can no longer glide it over my face). I did not apply it sparingly, used it most days and most evenings as I had forgotten my normal moisturizer. I found that sometimes I'd feel a pimple coming on and I think it actually helped it heal much faster. I haven't noticed wrinkle reduction, but my skin feels healthier and brighter. I tried slugging over it with CeraVe healing ointment, but that's too heavy together, unnecessary. I really like the scent and the packaging, I think I will repurchase, but if you're looking for wrinkle reduction - microneedling and/or retinol products will be more affective. This would be a nice product to alternate when not using retinol.

source_doc: Like the semi transparent ones better ---- Fits Acura Sedan & similar model -- Read review. I ordered these sun shades during Amazon prime day, but since it is winter time I didn't use them. Well, I recently got some moles and freckles removed from my face, so I am in complete vampire mode. That means I apply globs of sunscreen on face and hiss at the sight of sunlight, that is ......... until my skin heals.Yesterday, I pulled out these shades, happy that there was a dark option to help me stay in vampire mode, but both of the dark shades would not stick to my window. Only the two transparent ones worked. The transparent one is ok, but not nearly enough shade for those who need to be out of the sun. The darker ones are much better.  In fact, I would rather have bought 4 semi transparent ones instead of 2 transparent and 2 semi transparent.I guess I received a defective batch, but I still give them 5 stars because I sent them a message explaining the above situation, and they promptly responded stating they stand by their products and will ship me 2 working ones. 5 stars for the amazing customer service. I wish all companies were like them. Anyway, don't be like me and use this a month later. Check to make sure all shades work right when you receive them.Hope my review helps!

source_doc: Fizzy bath tablets. I had previously tried a Monster Bubble product by the same brand, in spicy citrus, that I really love, so I was excited to try this assortment pack. What I realized is that the Monster Bubble is the same bath tablet, but in a larger size. And I realized that I actually prefer the larger tablet, as there is more scent and bath ingredients (I’m a huge believer in using Epsom salts and other minerals in the bath, and I love going to the hot springs for the same reason, so I’m a fan of products that add minerals to my bath). However, though I didn’t find the scents to be offensive, I didn’t love them as much as I loved the spicy citrus scent that I had originally tried. Overall I still enjoy using these bath tablets. I have come to really enjoy the pop of color in my bath, as well as the fragrance. The color doesn’t stain my tub but does kind of lift my spirits. I never realized that I would enjoy color in my bath, until I started using these tablets. I definitely prefer the larger sized Monster Bubbles, but overall still really enjoy the regular sized assorted tablets in this set.

source_doc: Nice half cup size for baby and toddler food. I got these to have a set of same-sized containers for when I make baby food, and I really like the 1/2 cup size.  Currently I’m putting the food in various containers I have, and I am wanting to be more orderly.  I like that the lids are sunken in the middle so one container can sit on top of another without sliding off.  Because these are plastic, they are lightweight if I need to take them on a day trip.  I like the various colored lids for sorting fruits, veggies, and meats. I have also found that the screw lids are leakproof, which is necessary for traveling.  I will say that they are indeed plastic, not brittle thin but not super thick either, so I do not expect them to last forever.  If they get too close to the dishwasher heat element I suspect they would melt. These state that they are microwave safe but I would not do it.  I would purchase glass ones if you need to microwave.

source_doc: Good seat for floor play. I bought this seat for my 5 month old to help her sit up even though I was hesitant. We are doing as much of the Montessori method as possible, so I do my best to minimize her time spent in ‘containers’. There are still times where I want/need her to sit by herself for independent play while I complete a task and this fits the bill.The seat is lightweight, which makes it easy to move from room to room or travel with. The tray is very easy to install. Right now I put her in it and place on or two of the toys in our current rotation for her to play with on it. She seems to focus on them more in this upright position than she does in tummy time. I only use the seat after she has had some tummy time and I don’t keep her in it for more than 15-20 minutes.For what it is, I think the price is high. I don’t really need it as a booster seat, as we have a tripp trapp high chair and a Montessori table we’ll use when she starts solids next month. I can see how it would be helpful to people who don’t have or don’t want to buy those things.

Přesto se objevují chvíle, kdy chci/potřebuji, aby seděla sama a samostatně si hrála, zatímco já dělám nějakou práci, a tohle přesně splňuje účel. source_doc: I love it. I did significant research before pulling the trigger on the Honbay modular sectional. I’m so glad I did. My family and I absolutely love it. As other reviews mentioned, 5 out of 7 boxes arrived earlier than expected. The 2 remaining boxes arrived the next day. Once I had an idea of what I was working with in my space, I ordered two additional ottoman pieces to create the sectional I had envisioned. I have a weird space in my living area so many traditional sectionals would be too large. It was super easy to assemble, I did it myself over the course of the two arrival days. I love the storage in each piece, which really helped to declutter my living area and eliminated the need for two storage baskets, freeing up floor space in the process. I love the firmness of the seats. I would agree with other reviews that the back cushions could be fluffier but I added a lot of my own pillows which solves that problem for me. My kids and my dog have bounced around on it and I haven’t noticed any instability. With the layout I chose, I love the little cutout which makes it easy for kids or dog to climb in. I’m so thrilled with my new sectional. If you are on the fence, do it!!

source_doc: Does this company even have quality control! I can't believe what I received. If I buy a new product, I expect it to come in good condition. This thing is full of nicks and the paint is chipping off already. This should have never been shipped. It's not like I just got one bad piece, I also ordered my daughter a toy organizer, same company l, and that also came all scuffed up. My daughter of course fell in love with it and she's a toddler, I know she's going to ding it up, so that's why I decided to keep it and it was cheap. It was also horrible to assemble, the pilot holes were drilled crooked inside the trunk and I struggled to get the spring piece attached. Ended up stripping one of the screws. I was going to order a chest and toy organizer for my son's room, from the same company, it was just outer space themed, but not after this.I will be telling all my mom friends and family members to not purchase this brand. It is adorable, my daughter loves the princesses, but it's not worth it and I wouldn't want to support a company that can to this to it's customers. So please learn from my mistake and don't buy anything Delta makes.

source_doc: Works for me and helps improve my sleep. I was a little unsure about this because I've tried a wide variety of supplements for sleep and not a lot has been effective.I bought these during a bout of stress induced insomnia causing me to wake up around 4-6 am, unable to fall back asleep. Or I would try to sleep early and would struggle for hours to fall asleep. I was exhausted and desperate.These tablets have seemingly helped to stabilize my sleep enough to where even if it's interrupted, I can get back to sleep quickly. I don't wake up feeling groggy like I do if I were to take something like zzzquil.I'm so happy to have these and will definitely always keep them stocked for those stretches of time where my sleep just won't cooperate.Edit: one caveat is these contain lactose. I do not recommend if you are severely intolerant. I have a sensitivity to lactose myself and sometimes I do get a little extra gassy/bloated from taking these, but not enough to where it disrupts my sleep. These are not effective for all situations but months later I still find them helpful most of the time.

source_doc: Haven't even had it 3 months... This mattress was great at first, but I got it for my son on November 14th for his Graco Solano crib. I loved that I didn't have to purchase a protective cover for it, as the material covering the foam allowed me to wipe it clean easily. But this is a terrible mattress for toddlers - for infants, it should be fine. My son is 16 months old and is walking around and loves to jump like a maniac in his crib. He grabs the side and goes to town like it's a trampoline. This mattress was not made with that thought in mind, as you can clearly see in the pictures that it busted open. I was getting my son ready for a bath and put him in the crib stark naked for only a moment, and he proceeded to immediately pee on the mattress. I figured, no big deal, I could just wipe it clean after his bath and change the sheets while he played in his playpen. When I removed the sheet, I saw the damage, and he happened to have peed over the hole and the urine had been absorbed by the foam. Now I have a peed on mattress whose inside I cannot clean, and I'm not about to let my son sleep on a mattress that is damaged and unsanitary. I will just have to purchase a different mattress that possibly requires a mattress protector.

source_doc: Works for Me But Hard to Inflate. I got this for my small older dog. He sleeps on the bed with me but sometimes he gets up and moves around on the bed and once he fell off the bed onto the hard floor. I got this bumper so that when he moves around, he won't fall off the bed. I found the directions to inflate it a bit difficult to follow since there is minimal directions. It took me a few tries to get it all set up correctly to inflate but once I did, it worked. It stays inflated on the bed. I like the little carry bag that is include in case I would need to take it with me but I don't know if I could get it all packed neatly back into the bag. I have not tried to deflate this once I got it inflated. The plastic flaps that are supposed to fit under the mattress were too short for my bed so I wasn't able to secure it that way. I put it under my fitted sheet and so far it has stayed in place. My dog walked over to the side of the bed where I have it installed and he was under the covers but once he go to the bumper, he turned around and walked away from that side so I hope this will work for him to keep him safe on the bed.

source_doc: A little smaller than expected. I wear a size XL glove and they fit perfectly so I went with the XL size slide but it's a little tight. The first time I put it on I actually had a moment where I thought I was in trouble and really had to yank to get it off my finger. I thought maybe I just put it on too deep but after looking at the video they have that's not the case, it's just a little too snug to wear like that.Otherwise I like the idea and if I had gone a size up I think I would really like it. I like the one I got enough and am able to use it and get a sense of the "ergonomic design" which is actually pretty nice. I was ripping No More Tears earlier and it sounded much better with a slide as intended rather than faking it.

source_doc: How the...I LOVE IT. I LOVE IT. Basically, I have 5 tanks and at first was using really amazing usb pumps. They work great but after getting my 3rd tank and then a hospital tank and plant tank... so yeah... Here I am.Pros:- Can be used on 4 tanks and you can control the air flow for each one without it making the strength more/less on a different tank.- Pretty Quiet! I have my tanks in my living room and I don't hear it. I can hear the clicking on my keyboard more than the pump.- Easy to set up, comes with some airline tubing, and I just cut a bit and worked like a charm. Can't speak for the quality or longevity, but free anything is a plus nowadays.-Easy to hide in with the rest of my fish messCons:- Can get hot (but not hot to where I'm concerned though we shall see how it holds up)*will update if I have other issues*Overall - At the $39 I love it. Wish it came in black so I could hide it better but honestly I don't care. If I get more tanks I'll probably end up buying another.

source_doc: I can finally play the high notes. I am an adult casual learner of recorder. I started playing on a $12 yamaha plastic recorder and upgraded to a $30ish dollar wood recorder because I couldn't manage to play high notes. I like the tone of the wooden recorder for the most part but I have the same trouble with notes higher than "G" and couldn't really hit high "B" or "C" at all. With this recorder I am able to hit all of those notes. It's still not super easy but I'm getting better all the time, much less squeaking - the dogs are very thankful. I have read that the arched airway gives more "control" over pitch. As a beginner I can tell that this will be difficult for me as I can vary the pitch a lot unintentionally, would probably make an experienced player cringe. I downloaded a tuning app so I can work on being consistent with my pitch.I also really love the feel of this recorder. It feels more lightweight, refined and well built. I also like the snap on thumb rest. I am pleased with this purchase.

 use the slash to separate the masculine and feminine endings

 Only output the translation, with no additional formatting or explanations.

Tón té dřevěné flétny se mi sice většinou líbí, ale měl/a jsem stejné potíže s tóny vyššími než „G“ a vysoké „H“ nebo „C“ jsem nedokázal/a zahrát vůbec. source_doc: I'm impressed ! Honestly I was a bit skeptical when I bought it but I am pleasantly surprised.  It feels very sturdy !  I like how you can rotate the brush head. It didn't help that it took 3 weeks to get here but that's not the seller's fault. source_doc: Works with all Dr. Brown Wide-Neck Nipples. I have a 4 month old baby who is quickly outgrowing small bottles. He is combo-fed. No problem there, as the level 2 wide-neck nipples I have fit perfectly. There is zero leakage and the transition is seamless. As a bonus, I will not need to buy the next size up nipples because I now have them. I ordered the vents for these bottles, as well, since my baby is very gassy and I feel he still needs them.Another reason I chose these bottles were the rubber handle on the side. My son is always trying to hold his bottle but is unable to grasp it. These handles are perfect. Right now he’s still learning, so I place his hands on the handles to show him how it works. I then hold the bottle from the end to give him support. source_doc: Great keyboard, but not for beginners. TL;DR: I REALLY like this keyboard, especially once you add different switches and keycaps, but it didn't work out because my accuracy sucks. Definitely not for beginners.Long review: I got the optical reds with this keyboard and it's definitely not for me since I'm a heavy typist. It's just too sensitive so I got the orange and bananas (yellow) optical switches to try them out. I do like the oranges but the ping on some of the switches is too dang loud and annoying so I settled with the bananas (yellow).Once I got them to my liking, it's time to test drive the keyboard. I'm not a typist per day but I can type. Not 100% accurate though, and that's where my problems arose. When I do make a mistake, I will almost 50% of the time would hit the "page up" instead of the backspace.. I do use "del" a lot as well and would hit the light switch instead.. If you're competent and have 99% accuracy when you type, it may work for you. Otherwise, get the K1 DE (what I did instead).

hypo_0: Skvělá klávesnice, ale ne pro začátečníky. TL;DR: Tuhle klávesnici mám OPRAVDU rád/a, zvláště když vyměníte spínače a klávesy, ale nefungovalo to, protože moje přesnost nestojí za nic. Rozhodně ne pro začátečníky. Dlouhá recenze: K téhle klávesnici jsem dostal/a optické červené spínače (optical reds), což rozhodně není nic pro mě, jelikož píšu s velkým přítlakem. Jsou až příliš citlivé, tak jsem si na vyzkoušení pořídil/a oranžové a banánové (žluté) optické spínače. Ty oranžové se mi docela líbí, ale kovový zvuk (ping) u některých spínačů je strašně hlasitý a otravný, takže jsem nakonec skončil/a u banánových (žlutých). Jakmile jsem si vše upravil/a podle svých představ, nastal čas klávesnici otestovat. Neživím se psaním, ale psát umím. Nicméně ne na 100 % přesně, a v tom byl právě kámen úrazu. Když už udělám chybu, téměř v 50 % případů zmáčknu místo Backspace klávesu Page Up. Také hodně používám klávesu Del a místo ní jsem mačkal/a tlačítko pro podsvícení. Pokud jste zruční a píšete s 99% přesností, možná vám bude vyhovovat. V opačném případě si pořiďte K1 DE (což jsem nakonec udělal/a já).

source_doc: Not fresh! Full Moon Chicken Jerky Healthy All Natural Dog Treats Human Grade Made in USA Grain Free is product reviewed.I am SO disappointed in my recent purchases of this product!!  I used to trust that I would get a fresh, softer jerky like texture of the chicken from this seller and over the last few purchases, I have been noticing a severe decline in product quality!  This current purchase has smaller pieces and they are HARD!  There is some whitening of the product as well which indicates that they are older.  When I break the strip in half, there is often sharp, hard edges which cannot be good for my dog's mouths!I took a long time to decide on a jerky treat for my dogs...I wanted quality and a supplier that I could trust.  These strips used to be fresh and pliable!  Used to be fragrant! I am now having to decide whether I will buy these anymore and have begun to look elsewhere!  I cannot recommend this product as the decline in quality and freshness is SO disappointing!  I don't know whether this is a seller issue or an Amazon issue but I am disgusted!  I likely will NOT be purchasing this product again!

source_doc: Love it. 40LB great beginner weight to lift heavy. I'm a pretty out-of-shape woman I wanted to start lifting heavy meaning going as heavy as I could reasonably handle as a beginner but also without hurting myself or just being psycally unable to lift it.  I chose this 40LB kettlebell.  I think it's perfect. I do my squats with two 15 LB barbells so I went back and forth between the 40, 50, and 95 LB weights.  After getting this one I think 40 is perfect.  50 is the max I realistically prob could have handled and anything over that would have been a mistake for me. I can lift it with one arm, over my head, and do all my squat sets comfortably I get winded at the end but it feels good. I bought it used at 43bucks which is a great deal.  I had to sand the handle a bit because of some sharp bits and it arrived busted out of the box since the box the shipper chose was way too big for this item and it knocked around during transit.  That said it did not sustain any damage in transit. It was bubble wrapped well.  It has a few miner scuffs and chipped paint but I don't care about any of that stuff just mentioning it for the people who are concerned.  I made an awesome choice.

source_doc: Very convenient way to work on my bike. This repair stand has made working on my bike much easier.  My back is not what it used to be, so I prefer to sit when working on my bike.  I used to flip my bike over and balance it on its handle bars and seat to perform maintenance and repairs.  Now I just clamp it in and go.  I can work on the derailleurs so much more effectively now that it can be upright instead of upside down.  I do not have an e-bike so I am not sure if it would handle that weight.  My bike is about 58lbs to give you and idea of what I have been using this stand for.  The tool tray has magnets that are great for holding the little nuts and bolts that have to be removed.  The tray is sturdy enough to hold my commonly used tools, but I would recommend not putting too much weight on that particular part.  The clamp has been kind to my bike's finish and has not scratched it at all.  I don't fold the stand up very often because I have enough space not to worry, but I do like having the option.  It folds up easily and is pretty compact.  I recommended this to anyone that prefers to do their own bike maintenance.

source_doc: Don’t waste your time or money. I have a 6 year old German Shepherd that was going on a 1k mile road trip with me. I wanted her to be more comfortable while strapped into a safety harness in the backseat of my GMC Terrain. I ended up purchasing this 1 piece grey inflatable seat extender in a bind because a different product I ordered had been delayed and wouldn’t arrive in time. I read the reviews and knew I was taking a chance.Product inflated easily using a shop vac. It fit very well and I was able to adjust seat position and seat back easily.The outside temp was around 28° F so I left it inside the house after checking the fit thinking I would pop it in place before hitting the road.In a 70° F room it completely deflated in under an hour. I checked the plug, reinflated it and again it was completely deflated in under an hour. I decided to give it one more chance; fully inflating it and checked it for leaks in the bathtub. I could not find a single location where air was escaping. No air bubbles at any seams or the plug.I ended up putting empty cardboard boxes in the floorboard instead of using this product.Don’t buy it. It’s not worth the high chance that it will be defective.

source_doc: easy on belly, works as topper to kibble and/or home cooked. I also use in treat toys. So far so good. I have been giving my 7 years old baby girl home cooked meals, but wanted to make sure she has a good base. Recently she hasn't wanted her usual kibble, and this coincides with a cancer diagnosis.To whet her appetite, I focused more on the foods she loves, and then began adding in more vegetables. I happened to have a bag of Purina Beyond Organic dry food that when I offered it to her she seemed to like it. So then I decided to use that as a base, add the home cooked foods, then top off with some wet food. I basically want to make sure I am not missing out on anything nutrient wise. She seems to like this wet food.It is chunks with gravy, not a pate. She is on prednisone which has increased her appetite. I give her food in between regular meals to keep her belly happy. I have put some of this into treat toys for her to work on. I haven't totally figured out the best diet for her, but so far the combo of food I have been giving her has been easy on her stomach, has been making good poops, and seems to enjoy it a lot. I have already ordered some other variations from Purina Beyond offerings.

source_doc: Wish the Structural Part was Better Designed. I so want to love this bag for cloth diapers. It does very well with keeping the smell contained, looks nice, and I love the zipper bottom and how it fits with a hanger. However, the plastic pieces that provide the structure push themselves through the fabric during the washing process. I have mended it multiple times and they keep finding ways to push through...and the main one is difficult to put back in. The last time it happened, I decided I was done fixing it and got a different bag. The fabric near the ends of these plastic pieces needs to be reinforced. My other issue is that after washing once I left it in the washer a little too long and after going through the dryer on highest heat there were little spots that I guess I assumed were mold spots. I immediately washed again and made sure to move to dryer right away and they seemed to be gone. But they have come back over and over. I'm not sure how to dry hanging and keep these spots from developing, and the dryer makes the plastic pieces push through the fabric worse. If this bag was redesigned with reinforcements, I would consider purchasing again because I do like it apart from the two issues I talked about.

source_doc: These look REAL ENOUGH and will fit Small to Medium spaces! These are quite lovely and come well packed Ed, tightly preventing any damage so yes, you have to fiddle with them to spread out the branches maybe for a minute for each pot but it’s literally no time at all. Yes they are white plastic pots! In my case? They are on windowsills where I will be opening the windows so, I bought a bag of River Stones at the dollar store and filled each pot so when the breeze from the open window hits them they won’t topple over. You could probably use any stones or even dirt but I liked the weight of the River stones. Not my first rodeo with these plants! I loved them so much I bought a set of six Cactus potted plants plants as well. They’ll get a nice review too. I have two left over from the 8 pack and they’ll go on a small night stand in my guest room. I’ve already had to warn the cleaning lady NOT TO WATER MY PLANTS! LOL also, the center pots in my pics are MINE…I just dropped a pot in each to see how it looked and decided I liked it. I will be buying more for an Idea that I have for an arrangement I want to do. I 100% do recommend buying these! Good Luck and TRUST ME on this.

 TEXT:
hypo_0: Tyto vypadají DOST REALISTICKY a hodí se do malých až středně velkých prostor! Jsou docela krásné a přicházejí skvěle zabalené, natěsno, což zabraňuje jakémukoli poškození, takže ano, musíte si s nimi trochu pohrát, abyste rozprostřeli větvičky, možná tak minutu u každého květináče, ale to nezabere doslova žádný čas. Ano, jsou to bílé plastové květináče! V mém případě? Mám je na parapetech, kde budu otevírat okna, takže jsem v levném obchodě koupil/a pytel říčních kamenů a každý květináč naplnil/a, aby se nepřevrátily, když do nich opře vánek z otevřeného okna. Pravděpodobně by se daly použít jakékoli kameny nebo dokonce hlína, ale mně se líbila váha těch říčních kamenů. Tohle není můj první pokus s těmito rostlinami! Tolik jsem si je zamiloval/a, že jsem si koupil/a také sadu šesti kaktusů v květináči. Ty dostanou také pěknou recenzi.
